# Levyra 3.0.2

## Highlights

There's a lot more to this update than the version number suggests. Lyrics have a new way to come alive, your listening history has a story of its own, and the downloads you keep for offline days are easier to check and repair.

We've also spent time on the quieter annoyances: a lyric line that feels a little late, a video that asks too much of a modest phone, an album that won't open in your region, or a Back gesture that takes you somewhere unexpected. Those things matter every time you listen.

## ✦ Lyrics that feel closer to the music

There's now an Apple Music-style lyrics experience with a dedicated full-screen layout, word-level karaoke where timing is available, and controls that stay out of the way when you don't need them. It's the default lyrics view in the Apple Music Style skin, but you can choose it in the other skins too. The choice is saved in Lyrics Studio, so you don't have to set it again.

You can adjust automatic scrolling, original lyrics and romanization from the lyrics options. A song uploaded under a channel name instead of its real artist also has a better chance of finding the right lyrics: Levyra can read titles written as either “Song - Artist” or “Artist - Song”, without confusing a remaster label for an artist.

The existing lyrics view hasn't been left behind. During playback, synchronized lines follow the player's live position more closely. The default skin, Nocturne 78, Prism and Torque now have a softer artwork-coloured backdrop. Text is kept readable, decorative movement respects your animation setting, and blur is reduced on devices where it would be expensive.

## ✦ Your year, in your own music

Levyra Rewind turns the listening history already on your device into a sequence you can browse. There's time listened, favourite artists, tracks and albums, listening rhythms, an activity timeline and a closing poster you can share.

release.name: v0.4.8
release.notes:
# v0.4.8 主要更新

新增：视频实时翻译，识别视频或游戏正在播放的对白，以双语对照悬浮字幕显示原文和译文，没有原字幕也能使用。支持本地模型或在线识别，需要 Android 10 及以上版本。

新增：手势模式，支持八种手势分别绑定功能，并可通过点击主球、侧滑唤起、左右旋转或前后倾斜触发。

新增：快捷面板，集中显示六种模式、语言方向和四个快捷操作，支持横竖屏布局。

新增：本地模型管理，支持下载模型、导入 GGUF、独立保存模型参数，以及使用相同原文试译比较。

新增：Index-Translate、Qwen3、LFM2.5、Gemma 和 TranslateGemma 等本地模型选择。

新增：Root 和无障碍截屏，支持自动选择可用方式，也可手动切换截屏方式。

新增：「B站翻译(免费)」，内置服务配置，选择后即可联网使用，感谢bilibili的免费翻译服务。

新增：「PP-OCRv5 东斯拉夫语」模型，支持俄语、白俄罗斯语、乌克兰语和英语识别。

新增：开发者选项支持隐藏 OCR 置信度不足或未识别到有效文字时的红色提示。

新增：[Issue #31](https://github.com/ciddwd/overlay-translator/issues/31) 提出的阿拉伯语界面翻译，感谢 [Maxaseel](https://github.com/Maxaseel) 提供翻译。

优化：日漫 OCR 加速，**已下载旧版日漫模型的用户，可点击「补充下载」，在保持识别精度的同时加快识别，无需删除重下。** 同时优化 PaddleOCR 识别，减少重复识别和图案误识别，改善漫画原文擦除、背景修复及译文排版，减少残字、越界和排版拥挤。

优化：主页布局，更方便地查看预设、当前状态、截屏服务和批量翻译任务。

优化：悬浮球设置分组，将贴边、菜单按钮、触发方式和手势绑定分别整理到独立页面，统一模式切换提示。

优化：设置选择控件，统一选中块样式，增加滑动切换效果，并调整高度、边距与交互反馈。

优化：自动识别设置，使用语言卡片管理识别方式、模型选择和下载状态。

优化：初始化引导选择日文、韩文、俄语、白俄罗斯语、乌克兰语、中文或英文时会匹配对应 OCR；其它源语言默认推荐 PaddleOCR v5 mobile。

优化：相册图片导入与系统分享流程，改善批量翻译任务的创建和处理体验。

优化：模型下载进度、速度显示、失败恢复和就绪检查，整理语音模型下载状态展示；完善本地翻译模型的加载方式、旧配置迁移与资源释放。

优化：设置保存、预设管理、首页提示与词典交互，改善识别、屏幕旋转和循环翻译时的显示，减少配置丢失及使用过程中的崩溃。

* Recover after video decoder error thanks to @sizhky
* Fixes to music permissions, mute and other audio related issues
* Various fixes to Immich and NextCloud support
* Fixes issue with music file permission not being requested
* Fixes to time and date formatting from EXIF data
* Fixed an issue with music tracks being filtered out of the playlist by mistake
* Added resume behaviour options for Playlist Cache
* Added option to control audio track removal when muted, can cause issues on some devices

This version is likely to appear on the Google Play and Amazon Appstore in a week or so.

release.name: MCTier v3.10.0
release.notes:
- 双端正式区分“创建大厅”和“加入大厅”：创建时检查名称是否已被占用；加入时先检查大厅是否存在，再校验密码，避免通过加入操作意外创建大厅。
- 修复创建同名大厅时错误提示“密码错误”的问题，现在明确提示大厅名称已被占用，请更换名称后重试。
- 修复桌面端尚未通过服务器校验就提前进入大厅页面的问题，完成注册和本地会话初始化后才进入大厅。
- 修复手机端创建或加入大厅失败后没有明显提示的问题，操作按钮下方现在会展示完整失败原因，并支持自动换行。
- 优化桌面端创建、加入大厅的错误提示样式，采用更紧凑的小图标、细边框和淡红背景，去除重复标题，适配亮色与暗色主题。
- 完善连接失败后的资源清理、重试和强制停止处理，连接过程中按 Esc 不再提前关闭桌面端表单。
- 完善自动进入大厅、断线重连、大厅重载及虚拟 IP 冲突恢复时的模式处理，避免恢复连接时被误判为重复创建大厅。
- 双端大厅动态设置新增文件共享下载目录设置，无需退出大厅即可选择下载位置或恢复默认目录。
- 大厅内与软件设置中的下载目录共用持久化配置，修改后保持同步，重启软件后仍保留设置。
- 手机端文件共享新增“全选／取消全选”功能，可批量选择当前目录中的文件，配合下载选中功能使用，不递归勾选子目录。
- 修复手机端保存大厅网络配置时，旧表单数据可能覆盖刚修改的下载目录、音色和弹幕等设置的问题。
- 桌面端我方文字、语音及文件消息气泡统一调整为 `#45bd00` 绿色，气泡尾角同步修改，亮色与暗色主题均生效。
- 信令服务器新增创建、加入模式校验，并对同名大厅的并发创建进行原子检查，避免多个用户同时成功创建同名大厅。
- 新版信令服务器继续兼容未携带新模式字段的旧客户端，最低客户端版本要求保持为 3.8.0。
- 新客户端连接尚未升级的私有信令服务器时，会明确提示联系管理员升级服务端。
- 补充大厅准入、连接生命周期、下载目录设置和手机端全选等回归测试及验证文档。
- MCTier正式支持MacOS版本

release.name: v0.40.0
release.notes:
### GeckoView 158.0.2

This release brings together ten alpha updates since v0.30.0. WebLibre adapts better to larger screens, adds customizable keyboard shortcuts and more flexible gestures, introduces five interface translations, and gives you more control over downloads, profile locks, and automatic browsing-data deletion. It also improves tab recovery, connection reliability, and everyday browsing.

## Highlights

- **Adaptive Layout** — resizable side tab panels for tablets, foldables, and larger Android windows
- **Customizable Controls** — keyboard shortcuts, tab swipes, toolbar long-press actions, and searchable action pickers
- **Tab Groups & Recovery** — a new grouped quick switcher and a Recently Closed Tabs list
- **Five New Languages** — German, Spanish, Indonesian, Russian, and Simplified Chinese
- **Better Downloads** — choose a folder, follow progress, pause, resume, and retry
- **Profile Passwords** — separate passwords for individual profiles, including protection for installed website apps
- **Automatic Data Cleanup** — choose what to delete on Quit and startup, with recovery after interrupted cleanup
- **More Reliable Connections** — clearer proxy health, safer imports, and better WireGuard support
- **Engine Upgrade** — GeckoView 158.0.2 and Tor 0.4.9.14

## Adaptive Layout

- **Automatic tab-bar positioning** keeps tabs at the bottom on phones and can move them into a side panel on larger screens. Choose a fixed position in Toolbar & Layout settings if you prefer.
- **Resizable side panels** can show readable tab titles and browser controls, collapse into a compact icon rail, or hide automatically while using a mouse or trackpad.
- Tab groups can be expanded or collapsed without switching the current tab, and several groups can stay open at once on wide screens.
- Tab grids adapt to the available space. Dialogs, menus, and settings pages fit larger windows more comfortably, and foldables place panels on the more useful side

release.name: Convx v1.5.2
release.notes:
## Convx 1.5.2

Bug-fix release. 40+ fixes across login, playback, downloads, local-only mode, the player, and theming.

### Login & accounts
- Fixed the HTTP 500 on login and every authenticated request — the session id was being sent in a form the API rejects.
- Login validation now actually retries on failure instead of silently getting stuck.
- Saved-account switcher no longer stays empty for existing sessions.
- Channel switching no longer silently reverts to your primary channel.

### Playback
- Fixed a bug where songs would fail to play — a missing field in the stream response was discarding an otherwise-working stream instead of using a sane default.
- One playback error could previously cancel unrelated in-flight operations app-wide; fixed.
- Fixed a crash on some devices (Android 16 / One UI) where the player's foreground notification could be refused by the OS and kill the service.
- Crossfade timing now stays correct when playback speed is changed.

### Downloads
- Fixed downloaded stream links expiring incorrectly, causing repeated failures.
- Auto-download-on-like now works from every screen (song menu, queue, swipe-like), not just the player's like button.

### Local-only mode
- Excluding a folder now actually keeps it excluded on refresh.
- Excluded-folders screen rebuilt: permission prompt, scan button, per-folder song counts, and a folder picker for folders MediaStore hasn't indexed yet.
- Local library screen gained a fast-scroll bar and auto-refreshes when opened.

### Player & UI
- Fixed the player's "more" button and queue button not responding reliably.
- Custom player icon settings now apply everywhere they should.
- Your chosen text color now applies consistently across Home, Library, Search, Settings, and the player — instead of some screens staying on the old accent color.
- Fixed hero backgrounds (artist/playlist pages) sometimes rendering solid black instead of a color.
- Artist name now wraps to two lines and displays with correct capit

release.notes:
# Streak 2.5.0 🚀

A big one for Focus and widgets. Focus can now run rounds on its own and tells
you how much time you planned against what you really did, there are new
widgets to start a session or see your focus time, steps can come from Health
Connect, and changing a daily goal no longer rewrites your past days.

## ✅ Habits

- **Changing the daily goal keeps your history** (#406): past days are checked
  against the goal they had at the time, so your streak and stats stay as they
  were.
- **Track rereads of a book**: set the pages of the book in a reading habit.
  When you reach the last page it adds a read and starts again, and Statistics
  shows every read with the day you started and finished.
- **Steps from Health Connect** (#339) on Android 14 and newer, plus new art
  for amount habits.
- **Minute habits have their own Focus section** (#391), and you can start a
  session right from the time keypad.
- **The form shows which field is missing** when you try to save (#381).

## 🚭 Avoid habits

- **Money spent on each relapse** (#378), with the total for the month.
- **A clean days goal and a total goal** (#352).
- **Relapses by month** (#402): a chart with your monthly average and one bar
  per month. Tap a bar to see that month.

release.name: v1.2.0-RC.1
release.notes:
# YumaPlayer v1.2.0-RC.1

A massive milestone update representing over a month of intensive development and a complete architectural overhaul. This release introduces a dedicated low-level audio DSP engine, the YDS 2.1 design system with a draggable Telegram-spec navigation island, native Spotify browsing, Canvas loops, robust proxy networking, and deep performance optimizations.

---

### ✨ Major Highlights

#### 🎛️ Audio Engine & Smart Automix (`:core:audio-dsp`)
* **Dual-Deck Continuous Crossfade:** True gapless playback using two independent, synchronized audio deck controllers with atomic role swapping. Zero silence between tracks.
* **DJ Transition Intelligence:** Automated outro/intro cue detection, energy cliff analysis, BPM matching, and complementary bass-swap filters (0.45–0.55 window).
* **Audiophile Codec Pipeline:** Dedicated 24-bit packed PCM processing, Kopus-first Opus decoding with MediaCodec fallback, and native FLAC length resolution.
* **Stall Guard & Recovery:** Intelligent fallback to hard cuts during network drops, background stream revival upon reconnection, and strict source-scoped cache identities.
* **N+1 Prefetching:** Seamless background caching of upcoming tracks into the local download cache.

#### 🏝️ YDS 2.1 & Gesture Physics
* **Draggable Navigation Island:** Compact, draggable floating dock inspired by Telegram specifications, featuring dynamic corner morphing, scroll-hide sync, and local haptic feedback.
* **Unified Player Sheet V2:** Re-engineered gesture physics with GPU-accelerated backdrop blur (`Haze`), isolated drag layers, and independent artwork scaling.
* **Canvas Backdrop Engine:** Hardware-accelerated background video loops supporting up to 4K resolution, backed by an isolated cache to prevent ghosting during track changes.
* **Spoiler Veil:** Interactive Telegram-grade particle engine to obscure tokens and sensitive settings.
* **Particle Splash Screen:** Customizable startup burst physics with shap

**Bloom** rebuilds the look and feel of Vyxel Apps around Material 3 Expressive: new controls, new icons, a new font, a fresh Explore page and motion that connects every screen.

---

## ✨ What's New

### 🎨 Material 3 Expressive redesign
- **Redesigned Settings** — Grouped rows, connected buttons, Stride-style sliders and switches that keep each setting's own icon.
- **Material Symbols** — A full new icon set across the app.
- **Google Sans Flex** — The new default font, with a cleaner font picker.
- **Polished dialogs and buttons** — Expressive shapes, press feedback and haptics.

### 🧭 A new Explore
- **Daily hero photos** — Featured apps sit on a fresh wallpaper photo every day; pull to refresh for a new one.
- **Bento grid** — Apps laid out as a bento grid, with category bubbles, Top charts and New arrivals.
- **Better results** — Libraries, templates and sample repos no longer show up as apps.

### 🌊 Motion
- **Shared icon transition** — Tap an app and its icon flies into the app page; go back and it returns to its place, following the predictive back gesture.
- **The original splash is back.**

### 🏠 Home & Library
- **By the developer of Vyxel Apps** — Stride, Auralis and Relay as tiles with Google Play links.
- **Pull to refresh reshuffles** the Home and Explore lists.
- **Library** — New storage and stats overview, and your profile photo in the header.
- **Telegram** — Quick link to the announcements channel on Home, and community links in Settings.

### 💬 Help & support
- **AI support assistant** — Ask questions about Vyxel Apps right from Help & support.

---

## ⚡ Performance Improvements

- 🚀 **Faster startup** — Cold start cut from about 2.5 s to about 1 s.
- 🎬 **Smoother app pages** — Lighter page transitions and instant cached icons.
- 🖼️ **Lighter Explore** — Removed the costly blurred artwork from the carousel.

### Enforce must-use return value (#152).
If you enable compiler flag  `-Xreturn-value-checker=check`, the IDE will warn you when you create a store/subscription/plugin and not use it.

- add lambda intent emit { } lambda overload
- improve return type in store.test { } with `SubscriptionAware` to test subscriptions. You can now access `subscriberCount` in tests.
- Batch intent decorator now exposes `onUnhandledIntent`. This is used when the intent is batched, but then was unhandled. This is likely a temporary solution to "catch" those intents, as due to intents being deferred, we can' use our regular `onUndeliveredIntent` functions.

This update includes many important fixes for decorators and child stores.

- Each time you open Manage, the app checks the Home button again and tells you if the TV's setup wizard could take it.
- Right after the switch, if the TV brings up Live TV in front of the new home screen, the app presses Home again for you.

## Fixes

repo.description: dsh 安卓壳 APK——WebView UI + 内嵌 Termux 运行时快照（解压即跑），为dsh本地运行设计的高性能方案

release.name: dsh-mobile v0.14.10
release.notes:
# dsh-mobile-apk 0.14.10

> 版本：versionCode 54 / versionName 0.14.10（覆盖安装 0.14.9 的 versionCode 53）。
> 本文件面向用户：先写本版解决的问题，再写安装与升级、已知限制。
> 本版内容严格对应提交范围 `v0.14.9..33f1fd0b`（共 322 个提交）。33f1fd0b 之后合入主干的改动不在本版范围内，进 0.14.11。
> 双 ABI 产物的体积与 SHA-256 见本文件「产物」一节，或本 Release 的 MANIFEST.txt。

## 新增功能

### 1. 内置控制台成为真正的终端，全屏程序可以用（#549、#554、#580）

管理中心里的控制台此前只能敲命令：没有 PTY，按键送不进去，没有作业控制，程序按 0x0 排版。在它里面跑 `termux-change-repo` 会直接报 "TERM environment variable not set."，跑 `vim`、`top` 则画不出内容。

本版补上三处缺件：PTY（由引擎自带的 node-pty 提供，不新增依赖、不新增构建面）、终端环境变量与 terminfo 可达性、以及页面侧的按键编码。控制台现在带 Tab、Ctrl-C、Ctrl-D、方向键的按键条，`top`、`vim`、`termux-change-repo` 这类全屏程序可以正常使用，键盘弹出时按真实行数重新排版。

同一批审计修掉八处控制台缺陷（#580）：关闭会话时终止协议根本没发出去，全屏程序的后代进程只能等强杀回收；反斜杠被二次转义导致一条命令被拆成两条执行；程序就绪前的首条命令被静默丢弃；降级模式下窗口尺寸变化被当成命令注入；启动失败的会话仍显示「可用」；降级模式写满 64KB 后永久卡死；大文件输出按小片段逐帧跨进程推送导致主线程 ANR；以及整屏双倍行距。

### 2. 管理中心一键换源（#551、#555、#575）

移动端改软件源此前要么敲 `sed`、要么跑 `termux-change-repo`（而后者在旧控制台里必然失败）。管理中心新增「软件源」一行，显示当前源，点一下循环切换，覆盖六个常用国内镜像。

写入是双份的：`sources.list` 与 `chosen_mirrors` 链接同时更新，否则下一次 `pkg update` 会按「链接不存在」随机重选源、把用户的选择覆盖掉。切换前先备份、切换后验证；验证不只看退出码——不可达的源同样返回 0，但索引是空的——所以失败会真的回滚，且回滚一并还原链接。快照刷新会整树替换运行时目录，刷新前后自动捕获与重放用户的选择。

### 3. 会话行菜单可以删除对话（#493、#496）

引擎此前只有归档、没有删除会话的接口。本版新增内置插件：会话行的「…」菜单里多一条「删除对话」，确认后删除磁盘上的会话目录，并刷新列表、索引与搜索。

删除只处理「正在运行」的会话：引擎会把打开过的会话都留在内存里，按「加载过」拒绝等于删不掉任何东西。反过来，活动探测失败、返回非数组、拿不到活动瀑布这三种「不知道」的状态一律按未知处理并拒绝删除，绝不把「不知道」当「空闲」。删除前先把会话从内存列表卸载并落盘，再删目录，避免删完还留在搜索结果里。目录先改名成 `.deleting-<时间戳>` 再递归删除，并发扫描看不到半删目录；进程死在两步之间留下的残留，下次启动时清扫。

### 4. 插件市场做成整页（#505、#517、#541、#556）

市场入口收到插件页的「添加插件」下拉里，点进去是整页而不是弹窗，旧的页签入口已隐藏。此前打开要等六次 120ms 的导航探测，搜索框只有 32px 高，返回是个 32px 的小箭头。

现在直接打开、零等待；搜索框 44px；页头固定并带「返回」，让开系统状态栏与安全区，内容区自己滚动，滚动时页头不跟着走。列表每页 96 条，上下各一条分页条，支持首末页、当前页前后各一页与页码跳转，双击省略号翻页。

按仓库折叠是一行一个仓库（仓库名、作者、star 数），展开后列出该仓库的子包，安装按钮只出现在具体子包上。勾选「仅移动端可用」后按真集合分页：过滤条件不再写进搜索词，页码按实际条数算（此前仍按四千多条算出 48 页），列表为空时提示「其余插件的安卓兼容性还没验证过」。

### 5. 应用内更新拆成「检查」与「下载」两步（#485）

设置页新增一级分区「应用更新」（原生管理中心同一形态），检查与下载是两枚独立按钮，版本号独立成文本行。

修掉的三个缺陷：更新按钮点了没有任何反馈、再点一次会静默下载上百 MB（观察者注册被后来者顶掉，回调打不到渲染）；壳侧的 sha

The Poképark has been rebuilt from scratch. New map, new life, new everything.

## A whole new park

- One big map drawn by spritedmistery, from the home park to the volcano, the snowy summit and the coast
- Up to 24 of your Pokémon, with animated sprites for nearly every species, shinies and forms included
- Day and night, rain and storms, and wild Pokémon wandering in

## Pokémon that feel alive

Every Pokémon has its own temper, habits and favorite spots. They make friends and rivals, fall in love, pick fights, play pranks and stand up for each other. Some species have their own famous moments, and some show off their powers. Watch for a while and you'll see.

## Events

Now and then something rare happens, and the park lets you know. Some events are secret.

## Things to do

- Feed, pat and play with your Pokémon, and see who they get along with
- Take photos and share them from the album
- Daily goals, a daycare, and a few ways to lend a hand
- Short captions tell you what a Pokémon is up to
- On the AYN Thor, the sticks move and zoom the camera

## Music

Pick different music for the menus, the park by day and the park by night.

A huge thank you to **spritedmistery**, who drew the whole new Poképark map, the statue and the park's look. Go give them some love on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/spritedmistery/

# Moonfin 2.7.0 Release Notes [![github](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/Moonfin-Client/Moonfin-Core/2.7.0/total?logo=github&label=Downloads)](https://github.com/Moonfin-Client/Moonfin-Core/releases/tag/2.7.0)

Moonfin 2.7.0 lands less than two weeks after 2.6.0 with around two hundred and forty commits. If your server runs the Achievement Badges plugin you can now add friends and chat with them, phones get a redesigned bottom bar in three styles, and a seasonal Home row brings out the holiday movies at the right time of year next to a rebuilt set of seasonal effects. The in-app remote gained a D-pad and can type a search onto your TV from your phone, Live TV recovers from a stalled channel on its own, and you can now set your library order and hide detail screen sections. On the fix side, Moonfin finally honors the self-signed certificate setting on every server connection, DTS and TrueHD passthrough got another round of work, Android Auto actually plays on Media3, and Windows and Linux go back to the Skia renderer to end the laggy scrolling some of you saw in 2.6.0.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Moonfin now checks your server's certificate on every connection. If your server uses a self-signed or private CA certificate, sign-in will say it isn't trusted and offer to allow it, or you can turn on **Settings > Account & Security > Allow self-signed certificates** before you update.

> [!NOTE]
> Don't forget to update to Plugin v2.4.0 [here](https://github.com/Moonfin-Client/Plugin/releases/tag/2.4.0). The seasonal row needs it, and it syncs the new bottom bar, Friends button, detail sections and seasonal density settings.

# fqapp 1.0.121

版本：1.0.121（126），仅支持 Android arm64。源码提交：11d762a。
APK SHA-256：`2db1a41f8696f7a8ccbdff1ad5857cc8c3e528b9841e36d1be0eb3fa62be552b`

自上个正式版 v1.0.96 以来的汇总（含 v1.0.105 / v1.0.106 预发布内容）。

## 致谢

感谢 @liuqianhe 贡献本项目的第一个外部 PR（[#55](https://github.com/ch6vip/fqapp/pull/55)）：墨水屏阅读优化（正文纯黑、海信 EPD 整屏刷新、滑动直翻、单手模式）与音量键翻页修复。

## 阅读

- 连续阅读：分页与滚动模式到章末自动进下一章（分页模式可在排版面板开关）。
- 点击书籍直接进入阅读：设置 → 阅读可开启，点书直接进上次位置。
- 阅读背景延伸到刘海 / 挖孔区域；翻页动画跨章节；阅读时隐藏系统栏。
- 滚动模式滑到章节顶部继续下拉，回到上一章末尾。
- 墨水屏模式：正文强制纯黑；海信设备每翻 N 页整屏刷新压残影（默认 10 页，排版面板可调，0=关闭）；新增滑动直翻（无过渡动画）、单手模式（点左三分之一也翻下一页）。
- 音量键翻页：后台 ↔ 前台切换后不再失效（改走原生拦截）。
- 阅读信息展示、相关系列导航、目录对比优化。

## 听书与音频

- 持续听书：听书会话独立于页面，底部可恢复 / 暂停 / 关闭；边读边听支持跟章。
- 系统 TTS：小说与本地书可用系统朗读；本地书听书跟随。
- 音频迷你条、听书跨页面状态修复。

## 播放

- 清晰度切换拉伸修复；解码器初始化失败回退；MT6895 / 天玑 8100 兼容渲染路径。
- 软件解码绿条修复（软解切 SurfaceTexture）。
- 短剧切画质转横屏不再往上全屏拉伸。
- 横屏双击：中间暂停 / 播放，左右 ±10 秒。
- 短剧里点进阅读 / 听书，视频暂停；返回后同一集继续播。
- 弹幕设置入口（短剧 feed 更多面板）；浅色面板弹幕开关即时刷新。

## 书架、导入与备份

- 本地 TXT / EPUB 导入；修复仅标题章节导致正文空白（需先删除旧书再重新导入）。
- 收藏与进度文件备份；备份 / 恢复导出为 JSON（不含本地文件本身与缓存、统计、高亮、偏好）。
- 日志查看器重做，App 与核心日志可合并导出。

## 搜索与排行

- 搜索按分类、评分筛选，无封面列表视图；评分筛选只作用于已加载结果。
- 排行页新增短剧榜 / 漫剧榜；短剧榜上不出现小说分类 chips。

## 去品牌化

- 桌面名 `fqapp`、新图标；界面里「原创」「听书」「书友」，不再出现「番茄原创 / 番茄听书 / 番茄书友」。

## 安全与工程（简述）

- 第二轮代码审查修复合入：加密存储、密钥处理、输入校验等；CI 全绿。
- 本版未包含：#24 浮窗后台播放（仍需真机验证，后续版本）。

## 验证状态

- master CI：flutter analyze 无问题；Flutter 测试 1843 通过、1 跳过、0 失败；Rust 测试 176 通过、0 失败。

release.notes:
## 🎉 MagicWX v1.2.0 — LocalDream NPU 端侧生图

### 新特性
- **NPU 端侧生图**（骁龙 8 Gen 2+）：绕过 QNN SDK 编译限制，改用 local-dream 预编译 `libstable_diffusion_core.so`（含 QNN 管线，MNN 静态链接）+ QNN 运行时 .so（20 个），端侧 NPU 出图 **2.5 秒/张**（SD1.5 512×512）
- CPU 生图路径保留（MagicWX 自编译 MNN 管线，Exynos/天玑等非骁龙设备可用）

### 验证
- vivo V2505A（SM8850 8 Gen 2）：AbsoluteReality NPU SD1.5 txt2img 2.5s 出图，非黑有内容
- `libQnnHtpV81Skel.so` + CDSP fastrpc domain 3 加载成功

### 安装
- arm64-v8a only（骁龙平台享 NPU，其他平台走 CPU）
- 如已装旧版且签名不一致，需先卸载再装

### 已知限制
- SDXL/Anima NPU 需下载对应 8gen2 QNN 模型包
- img2img/inpaint/ultrafix NPU 链路待补
- Samsung CPU 路径 xtensor bad_alloc 回归未验证（待连机）

### 技术细节
B 方案：local-dream 是 HTTP 进程隔离架构（非 JNI），与 MagicWX 同构，只需换可执行文件，HTTP 架构 0 推翻、协议 100% 对齐。详见 commit 337d08d。

# DiPlay v0.3.6 — 忽略Surface重建期间过渡缩小、跳过无线会话MainAudio索回避免黑屏断连

## 更新

- **忽略 Surface 重新挂载稳定窗口内的过渡尺寸缩小**（Issue #290）：
  - 修复倒车退出高度增长后重建 Surface 期间，视图经过中间过渡缩小尺寸导致 `setFixedSize` 重新将 Surface 缩小并在 3 秒稳定窗口内持续维持小尺寸、无法收敛恢复全屏的问题；
  - 过滤该窗口内的过渡缩小，保持已恢复的目标尺寸。
- **跳过无线 CarPlay 会话的 MainAudio Untake 索回请求**（Issue #293）：
  - 修复无线连接下触发 `takeMainAudio()` 时向 iPhone 发送 Untake 请求导致 iPhone 瞬间关闭视频画面流并断开会话的严重缺陷（实测发送后约 4ms 手机关闭流）；
  - 无线模式下保持协商好的 MainAudio 所有权，仅在有线模式切回原生媒体时保留 Untake 机制。

## 验证

- 版本 `0.3.6` / `versionCode 126`，包名 `com.shihab.diplay`，最低 Android 4.2（API 17）。
- 完整单元测试全部通过，发布包内嵌源码 commit 严格核验通过。

repo.description: App which allows you to use your health devices beyond subscriptions. Supports Workout Tracking, Nutrition Tracking, Wellness Excercise, Sleep, Recovery, Strain, and Many more.

release.name: v0.11.3
release.notes:
## What's new in the app

### New look
- Four tabs: Today, Sleep, Activity, Health.
- One name per score, and every trend tells you how today compares with your usual range.
- Heart-rate zones are labelled rows with their bpm ranges.
- Profile opens from your avatar on every tab. Detailed charts moved to an Advanced screen.

### Report an issue
- Settings > Report an issue: pick what went wrong, describe it, add a screenshot if you like.
- "Create ticket" packs app info, sync state and recent logs, encrypts them on your phone so only the maintainers can read them, and gives you a ticket ID (OS-XXXXXX) to quote on Discord or GitHub.
- Your health database is included only if you switch it on. "Share locally" builds the same file and lets you share it yourself; nothing is uploaded.
- You can delete a ticket any time from My reports. Reports are deleted automatically after 30 days (14 if they include your database).

### Scores
- Recovery is calibrated to your own normal range and combines HRV with resting heart rate.
- Every screen shows the same recovery number, and it's only locked in after a full night.
- When recovery isn't scored, the app tells you why.
- Nightly HRV is more accurate, and the HRV sent to Apple Health now matches what Apple Watch reports.
- Strain is measured against your own resting level.
- A day's strain is never lower than a workout on that day, and days with no detected sleep still get a strain.
- Naps and broken sleeps under 3 hours no longer push resting heart rate up.
- WHOOP 5: nightly skin temperature compared with your usual, in °C.

### Your data, more of it
- History from older WHOOP 4 firmware that was stored but never read now gets decoded, so some people get missing days back.
- New users see "Recovery starts in N nights" while their baseline builds, with resting HR, steps and sleep from night one.

### New
- Nutrition: search past foods, meal times, edit entries, today's protein.
- Heart rate: zoomable day chart and minute-by-minu

REX Player v5.3.0 is here! 🎉
This release introduces the "You" tab to consolidate personal media, redesigned player control capsules, and automatic subtitle character encoding detection.

### 🔥 The new "You" tab
Consolidates personal media into a single tab to reduce bottom navigation clutter:
* **Recents & Playlists:** Features a horizontal shelf for Recently Played media alongside your playlists, letting you navigate both from one screen.
* **Quick-Access Chips:** If you disable the Shorts or Network tabs in settings, quick-access chips appear at the top of the You tab so you can still reach them.
* **Profile Header:** Adds a profile avatar and display name with a hidden customization easter egg for curious users to discover.

### ✨ New Features
* **Grouped Player Controls:** Replaces individual circular buttons with grouped control capsules that show active toggle states (e.g. repeat, shuffle), paired with matching pill-shaped volume, brightness, speed, and chapter indicators.
* **Subtitle Encoding Detection:** Automatically detects subtitle character encodings (with manual override support) and reloads subtitles immediately without restarting playback (#344, #394).
* **Dynamic Auto-Playlists:** Automatically generates "Recently Added" and "Most Played" playlists with contextual sorting and deletion options.

**Also new:**
* **Ytdlp Stream Quality Selection:** Select video resolution (up to 4K, 1080p, 720p, or audio-only) directly in the player for streams resolved via the REX Ytdlp companion add-on (requires updating the companion app).
* **Navigation Tab Reordering:** Reorder bottom navigation tabs in Appearance settings.
* **Custom Playback Speed Presets:** Customize the speed steps cycled when tapping the playback speed button (#331).

## Security release

Release `v4.12.0` ships the coordinated security hardening work after `v4.11.1`.

**Please update as soon as possible.** Critical security issues found in earlier versions are fixed in this release. Make sure you are running the latest ADAMANT Messenger build.

### Key changes

- Close confirmed stored XSS paths, remove all `v-html` usage, harden markdown rendering through `SafeHtml`, and verify node-supplied public keys against addresses
- Upgrade local secret storage and password KDF (versioned scrypt), migrate cryptographic helpers to `@noble` / `@scure`, and enforce strict CSP across PWA, Tor, testnet, Android, and Electron artifacts
- Harden Android backup / data-extraction boundaries and FileProvider paths, keep AIP-6 signal messages out of visible chat history, and normalize binary / hex crypto input boundaries
- Fix coin-service sync thresholds so lagging indexers are not treated as available, and correct node minimum-version checks to use semver instead of lexicographic string comparison

3. Vulnerable host validation when processing deeplink `oversecured://ovaa/webview?url=...`.

release.notes:
First stable v2.0 release, out of pre-release after five iterations (v2.0-pre-1 through v2.0-pre-5).

### What's in v2.0
- **Raw TCP tunnel**: Apps Script to VPS tunnel for Android, no CA install required for normal VPN use.
- **Android**: config export/import via clipboard (compact JSON, shared with desktop), split tunnel with a preloaded app picker.
- **VPS exit installer**: one-command install/update via `scripts/install-vps-relay.sh`, replacing the old manual build and copy steps.

### Known issues
- Tunnel is TCP only (no UDP). Some apps (e.g. WhatsApp calls) may not work over the full relay chain.
- Cloudflare Worker exit can't reach Cloudflare-fronted sites (X/Twitter, Discord, ChatGPT, LinkedIn). Use a VPS exit for those.

---

Note: if you're upgrading from a v2.0-pre-* build, update your Apps Script (`Code.gs`) and VPS relay to match this release.

release.name: v1.12.0
release.notes:
## Summary

### Highlights

The biggest wins this release: ChatGPT can now connect via its custom connectors, a visible on-screen indicator tells you when the agent is driving your phone, the camera roll and voice recordings are finally reachable through the file tools (with proper Android 14 "limited access" handling), and a path-traversal hardening of the file tools you'll want to update for.

- **ChatGPT connector support** — the app's built-in OAuth server now accepts ChatGPT's callback URLs and advertises the `offline_access` scope it needs, so you can add the server as a ChatGPT custom connector and approve it with a code on the phone, exactly like Claude.ai (PR #166).
- **Tool-call indicator** — a small on-screen banner shows "MCP controlling · <tool>" while a tool is executing, so you always know when the agent is acting on your device; toggle in General Settings, on by default (PR #143, thanks @adelin-b!).
- **Camera roll, recordings, and Android 14 limited access** — new `builtin:dcim` and `builtin:recordings` storage locations, plus proper handling of "Allow limited access": user-selected photos/videos become readable and `list_storage_locations` reports the access level (PR #157, #158, #159).
- **Security hardening** — every non-builtin file operation now rejects path-traversal attempts before touching anything, and Android auto-backup of app data (settings, tokens) is disabled (PR #174).

### 🔌 ChatGPT connector support

- **ChatGPT custom connectors work** (PR #166) — the OAuth authorization server's redirect-URI allowlist now accepts ChatGPT's fixed connector callback and its per-connector HTTPS callback namespace (exact `chatgpt.com` host only — deceptive hosts like `chatgpt.com.evil.example` stay rejected), and the discovery metadata advertises `offline_access` so ChatGPT gets refresh-token connectivity. Rejected redirect URIs are now logged to the server logs to make connector troubleshooting less of a guessing game. Ported from @ciel051130's fork

repo.description: Android application and Xposed module that allows you to spoof your device's location globally or for specific apps without using "mock location" from the developer options.

release.name: v0.3.0
release.notes:
## New: Custom routes

Build a route on the map and let your fake location travel along it.

- Switch the map to **Route** mode with the Location / Route toggle at the top.
- Tap the map to add points. Long-press and drag a point to move it, or tap it to delete it, move it earlier or later, or give it a new number. You can also reorder points by dragging them in the route panel.
- Tap a line between two points to set that section's speed (Walk, Run, Bike, Drive or a custom km/h), a wait time at its end point, and a speed variation for more natural movement.
- Set a default speed for the whole route, and turn on **Loop** (closed circuit) or **Reverse**.
- See the route's distance and estimated time as you build it.
- Press **Play** to start. A music-player style overlay lets you play, pause, stop, drag the progress bar to jump along the route, and switch between 0.5x, 1x and 2x speed. You can minimize it to a bubble, or control playback from the notification.
- One-time routes stop at the last point and offer **Replay**.
- Save routes to favorites. Favorites now have **Locations** and **Routes** tabs, where you can load, rename and delete routes.
- Your route in progress is kept between app launches, and saved routes are included in settings backups.
- A route and the joystick can't run at the same time.
- The overlay needs the "Display over other apps" permission. Without it, the route still plays with notification controls only.

The Command-line tools can be used to run qaul from the terminal. For example on an embedded computer without a screen such as a Raspberry Pi or on a Server in the internet.

**qaul-cli** is the interactive qaul CLI client for communicating over the qaul net via the terminal.

**qauld** is the qaul daemon to be run in the background and work as a _Community Node_ in the network.

**qauld-ctl** is the control client for the qauld daemon. It connects to a running daemon to inspect and configure it, from single commands, an interactive shell or a terminal UI.

repo.description: 手机端 AutoGLM：无需电脑，真·后台全自动。 支持熄屏、同时多个任务并行，主屏操作互不干扰。（一个基于 AI 的 Android 自动化与多任务框架，开启无限可能。）

release.name: Ruto (Run, Auto) v1.0.0
release.notes:
# 🚀 Ruto (Run, Auto) v1.0.0 

我们非常自豪地发布 Ruto 的第一个正式版本！Ruto 不仅仅是一个自动化工具，它是一个赋予 Android 系统“多线程并行”能力的 AI 任务框架。

### 🌟 核心突破：真正的后台多任务
不同于传统的自动化工具，Ruto 结合了系统级虚拟化能力与 AI 大模型，实现了：
* **虚拟化静默执行**：利用 `DisplayManager` 创建独立的虚拟空间，AI 在“二号屏幕”执行任务，主屏幕依然由你掌控，互不干扰。
* **智能差集任务流**：底层采用 `Flow.scan` 差集算法，精准捕获每一条新指令，杜绝任务重复执行，确保后台调度的绝对稳定。
* **桌面级多窗口管理**：首创 Android 端桌面级多任务界面，你可以像在电脑上一样管理多个虚拟屏幕和 AI 进度。
* **免电脑独立运行**：基于 Shizuku 授权，摆脱 ADB 线缆束缚，手机端即开即用。

### ✨ 主要功能
* **AI 深度集成**：支持自定义 API，结合 Open-AutoGLM 实现“说到做到”的 UI 自动化操作。
* **应用多开分身**：在隔离的虚拟屏幕中运行应用，实现真正的原生级应用多开。
* **现代 UI 体验**：全量采用 Jetpack Compose 构建，拥有极致丝滑的动效与精美的 Material 3 设计。

### 🚀 快速上手
1.  安装 `app-release.apk`。
2.  确保设备已激活 **Shizuku** 并为 Ruto 授予权限。
3.  进入“模型”页面配置您的 API 密钥。
4.  新建一个虚拟屏幕，并在任务设置中指定该屏幕，感受“后台打工”的魅力。

---
**Ruto 正在参加 AutoGLM 实战派开发者激励活动！**
如果您觉得这个项目有用，请在 GitHub 为我们点亮 ⭐️ Star，您的支持是我们持续迭代的最大动力！

2. 修复 macOS 重新启动应用后 Mini Player 和播放会话无法恢复的问题。
3. 修复部分情况下 Android 从最近任务中移除应用后，音频和媒体服务仍会继续运行的问题。
4. 修复部分 LRC 字幕因使用毫秒、逗号分隔符、单数字段或省略小数部分而被识别为不支持格式的问题。
5. 增强音频缓存和预加载的可靠性；不完整或无法读取的缓存文件会被自动丢弃，并回退到远程音频源继续播放。

repo.description: Simple Android incoming SMS to URL forwarder

release.name: Version 2.4.0
release.notes:
## New features

- **Reliable delivery after the app is killed** — SMS are now received even when an aggressive battery manager stops the app in the background, so messages no longer get missed.
- **Refreshed look** — modernized Material design with dark mode support, a cleaner card-based rule list, and updated forms.
- **Payload signing (HMAC SHA-256)** — optionally sign each webhook request with a shared secret so your server can verify the message really came from your phone.
- **Backup & restore** — export all forwarding rules to a file and import them back, for easy backup or moving to a new device.
- **Local network mode** — forward to a server on your LAN without an internet connection.
- **Filter by message text** — add a per-rule filter so only messages whose content matches are forwarded.
- **Regex sender matching** — match senders that use rotating prefixes via an optional regular expression.
- **Store & retry failed messages** — optionally keep messages that failed to deliver and resend them manually later.
- **App-alive heartbeat** — optional periodic ping to a URL so you can monitor that the app is still running.

## Template placeholders

- New device-health placeholders: `%version%`, `%battery%`, `%power%`, `%network%`.
- New `%Regex=...%` placeholder to extract part of the SMS body.
- Optional date formatting for `%sentStamp%` / `%receivedStamp%`.

## Improvements & fixes

- New rules now send the message body correctly to PHP-based webhooks by default.
- Failed deliveries now log the HTTP status code to help debugging.
- The foreground-service indicator now shows reliably on newer Android versions.
- Fixed a crash when a sender or SIM value contained a `$` character.
- Various reliability fixes for local mode, signing, and rule import.
- Added Russian translation.

The wipe waits for the cookies to be removed and then 3 seconds for the HTTP cache: loading the page sooner failed once with `ERR_CONTENT_LENGTH_MISMATCH` on the emulator. Also available over ADB (`session_reset_button_enabled`). Not tested on a physical tablet. Part of the config export/import (`general.sessionResetButtonEnabled`) and the backup.

## 一、下载

| 变体 | 文件 | 字节 | MD5 |
|---|---|---|---|
| official（推荐） | `DeepSeekHarness.apk` | 162,006,797 | `418956bcdafb6e8cac312a6863283f55` |
| Lite 共存版 | `DeepSeekHarnessLite.apk` | 162,006,797 | `d43646cd9dc37b32b397cf4755b99ada` |

校验：`md5.txt` 随包附带；三套都过同一套包内判据 **109 PASS / 0 FAIL**。

## 二、安装 / 升级

- **official / Lite**：Android 7.0+（minSdk 24）；**兼容版**：Android 8.0+（minSdk 26，自带 GeckoView，不依赖系统 WebView）。
- 直接覆盖安装（同签名），**不需要卸载**；会话、插件、配置、主题都保留。
- 三套包可以同时装：通知/引擎端口 official `3080`、Lite `3082`、compat `3084`，互不冲突。
- ⚠ **虚拟屏桥 8999 / 特权核心 8998 是三套共用的**：同一个时刻只让**一个**版本开虚拟屏，否则会互相抢。
- 覆盖安装后系统会把无障碍服务解绑，需要在「设置 → 无障碍」重新打开「DeepSeek Harness 屏幕助手」（这是 Android 的行为，不是本版的 bug）。

### 1）内核升级到 0.2.1-rc.2

- 上游 npm 包开始携带 TypeScript 源码（多出约 290MB），出货前按「运行时只留 lib」剪枝，APK 只比上一版大 ~3.8MB。
- 16 个既有补丁文件全部三方合并到 0.2.1；终端协议随上游改为 `terminal/attach` 双向流（界面无感）。
- 4 个自研插件与 AI 浏览器插件继续随包。

### 2）会话列表「0 条」根因修复

- 0.2.1 把会话文件从 `session.jsonl.zstd` 改名成 **`session.v4.jsonl.zstd`**，而控制台的「会话管理 / 会话修复」脚本只认旧名 → 显示 0 条会话。
- 现已同时兼容新旧两种文件名（并做 `session*.jsonl.zstd` 通配）；**数据从来没丢**，真机 41 条会话全部可列出 / 修复。
- 铁律不变：任何「修复」都不靠删掉整条会话解决；删除只进回收站，彻底删除只在回收站里单独确认。

每个插件都让**设备上的 AI 真的用一遍**，由它写出带真实返回值的 3 条改进建议，再逐条决定采纳与否。

release.name: Android Smart WebView 7.5 🔐 (Stable)
release.notes:
This is a critical security and stability release that addresses several core issues related to the authentication lifecycle, UI theming, and state preservation. We strongly recommend all users update to this version.

## ✨ **Security & Enhancements**

This release introduces a major overhaul of the Biometric Authentication plugin to make it more robust and secure against common bypass methods.

*   **Hardened Authentication Lifecycle**: The app session is now invalidated whenever the app is paused or sent to the background. This ensures that authentication is **required every time the app is brought back to the foreground**, closing a critical security loophole that previously allowed bypassing the lock on resume.
*   **Secure App Snapshot**: The main app window is now flagged as secure (`FLAG_SECURE`). This prevents the app's content from being visible in the "Recent Apps" switcher or in screenshots, protecting sensitive information when the app is in the background.
*   **Robust Auth Cancellation**: Fixed a critical flaw where tapping outside the system's authentication prompt would minimize the app. The security overlay now correctly persists, forcing the user to either complete authentication or manually exit the app.
*   **Guided Security Setup**: If a user has no screen lock (PIN, pattern, fingerprint, etc.) enabled on their device, the "Authenticate" button on the security overlay will now correctly redirect them to the Android Security Settings to set one up.

## 🐞 **Bug Fixes & Stability Improvements**

*   **Fixed: State Loss on Configuration Change**: The WebView no longer reloads to the initial URL after a screen rotation. The user's current page, scroll position, and plugin states are now correctly preserved. *(Note: The runtime theme toggle has been temporarily disabled to prevent this issue).*
*   **Fixed: Status Bar Color**: Resolved all inconsistencies with the status bar color, ensuring it correctly matches the app theme in both full

release.notes:
# Bare 1.0.1

A fix release on Chromium **156.0.8078.25**, the same as 1.0.0. The series is now 164 patches.

## Which APK should I download?

- `Bare-1.0.1-arm64-v8a.apk` is for most Android phones from the last several years. If you are
  unsure, take this one.
- `Bare-1.0.1-armeabi-v7a.apk` is for 32-bit ARM devices only. It is not lighter or better on a
  64-bit phone.

## What's new since 1.0.0

- **Samsung phones on One UI 9 no longer restart.** On Android 17, Samsung's kernel crashes when Bare's
  GPU process turns on Chromium's Landlock sandbox, and the whole phone reboots. Bare now skips that
  sandbox on Samsung phones running Android 17 or later, and keeps it everywhere else. We'll narrow or
  remove this once Samsung ships a fixed kernel. Thanks to everyone who reported it and tested the
  fix (#82).
- **Protected video plays on Android 16 and later phones whose kernel has Landlock.** On those
  phones the same sandbox stopped Android's DRM library from loading, so Widevine video never
  started. The GPU process can now read Android's system libraries, and the sandbox stays on. We
  tested this on an Android 17 emulator, not on 32-bit phones. Some services, Netflix among them, don't allow any browser on
  Android to play their videos, so they still won't play in Bare.
- **Google sites open in their mobile layout again.** 1.0.0 meant to show only the Chrome Web Store
  as a desktop site, but the setting it stored covered every google.com site. 1.0.1 removes it once,
  on first launch.
- **The Chrome Web Store still installs extensions, at your phone's width.** Extension pages fit the
  screen, and "Add to Chrome" works as before. The store's front page and category pages are still
  laid out for a desktop, so some rows run off the side of the screen.

release.name: GoRead v1.5.9
release.notes:
## GoRead v1.5.9

### 🚀 新增

#### 听书：系统媒体通知与锁屏控制（Android / iOS）

- 朗读时提供系统媒体通知与锁屏播放卡片：书名、章节、当前句与章节进度，支持播放、暂停、停止、上一章/下一章及进度拖动；Android 通知还带封面大图标。
- 章节进度按已读文本比例推进，章节时长按语速估算，并在播放中自动校准、按「引擎 + 语音 + 语言」记住。
- Android 13+ 在设置页新增朗读通知权限项，未授权时可一键申请或跳转系统通知设置。

#### EPUB3 固定版式

- 自动识别固定版式章节，按书籍声明的逻辑尺寸渲染后等比缩放适配阅读区；内容超出声明视口时整页展开不裁切，且不覆盖书籍自身排版。

#### EPUB3 阅读顺序

- spine 中的导航文档不再作为正文出现：翻页、阅读进度与听书都会跳过，章节索引保持稳定，书签与已有进度不受影响。
- 目录与正文中的章内锚点（脚注、交叉引用）可以正确跳转。

#### 阅读页外观

- 阅读页全屏统一底色，页边界改用纸张投影（深色主题为淡描边），PDF 暗色纸色与其他格式一致。
- 状态栏与阅读页同底色，图标明暗随底色与浮层自动切换，离开阅读页恢复系统默认。

### 🐛 修复

#### 听书

- 修复进度条跨章归零、章节内提前满格、拖动定位偏差，以及 Web Speech 下的进度问题。
- 修复翻页、回到前台、后台跨章后朗读位置与高亮丢失，以及从章节中间起播时的重复朗读。
- 修复被其他应用抢占音频焦点后朗读暂停且通知不再恢复，以及通知文案与封面不更新。

#### 阅读器

- 修复显示状态栏时横向阅读页底部文字被裁切、部分机型阅读页被黑色遮罩遮挡，以及挖孔屏遮挡首行与横屏行首/行尾。
- 修复 EPUB 分页模式长按选字时页面抖动。

#### iOS

- 修复状态栏隐藏不生效、音量键翻页会改变系统音量并弹出音量条；外部文件、安全区与存储权限桥接与 Android 对齐。

### ⚡ 性能

- 听书按章反复读取缓存时不再每次回写访问时间，减少磁盘写 I/O。

repo.description: A Xposed module for hiding Android developer-related switches status.

release.notes:
## 中文

### 主要变更

- **迁移到 libxposed API 102（LSPosed 2.0）**：模块入口从旧版 `de.robv.android.xposed` API 改为 libxposed 模块 API，并重写了依赖 `XposedBridge.hookAllMethods` 的 Hook 层。现在每一项检测方法都对应一个显式的 Hook，缺少 Hook 会在编译期直接报错。本版本为**破坏性变更**：需要支持 libxposed 模块 API（`minApiVersion 101`）的框架。
- **激活状态**：改为直接取自框架服务（`XposedService`），不再依赖对模块自身代码的 Hook。
- **翻译更新**：更新了多语言翻译（#127）。

### 检测功能说明与已知问题

- 检测仍是内置功能：`DetectionMethod.test()` 通过普通 Android API 读取设备状态。
- **已知问题**：libxposed API 102 下框架**不再把模块注入模块自身的应用进程**，因此模块应用内的检测图标只能显示真实设备状态，无法再显示被 Hook 后的“隐藏”结果。这**不影响**对被 Hook 的目标应用的隐藏效果。
- 计划通过拆分出独立的 detector 应用、由 detector 向模块应用暴露 provider 查询接口来恢复准确的自检，详见 #145。

### 注意事项

- 本版本需要 **LSPosed 2.0**（即实现 libxposed 模块 API、`minApiVersion >= 101` 的框架）。仅提供旧版 XposedBridge API 的框架将无法再加载本模块。

## English

### Highlights

- **Migrated to libxposed API 102 (LSPosed 2.0)**: the module entry point moved from the legacy `de.robv.android.xposed` API to the libxposed module API, and the hook layer that relied on `XposedBridge.hookAllMethods` was reworked. Every detection method now maps to an explicit hook, and a missing hook is a compile-time error. This is a **breaking change**: it requires a framework implementing the libxposed module API (`minApiVersion 101`).
- **Activation status**: now taken directly from the framework service (`XposedService`) instead of a hook on the module's own code.
- **Translation update**: refreshed several translations (#127).

### Detection feature and known issue

- Detection remains a built-in feature: `DetectionMethod.test()` reads the device state through ordinary Android APIs.
- **Known issue**: with libxposed API 102 the framework **no longer injects a module into its own app process**, so the in-app test icons can only show the real device state and can no longer show the masked result. This does **not** affect hiding the module from hooked target apps.
- Accurate self-detection is planned to be restored by splitting out a standalone detector app that exposes

## What's Changed

### Added
- Added a full refresh on page turn for e-ink screens: after a page turn the screen briefly flashes a solid color to clear ghosting. Color, interval and duration are adjustable. Gallery modes only.
- Added a ripple page turn for iReader e-readers: tap and key page turns in gallery modes use the device's own ripple effect, with adjustable speed. The option only appears on supported devices.
- Auto page turning can now scroll continuously in continuous reading modes, at an adjustable speed. Touching or scrolling takes over, and auto scrolling picks up again shortly after you let go.
- While auto page turning is running, speed / interval controls and a stop button appear above the bottom bar.
- Added "Keep screen on while reading" to the reader settings, which keeps the screen on for the whole reading session (mobile only).

### Changed
- Auto page turning now pauses while the menu, a popup or another page is open, or the app is in the background, and continues when you return.
- Auto page turning now keeps the screen on while it runs (mobile only).
- Auto page turning now waits for a page that is still loading, and restarts its countdown after you turn a page yourself.
- The app now runs on iOS 15.1 and later; it previously required iOS 16.

### Fixed
- Fixed the app crashing on launch on iOS 15 devices.
- Fixed auto page turning sometimes stopping on its own, with no notice, while the next chapter was loading. It now stops only at the end or when a chapter fails to load, and shows a notice.

### Removed
- No features were removed in this release.

* Kotlin Migration: The core application logic has been entirely converted from Java to Kotlin.

release.name: v1.3.0
release.notes:
新增瀑布流画廊、链接内容先看后存、以引用保存与画面框选放大，升级多标签工作区与播放体验。

## 修复

- 修复 Android 版在部分手机与平板上需要侧滑两次才能返回上一级或退出播放器的问题（#30）。
- 修复平板横屏下无法在右侧分栏刷信息流（#20），以及无法通过返回手势退出全屏视频的问题。
- 修复信息流翻回上一段视频，或多次刷到同一部长视频的不同片段时画面卡住的问题（#23）。
- 修复下载文件夹或批量下载时因预先扫描整个目录树导致迟迟无法入队的问题。
- 修复批量重命名时列表反复跳动、同目录外挂字幕未能跟随视频改名或额外占用序号的问题。
- 修复切换账号瞬间，未完成的目录加载或后台同步偶发串入新账号的问题。

## 变化

- **瀑布流画廊**：支持将当前文件夹（含全部子文件夹）或选中的多个视频汇集为瀑布流，按视频画幅错落排布（#25）。
- **先看后存**：解析磁力或 PikPak 分享链接并勾选文件后，网盘列表会同步显示「待保存」的虚拟目录；保存前即可直接翻看目录、播放视频、查看图片或浏览压缩包。
- **以引用保存**：添加链接时可选择「以引用保存」，不占网盘空间即可将磁力或分享内容存为目录条目，并保留视频与图片缩略图；同目录会生成供其他客户端读取的来源文件，在 Piko 内浏览与搜索时自动隐藏。
- **刷片顺延与接续**：信息流片段播满 30 秒或拖动进度条接近末尾时，自动向后顺延 30 秒直至播完全片，往回翻页仍保留已延长的进度（#29）；中途定位到网盘查看文件后，可随时点「继续刷」回到原位置。
- **播放器与媒体控制**：画面比例新增「框选填充」，可框选画面任意区域放大铺满屏幕；音轨与字幕切换移至顶栏；支持系统媒体控制卡片、蓝牙耳机按键与键盘多媒体键。
- **多任务工作区**：手机与平板可像浏览器一样切换多个文件标签、查重结果与添加链接草稿，支持滑动关闭；桌面端开启多个文件标签时可关闭任意标签。
- **网盘浏览与整理**：新增按视频时长排序，列表视图支持三档列宽；重做属性面板，名称、路径、哈希与来源链接可一键复制或直接解析；右键菜单与操作面板提拔「下载指定段落…」与「归档」，新增「复制下载链接」；手机端长按直接进入多选，多选操作移至底部工具栏。
- **任务页与异常恢复**：顶栏整合五段分类筛选与蜗牛模式开关；任务按「需要处理」「进行中」「已完成」分组展示，批量移动、复制、删除、重命名或转存遇到网络中断时，可在任务页核对结果、重试或撤销。
- **桌面与系统衔接**：Windows 版支持开机自启，关闭主窗口时可选择最小化到托盘或直接退出；新增「自动检测剪贴板中的链接」开关（#22）；「防窥模糊」改为每台设备独立生效；Android 版支持直接打开官方分享链接与应用深链。

release.notes:
# Connect your pages. Make room for guests.

Candy Browser 0.47.0 introduces Candy Constellations, a local map of related pages, and Guest Bubble,
a separate browsing space for lending someone your phone. New Android integrations bring selected
website snapshots, saved articles, and personal link rules closer to the places you already use them.
Reader Studio and everyday navigation get a more comfortable touch, too.

## Discover connections with Candy Constellations

Open **Candy Constellations** from the browser menu to explore related pages in the current profile.
Pan and zoom through the map, select a page to see its excerpt and related pages, or search saved
titles, URLs, and excerpts to jump between matches.

- Enable Constellations separately for each regular local profile. Maps stay within their profile.
- Download the optional model once, then page analysis runs on your device. Page content is never
  sent to a model service.
- New readable visits build the map; Candy does not fetch your old history in the background.
- Private tabs and temporary previews are excluded. History deletion removes the corresponding map
  entries; disabling Constellations clears that profile's map. Maps are excluded from sync and backup.

> Setup requires an explicit model download of about 138 MB from Hugging Face. Connections indicate
> topic similarity, not agreement or factual accuracy.

Learn more about [Candy Constellations](https://github.com/sk2andy/candy-browser/blob/v0.47.0/docs/browsing/README.md).

## Lend Candy with Guest Bubble

Enable **Guest Bubble** under **Settings → Tabs & gestures**, then long-press the profile **+** button
to hand over a separate, temporary browser. Your Candy profiles, tabs, history, and settings stay
behind the owner lock. Returning to your browser requires Android device authentication; Candy
stops the guest session and clears its website data before unlocking.

Guest Bubble requires profiles and an available strong biometric or device scr

release.name: v1.2.44 — گره: سنجاق، کانفیگ در گفت‌وگو و گفت‌وگوهای رسمی سریع‌تر
release.notes:
## گره: سنجاق، کانفیگ در گفت‌وگو، پی‌وی از گروه رسمی، و رفع کندی و دانلود در گفت‌وگوهای رسمی

### افزوده‌شده
- **گره: سنجاق کردن پیام.** در گفت‌وگوی تکی، گروه، کانال و کانال و گروه رسمی پیام را سنجاق کنید: صاحب و مدیران سنجاق می‌کنند (و اعضا، اگر گروه اجازه داده باشد)، همهٔ اعضا سنجاق را بالای گفت‌وگو می‌بینند و کسی که بعداً بپیوندد هم آن را می‌بیند. در گفت‌وگوهای رسمی فقط مدیرانشان سنجاق می‌کنند.
- **گره: کانفیگ در گفت‌وگو.** زیر پیامی که لینک کانفیگ (VLESS، VMess، Trojan، Shadowsocks و بقیه) یا فایل کانفیگ (.conf، .npvs، .ovpn، فهرست در .txt) دارد دو دکمه می‌آید، زیر پیام خودتان هم. «سنجش» هر کدام را روی شبکهٔ شما می‌آزماید، بی بیرون رفتن از گفت‌وگو؛ «انتقال» آن‌ها را (همه، یا فقط آن‌ها که وصل شدند) به کانفیگ‌های برنامه در پوشهٔ «گره» می‌برد و «برو» همان صفحه را باز می‌کند.
- **گره: پی‌وی از گروه رسمی.** هر پست گروه رسمی حالا کارت نویسنده‌اش را دارد، پس با زدن نام یک عضو در آن‌جا گفت‌وگوی تکی با او باز می‌شود.
- **گره: زمان پیوستن هر مشترک.** فهرست مشترکان کانال زمان پیوستن هر کس را نشان می‌دهد، نه «همین حالا» برای همه (تیم دکتر نت).

### رفع‌شده
- **گره: پیام‌های گروه رسمی دیر می‌رسید.** هر ۲۰ دقیقه خوانده می‌شد؛ حالا وقتی گفت‌وگوی رسمی باز است هر ۱۰ ثانیه، و وقتی برنامه جلوست هر ۲ دقیقه.
- **گره: عکس، ویس و فایل در کانال و گروه رسمی دانلود نمی‌شد.** لودینگ بی‌پایان می‌ماند. حالا مهرشده از راه رلهٔ ایران می‌رود و ۱۴ روز همان‌جا می‌ماند.
- **گره: ریپلای در گروه رسمی برای دیگران بی نقل‌قول می‌رسید.** حالا پیام اصلی به محض رسیدن بالای ریپلای می‌آید.
- **گره: بی‌صدا کردن کانال و گروه نمی‌ماند.** حالا بی‌صدا می‌ماند.
- **گره: «مقاله» پرمیوم می‌خواست.** قالب‌بندی مقاله برای همه کار می‌کند.
- **گره: پیام‌هایی که یک تیک می‌ماند.** گوشی دیگر منتظر رله‌ای که هرگز جواب نمی‌دهد نمی‌ماند، و پیام به کسی که گره را دوباره نصب کرده دیگر روی جلسه‌ای که گوشی او ندارد نمی‌رود (تیم دکتر نت).
- **گره: گفت‌وگوی رسمی نسخهٔ قدیمی در فهرست می‌ماند.** حالا از فهرستی که هنگام باز شدن خوانده می‌شود هم می‌رود (تیم دکتر نت).

## What's Changed

**NEW FEATURES**
* Add a "My survey points" map layer that shows where your surveys actually recorded data, on both the tower map and the Survey Monitor map. [#101](https://github.com/christianrowlands/android-network-survey/issues/101)
* Color survey points by signal strength, technology, provider, sent status, cell, or area (TAC/LAC), and switch the layer between cellular, Wi-Fi, and Bluetooth.
* Filter survey points by when they were surveyed, which upload destination collected them, and whether they have been sent, with the active filters shown as dismissible chips on the map.
* Add a Cellular Tools screen with a browsable reference of every LTE and 5G NR band, searchable by band designator, name, EARFCN, NARFCN, or frequency.
* Rename the Cellular Calculators screen to Cellular Tools with Bands and Calculators panes, and add a Channel to Band calculator that resolves an EARFCN or NARFCN to its band and shows the frequency.
* Tap the Band field on the cellular details screen to open that band's entry in the reference.
* Rework the ongoing survey notification to report the state of the survey.

**IMPROVEMENTS**
* Load towers onto the map through a session tile cache, so panning back to an area you have already viewed, or zooming into it, no longer refetches it.
* Raise the on-map tower budget from 7,500 to 20,000, and build the map features off the main thread.
* Replace rather than stack new tower alerts, make them dismissible, and count towers per survey.
* Translation updates contributed through Weblate.

**BUG FIXES**
* Fix the 5G NR band being left blank when the device does not report one and the NARFCN falls in more than one band. Every candidate is now listed (for example `n48 / n77 / n78`), with a different separator than the bands the modem reported.
* Fix the tower map repeatedly refetching a dense city view after the server truncated the result.
* Fix two- and three-digit MNCs producing colliding tower identifier

repo.description: 💽 Fast SQLite library for React Native built using Nitro Modules

release.name: NitroSQLite 10.2.0
release.notes:
NitroSQLite 10.2.0 improves repeated queries, async result delivery, and Android writes. It also adds runtime error constants and an errors-only entry point for shared code and Node.js tests. This minor release includes compatibility changes to SQL validation and query result objects, so review the upgrade notes before rebuilding your app.

## Performance improvements

Each connection now caches its 32 most recently used query and data-change statements. Repeated calls to `execute()` and `executeAsync()` can reuse compiled SQL when the query text stays the same. Bind values as parameters to benefit from this cache. Statements such as `PRAGMA`, `ATTACH`, and transaction commands still compile on every call. See the [performance guide](https://sqlite.margelo.com/docs/guides/performance).

Async queries, batches, and file imports now run on a dedicated worker thread per connection. Large managed async queries convert rows to JavaScript in batches while SQLite reads the remaining rows. The promise still resolves once with every row in order; paginate large queries to limit the final result size.

Android builds now use `fdatasync()` and enable batch atomic writes on supported F2FS filesystems. These changes reduce commit I/O without lowering `PRAGMA synchronous`. SQLite falls back to its rollback journal when atomic writes are unavailable. See the [Android configuration guide](https://sqlite.margelo.com/docs/configuration/android) for details and build-time opt-outs. [#440](https://github.com/margelo/react-native-nitro-sqlite/pull/440)

## Breaking changes and migration

### One SQL statement per query

SQL strings containing more than one statement now throw or reject instead of running the first statement and silently ignoring the rest. This affects `execute()`, `executeAsync()`, `prepare()`, each batch command, and each nonempty SQL-file line. Trailing whitespace, comments, and extra semicolons remain allowed. release.notes:
# X360 Mobile 0.6.3 and X360 Companion 0.1.0

X360 Mobile 0.6.3 introduces local wireless multiplayer through the new X360
Companion application, alongside Android Home shortcuts, a clearer driver
catalog and a unified touch-control system.

## X360 Companion 0.1.0

- Added X360 Companion, a separate Android application that turns a phone on
  the same local network or a paired Bluetooth device into a remote XInput
  controller.
- Up to three companions can be assigned independently to P2, P3 or P4. P1
  remains protected from remote assignment unless the host explicitly enables
  remote-only play.
- Added user-confirmed pairing, trusted-host management, connection recovery,
  per-player rumble and GamerProfile selection on the host.
- Added a shared, localized touch-control editor with compatible TOML
  import/export, presets, Xbox player indicator and controller artwork.
- LAN gameplay was validated between Odin3 and Honor through Gears of War 2.
  Bluetooth remains experimental and device-dependent.

## Library, shortcuts and input

- Added per-game Android Home shortcuts. A shortcut uses a title image embedded
  in supported game content when available, opens the direct-game loading
  screen, applies the game's saved settings and returns to the launcher when
  the game exits.
- Unified the host and Companion touch artwork, layout model and edge-aware
  factory placement. Standard layouts now preserve intended controls that
  extend partially beyond a screen edge on every supported aspect ratio.
- Expanded the integrated driver catalog with release descriptions so users can
  review maintainer compatibility notes before downloading a driver.

## Packages

- **X360 Mobile:** `emu.x360mobile.com`, version `0.6.3` (`versionCode 6039000`),
  asset `x360-mobile-0.6.3.apk`.
- **X360 Companion:** `emu.x360mobile.controller`, version `0.1.0`
  (`versionCode 11002`), asset `x360-companion-0.1.0.apk`.

Both APKs are signed with the established X360 Mobile Release identity.

> 本次更新聚焦：**刮削源升级 · FVP 引擎画质与音频修复 · 内置文件提取 · 社区收藏集**

repo.description: Native port of Metroid Prime (GameCube) for Linux, Windows and Android, built from the PrimeDecomp decompilation. No emulator, no game assets included: bring your own disc image.

release.notes:
## Metroid Prime Trilogy support

**The port now runs Metroid Prime from a Metroid Prime Trilogy disc** (`R3ME01` USA, `R3MP01` PAL), with Trilogy's own Wii presentation:
- **Trilogy's HUD**: Scan visor
- **Wii radial beam and visor menus**, also on touch (slide a Beam/Visor button to point at an entry). With radial menus turned off, the corner menu icons show instead.
- **Trilogy saves**: import and export on a Trilogy disc, and the port's card can mirror an emulator's Trilogy save. Switching from a GameCube disc offers to bring your saves over.

Also in this release: an experimental iPhone and iPad build, an OpenGL renderer, Remastered's thermal visor and a Remastered performance mode.

**You need your own disc image:** Metroid Prime Trilogy (`R3ME01` USA, `R3MP01` PAL), whose Metroid Prime is run as the base game, Metroid Prime USA (`GM8E01`, revisions 1.00, 1.01 and 1.02), or the experimental PAL release (`GM8P01`). No disc image or game assets are included.

## What else changed

### Saves
- After switching to another release's disc (for example GameCube to Trilogy), the port offers to copy that release's newest saves over, randomizer and Archipelago cards included. The Memory card settings have a "Restore from …" button for later.

### Rendering
- OpenGL renderer on Linux and Windows (Settings > Renderer). The port falls back to OpenGL automatically when the default backend can't start (#202).
- Mirrored room geometry no longer draws inside out, and Remastered door frames get their baked lighting back.
- A depth pre-pass for room models, and no present resample when the frame already matches the window.

### Prime Remastered
- The Thermal Visor draws Remastered's cold and hot passes, with hot models through Remastered's thermal shader.
- A performance mode, on by default (Mods > Prime Remastered > Performance mode)
- The pause screen keeps its translucent blurred backdrop and text (#208), inventory lighting and HDR post on the pause scr

- Player: Start Over is hidden by default (turn it on under Controls)
- Player: seeking while the controls are hidden shows only the scrub bar instead of the full controls, and the bar glides instead of stepping

- Stream picker: addons are listed in your addon order with the preferred auto-play addon first, and the list no longer reorders under you as results arrive

release.notes:
# Release Notes

### 🐞 Known issues

*   Android TV not yet ready

### ✨ New Features

*   **Fully provider-driven**: The app now runs entirely on providers. The old built-in TMDB metadata API has been removed and converted into a provider, which is easy to install and is recommended by the app's author.
*   **Downloads**: You can now download movies and episodes to watch offline, with progress notifications you can cancel right from the shade.
*   **Smarter playback links**: Downloads now pick the best available link, preferring direct links and handling HLS streams more reliably, so interrupted downloads resume where they left off.
*   **Library**: Pull down to refresh your library lists.
*   **Backup & restore**: Your cached links are now included in backups.
*   **Profiles**: Switching profiles feels smoother, with a proper loading state.
*   **Settings**: Added a logcat viewer to make sharing bug reports easier, and third-party gateway links can now be opened directly.
*   **Incognito mode** has been removed.
*   Welcome to the first preview build in two years!

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

*   **App updates**: Fixed failed update downloads, wrong APK picks on mobile and TV, and the app getting stuck on the splash screen after being in the background.
*   **Providers**:
    *   Fixed providers failing to install, crashing on missing metadata, or showing up twice in lists.
    *   New links for a media now load correctly.
    *   Provider settings are cleaned up when a provider is removed.
    *   Error messages in the crash dialog and bottom sheet are clearer.
*   **Library**: Lists now update when a name, description, or preview changes, and tracker lists are managed more reliably.
*   **Profiles**: Switching users now reloads properly, and text fields update with their latest value.
*   **Onboarding**: Moving between steps is more stable.
*   **Restore**: Restoring a backup no longer breaks when unloading providers.

release.notes:
A maintenance release focused on correctness and modernisation.  Highlights:

* Builds with the current Android toolchain (compile/target SDK 37, AGP 9.4, Gradle 9.7); the core
  library's minimum SDK is unchanged.
* The core library's only dependency is now `androidx.annotation`; the XML configuration engine
  (formerly the separate Fig library) lives in `androidplot-core`.
* Nullability annotations across the whole public API for Kotlin callers.
* Around forty bug fixes, including several crashes, found by a code review of the library and a
  large expansion of the test suite (core line coverage is now above 95%).
* A reworked background render loop and demo app; see **Behavior changes** below for the handful of
  observable differences.

Full list:

* Nullability annotations (`androidx.annotation.NonNull` / `Nullable`) across the whole public API of
  `androidplot-core`: every reference-typed return value and parameter of every public or protected
  method and constructor is annotated, so Kotlin callers see real nullable / non-null types instead
  of platform types.  Kotlin code may see new compile errors where it passed `null` to a parameter
  that is now `@NonNull`, or used a now-`@Nullable` return (for example `XYSeries.getX()` /
  `getY()`, `Region.getMin()` / `getMax()`, `XYPlot.getDomainOrigin()` / `getRangeOrigin()`,
  `Plot.getRenderer()` and formatter paint getters that return `null` when disabled) without a null
  check.  A test (`NullabilityAnnotationsTest`) keeps the annotations complete.
* Fix `Redrawer` occasionally never exiting (or never resuming) when `finish()`, `pause()` or
  `start()` raced with its thread: the flag was set before the thread started, or a notify slipped
  in between the thread checking its state and waiting.

# DiAuto 0.3.12 — Dashboard map, HUD and connection fixes

DiAuto can now show Android Auto's map on the BYD instrument cluster, with DiPlay's
turn card, and fixes the windshield HUD and several connection problems.

## Dashboard map (off by default)

- Google Maps or Waze draws its own map for the instrument cluster, and DiAuto shows it on
  the BYD dashboard (#44, by 07x01313480). Turn it on under Settings → Navigation →
  Android Auto map on the dashboard.
- DiPlay's turn card (glyphs, distance, street and arrival time) on top of the map.
- On the Han L and other measured DiLink 5.1 firmware, the map follows the cluster theme
  by itself, as in DiPlay: the full map in the Map theme, and in Scenario and Simple only
  while the mini map card is open. Switching themes while driving needs no reconnect.
  This needs Usage access for DiAuto; Settings offers the grant, and without it the map
  shows on every cluster card.
- Google Maps may switch the car screen to its Overview view while the dashboard map is
  on. Switch it back to Perspective in Google Maps.

## HUD and navigation

- Windshield HUD arrows appear as soon as a route starts and stay on. BYD's own map
  turned them off when the cluster display appeared or the navi mode changed (#41).
- Numbered roundabouts show their exit on the HUD and the turn card, with a new
  "traffic keeps left" setting for the direction (#26, by JuanGaVS).
- DiLink 3.0: HUD and cluster guidance, and a long press on the steering-wheel voice
  button opens the phone's assistant (#25, #27, by JuanGaVS).

## Connection

- Reconnecting during a route no longer ends in "Connection lost" (#42).
- Fixed a reconnect loop when the phone was still on the car's Wi-Fi from the previous
  connection (#45).
- Exiting Android Auto from the phone no longer reconnects by itself, and a phone removed
  from auto-start is not added back (#35).
- Wi-Fi Direct: a working 5 GHz group on Android 10, and no repeated 5 GHz attempts after
  a definite failure

🚀 ShizuCoreFetch v2.4.0 (Stable) — Store Curation & Smart Profiles

* **The "Newest" Filter:** Discover fresh tools instantly! We implemented a surgical backend update that leverages GitHub's native `created_at` metadata. This allows the app to accurately display applications released within the last 14 days without consuming any additional GitHub API quota.
* **Decluttered Storefront:** To keep the focus on new discoveries, the core apps "Shizuku" and "ShizuCoreFetch" are now officially hidden from the main feed via backend configuration, heavily reducing redundancy.

**🛠️ Stability & UI Polish**
* **Crash-Proof Developer Links:** Completely rebuilt the social link parsing in the Developer Profile screen. Whether a developer enters a full URL (`https://x.com/user`) or just a bare username (`user`), the app now intelligently constructs the correct, safe link for GitHub, Telegram, YouTube, X, and Instagram, completely eliminating the `ActivityNotFoundException` crash.
* **Balanced UI Skeletons:** The store filter buttons and their loading shimmer effects have been redesigned into a perfectly balanced 2x2 grid, ensuring a seamless, jitter-free visual transition when data loads.

**🙏 Community Credits**

A special thank you to the users whose feedback directly shaped this update:
* **@source-sketch** — For the great suggestion to hide Shizuku and ShizuCoreFetch, keeping the storefront clean and focused on third-party tools.
* **@wizzwuz** — For proposing the highly useful "Newest Apps" section to drastically improve project discovery.

Thank you to everyone who continues to test, report issues, and contribute ideas to the project.

## 简体中文

### v3.7.3 更新内容

- 新增独立字号调整：普通气泡、游离文字气泡和悬浮窗气泡均可单独设置文字填充比例，范围为 20%–100%，默认 100%。调整文字大小不改变气泡大小，支持横排、竖排、阅读和导出。
- 优化横排文字换行：在保持字号可读的前提下，减少不必要的换行。
- 修复长图检测遗漏：修复分块重新检测时误删边缘气泡的问题，改善跨分块区域的检测完整性。
- 优化文本块合并：改善相邻横排文本块合并，按图片短边统一合并尺度，修复垂直方向远距离误合并及跨列串并问题。
- 适配 Android 17：新增局域网访问权限授权入口，仅在配置 HTTP 接口时显示。
- 修复启动闪退：解决发布版因数据库初始化失败导致的启动崩溃。
- 更新使用教程：补充独立字号设置说明，明确气泡回缩用于避免遮盖原漫画气泡边缘；同步更新中英文 API 教程，DeepSeek 推荐模型名称改为 deepseek-flash。

## English

### What's New in v3.7.3

- Independent text size controls: Set separate text fill ratios for normal bubbles, free-text bubbles, and floating-window bubbles. Each supports 20%–100%, with a default of 100%. Adjust text size without changing bubble size, with support for horizontal and vertical text in reading and exports.
- Improved horizontal text wrapping: Reduced unnecessary line breaks while keeping text readable.
- Fixed missing bubbles in long images: Edge bubbles are no longer incorrectly discarded when image tiles are detected again, improving detection across tile boundaries.
- Improved text block merging: Refined merging of adjacent horizontal text blocks using the image’s shorter side for consistent merge distances. Fixed incorrect merging of vertically distant blocks and blocks in separate columns.
- Android 17 support: Added a local network permission entry, shown only when an HTTP endpoint is configured.
- Fixed a startup crash: Resolved a release-build crash caused by database initialization failure.
- Updated tutorials: Documented the independent text size controls and clarified that bubble inset helps preserve the original manga’s bubble borders. Updated both Chinese and English API guides to recommend deepseek-flash for DeepSeek.

repo.description: A Pure JavaScript Color Picker for React Native

release.name: v5.1.3
release.notes:
## What's changed

### Fixes

- No more Reanimated 4.6 `dependencies should only be used in web implementation` warnings: hook dependency arrays are now passed on web only, where older Reanimated versions still need them.
- `ImageBackground` (deprecated in React Native 0.87) replaced with a `View` and an absolutely positioned `Image` in Panel2, Panel3, HueCircular and Preview.
- Input widgets no longer read shared values during render (Reanimated strict-mode warning) and no longer remount their inputs on every render.
- `ColorPickerRef.setColor` accepts every supported color format, not only strings.
- Panel2 and OpacitySlider animated styles declare the right dependencies.
- ExtraThumb worklets always call the latest `onChange` / `onComplete` callbacks, and negative hue transforms wrap around 360.
- Web keyboard handlers use the latest callbacks.
- LuminanceCircular normalizes the gesture angle after `rotate` is applied.
- Preview formats its initial color from the `value` prop.
- Panel2 accessibility label, and percentage spin scaling by hue.
- colorKit: decimal percentages are kept when parsing color strings; negative `spin` wraps below 0; manipulation methods are covered by tests.
- Deprecated `addWhitelistedNativeProps` call is guarded (no-op on Reanimated 4, still needed on Reanimated 3).

### Examples and docs

- ExampleLatest upgraded to React Native 0.87.1, ExampleExpoLatest to Expo SDK 57, ExampleOldArch builds with Xcode 26.
- The React Native examples run in the browser on the documentation site, and the docs are also published as markdown for LLMs.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/alabsi91/reanimated-color-picker/compare/v5.1.2...v5.1.3

2.3. Infinix (AOSP / XUI / XOS) and Tecno (AOSP / HiOS) detected by Android version.
2.4. Sony: notification LED emulation.
2.5. Fixes for MIUI, HTC Sense, TouchWiz, Xperia and AOSP. Tested on Nexus 4, Galaxy Nexus, Galaxy S II/S III, Redmi 1S, Desire HD, One M7, Nexus 5X, Phh 9, AOSP GSI 17.

_3. Import_
3.1. New formats: 7z, RAR, .pac, yaffs2, rfs, EROFS, super.img, APEX, .tar.gz.

_4. Features_
4.1. Internet works in more firmware.
4.2. Sound fixed; microphone, camera, accelerometer and vibration added.
4.3. Navigation bar: Back, Home and Recents work on every firmware.
4.4. ADB over the local network and a built-in ADB terminal.
4.5. Three-dot menu in a running system fixed: screenshots, screen recording, VNC, SMS, airplane mode, APK install and more.
4.6. The menu button can be moved in a running system.
4.7. Option to hide the LED indicator: in defaults for new systems and per system.

- **Image backgrounds for reading.** The built-in Image Background plugin turns any local PNG, JPEG or WebP into a reading theme. repo.description: Encrypted & Privacy First, On Android Device AI App

release.name: Tool Neuron v3.0 - Complete Rewrite
release.notes:
Tool Neuron v3.0 is a ground-up rewrite. Very little of the v2.x code survived. The old app could not honestly call itself privacy-first. Chat history sat on disk in plaintext. So did preferences. On a rooted phone or after a malicious app reinstall, everything was readable.

v3.0 fixes that at the foundation. Every byte the app persists lives inside an encrypted vault sealed under a key the OS will not hand to a different signer. Every gated feature is checked by native C++ code that returns a session token, not a Kotlin boolean. PIN entry runs Argon2id at t=4, m=128 MiB. There is a panic PIN that wipes the device. There is boot integrity, hook-baseline verification, frida and debugger detection. If any of it trips, the app exits the process.

The app now requires Android 12 (API 31) or newer. v2.0.3 dropped to Android 10 to support Note 9 users. v3.0 cannot. The security work depends on StrongBox and TEE attestation paths that on pre-API 31 either do not exist or are unreliable. The trade is worth it for the rest of the user base.

The APK in the asset is built from main, R8-minified, signed with the production key. It is 76 MB because it ships llama.cpp, sherpa-onnx, the Stable Diffusion runtime, and the full embedded HTTP server in one binary.


New in v3.0 (relative to v2.0.3)

App Guide. A multi-screen walkthrough covering chat, models, RAG, vision, voice, themes, lock, and the remote server. Reachable from the drawer.

Chat compact. When the conversation gets long, the user can fold older turns into a single LLM-generated summary card. The KV cache resets after compact so the next turn prefills against the summary only. Old messages stay visible (greyed out) and remain searchable, but the model only sees the summary going forward.

Fork from any message. Tap the fork action on any user, assistant, or compact-summary message and the chat clones up to that point into a new chat titled "<original> (fork)". Closes issue 76.

Edit any message. User and AI both. Ed

release.name: v0.9.3
release.notes:
**Please note:** The fix below has not been tried on a real AMD Radeon RX 7000 graphics card, because no such card was available while it was made. The cause was found in the graphics driver's own source code, and the game's drawing tests pass on the software graphics driver they run on. If the picture is still striped for you with Vulkan, please send `logs/ico-pc.log` from a start with Vulkan.

## Fixed

- On AMD Radeon RX 7000 graphics cards on Linux with the Mesa 25 drivers, Vulkan drew every other column of the picture black with bright dots, on every screen from the title on. The game left a blending setting from the previous drawing step in place while blending was off, and that driver treated the step as two-colour blending, which these cards handle by pairing neighbouring pixels. The game now clears the setting, so the picture is whole on those drivers too. OpenGL was not affected, and Mesa drivers from 26.2.4 on already drew it right. The game's start-up drawing check now also looks for this fault, and if a driver still shows it, the game switches to a slower way of blending that avoids it.

repo.description: 小米 / OPPO / vivo 等 ICCOA CarLink 手机投上车机：无线连接，无需转接盒、无需 root。Car-side ICCOA CarLink receiver for Xiaomi CarWith, OPPO Car+ and vivo Jovi InCar.

release.name: MiAuto 0.1.1
release.notes:
Wording only — behaviour is identical to 0.1.0.

## Why

ICCOA CarLink is a standard **jointly initiated by Xiaomi, OPPO and vivo**, and CarWith, OPPO Car+ 车联 and vivo Jovi InCar are three front ends on the same protocol. Describing the receiver as "Xiaomi CarWith only" understated what it actually speaks. 0.1.0's repository, README and download page were already corrected; this release carries the same wording into the parts that are **packaged inside the APK**.

## Changed

- Home screen: `da_description`, `da_hint` and the eyebrow label now name Xiaomi CarWith, OPPO Car+ and vivo Jovi InCar together, in all six languages.
- **Legal notice** (`da_legal`) in all six languages: now also states what ICCOA CarLink is — a jointly initiated in-car connectivity standard whose phone-side front ends are CarWith, Car+, and Jovi InCar — and lists OPPO and vivo next to Xiaomi, ICCOA, Google and BYD.
- About screen: the description and the "not affiliated with" line now cover OPPO and vivo as well.
- Support screen: `support_rules_phone_desc` asks for the version of the CarWith / Car+ / Jovi InCar app (3 languages).
- Added **Traditional Chinese home-screen strings** (`values-zh-rTW/diauto.xml`). They did not exist before, so a zh-TW device fell back to English for the whole home screen.

## Verified

Installed on a Newland NLS-MT9055-GL running Android 11 (arm64): installs, starts, advertises, shows a pairing code and reaches `onInitSuccess()` / `startAdvertise() = true`. Same as 0.1.0 — this release does not touch any behaviour.

## Not verified

Installation and pairing on a production BYD or other head unit, and the instrument cluster / HUD projection paths, which are carried over from the base project and have not been exercised together with MiAuto's protocol stack.

## Install

Download `MiAuto-0.1.1.apk` below and verify it against `MiAuto-0.1.1.apk.sha256`. It is signed with the same key as 0.1.0, so it installs over the previous version in place.
