repo.description: Unofficial YouTube Music / Spotify Premium client for Android, built in Liquid Glass. Audio effects, Spotify Connect, listening history, 8 languages. Rust core on librespot.

release.notes:
## Improved

- **Song rows are tighter**, so more of a playlist fits on screen. A record's numbered rows are packed closer than a playlist's, where every row has its cover.
- **A download waiting for Wi‑Fi says so.** With "Download over Wi‑Fi only" on, which it is unless you change it, a download asked for on mobile data waits for Wi‑Fi. Only the download notification used to say that; now the app tells you when you tap download, and where the setting is.

## Fixed

- **Signing in to YouTube Music could stop on "Webpage not available"**, when Google tried to send the phone on to the YouTube Music app. The sign-in now finishes (#110).
- **"Switch to offline mode" on YouTube Music showed the same spinner again** when nothing was downloaded. Offline, the library now shows the music on your phone straight away, and online it no longer waits for ever on a connection that does not answer.
- **Slowed, sped-up, remixed and other reworked uploads were replaced by the original song** in your YouTube Music playlists. They now play as you saved them; songs already swapped are looked at again.

## Which APK

- `square-2.6.3-arm64-v8a.apk`: almost every phone from the last few years.
- `square-2.6.3-armeabi-v7a.apk`: older or entry-level phones with a 32-bit processor.
- `square-2.6.3-universal.apk`: works on both, if you are not sure. It is larger.

The update offered inside the app picks the right one by itself.

## After installing

Android takes a while to optimise a freshly installed app, and until it does the interface is noticeably slower. To do it straight away, open the app once and give it a few seconds: that is when it hands Android the list of what to compile. Then, with the phone connected:

```
adb shell cmd package compile -m speed-profile -f dev.lelonio.square
```

Run before the app has been opened, the command finds nothing to compile and leaves it as it was.

## Questions and ideas

Ask in [Discussions](https://github.com/Lelonio/Square/discussions): questions

repo.description: Graphics API Manager for Android (GAMA)

release.name: v1.4
release.notes:
# GAMA v1.4 - Complete Detailed Changelog

**From v1.3 to v1.4**

**Scale of the change:** 34 → 67 main source files, ~14,600 → ~26,200 lines of app code; 0 → 4 translation files (~6,000 lines); 0 → 20 unit tests + 1 instrumentation test; 0 → full CI pipeline; 19 → 26 panel composables.

---

## 1. Architecture and code organisation

- The v1.3 monoliths were broken up further: `GamaComponents.kt` (2,935 lines) shrank to 115 lines, its contents redistributed into `GamaCards.kt`, `GamaButtons.kt`, `GamaTitle.kt`, `GamaSelectors.kt`, `GamaPanelScaffold.kt`, `PanelButtons.kt`, `GamaAnimations.kt`, `GamaHaptics.kt`, `GamaModifiers.kt`.
- New subsystems that did not exist in v1.3: `RendererState` / `RendererController` / `RendererSwitchStateMachine` / `RendererActionHistory` (renderer transaction core), `GamaLocalization` (i18n), `SettingsSearchPanel`, `SettingsHubPanel`, `TaskerAuth`, `ShizukuBackend`, `SupportBundle`, `OpenGLReminderWorker`, `GamaMatrixRain`.
- Dialog layer split: v1.3's `GamaDialogs.kt` became `GamaDialog.kt` (base modal), `GamaDialogs.kt`, `InfoDialogs.kt`, `WarningDialogs.kt`, `ActionDialogs.kt`.
- `GamaUI.kt` remains the largest file (4,391 lines) but is now mostly orchestration; all panels, cards, buttons, selectors, and animation primitives are extracted.

---

## 2. Navigation and panel framework

- **New unified `PanelScaffold`.** In v1.3 every panel re-implemented its own backdrop, padding, back button, and scroll handling. v1.4 has one scaffold used by all panels:
  - Full-screen `BouncyDialog` container; content scroll resets to top on open.
  - **Dismissal:** tap-outside only (gated by the new `dismiss_on_click_outside` preference, default on), floating back button, or system back. There is no drag-to-dismiss.
  - **Sub-dialog layering:** when a child panel/dialog opens, the parent dims to 38% alpha (`tween 300 ms emphasizedDecelerate` in, `190 ms` out) and, on API 31+, gets GPU `Modifier.blur(20.dp)` - blur radius del

release.name: v0.3.0
release.notes:
## 现代化重写

本版本完成了锤子音乐 UI 从 XML / Kotlin View 到 Jetpack Compose 的全量迁移与现代化重写，由 *GPT-6 Astra* 完成。迁移覆盖主壳、资料库、搜索、收藏、播放列表、设置和播放页。

Compose 使用声明式 Kotlin API 描述界面，减少了 XML 布局与 View 控件之间的样板衔接，也让 UI 状态、组件复用和后续交互迭代更加直接。

迁移过程中保留了原有视觉、交互、本地播放链路及用户数据兼容性。

## 主要更新

### Jetpack Compose

- 主壳、底部导航、标题栏、资料库、搜索、收藏、播放列表、设置和播放页全部使用 Compose 重新实现。
- 移除原有页面布局 XML、生产 UI View、Adapter 及旧的 framework shim。
- 使用自定义 Smartisan 组件呈现标题栏、列表、弹窗、开关、滚动条和播放控件。
- 保留原版资源和交互状态，不使用 Material 默认样式替代既有视觉。

### 功能与交互

- 保留本地歌曲扫描，以及歌曲、专辑、艺术家、流派和文件夹浏览。
- 保留排序筛选、字母快捷栏、资料库排除、多选滑选、滑动删除和系统授权删除。
- 保留后台播放、媒体通知、耳机与蓝牙控制、播放队列及进度恢复。
- 保留收藏、自建播放列表、播放统计、歌词、音效和睡眠定时。
- 保留黑胶唱盘、唱针拖拽、搓碟、爆豆音及播放页相关交互。

### 系统与工程

- 完成 edge-to-edge、系统栏、刘海、手势导航、三键导航、WindowInsets 和输入法避让适配。
- UI 使用公开 Android API，不依赖 Smartisan OS 私有服务或隐藏接口。
- 升级 Android Gradle Plugin 至 `9.3.2`。
- 升级 Gradle Wrapper 至 `9.5.0`。

**完整变更**：[v0.2.2...v0.3.0](https://github.com/Mangi-11/SmartisanMusic-Revived/compare/v0.2.2...v0.3.0)

# 红果短剧 v0.2.128

统一发布 Android、macOS、Windows、Linux AppImage 和 LG webOS 测试包。此版本修复系列剧播放完一季后的续播判断，并继续保留紧邻下一集的有限播放准备。

- 系列剧结束一季后以完整季列表为准选择下一季；待上线季保留预约入口，不跳过缺失或不可播放的季，也不使用不完整的关系响应猜测跳季。
- 标准版、MPV 版、桌面版和 webOS 继续共用相邻集预取协调逻辑，并按平台保留各自播放器适配器。

- 保留 Range/CENC 按需读取和边播边下路径，不下载整集作为切集前置条件。
- 标准版与 MPV 版继续保持独立包名、签名和更新渠道。webOS 有声倍速实验入口默认关闭。
- Linux AppImage 继续要求系统提供 WebKitGTK、GStreamer 和对应解码插件；Windows 播放 HEVC 需要系统 HEVC Video Extensions。

## Release

Stable release of Harness Remote `3.5.0`: the Android APK below, plus unsigned Windows, macOS and Linux desktop builds attached by the desktop workflow.

> **Harness Remote 3.5.0 keeps the whole machine responsive when one harness fails, and keeps Session activity accurate wherever work starts.**
> A missing or immediately exiting ACP adapter now reports its error without restarting the daemon. Turns started in a terminal or desktop client appear busy in Harness Remote, and background completions update the Session list promptly.

| | Improvement | What you see |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 🛡️ | **One failing adapter no longer takes the machine offline** | An unavailable CLI fails its own request while other harnesses remain reachable. |
| 🔴 | **Live activity across clients** | Codex and Claude Code Sessions started outside Harness Remote show as busy while they work. |
| ⚡ | **Faster, clearer startup** | An unreachable saved machine no longer holds up the machines and Sessions that are available. |
| 🌍 | **Brazilian Portuguese** | The app is now fully available in pt-BR. |

### Reliability when a harness fails

- **Adapter startup:** An ACP adapter that exits before the handshake, including a configured Copilot CLI that is no longer installed, can produce an `EPIPE` on stdin. a fighting game to be.

The problem was size. To rewind, rollback keeps dozens of snapshots of the
machine in memory, and a CPS-3 snapshot was enormous — it carried the entire
game loaded from the CD, tens of megabytes of code, graphics and samples that
never change while you play. Snapshots now leave all of that behind and keep
only what the game actually writes to. What used to be far past any sane limit
now fits with room to spare.

Games that already fit benefit too: smaller snapshots mean less memory and less
work on every correction.

## More games run in rollback

The host now hands its machine state to the joiner by default, so games that
used to refuse rollback because both sides could not be trusted to boot
identically now qualify.

## Sessions that used to break

**Joining and resyncing.** A drop-in join or a mid-game resync would sometimes
leave one machine frozen, or the joiner on a black screen, with nothing to do
but disconnect. The snapshot was being taken wherever the emulation happened to
be at that instant, sometimes in the middle of a frame with work still pending.
It is now always taken at the end of a frame, once the video chip has finished
and the interrupt queue is drained. The state that arrives is one the other
machine can actually resume from.

**Brief network drops.** Lose enough packets in a row and one frame would stay
a guess forever: the game kept running, quietly wrong, and the two sides drifted
apart over the next minutes. Th

# FlixQuest v4.3.0

FlixQuest now runs on its own accounts backend and has three new features: FlixQuest Plus for ad-free watching, FlixAI recommendations, and your own lists that you can share. - If you delete an account that still has credit, the app shows the balance and asks you first.

If you cant see CarStream because of Google blocking third party Android Auto Apps, this version will unlock Carstream on Rooted phones. Thanks to slashmax for figuring out the trick. Download the app-release.apk and install it.

1) Start Android Auto on your phone (the phone is not attached to anything at this time)
2) click on the menu on the top left (three bars)
3) Click "About"
The following steps may already be done. I am including them for reference for newbies.
4) If developer mode is not enabled, click on the bar "About Android Auto" 10 times.
5) click on the three dot menu (on the top right)
6) click on "Developer settings"
7) click on Application Mode and set to "Developer". Also go to the bottom of the developers settings and make sure "Unknown Sources" is checked.
8) click back, and then go to the three dot menu. Click "Start head unit server".
9) connect the phone to the computer, enable "USB debugging" in your phone's developer settings. This is different from Android auto developer settings.
10) open a command shell
11) type "adb forward tcp:5277 tcp:5277"
12) navigate to <sdk>/extras/google/auto. This is usually found at "c:\users\USERNAME\AppData\Local\Android\Sdk\extras\google\auto"
13) start the desktop head unit with the command "desktop-head-unit"
14) accept all the permissions, etc.

At this time you should see the typical head unit display that you would see in your car.

15) click on the lower right speedometer symbol (to return to Sync, or other OS).

you should see 'Carstream' listed. If it is not, click on "All car apps".

16) Click on Carstream. Your phone should prompt you to grant root access. Accept root access.
17) Stop the Desktop head unit (click the x on the top right).
18) go to your car. Turn on your car and connect your phone to start Android Auto. Accept all the permissions requests, etc.
19) Turn off your car. Disconnect your phone from Android Auto. 
20) Now, go to your apps, and start Carstream

release.name: Ventoid 0.4.0
release.notes:
## Ventoid 0.4.0

Ventoid 0.4.0 bundles Ventoy 1.1.18 and adds tools for inspecting and maintaining
prepared USB drives from Android.

**Recommended install:** [F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/packages/com.ventoid.app/) (build pending merge of [fdroiddata MR 52385](https://gitlab.com/fdroid/fdroiddata/-/merge_requests/52385)). The GitHub APK below uses a different signing identity than F-Droid; do not mix install sources. Verify downloads with SHA256SUMS.txt.

## Changes

- Refresh boot/core and VTOYEFI assets from the checksum-verified official Ventoy
  1.1.18 release. Update runtime digests, signed EFI pins, source provenance, and
  the F-Droid source-rebuild recipe together.
- Inspect existing Ventoy drives read-only, compare installed/bundled versions,
  and show exFAT image names, free space, and zero-byte-image warnings.
- Update Ventoy while preserving the ISO data partition and disk layout. Reject
  downgrades before writing and offer same-version boot-file repair.
- Support drives beyond 2 TiB with SCSI 16-byte commands and GPT, retaining the
  512-byte logical-sector requirement.
- Repair GPT BIOS boot pointers, validate reserved space before writing, sample
  written core/EFI sectors, and analyse the drive after installation.
- Show VTOYEFI transfer speed and estimated remaining time in the progress UI.

## Upstream Ventoy 1.1.18

The upstream release includes Windows/WinPE Secure Boot version-check and Ubuntu
persistence fixes, Linux remount improvements, Fedora/Grml boot fixes, and
experimental SteamOS recovery-image support. See the
[upstream release notes](https://github.com/ventoy/Ventoy/releases/tag/v1.1.18).
These changes are inherited through the bundled payload; individual ISO/firmware
compatibility still needs separate verification.

## Verification and Distribution

All 118 unit tests passed, including image generation from the actual prior
Ventoy 1.1.17 assets and data-marker preservation during MBR/GPT updates.

release.notes:
# FuseHide 1.191

- **Version:** `1.191`
- **VersionCode:** `191`
- **Commit:** [`a1d3c7a`](https://github.com/XiaoTong6666/FuseHide/commit/a1d3c7a7cd3afaf6f499d7d15756b93b3acbb877)
- **Build time:** `7m 24s`

## Assets

- `FuseHide_v191.apk`
- `FuseHide_Debug_v191.apk`
- `FuseHide-1.191_191-a1d3c7a-release.zip`

## SHA256

- Release: `fe7851878c3d98524dbab9453db2a53d65f15c88f9ca572de0030f9d7af662b4`
- Debug: `0e0f4dab71cf8ef27c12c366a51f7e484fde8a69dfde40a92b065a3d0daed9d1`
- Zygisk release: `fe7851878c3d98524dbab9453db2a53d65f15c88f9ca572de0030f9d7af662b4`

## Message

```text
fix(fusehide): Harden FUSE invalidation and hot reload, Meow

之前有些目录明明该隐藏，却会因为别的 UID 先访问过，就从 FUSE 缓存里漏出来喵（伸爪按住乱跑的 dentry）。这次把 lookup 和 READDIRPLUS 的缓存一起管好，不让不同 UID 再串缓存喵。

顺手理了理 Session 生命周期和失效队列，让通知跟着正确的 Session 代次走喵。热更新碰到 root_ino=0 时，会先查看 AOSP 和设备实际 libfuse_jni 的节点树喵（认真翻翻节点树）。只有确认这个 Session 没创建对应子节点、也没有缓存要清，才跳过没必要的根目录通知喵；有东西要清的还是照常处理喵。

另外补好了 KernelSU 热安装、模块操作和配置重载的细节喵。根 inode 和回调入口的诊断日志继续留着，但只在全局 Debug 开关打开时才打印，Release 就安静一点喵（把日志本收好）。测试源码也从 app/src/main 移走，不放进正式项目喵。

```

release.name: Droidline 0.1.11
release.notes:
## What's Changed

### New, all optional

Picture search for games and other screens without elements. Nothing changes until you use these.

- `image_exists(image)` answers `true` or `false` at once and never fails, for an `if`.
- `find_images(image)` returns every place the picture appears, best first and without overlaps, each with `x`, `y`, `bounds` and `score`. It answers at once unless `timeout` is set, and `max` caps the count (20 by default).
- `wait_image_gone(image)` waits until the picture leaves the screen, such as a loading spinner.
- `find_image`, `tap_image` and the three commands above take three options: - `region` searches only inside left, top, right, bottom, which is faster and keeps matches inside the box. - `scales` also tries the picture at other sizes, such as `[0.8, 1, 1.25]`, for phones with another screen density. - `color` also requires the average color to agree, so a red and a green button of the same shape differ.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/KnifeLemon/Droidline/compare/v0.1.10...v0.1.11

release.name: TeleDrive v1.5.0
release.notes:
## What's new

**Linux and macOS**
TeleDrive now runs on Linux and Apple Silicon Macs as well as Windows. Linux gets an AppImage that runs on most distros from 2022 or later, plus a `.deb` for Ubuntu 24.04 and Debian 13 or newer. Video and audio play inside the app on both, with VLC included. Linux support contributed by @indigo-steam (#53).

**Changes sync between devices live**
Renames, moves, deletes and folder changes made on one device now show up on your others within seconds, instead of only after a full rebuild (#74).

**Upload whole folders**
Pick a folder and TeleDrive uploads everything in it, keeping its subfolders as they are (#54).

**Offline files**
Mark files or folders **Available offline** to keep a copy on your phone. They get their own section on Home, are skipped by **Free up space**, and can be downloaded straight from the Gallery and search (#59, #70, #71).

**A better video player**
- **Picture-in-picture:** video keeps playing in a floating window when you leave the app (#58).
- **Controls:** the screen stays awake while playing, you can swipe for volume and brightness, and you can lock the controls (#57).
- **Audio formats:** AC3, EAC3 and DTS sound now play on any phone (#44).
- **Streaming:** single-part videos stream without downloading first (#47).
- **Decoder fallback:** if one video decoder can't handle a file, the next one on your phone is tried (#88).

**Progress in your notifications**
- **Transfers:** the notification shows which file is uploading or downloading, how many are left and how far along it is.
- **Saving changes:** large moves and renames show "Saving changes to Telegram" with a counter, and keep going after you close the app (#80).
- **Battery:** Settings → Permissions has a new **Unrestricted battery use** option, so the system doesn't stop these in the background.

**More languages**
Brazilian Portuguese, contributed by @iya0 (#42), and Simplified Chinese, contributed by @suiang (#67).

## Security update

This release includes platform security fixes for the compromised eMudhra intermediate certificates described in the [security advisory](https://blog.mozilla.org/security/2026/10/20/protecting-firefox-users-following-the-compromise-of-emudhra-intermediate-certificates/). An attacker with the affected signing keys could impersonate websites if they can intercept your connection.

It also fixes an Android startup issue that could delay applying the bundled certificate blocklist. Waterfox now loads the blocklist at startup, without waiting for a background update.

> [!NOTE]
> The blocklist loading issue was inherited from the upstream Android codebase. We prioritised getting this fix to Waterfox users as quickly as possible - Waterfox for desktop was not affected by this startup issue.

## Updated browser engine

Waterfox now uses Gecko `159.0`, up from `158.0`, with upstream security and website compatibility fixes.

## Waterfox changes

### Local crash reporting

Sentry is no longer bundled with Waterfox, and remote crash uploads are disabled. Crash records stay on your device.

We removed the settings and prompts for uploading crash reports. Previously saved reporting choices cannot enable uploads. Local crash recording and browser recovery remain available.

- Improved playback of some streaming videos, including AV1 video, and fixed missing audio in some protected streams.

# Patch Notes v0.2.0

Big update.  Below are slightly technical bullet points if you don't want to read this entire text. Reworked the cloud sync to prevent save files being overwritten with a new save. Now it uses progress-based checks instead of timestamp-based checks if auto-sync is on. Also added manual push/pull from cloud if you want to leave the auto sync off. 

Automatic save backups can now be turned on for both cloud and local saves, and are stored in an external folder (storage/emulated/0/StS2Launcher/Saves/). This does require external storage permissions but it is NOT necessary if you don't care about save backups. If you do want to enable save backups, tap on one of the push/pull buttons and it will ask you for read/write permissions.

Mod compatibility is also included in this release. Currently only works for v0.98.x of the game. StS2 v0.99.x removes the requirement of a .pck file so it may be necessary to update this again when v0.99.0 drops publicly. If you'd like to test out mods, place them in the storage/emulated/0/StS2Launcher/Mods/ folder that gets created after enabling storage permissions indicated above.

The Steam session has been reworked. Instead of a persistent connection at launch, it now uses an on-demand connection in case the user backgrounds the app or the network drops. Validation of game ownership has been changed from every 30 days to now only required once at first download. release.name: DSHBox v1.5.0
release.notes:
## v1.5.0（versionCode 9）— AI 浏览器助手、系统文件共享区与 DSH 界面交互升级

感谢你使用 DSHBox！如果使用中遇到问题或有改进建议，欢迎通过 [Issues](https://github.com/WSK-build/DSHBox/issues) 反馈——你的反馈会让它变得更好。

**新增**

#### Browser 模块

- **独立的内置浏览器**：新增全屏 Browser 工作区，提供前进、后退、刷新、地址输入、页面内查找、页面缩放、多页面管理和外部应用打开等常用能力。搜索引擎可选必应、谷歌、百度，默认必应；紧凑工具栏与可滚动菜单为网页保留更多显示空间。
- **DSH 网页助手工具**：新增 `browser-use` 适配插件与沙箱 CLI，向 DSH 开放 24 项工具，支持观察网页、读取内容、定位元素、点击、输入、滚动、导航及条件等待。新用户默认装配，可在 Cordis 面板独立开关；网页助手与操作手机原生应用的 Pilot 分工独立，由 DSH 选择调用。
- **网页窗口与事件**：支持管理网页打开的子页，将新窗口、网页对话框及下载事件与操作关联；自动弹窗受授权约束，已打开的子页可继续读取和操作。
- **元素与区域反馈**：顶部增加选取入口，可切换元素或区域模式；框选后添加评论，将页面信息、所选内容与截图提交给已绑定的 DSH 会话，便于 AI 看图分析、理解页面和继续操作。提供投递状态反馈。
- **沙箱本地网页预览**：支持通过 CLI 为沙箱内 HTML 等文件启动本地静态服务，也可登记已有开发服务，在 Browser 内打开预览；选区反馈可携带对应项目上下文，用于「制作网页—查看效果—框选评论—交给 AI 修改」的工作流程。
- **页面观察与调试**：提供 DOM、控制台、脚本求值和设备模拟等调试入口；在相应能力可用时，可通过网页辅助功能树（AX）补充观察和操作。支持有界滚动采集及结构化内容提取，返回采集范围与截断信息。
- **网络抓取与处理**：支持请求/响应、状态码、耗时、请求头、响应头、正文查看及 HAR 导出；可在单独授权下使用请求拦截、修改和重放，并记录、查看和导出 WebSocket 帧。正文与帧载荷按各自开关控制。
- **截图与后台执行**：支持前台与后台网页截图；普通后台截图失败时，在已开启高级调试的条件下串行尝试 CDP 后备，未开启时返回明确提示。后台打开网页和上传准备不主动把整个 Browser 页面拉到前台。
- **文件上传与下载**：提供下载任务及列表管理，可保存到手机、分享到其他应用或删除浏览器副本；上传支持由 AI 申请项目文件，显示目标站点和文件信息，经用户批准后交给网页文件控件。后台准备、用户批准与网页实际接收分别处理。
- **任务与控制权管理**：新增持久任务记录，可查看、编辑、删除及向 AI 发送续接摘要；用户接管 AI 操作前增加确认，AI 控制关闭时可发起控制权申请，由用户审批。
- **常用记录与设置**：提供持久历史记录、收藏夹、收藏切换、记录管理及浏览数据清理；支持移动、桌面、宽屏显示模式和可设置的闲置关闭时间。Browser 界面跟随应用的主题与六语选择。
- **界面与模块切换**：历史、收藏、下载和设置使用统一管理面板，菜单内部滚动，适应横屏及小窗口；提供 AI 活动提示，点击 AI 标记可快速返回 DSH。
- **会话与产物管理**：有效 AI 操作维持会话，隐藏后按设定的闲置时间关闭；截图、选区、上传副本及网络产物集中管理，纳入过期及缓存清理，用户下载和已导出文件按各自规则保留。
- **操作结果反馈**：工具返回页面状态与执行结果，区分明确失败和结果不确定；对过期页面引用、已变化节点及迟到回调作校验，为连续操作提供依据，避免直接重复可能已生效的动作。

#### 其他模块

- **新手安装引导页**：新增欢迎、Debian 安装、Node.js 安装、WebView 检测及完成提示组成的分步引导。安装页支持多镜像源探测与选择、阶段进度、失败重试，并按实际安装状态处理前置依赖与未完成安装；中途退出或安装尚未完成时，可继续补齐缺失层。
- **引导内的 WebView 版本探测提示**：展示当前 WebView 提供方、版本和 Chromium 主版本；版本偏低或检测失败时给出兼容性提示、升级建议及检测信息复制入口，帮助定位白屏、页面加载异常等问题。特性支持提示按版本推断，精确检测仍可进入诊断页。
- **系统文件共享区**：授权后在手机公共存储创建或沿用 **DSHBox** 专用文件夹，并映射到沙箱共享区。文件管理、DSH、终端

release.name: MasterDnsVPN-GG 1.1.1 — upstream v2026.05.10.180256-27c7e11
release.notes:
## MasterDnsVPN-GG 1.1.1
Upstream engine: `v2026.05.10.180256-27c7e11` · Commit: [`88fe4fef79b67ca98543d4ee58a85962857e5721`](https://github.com/RevocGG/MasterDnsVPN-AndroidGG/commit/88fe4fef79b67ca98543d4ee58a85962857e5721) · Build #16

### 📌 Resolver management moved to the Home screen (please read)
Starting with this version, resolvers are **no longer managed inside the profile editor** — they are managed from the new **Resolvers card on the Home screen**.

**Your data is safe:** existing profiles load exactly as before and their stored resolver lists are **kept and still used** whenever no Home-screen list is selected. Nothing is deleted during the update. (Backing up before updating is always a good habit anyway.)

How the new system works:
- Open the **Resolvers** card on the Home screen to create one or more named resolver lists (e.g. "Resolvers 1", "My list"), add resolvers by hand or **import** resolver files, and **export** any list to a file.
- Select **one or several lists** — every profile you start will use the selected lists (merged & deduplicated) instead of its own built-in text.
- If **no list is selected**, profiles automatically fall back to the resolver list stored inside the profile (the old behavior).
- **Best Match** is an automatic list: while a profile is running, the engine continuously scores resolvers (ACK success rate + latency) and keeps the best ones. Persistently failing resolvers are pruned automatically, so the list always reflects the resolvers that actually work for you right now.
- Starting a profile with no selected list shows a hint asking you to pick or create one first.

### ✨ What's Changed
**Tunnel / engine (Go layer of this app):**
- Cancelled uploads no longer leave orphan streams: TUN-bridge relays now honor cancellation, per-write deadlines and an idle watchdog — the tunnel (and server CPU/RAM) is released promptly instead of retrying for an hour (TUN and SOCKS modes).
- SOCKS5 authentication path fix

## Note from BrutalCoding
This release was manually made instead of automatically deployed with a proper CI/CD workflow.

No idea what that meant? That's fine. In the near future, I'd like to have all of the supported platforms included as a GitHub Release.
For the time being, I have manually built & uploaded a few files just to get at least 1 pre-compiled (ready-to-go) app out in the wild.

## Instructions
Inside the zip *macOS_AubAI.app.zip* file, you should see one file: *AubAI.app*. Double click to open and try out any <filename.gguf> which is the AI / LLM model that can be found on websites such as HuggingFace.co. The example app is using ChatML as the prompt template which cannot be changed within the app yet.

## Supported Architectures
- M family (M1, M2, M3) (Apple Sillicon)
- Intel

## Reminder for Flutter Devs
If you're a (Flutter) developer, remember that you can still try the app on any platform. What you need to do is navigate to the `example/` directory and like any other Flutter app, execute:`flutter run`.

release.notes:
# Obsidian Music v2.5.1 🚀

Obsidian Music **v2.5.1** brings studio-grade **Lossless FLAC playback**, complete **YouTube playlist importing**, seamless **real-time lyrics**, crystal-clear **album artwork**, and major performance and battery optimizations!

---

### 🎧 What's New & Highlights

* **Studio-Grade Lossless FLAC**:
  - Added native **Lossless FLAC 24-bit** (studio master) and **16-bit** (CD quality) playback tiers.
  - Reordered Audio Quality settings with **24-bit Lossless** at the very top, followed directly by **16-bit Lossless**, Obsidian Dolby Atmos, True Dolby Atmos, and OPUS tiers.

* **Crystal-Clear Album Artwork**:
  - Fixed blurry and low-resolution cover art across all screens with high-resolution artwork decoders.
  - Optimized artwork RAM caching to prevent stutter and memory pressure when browsing large libraries.

* **Synchronized Lyrics & Zero-Gap Flow**:
  - Fixed lyrics line timing drift and awkward gaps during track switches and crossfade transitions.
  - Added smooth animated interlude dots during instrumental sections.
  - Improved scroll smoothness and typography contrast in full-screen lyrics.

* **Unlimited YouTube Playlist Imports**:
  - Fixed playlist import limits and crashes on large playlists—now seamlessly imports 500+ tracks with exact track count accuracy.
  - Improved background import stability and deduplication.

* **Performance, Stability & Bug Fixes**:
  - Fixed player metadata freeze when rapidly skipping tracks.
  - Reduced battery consumption and optimized background wake-lock handling.
  - Removed verbose debug logging in release builds for faster execution and leaner size.
  - Verified 100% test pass rate with zero crashes.

repo.description: Modular Windows/Android toolkit for Arknights: Endfield: BEM model mods and creator tools, native plug-ins, MMD playback, camera/UI controls, character voices, title-screen customization, and PC combat/gacha tools.

release.name: Better Endfield Next 4.1.1 / BEM Tools 1.6.3
release.notes:
Better Endfield Next **4.1.1** 与 BEM Tools **1.6.3**，带来昼雪免校验骨骼兼容修复、安卓界面重构与英文本地化、安卓端管理员外观对齐、持续冲刺支持「祀」、材质包加载提速、BEM Tools 22 个证据门控修复子命令与 DeepSeek Harness 创作者插件。

## Windows 4.1.1 & Android 4.1.1

- **修复昼雪旧模型包在 4.1.0 或免校验模式下的左手骨骼错位问题**：
  - 修复开启「关闭模型校验」（skip_validation）或普通名称匹配时条件短路导致昼雪专属 1.6.3 兼容与骨骼重排被跳过的问题；
  - 强制识别昼雪旧包并无条件执行 1.6.3 规范化与 10 槽位骨骼重排，彻底解决人物自身左手大拇指、食指严重扭曲与中指变形问题；
  - 补全测试套件中免校验场景下的昼雪回归断言，恢复自动化防护网。

- **安卓界面重构：主页改为「启用功能一览」**：
  - 主页只列出已开启的功能并显示实时状态（替换角色与动作、主题色、自定义配音角色数、已开启的界面与相机项、冲刺角色、悬浮窗透明度、当前 MMD 作品），点击直达对应设置页；
  - 未启用的功能不再出现在主页，入口集中在「增强功能」页；第三方模型单独保留一个主页入口；
  - 顶部导航收敛为「主页 / 增强功能 / 关于」，开屏模型、第三方模型、角色配音作为二级页面收进增强功能，二级页提供返回入口，系统返回键先回主页。
- **安卓端接入「管理员外观」模块**（与桌面端能力对齐）：
  - 宏愿武器、管理员服装、战斗与剑光特效三块各自独立开关；武器样式可选「宏愿 · 剧情水墨流光 / 原版默认外观」，角色形态可选「剧情水墨专属服装 / 剧情摘面具形态 / 原版默认形态」；
  - 配置键位与桌面端完全一致，原生模块按桌面源码原样进 NDK 构建；主页功能一览按细粒度开关动态汇总。
- **持续冲刺新增「祀」支持（双端对齐，默认关闭）**：
  - 基于 Issue #32（zhuran24）逆向研究成果精简实现。采用原生 Animator 状态回绕与坐骑墨兽同帧 CrossFade 协同驱动，伴随墨兽自适应回绕；首次回绕后自动冻结墨兽消散时钟并抑制收尾水花，全程奔跑不溶解、不脱节；
  - 纯轻量化逻辑，无需额外打包骨骼或附属件数据文件，双端设置页均提供开关，默认保持关闭。
- **安卓界面英文本地化**：
  - 系统语言为英文时，主页、增强功能、开屏模型、第三方模型、角色配音、MMD 作品库、会客室媒体屏、关于页以及游戏内悬浮窗全部切换为英文；中文环境行为与文案完全不变；
  - 角色名沿用桌面端官方英文名（如洁尔佩塔 Gilberta、梨诺 Reno、祀 Si），角色配音列表与开屏模型的角色名同步英文化；
  - 依赖中文字面量判断的操作状态栏显隐改为结构化标志，避免本地化后错误状态无法提示。
- **赞助面板新增 Ko-fi**：
  - 桌面端与安卓端赞助面板新增 Ko-fi（https://ko-fi.com/hydra405），与微信赞赏、爱发电、PayPal 并列。
- **材质包加载提速**：
  - 修复不带动画驱动的纯材质包加载时明显卡顿的问题。原因是加载过程中每处理一个材质、每构建一张贴图都要写一条日志，而日志器每次都重新打开一次文件；在开启实时防护的 Windows 上，单条日志耗时可达 10 ms 量级，上百个材质的包会白等数秒；
  - 日志器改为常驻文件句柄，逐材质、逐贴图的明细日志改为按组件、按上传事务汇总。实测单条日志成本降至原来的约 1/500，材质包加载不再被日志拖慢；
  - 诊断信息没有减少：贴图格式与尺寸、材质覆盖条数与属性总数、本次加载的贴图格式分布都保留在汇总行里。

## BEM Tools 1.6.3

- **修复工具重写**：`bem_repair.py` 重写为 22 个证据门控子命令，覆盖索引越界、超大贴图、INI 重复段、条件贴图、蒙皮调色板、合并骨架、入口程序、贴图覆盖、角色资料缺口、形变校验、选项空间、CrossIB 分组等常见源包缺陷。每个命令要么给出带数字的判定，要么以明确错误码拒绝，不会悄悄产出一份错包；所有写入都要求显式输出路径，输入文件永不修改。
- **形态键可直接转成滑条**：新增 `shape-params`，从源 INI 的 ShapeKey 缓冲生成 BEM 1.3 参数通道，用中性帧与满权重帧覆盖整个权重范围，源常量作为滑条初始值。
- **随包附带材质属性名字典**：`catalog/material-attributes.json` 收录 9 个 shader 的 119

# HyperChanger v1.2.1

**HyperChanger 1.2.1 正式版发布！**

这是一个面向小米 HyperOS 4（Android 17）系统的 LSPosed 自定义模块。本版本在 1.2.0 的基础上，进一步扩展通知中心、柔光玻璃、超级岛与背屏自定义能力，加入系统框架设置、模块安全与日志管理，并完善状态栏、锁屏快捷功能和应用导航的显示与交互。

**新增**

* `Feature` 完全重构柔光玻璃参数调整，包含全新的内置、用户预设，支持玻璃光学、背景模糊、缩放、不透明度及颜色混合等参数，并且为多个场景接入了新的柔光玻璃参数。
* `Feature` 新增 iOS 风格通知中心的通知横条，可自定义图标、文字、缩放与间距，以及清除按钮的样式、圆角和背景材质；支持添加锁屏左右快捷按钮，并单独调整快捷按钮模式下的通知底部偏移。
* `Feature` 新增超级岛模拟，覆盖文本、通话、配送、进度、电影物流、运动健康、预约、文件分享、待支付订单和验证码等场景，支持自定义内容、图片、外发光及同步发送到背屏。
* `Feature` 新增人脸解锁岛动画、首次悬浮及解锁成功后保持显示等选项，扩展焦点通知与超级岛认证限制解锁，并支持展开态超级岛独立柔光玻璃参数。
* `Feature` 新增系统框架设置，提供多小窗、强制小窗、记住小窗状态与位置、贴边小窗后台活动、音量即时调整、高音量提示控制、强制深色模式、原生安装器、即时截屏及任意界面截屏等选项；系统框架功能设置后至少需要软重启才能生效。
* `Feature` 新增模块安全页面，提供模块总开关、系统界面安全模式与按功能分区停用；支持日志级别与标签筛选、保留期限、清理及 ZIP 保存分享，导出日志附带设备、系统、框架与作用域应用版本信息；允许热重载进程，需要框架支持，并非所有设置均可通过热重载生效。
* `Feature` 新增系统设置入口文案、模块入口名称、处理器图标及音效徽标自定义，扩展刷新率选项、定时抬起亮屏、BOSE 音效和部分国际版设置页面等功能。
* `Feature` 新增超级小爱悬浮输入框柔光玻璃效果，支持独立调整模糊、折射、柔光、饱和度与亮度。
* `Feature` 新增背屏左滑启动应用、允许所有 Activity 在背屏打开，以及网易云音乐迷你播放器投放；播放器适配网易云音乐 9.5.37，需启用网易云音乐与背屏作用域，并在设备解锁后使用。
* `Feature` 新增背屏带壳截图外壳自定义，支持聚焦与完整样式、图片或 ZIP 导入、预览、命名保存、应用及 PNG 导出。
* `Feature` 新增腾讯会议与招商银行底部导航适配，支持原生标签与点击行为衔接；招商银行适配基于 14.4.6，其他版本需验证。

**变更与优化**

* `UI/UX` 新增首页设置搜索，可按名称、描述或作用域查找入口；整理通知、超级岛、状态栏、控制中心及模块设置分组，完善更新提示与设置后的作用域重启建议。
* `Optimize` 扩展控制中心各类卡片、按钮、音量与亮度条的圆角调节；顶部按钮提供独立设置页面，支持横屏显示、图标缩放及纯色、高级材质、柔光玻璃背景，玻璃参数可独立配置或跟随全局。
* `Optimize` 扩展音量条宽高、圆角、静音与勿扰按钮显隐、展开按钮显隐及长按展开设置，并完善音量面板的柔光玻璃参数调整。
* `Optimize` 扩展锁屏快捷按钮背景、尺寸、间距与长按手势，锁屏胶囊可独立调整柔光玻璃参数；新增锁屏通知底部偏移、通知文本颜色与通知堆叠模糊设置。
* `Optimize` 完善 Rust 桌面 Dock、文件夹间距与桌面材质适配，支持桌面和 Dock 的柔光玻璃参数来源选择，并改进原生配置传输与旧设置迁移。
* `Optimize` 新增状态栏资源导入、图标间距与电池百分比显示选项，状态栏与控制中心可分别选择电池百分比样式；完善微博等应用的导航栏识别、选中状态与页面底部留白处理。
* `Optimize` 优化iOS 风格通知中心的横屏显示效果。
* `Optimize` 优化首页、设置页以及部分二级界面的分组与设置项目，提高模块的易用性。

**修复与重构**

* `Fix` 修复 iOS 风格通知中心与控制中心切换、收起或关闭功能后，壁纸模糊和材质层可能残留并遮挡桌面、悬浮通知的问题，完善原生材质恢复顺序。
* `Fix` 修复状态栏与控制中心采用不同电池百分比样式时，控制中心收起过渡中的样式切换问题；修复双排信号模式下独立网络类型未正确跟随当前数据卡显示的问题。
* `Fix` 修复锁屏快捷按钮长按手势绑定、玻璃尺寸与材质重复调整问题，完善 AOD

release.notes:
### v1.5.8 更新摘要

#### 新增与完善

* **新增桌面图标感知光影**：开启后，桌面图标的投影会跟随当前环境的天气、光照情况以及手机握持视角动态变化。开启此功能会增加桌面耗电。
* **新增状态栏高设置**：状新增态栏和dock栏高度自定义调节。
* **新增T9键盘输入法**：搜索界面支持T9原版输入法，默认开启，关闭后将使用手机自动输入法。
* **新增桌面设置过渡动画**：桌面设置打开、关闭支持过渡动画，默认跟随系统。
* **新增密码与按键反馈**：补齐隐私密码错误时的原版提示、红点、摇动和按键按下状态反馈，并统一锁屏验证页与设置验证页的提示几何。
* **新增默认应用图标框**：修复 DEFAULT 自适应圆形图标四端平边、原版图标 MD5 命中时不必要的重试；跟进主题切换后的状态栏颜色和在线图标备份。
* **新增应用图标和图标包搜索**：支持快速搜索应用和搜索在线图标、图标包的功能，方便修改应用图标。
* **桌面图标优化**：优化桌面图标边缘模糊的问题。
* **桌面主题界面优化**：桌面主题新增自动补位功能，屏幕上下滚动左右两侧一致。
* **解锁动画优化**：强迫症选项新增解锁动画兼容开关，开启后解锁动画略微提前播放。
* **四指横滑切换主题优化**：修复oriain os下，桌面四指横滑切换主题后状态栏颜色不跟随的问题。
* **搜索页面图标逻辑修复**：修复微信分身关闭后，搜索界面微信图标不显示的问题。
* **备份界面优化**：增加备份/恢复共用预览、归档设置清单、快捷桌面配置与在线图标归档；兼容旧备份和包名式图标文件名，单个损坏或缺失图标不再使整份归档失败。
* **多处界面细节优化**：加载动画去除底部文字，多处功能改名并增加描述、翻页动画界面细节优化。
* **优化系统稳定性和流畅度**：增加系统稳定性，优化桌面设置，单页面与多页面切换卡顿的问题。

repo.description: A MIUI / HyperOS-style Android music player with local playback, remote sources, online sources, word-by-word lyrics, floating lyrics, and FFmpeg decoding.

release.notes:
From `1.2.9` to `1.3.0` — 播放、歌词与曲库更新 / playback, lyrics, and library updates.

## 中文更新日志

### 歌词

- 立体歌词与边缘虚化改用单一图层的原生图像滤镜，移除递归录制歌词内容的多层渲染链，修复图层树递归导致的 RenderThread 栈溢出风险。
- 多选列表支持长按后连续拖选，覆盖歌曲、专辑、艺术家、分类、歌单、文件夹歌单、搜索和最近播放；支持边缘自动滚动与回拉收缩范围，保留此前选择与排序把手。
- 多选界面、歌词分享、备份类型和模块排序等选择面板增加反选；仅反转当前可选范围，保留其他范围的选择及数量上限。
- 绘光主歌词唱完后保持正常排版，装饰词片沿光场缓慢漂移并在有限时间内淡出，避免长期散落堆积在一侧。
- #716：恢复原有底栏交互，页面左右滑动完成后及时同步气泡位置，不再触发模拟按压放大；底栏拖动仍在松手后切换页面。
- 平板首页默认显示 8 个快捷按钮，功能块排除快捷区已有项目；保留手动配置。海报卡片修正标题分隔符，左右切歌复用已加载封面并避免旧播放状态覆盖新卡片。
- 艺术家传记增加名称匹配替换规则，可单独开关并指定数据源；按别名、原名、繁转简名称依次匹配，接入备份恢复。
- 液态底栏从 Miuix 0.9.4 的 Apache-2.0 示例重新适配，替换旧 GPL 动画与手势文件，保留外观设置与电视交互；增加来源与许可证检查。

- 海报墙点击封面只展开卡片，暂停时滑动切歌仍保持暂停；隐藏底部迷你播放条。堆叠布局缓存几何数据，弹窗与滑动使用稳定布局的图层动画，降低重复排版和解码开销。
- 凝彩、绘光、回环和商籁补齐逐字羽化扫光；凝彩黑白字按实际背景区域反转，回环保留英文词间空格，商籁保持歌词正常阅读角度，时计相邻歌词支持换行。
- 自定义分类条目使用卡片，删除按钮与箭头垂直对齐。
- SMB、WebDAV、FTP / FTPS 和 SFTP 音乐库扫描只建立目录索引，按需读取当前歌曲元数据；SMB / FTP / SFTP 播放流增加 256 KiB 有界缓冲以减少小块读取的网络往返，WebDAV 移除目录预取并沿用 HTTP 流缓冲，清理旧的大量元数据缓存。

- 歌词页补回立体歌词开关，并与播放页歌词显示菜单共用实时设置；角度也同步。补齐 AM 普通、沉浸、横屏和独立歌词页的立体效果；顶部信息区与底部控制区的边缘虚化固定在视口，立体旋转后仍有柔和过渡。

- 首页在线音乐移除 WebDAV；音乐来源只显示当前来源设置。频谱查看新增每次询问，内置频谱可调用其他应用。
- 海报墙堆叠保留适当间隙并错落排列；下层封面长按松手可置顶，拖动可在同组任意层插入或换组，每组最多 10 张并保存层序。播放保留原完整弹窗，后方叠放相邻弹窗，左右滑动切歌，移除上一曲和下一曲按钮。
- 对照 Folia 重做凝彩的大色块逐字拼贴、绘光的光场与飘散径迹、回环的倾斜椭圆字素环；新增商籁的大小字穿插与几何线稿。保留全局字体和独立歌词配色。
- 全局搜索返回进入前的底栏页面，悬浮底栏的返回图标与目标一致；远程曲库搜索、音质和红心筛选合并后台标签更新，保留完成结果，避免筛选进度反复重置。

- 修复 TTML 重叠演唱和逐字 LRC/ELRC 的多行高亮；拉长音文字与发光同步逐字羽化，限制旧播放采样停滞时的时钟提前。
- Beautiful Lyrics 背景支持非当前行歌词模糊，补齐设置与音频信息页面的应用字体。
- 歌词分享新增旧版 1.2.7、Spotify、杂志、电影感、拍立得、书法等样式；旧版补齐圆角，网易云样式支持 Halcyon 或自定义署名。

- 彩虹色歌词改为整句渐变：当前高亮行共用一条七彩光谱，每个字只取自己所在位置的色段，逐字不再各自循环一遍彩虹，长时间观看不再晃眼睛。

### 音乐库与扫描

- 首页支持按任意歌曲标签配置自定义分类（如编曲家 / ARRANGER），接入显示与排序及 JSON / ZIP 备份恢复；流派、年份和自定义分类可批量写入对应标签，分隔符设置统一为可保存或取消的底部面板。

- WebDAV、SMB、FTP / FTPS 和 SFTP 支持在音乐库设置中管理，递归扫描共享目录、搜索、分类及连续播放；SFTP 支持服务器密钥指纹确认与变化拦截。
- 搜索「所有」页的文件夹歌单分类默认开启，兼容旧分类设置和备份；修复 Release 混淆导致艺术家传记的繁转简匹配组件初始化失败。
- 空曲库可以下拉刷新，修正空状态说明；音质筛选使用底部面板并实际应用到曲库。
- 曲库分析与音质筛选复用缓存，减少重复构建；双指缩放进入详

repo.description: 逆向复活锤子天气，使用现代 Android 技术栈重写，并更换天气数据源

release.name: v0.3.0
release.notes:
## 现代化重写

本版本使用 *GPT-6 Astra* 完成了锤子天气 UI 从 XML / Kotlin View 到 Jetpack Compose 的全量迁移与现代化重写。迁移覆盖主天气、城市搜索、城市管理、天气预警、首次说明、应用内弹窗和桌面小组件配置页。

Compose 使用声明式 Kotlin API 描述界面，减少了 XML 布局与 View 控件之间的样板衔接，让 UI 状态管理、组件复用和后续交互迭代更加直接。

迁移过程中保留原版视觉资源与核心交互，并完善了定位权限、定位刷新及现代 Android 系统适配。

## 主要更新

### Jetpack Compose

- 全部应用页面使用 Compose 重新实现，保留多 Activity 页面结构。
- 使用 Compose Foundation、Canvas 和自定义 Smartisan 组件呈现标题栏、天气卡片、列表、弹窗及温度动画。
- 保留原版 PNG、NinePatch、按压反馈和日夜资源。
- 移除旧页面布局 XML、View 控件、Adapter 及冗余映射代码，清理 312 个未使用资源。

### 功能与交互

- 保留城市滑动切换、边界阻尼、温度滚动、摄氏／华氏切换及天气背景过渡。
- 保留城市拖拽排序、浮层阴影、边缘滚动、取消恢复和确认保存。
- 保留城市搜索的弹性滚动、回弹和按压反馈。
- 修复统一弹窗在 Compose 迁移后圆角裁剪不一致的问题。
- 修复深色天气卡片底部黑边。

### 定位与刷新

- 修复无法申请精确定位权限的问题，同时支持大致位置授权。
- 完善定位权限说明、精度提升和系统定位服务提示。
- 优化多定位来源的并发获取与结果筛选，减少过期位置对刷新结果的影响。
- 修复重新定位到同一城市时天气未及时刷新的问题。
- 完善返回前台后的定位更新，以及定位失败时的天气刷新处理。

### 系统与工程

- 统一系统导航栏沉浸显示，完善系统栏、刘海与输入法避让。
- 大窗口下背景铺满窗口，天气内容保持最大 480dp 居中显示。
- 使用生命周期感知的状态收集与协程任务管理，完善后台取消和前台恢复。
- 更新 Android 构建工具链与 Compose 依赖。

完整变更：https://github.com/Mangi-11/SmartisanWeather-Revived/compare/v0.2.0...v0.3.0

release.notes:
# MeshLive 0.4.1-beta

Open-source build signed with the project's release key, the same key Google Play uses for MeshLive.
Application id: `io.github.meshlive.app`. Source: tag `v0.4.1-beta` in this repository.
Licence: GPL-3.0-or-later; the full text is in `LICENSE` and third-party licences are in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` of the source.

## What changed

- **Hide phone name is now on by default.** Setup asks about it, and you can change it later in Settings > Privacy. MeshLive keeps your phone's own name and puts it back when you turn the option off.
- **If your phone is stuck as "Phone":** Settings > Privacy shows a line under Hide phone name. Tap it to set your phone's name again.
- **Whole picture in calls:** when the other side's video is a different shape, you see all of it with black bars. Double-tap to fill the screen.
- **Calls from OPPO A15s-class phones** work again.
- **Privacy:** fixed a problem when sharing the app.
- **Clearer messages:** a clearer "Call link lost" message.
- **Permissions:** setup explains each permission before Android asks for it.

## Which file to download

| File | ABI | versionCode | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `MeshLive-0.4.1-beta-arm64-v8a.apk` | arm64-v8a | 72 | `b9d5761e2ce88a27a0327f8a916d28baa1cdee19dd16f27337937c143e8b2206` |
| `MeshLive-0.4.1-beta-armeabi-v7a.apk` | armeabi-v7a | 71 | `96c29f3e1f9dcd4828c337145ae3eb23aee7c1175f07df190e1f740ed1a11611` |
| `MeshLive-0.4.1-beta-universal.apk` | universal | 70 | `c9540b57e528dfd0d6f5abb27f6ecdace4389b45645c23a171b74cf35359d1b7` |

`MeshLive.apk` is the same file as the arm64-v8a APK, for the download button and Obtainium.

- **arm64-v8a**: Almost every phone sold since about 2016 (64-bit ARM). Pick this one if unsure.
- **armeabi-v7a**: Older or 32-bit-only ARM phones (some Android Go models). A 64-bit phone can also run it, but it is slower and Android will not move it to the 64-bit build by itself.
- **universal**: Both libraries in one larger file, for sideload

repo.description: Static recompilation of The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild (Switch 1.0.0 / 1.6.0 / 1.8.2) for Android - no game files included

release.name: BOTWRecompAndroid 0.2.2 (beta 15): modo nativo / native mode
release.notes:
**Beta 15.** Chegou o **modo nativo (experimental)**: o código do jogo roda direto na CPU do celular, sem compilar nada.

## Novidades

### Modo nativo (experimental)

Até agora, configurar o jogo significava compilar o código dele no próprio celular: uma espera longa, o aparelho quente, e em alguns celulares a compilação nem chegava ao fim. O Switch e os celulares Android usam processadores ARM64, então o código original do jogo pode rodar direto na CPU. O app só ajusta, ao carregar, as poucas instruções que dependem do Switch (chamadas ao sistema, registradores das threads, o relógio).

- **Sem compilação:** no modo nativo, a configuração só copia os arquivos do jogo. Para quem nunca conseguiu terminar a compilação, pode ser a saída.
- **Como escolher:** em Arquivos do jogo, a nova opção **Código do jogo** vem antes da pasta: *Recompilado* (como antes: o celular compila o código uma vez) ou *Nativo (experimental)*.
- **Dá para alternar:** quem configurou como Recompilado pode ligar o nativo a qualquer momento em Vídeo > Código nativo do jogo (experimental). Quem configurou só como Nativo precisa compilar se depois quiser o Recompilado.
- **Estado:** joga-se do título ao mundo, com saves e reinício, na 1.9.0 e na 1.0.0. A 1.6.0 e a 1.8.2 ainda não foram testadas. O FPS fica parecido com o do Recompilado, mas oscila um pouco mais. O Link às vezes pisca num golpe, e as "cortinas" do terreno aparecem com mais frequência. Se algo der errado, conte numa issue com o log (Configurações > Arquivos > Salvar arquivo de log).

![Código do jogo](https://github.com/mamcjr/BOTWRecompAndroid/releases/download/v0.2.2-beta/game-code.png)

A ideia veio do [MacNativeGames](https://github.com/ly05010419/MacNativeGames), do [totk-mobile](https://github.com/OJZen/totk-mobile) e do [d2r-mobile](https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/d2r-mobile), que rodam o código de BOTW e TOTK assim no Mac e no iPhone.

release.notes:
# ArasClient v1.8.2

Two rounds since **v1.8.1**: the ECH (Encrypted Client Hello) work for the
Xray profiles, and WireGuard/AmneziaWG dialled by the core like every other
protocol. Everything from v1.8.1 and earlier is described in the
[v1.8.1 release notes](https://github.com/ArasTey/ArasClient/releases/tag/v1.8.1).

## 🕵️ ECH: the key lookup can now ride through its own outbound

Plain-DNS ECH key lookups are being blocked in some places while ECH itself
still works (cloudflare-ech.com answers). The lookup needs a path of its own,
and the app now has one:

- **Two fields on TLS profiles** (VMess / VLESS / Shadowsocks / Trojan, and
  Hysteria2): `echConfigList` — the key source — and **`echOutbound`**, the ECH
  outbound as raw JSON. The Aether profiles keep their own ECH fields (ECH DNS
  / ECH domain) from v1.8.1; this one is for the Xray protocols.
- **The recipe** (from the core's author):

  ```json
  echConfigList: h2c://1.1.1.1/dns-query
  ```

  ```json
  echOutbound:
  {"tag":"tls-repack-dns","protocol":"freedom","settings":{"redirect":"1.1.1.1:443"},"streamSettings":{"security":"tls","tlsSettings":{"serverName":"www.microsoft.com","verifyPeerCertByName":"fromMitm,www.microsoft.com","alpn":["fromMitm"],"fingerprint":"chrome"}}}
  ```

- **What the app does with it**: the ECH outbound is appended to the generated
  configuration exactly as written, and the profile's TLS settings get
  `echSockopt.dialerProxy` pointing at it — so the ECH key query leaves
  through that masked outbound (a TLS connection to a public resolver with a
  borrowed SNI and a certificate checked by name) instead of a plain DNS
  query. The profile's own handshake then uses the fetched key, and the real
  server name stays hidden.
- **The guards**: the ECH outbound must be a JSON object, must come with an
  echConfigList, and needs a tag of its own — not `direct`, `block` or
  `exit-node`, and not starting with `proxy` (balancers pick their members by

release.name: v1.6.9
release.notes:
# Release v1.6.9

> 数据安全版本：未编辑的「打开 → 保存」不再改动文件；修复 frontmatter、图片路径/标题、列表与结尾换行的 round-trip 损坏；代码块改为按需挂载，冷启动创建耗时 1058→281ms。

## 更新日志 2026-10-22

### 🛡️ 文件安全与 round-trip

- **打开再保存不再改写文件**：未做任何编辑时，保存直接跳过写盘，换行与序列化规范化都不会落到用户文件；round-trip 判据 41/41 逐字节一致。编辑过的块仍只做语义等价的规范化（不改变渲染），未触及内容由增量合并保留。
- **Frontmatter 原样保留**：修复首篇文档在编辑器创建前走 `ensureEditor`、绕过 frontmatter 拆分的问题——此前 YAML 头会被当成分隔线和正文渲染，保存后写成 `***` + 列表。
- **图片行不再被写坏**：相对图片只把路径改写成渲染用代理 URL，序列化时还原；旧逻辑会把 `"图片标题"` 一并吞进路径，导致图片加载失败、标题丢失、保存后路径永久损坏。
- **列表与结尾**：紧凑/松散列表、任务列表、有序列表起始号（`3.` 不再变 `1.`）保持原样；以列表结尾的文档不再多出空行。
- **第一笔编辑不再丢失**：修复打开文档后立即输入或点工具栏时，第一笔修改被初始化闸门静默吞掉的问题。

### ⚡ 性能

- **代码块按需挂载**：离屏代码块不再在打开文档时创建 CodeMirror，进入视口或点按时才挂载；受控 A/B 中 `crepe.create()` 1058→281ms。
- **渲染收尾消除布局抖动**：冷路径 sync 251→63ms。
- **HTML 块改真节点**：不再为每个 HTML 块创建 CodeMirror，挂 DOM 成本 +4.26→+0.03ms/块。
- **同步路径减负**：去掉每个代码块的 ProseMirror 反查与重复样式写入；activeHints 改为 O(1)。

### 🧩 渲染修复

- 切换 UI 档位后 HTML 块不再整片空白（overlay 与 MutationObserver 不再缓存旧 `.milkdown`）。
- HTML 块占位高改按 border-box 回写，消除逐块累积的位移；异步重渲染抹掉高度时由观察者按内容哈希补回。

### 🧪 测试与验证

- 新增/扩充判据：round-trip 41 条、coldpath-bench 分段归因、overlay D 组（删中间块）、样式基线；`vitest` 31/31。
- 真机验证：未编辑保存 84KB 文档后 hash/size/mtime 均不变；编辑保存 25→26B，diff 只有目标字符；列表结尾文件无额外空行。

### 🧰 工程

- 移除未使用的 vendored Milkdown monorepo（931 个文件）。
- 关闭 Android Kotlin 增量编译，规避跨盘缓存崩溃。
- profile/release 构建支持 `MILKDOWN_URL_STAMP` 缓存戳，避免同版本号装到旧 bundle。
- 纯扫描函数外移并建立等价性测试网，删除未使用的 import。

### ✅ 下载

> 建议使用 arm64-v8a 版本

- `ushio-md-v1.6.9-armeabi-v7a.apk` - 适用于大多数 32 位设备
- `ushio-md-v1.6.9-arm64-v8a.apk` - 适用于 64 位设备（推荐）
- `ushio-md-v1.6.9-x86_64.apk` - 适用于 x86 模拟器
- `ushio-md-v1.6.9-universal.apk` - 通用包

**v0.7.19: apps that refuse to be streamed are skipped, and one-file recording becomes a choice**

- **Apps that close themselves when streamed are skipped (#31).** Some apps - TiCo's protected builds, for one - shut down when the stream attaches. Switch Frame Tap now notices that and leaves the app alone from then on, so it starts normally next time (without the stream). Turn **Stream this app** on in the overlay to try again.
- **One-file recording is an option now, off by default.** Recordings work as before 0.7.18 again: never scaled, and a new file starts when the picture size changes (docked/handheld, the HOME menu). Turn on **One file per recording** (PC viewer: Settings → Recording; Android: Capture) to keep the size the recording started at in one file instead (#44).
- **Smoother scaling in one-file recordings.** When a recording has to enlarge a smaller picture (the HOME menu in a 1080p recording), it is no longer blocky - and needs about half the bitrate.
- **Games above 1080p (#48)** show "This game draws above 1080p" in the viewer instead of the stream retrying every few seconds. Switch Frame Tap streams up to 1920x1080.
- **Project Diva Mega Mix (#43):** once a game's still background is recognized, it is remembered until the console restarts, not just until the game closes.
- **Recordings** no longer leave an empty 0-second file when the picture size changes right as they start (PC viewer and Android app).

**Updating:** open the Switch app's **Updates** page (or unzip `switch-frame-tap-0.7.19-switch.zip` over the SD card root) and restart the console. Settings are kept. The PC viewers and the Android app offer the update when they open.

## [1.0.2]
* **FIX**: iOS 26: the fixed toolbar's automatic back button is now a 44-point circle like the native one, instead of a 38-point rounded square, and sits level with the title. The page-owned toolbar's back button is circular too (@Anderzzon, #171)
* **FIX**: iPhone Duo: in Split View, an app in the left pane now shows its controls and tab bar in a vertical bar on the left edge, as native apps do. It used to fall back to horizontal bars. The side now comes from the system's vertical bar edge (iOS 27.1) instead of the safe-area insets alone (@sergi-labhouse)
  * Adds a Swift source file. With CocoaPods and a path or git dependency, if the iOS build fails with `cannot find 'VerticalBarEdgeStreamHandler' in scope`, run `pod install` in your `ios/` folder
* **FIX**: iPhone Duo: in the left Split View pane the package reserves the strip itself, as UIKit only adds that inset for bars it draws, so the page body and `SafeArea` stay clear of the bar. The controls start near the top of the pane, since there is no camera there (@sergi-labhouse)
* **IMPROVEMENT**: iPhone Duo: when the system gives no inset for the strip, its width now matches the system's 84 pt (it was 60 pt) (@sergi-labhouse)
* **FIX**: iOS 26: reversing an interactive back swipe under the fixed toolbar could throw `SemanticsNode._replaceChildren` with a screen reader on. Every layer of the fixed chrome now keeps its semantics attached, and the layer that is not in front is excluded explicitly, so VoiceOver never lands on invisible items. release.name: Shroudly v2.6.33
release.notes:
## Shroudly 2.6.33

**Shroudly never takes the screen from a full-screen game again.**

### Nothing pops up over your game
- When a site could not be opened, Shroudly used to bring its own window to the front to suggest Advanced mode, and that threw a full-screen game back to the desktop, sometimes in the middle of a match. The window now never comes up by itself. You get a notification instead (Windows holds notifications back while you play), and clicking it opens Shroudly with the suggestion waiting.
- Things Shroudly does on its own now wait while a full-screen game, video or presentation is in front, and happen once you are out of it:
  - the permission prompt for Advanced mode, when the autopilot asks for it or brings it back;
  - the permission prompt for Microsoft Store apps (Minecraft is one);
  - restarting Discord when it does not get through;
  - restarting to install an update.
- This covers games in "borderless" or "windowed full screen" mode as well as true full screen. It works on Windows, and on Linux under X11.

Everything from [2.6.32](https://github.com/umutxyp/Shroudly/releases/tag/v2.6.32) is included. Desktop users update automatically; the Android app tells you that 2.6.33 is out.

release.name: NFSMW Android Evolved 0.8.2 — compilaciones por edición
release.notes:
Esta versión prepara las compilaciones Android por edición del juego y evita iniciar un ejecutable con código de otra región. Conserva nuestro launcher, controles, partidas y la generación de shaders en el teléfono.

**El APK de esta release incluye únicamente PAL España de Xbox 360.** USA, Japón y otras regiones necesitan su propio `default.xex`, preparación, compilación y pruebas antes de anunciar compatibilidad. No se han añadido esas bibliotecas al APK.

Cambios:
- Preparación de árboles separados y compilación de bibliotecas nativas por edición, con comprobaciones de direcciones, funciones y shaders especiales.
- Empaquetado de varios módulos con SDK compartido, verificación de arquitectura y hashes, y selección por SHA-256 del XEX.
- Bloqueo de ejecutables desconocidos o sin módulo incluido; se elimina «Jugar igualmente».
- Cachés vinculadas al ejecutable para nuevas ediciones; se conserva la caché PAL existente.
- Idioma y país iniciales según la edición. Cambiar de biblioteca requiere cerrar completamente y volver a abrir la app.

**Instalación:** actualiza con este APK. Necesitas Android 8+ ARM64 y tu copia propia PAL España de Xbox 360: `default.xex`, `NFS/` y `Movies/` dentro de `Memoria interna/nsfmw-androidevolved/`. No desinstales para actualizar: se conserva el paquete y la firma. No se incluyen datos del juego ni shaders comerciales. Requisitos gráficos e instrucciones completas en [README](https://github.com/codepdbh/nfsmw-android/blob/main/README.es.md).

**Verificación:** compilación Release, lint crítico y pruebas host correctos; 11 bibliotecas ARM64 alineadas a 16 KB y firma coincidente con las versiones anteriores. El emparejador se comprobó con PAL contra sí misma. Sin prueba en teléfono ni emulador de esta versión; no se afirman mejoras de FPS. El lint completo conserva errores previos en SDL y otras partes de la app, documentados en [resultados](https://github.com/codepdbh/nfsmw-android/blob/main/docs/EVOLVED_2_TEST_RESULTS.md).

release.name: Prime Video #260 field-test — pre-roll freeze (split-tail fix)
release.notes:
**Field-test build for #260** (Prime Video `6.23.23+v15.5.0.70`, armeabi-v7a). Not a general release — for @Sapleexx and anyone in a heavy-ad region who hit the pre-roll hang.

> **Updated 2026-10-27:** the asset is now `pv-6.23.23-FIX-260-split.apk`, built with the **split-tail** fix. The earlier reassembler-only build has been removed — @Sapleexx's logs showed the continuation bytes don't arrive through the hooked copies in the EU tier, so that path mostly never fired. The split closes the playlist from the prefix alone, independent of where the rest of the response lands.

### What it does
When the regolith `playlist` splits across memcpy chunks, the hook closes the array **in front of** the unclosed tail object — after the complete ad objects are blanked, it splices `],"_":[` into the gap so the playlist becomes `[]` and the original `]` closes a dummy `"_"` array. On reassembly the body is valid JSON with `playlist.length === 0`, so the app takes its clean empty-break path and no ghost ad period survives to hang the pre-roll. The older cross-chunk reassembler is kept as a fallback for the one case the split can't cover (tail is the first item).

### Install
- The hook `.so` is rebuilt from the #263 branch (split-tail primary); everything else matches the current shipped native strip.
- Signed with cert SHA-256 `49c04fa9…e3c8fc`. It will **not** update over a build you patched yourself with a different key — **uninstall your current Prime Video, then install this** (you'll need to sign in again).
- `adb install -r pv-6.23.23-FIX-260-split.apk` (or sideload).

### What to capture
Play a few titles that previously hung, then grab logcat (`adb logcat -s PVNativeHook`). The lines that confirm the fix fired:
- `PVKILL path=tv-split ...`
- heartbeat `[hb] ... rego_trunc=N ... rego_split=M` — **`rego_split` climbing** alongside `rego_trunc`, and **no** "Something went wrong".

release.notes:
# Qeli 0.8.3 Beta — fixes for 0.8.2 and more resilient connections

## English

Qeli 0.8.3 is a maintenance and bug-fix release for 0.8.2, focused on reliability
and recovery rather than a new feature generation. Its main purpose is to make
connections more predictable under long RTT, stalled carriers, changing UDP path
MTU and temporary loss of connectivity — and to make an interrupted upgrade easier
to diagnose and recover safely. It also closes concrete Windows storage-upgrade,
macOS service and router-startup failures. This is not a new VPN protocol or a
claim that every network or device limitation has been resolved.

For users and operators, the changes mean fewer indefinitely stuck paths, clearer
routing and transport state, and safer handling of existing profiles and recovery
journals. The performance-related changes remove specific bottlenecks; they are
not a promised speed increase on every network.

### Transport stability and network efficiency

- TCP server socket buffers now default to OS management instead of fixed sizes.
  This removes an artificial buffer limit on high-RTT paths while preserving explicit
  operator settings. Linux setup enables and verifies receive autotuning without
  changing the global `tcp_mem` budget.
- TCP/TLS/WebSocket writers and genuine HTTP/2 DATA/PING handling have bounded
  no-progress deadlines. A stalled carrier can be terminated rather than reused
  after a partially written record. Idle server readers no longer reserve a shared
  packet-pool slot before the first byte arrives.
- UDP PMTU checks track the current path and budget revision, reject stale replies
  and safely re-fragment unsent records after a budget decrease. A manually selected
  tunnel MTU no longer disables outer-path probing; `mtu_probe=false` remains supported.
- TUN dispatch first tries immediate delivery, retaining bounded backpressure when
  full. Additional queue, pool and batch-send metrics help locate congestion

### 中文

#### 音源与播放

- 修复第三方音源使用 HTTP 导入地址、HTTP 接口或播放链接时被系统明文策略拦截的问题：脚本导入、脚本请求与媒体播放改走隔离的 HTTP 通道，支持动态域名、跳转与媒体 Range 请求，不继承应用账号 Cookie；默认网络安全策略仍禁止普通明文访问。
- 修复 LX 音源脚本复用时跨线程调用 QuickJS 导致解析失败：每个脚本的创建、调用、回调与销毁均串行运行在所属线程，等待网络结果的时间覆盖默认 HTTP 超时，超时后丢弃旧脚本会话。
- 跨平台聚合搜索按音质择优：同一歌手、同一曲名且时长接近（10 秒容差）的结果只保留可播放且音质最高的来源，不同版本仍并列展示。
- 修复汽水音乐扫码登录：保留抖音 Passport 下发的完整 Cookie，兼容扫码确认后的 3xx 响应，修复扫码后 404。
- 修复系统歌词、悬浮窗歌词、HyperOS 超级岛、vivo 原子岛、ColorOS 锁屏歌词与 SuperLyric 只识别网易云歌曲的问题，统一改用与歌词页相同的 Provider 歌词加载链。

#### USB 与设备输出

- 实验性 USB 独占扩展到全速与高速 UAC1：接受自适应／同步等时 OUT 端点，按端点间隔（125µs～1ms）以 USB 微帧计算包长，并支持每采样 2／3／4 字节（16～32 有效位）的 PCM 描述符；24／32 位容器由 PCM16 左对齐补零转换，不宣称高位深直通。UAC2、异步反馈、多事务端点与 DSD 暂未支持。
- 暂停时保留尚未提交的环形缓冲、恢复播放接着输出；拖动进度时清理旧缓冲，避免恢复后回放旧音频；首个 URB 实际完成回环后才报告就绪。
- USB 独占与自动混音互斥：混音交叉淡化不会静音或断流 DAC 输出，交接后也不会留下静默的 USB 会话；LAN 投放恢复本机输出时不会误解除 USB 持有的静音，避免本机喇叭与 DAC 同时出声。
- 每次 USB 尝试都会记录 VID:PID、速度查询结果与来源、音频接口描述符（十六进制，含 UAC 协议版本）、解码格式、选中的接口／端点／最大包长与失败原因；可在「设置 → 关于 → 导出 MeloX 全部日志」中附带导出，不含 USB 序列号字符串。

#### 启动与稳定性

- 修复启动时账号加密迁移失败仍抛出异常的问题：磁盘写入／旧数据清理失败时保留数据并允许重试，加密存储降级到内存时不再清除唯一的持久化旧会话。
- 加固首屏播放控制器连接与系统音量监听：捕获异步绑定异常、正确释放延迟完成的连接，系统音频服务暂时可用性波动不再中断启动轮询。
- 补齐启动时 Lyricon 外部歌词桥接的异常隔离，并加固可选小米兼容链路（超级岛、Shizuku、妙播并发竞态），可选服务异常不再传到应用主线程。
- 修复旧系统冷启动兼容性：Android 10 / EMUI 等旧系统使用兼容输出面板与系统蓝牙设置，Android 14+ 路由与前台服务类型按版本判断；修正 Android 12+ 画中画缩放。
- 汽水音乐会话存储改用统一的可恢复加密存储，密钥库异常时自动降级为未登录状态，不再阻塞启动。

- 新增弥乐内「我喜欢」：跨平台内容设置首次启用时可选择要迁移的音乐源，自动生成弥乐本地收藏歌单并导入所选音源收藏，之后任意音源的爱心操作都写入这个本地歌单。
- 新增「测试功能尝鲜 → CLI 模式」：通过 ADB 查询播放状态与队列、控制播放／暂停／切歌／进度／音量／循环，并按指定音源搜索或搜索播放；提供 `tools/melox_cli.py` 与 `docs/CLI.md`。
- 自动混音期间流光背景合并两首歌曲封面取色，交接结束后平滑恢复单封面配色。
- 构建产物按 CPU 架构拆分为 `arm64-v8a` 与 `armeabi-v7a` 两个 APK，不再发布同时包含两套原生库的通用包。

## GalaxyAndroid v0.0.4-gamma — Community Beta Tester Build

Beta tester release delivering verified Vulkan shader inventory & graphics pipeline prewarming architecture, canonical `PipelineKey` unification, multi-stage startup compilation, durable cache serialization with corruption recovery, and texture staging safety.

### Mandatory Requirement for Testers: Discord Membership
Testers are required to join our official Discord server to report bugs, submit cutscene/GPU crash logs, and receive test updates:
- **Official Tester Discord**: https://discord.gg/H3qdNWYu2

*Notice: Bug reports and support requests must go through Discord or GitHub Issues. Emails are not monitored for technical support.*

---

### What is new in v0.0.4-gamma:
- **Shader Precompilation & Pipeline Prewarm**: Eliminated runtime shader hitches with a verified two-stage startup architecture (Stage A: parallel SPIR-V compilation with bounded hardware concurrency; Stage B: active Vulkan device pipeline prewarming).
- **Canonical PipelineKey Unification**: Replaced ad-hoc bit shifting with canonical `DecodedPipelineKey` encoding. Fixed topology vs. culling face mask bit collisions so prewarmed pipelines match runtime draw lookups bit-for-bit with 0 redundant re-creations.
- **Measurable Startup Readiness**: `verifyStartupReadiness()` audits essential pipeline stubs and title screen variants, strictly rejecting placeholder stubs from counting as successful prewarms.
- **Offline Asset Material Cooker**: Introduced `tools/cook/generate_shader_manifest.py` to parse GameCube/Wii J3D `MAT3` chunks from models (`.bmd`, `.bdl`) into binary manifests, reporting explicit unparsed gaps rather than false full-game coverage.
- **Durable Binary Cache & Corruption Recovery**: Implemented robust field-by-field binary serialization with FNV1a-32 checksums, strict 512-byte string bounds checks (curing reader desynchronization), and atomic replacement.
- **Texture Upload & Mip-Chain Safety**: Added extent validation

- **梅花易数**：时间 / 数字 / 随机三种起卦，输出主卦、互卦、变卦三卦与动爻爻辞；以动爻定体用，按《体用总诀》五关系断吉凶，结合月建旺相休囚死修正力度；互卦遵循「乾坤无互，互其变卦」特例。**零新建卦数据**，直接复用易经库，与易经模块同源。
- **排盘结果存图 / 分享长图**：八字排盘、紫微斗数、五运六气、梅花易数四个结果页 AppBar 新增图片入口，进入长图预览页（可滚动查看），提供「保存图片」（存本机，无需存储权限）与「分享长图」（系统分享面板，可转存相册 / 文件 / 微信）两个出口；导出内容与各页结果区同源，统一附带免责脚注。
- **梅花易数「摇一摇起卦」**：输入区新增「摇一摇随机起卦」开关（默认开启，可随时关闭）。摇动手机即自动切到随机起卦并重摇一卦（不动已输入的时间 / 数字），触觉反馈确认；一次摇动只出一卦，缓慢倾斜不误判。

## 🔧 改进（Changed）

- 长图预览页底部按钮带漏出内容：供截图的底层全量布局副本溢出部分会画到底栏上，卡片标题从半透明按钮后漏出、被实心按钮截断。现将溢出裁在视口内并给底栏加不透明背景。
- 小六壬双口径不冒充唯一正解：页面并列呈现，口径出处随结果展示。

## ⚠️ 边界（Known Issues）

- 三个术数模块均属**民俗文化参考**，页内固定免责声明，与经方医疗模块在界面与文案上清晰分隔，不构成任何吉凶指令或医疗建议。
- 小六壬不署作者名（「李淳风」署名无可靠版本学证据）。
- 灵签数据未收录「典故 / 现代解读」层（参考开源项目命语自带的该层为现代 AI 生成内容，未采用）。

## 📜 数据与实现

- 签谱正文整理参考开源项目**命语**（`github.com/Brhiza/mingyu`，AGPL-3.0）的 `ssgw-data`，仅取祖庙签谱的传统文本字段，其自带的现代解读内容一律未采用；全部代码与数据层为本项目自行撰写（Apache-2.0），生成脚本 `tool/gen_sanshan_lingqian_data.py` 可完整复现。
- 本版新增依赖 `sensors_plus`（加速度计，Android / iOS 均无需传感器权限）；存图功能零新增依赖（复用已有 `path_provider` + `share_plus`）。

## ✅ 验证（Verification）

- 新增测试 **56 例全绿**：小六壬 12（双口径已知答案 + 4320 组落位穷举）、梅花易数 22（主互变三卦已知答案 + 纯乾特例 + 12×12 穷举 + 摇一摇 3）、摇一摇检测器 7（触发 / 防抖 / 重新武装 / 边缘值 / 倾斜不误判）、长图导出 7（渲染 / 全量布局 2400px / 宽度不塌 / 空安全 2 / 端到端 / 底栏回归守卫）。
- `flutter analyze` 对新增 / 改动文件 **0 issue**。
- 全量 `flutter test`：**771 passed / 4 failed**，4 个均为既有问题（2 个登记基线 + 2 个全量并发下的对话框抖动，单独复跑均通过），**无新增回归**。
- 四包版本一致（versionName 1.11.27 / versionCode 4032），签名与既往版本一致，升级可直接覆盖安装。

release.name: VortX 0.5.6 beta 7: More add-on results, playback queues and a better Quick View (280)
release.notes:
<!-- vortx-distribution: hosted-direct-beta -->

# VortX 0.5.6 beta 7 - More add-on results, playback queues and a better Quick View

Build **280** across Apple and Android. This beta keeps different configurations of the same add-on separate, gives slower aggregators more time to answer, and fixes updating an add-on without changing its URL. You can queue what to watch next, let Home surprise you, and open a larger, more cinematic title preview.

## Fixed

- **Several AIOStreams configurations, only one set of results.** Configurations can all call themselves AIOStreams. VortX used that shared name in parts of the source list, so their sections, filters and selections could collide. Each configured add-on now keeps its own identity, and a selected source stays tied to the configuration that returned it.
- **Slower add-ons cut off too soon.** Stream requests now have **40 seconds** to answer on Apple and Android. Faster add-ons still show their results as they arrive. Metadata keeps its separate, shorter timeout.
- **Singularity torrent rows that could not be selected on Apple.** When you have a compatible debrid account connected, an explicit selection can ask your own account to resolve an eligible torrent result even if it has no ready-to-play URL. Episode selections keep the requested season and episode instead of guessing the first file. Successful playback still depends on your provider and the release.
- **Singularity stopping at the first 100 results.** The updated Apple client and the deployed source service now support paged torrent results, allowing lists beyond the first page. Older clients keep their existing 100-result response. Android's Singularity pool remains disabled.
- **Update did nothing when the manifest URL stayed the same.** **Refresh manifest** fetches the latest configuration at the current URL; **Update URL** changes the address. A refresh ignores an old manifest preview, and the existing add-on stays until the update confirms

alignment checks passed. Alan's RP6 gameplay report applies to his original

repo.description: Apple TV-style launcher for Android TV — ready-to-install APK, no build needed. Apple TV 风格的 Android TV 桌面 —— 装完即用，无需编译。Based on Gathin23/tv-vibehack (CleanYourTV).

release.name: v1.6.1
release.notes:
# tvhome-zh v1.6.1

**Apple TV 风格电视桌面** —— 装完就能用，所有设置都在遥控器上。

> [Gathin23/cleanyourtv](https://github.com/Gathin23/cleanyourtv)（原 tv-vibehack，MIT © 2026 Gathin）的**非官方衍生版本**。
> **一句话：上游把配置交给文件和命令行，本版把配置交给遥控器。**

这一版是 v1.6 的修补版：**磁贴搬家重做了**（光圈不再乱跳、常用栏进出顺畅），天气详情**整屏显示**，隐藏应用的入口**合并到应用库**，日期颜色**统一**。

## 新增

| | | | |
|---|---|---|---|
| 🎯 **磁贴搬家重做** | 长按磁贴 → 方向键搬家 → OK 放下。磁贴会**滑过去**，中间的磁贴依次让位，而不是瞬移 | 光圈全程贴在被搬的磁贴上；常用栏与网格**同一套移动语义**，上/下进出常用栏就是普通的一行位移 |
| 🧾 **常用栏自由进出** | 常用栏里的应用也能被搬出去，网格里的应用也能搬进常用栏 | v1.6 的常用栏是"收藏数"算出来的边界，位置常常对不上；现在常用栏就是最下面那一行，搬进搬出跟网格里挪位一模一样 |
| 📐 **天气详情整屏** | 天气详情从屏幕顶铺到底，**每小时与未来几天都完整显示**，底部「更换城市 / 定位我的城市」不再被裁 | v1.6 会在屏幕不够高时**折叠掉每小时**；现在宁可滚动也不丢内容 |
| 🙈 **隐藏应用并入应用库** | 隐藏过的应用，在顶栏最右侧「应用库」里点一下就回到桌面 | 桌面设置菜单里那个重复的「隐藏应用」入口已删 |

## 修复

- **搬家时光圈跳到别的应用上**：平台的坐标换算不跟动画的位移走，光圈量到的是磁贴的旧位置，磁贴滑走后就停在别的应用上了。现在每帧按磁贴的**实际位置**重新贴合，搬运途中弹簧也调得更硬，跟得更紧。
- **搬家经常中途断掉**：遥控器长按 OK 时会自动重复发键，被当成了"第二次按下"，磁贴刚被拎起来就放下了。现在按住期间的重复不算数，**松手后再按一次**才放下。
- **搬家时桌面闪一下、焦点乱跑**：跨常用栏时旧版会把整面墙重新绑定一遍（丢焦点 + 闪屏）。现在只做位置动画，放下时只存顺序，不重建桌面。
- **天气详情底部被裁**：面板整体上移并撑到屏幕边缘，底部按钮完整可见。
- **日期与农历颜色偏淡**：日期和农历都改成纯白，与时钟、天气一致。
- **隐藏后找不回来**：只有 TV 入口的应用以前在应用库里查不到，现在两类入口都列。

## 其他

- 隐藏应用面板与相关代码已删除，桌面设置菜单少一行。
- 应用库会优先给出 TV 入口，搬回桌面的应用照旧用电视方式启动。
- 版本号 1.6.1（versionCode 10），签名与 v1.6 相同，**可直接覆盖安装**。

## 与上游的差异

**本版独有**：菜单键快捷设置浮层、遥控器上编辑常用应用、必应每日壁纸、从电视里选图、面板紧凑玻璃样式、减弱动画开关、内存紧张时让出内存、内置天气（含自动定位与温度区间）、小米 / 酷开切源、农历、磁贴统一风格、隐藏应用、应用库、**像 tvOS 一样用方向键搬磁贴**、直接提供编译好的 APK。上游多数要改配置文件才生效、且按键映射要自己试；这里点一下就好。

**本版暂缺**：主题目录一键推送、模块卡片（第三方 App 往桌面插磁贴）、每应用单独定制启动动作/名称/封面、紧凑顶栏、真彩色壁纸解码、AOT、227 机型 debloat 清单 —— 需要这些请用[上游](https://github.com/Gathin23/cleanyourtv)。

## 安装 / 升级

```bash
adb connect <电视IP>:5555
adb shell settings put global verifier_verify_adb_installs 0   # 仅当电视拒绝安装（见下）
adb install -r tvhome-zh-debug.apk
adb shell cmd package set-home-activity com.gathin.tvhome/.MainActivity
```

- **新用户**：直接下载 `tvhome-zh-debug.apk` 安装即可，不需要先装别的版本。
- **从 v1.3.0 / v1.4.x / v1.5.0 / v1.6.0 升级**：直接覆盖安装，设置、壁纸、隐藏列表和磁贴顺序都保留。
- **从 v1.2.0 及更早升级**：需要先卸载一次（那几个版本换过签

## Graphics

- **Adreno 8xx driver for Snapdragon 8 Elite.** A source-built Mesa 26.3 Turnip with a fix for the newer Qualcomm gralloc, which otherwise leaves the whole image garbled on Adreno 830. Auto selects it on SM8750 devices unless an imported driver is chosen, and it always renders with `TU_DEBUG=sysmem,nobin`. On Adreno 830 it measured about 12 ms of GPU time per frame at 100% resolution, compared with about 26 ms on the stock driver. Other Adreno 8xx GPUs can select it manually; it has only been validated on Adreno 830.
- **High refresh rate displays.** The game requests the display's fastest mode and passes the FPS option to Android, so FPS settings above 60 are no longer capped at 60 by vsync on 120 Hz phones.
- **Fewer frozen images on Adreno 6xx** ([#170](https://github.com/SansNope/UnleashedRecomp-Android/issues/170)). Some Turnip builds return early from an unlimited GPU wait; the game now waits again instead of reusing buffers the GPU is still drawing. If the GPU driver stops responding, the game explains that and closes instead of freezing the image while audio continues. Choose another driver in the launcher if this happens.
- A saved **Adreno 8xx Experimental** choice from 0.5.3 opens as the new **Adreno 8xx** driver.

release.name: YPtun v3.7.2
release.notes:
## YPtun 3.7.2

Новые ядра olcRTC и CSQTT, режим TPROXY наконец перенаправляет трафик, обновлённый дизайн и окно «Сессия».

### Новое

- **olcRTC: ядро обновлено до форка ghostlane-project** (#75). Оригинальный `openlibrecommunity/olcrtc` заархивирован, а Wildberries Stream закрыл создание комнат для гостей. Добавлены новые провайдеры: **MTS Link**, **VK Calls** и **SaluteJazz** (прежний `jazz` теперь называется `salutejazz`, старые локации подхватываются сами). По умолчанию для обхода предлагается MTS Link. WB Stream остался только для старых локаций, из установщика на VPS он убран. Серверы olcRTC, поставленные прошлой версией, лучше переустановить: формат записей в новом ядре изменился.
- **CSQTT: ядро обновлено до v2.5.0.** Клиент и сервер синхронизированы с апстримом. Серверы CSQTT, установленные прошлой версией, нужно переустановить.
- **Главная: окно «Сессия».** Показывает IP, провайдера и место выхода через туннель, а также тест скорости (скачивание кусками, 4 потока). Кнопку можно скрыть в «Вид списка» → «Скрыть кнопку Сессия».
- **Новый дизайн.** Настройки разбиты на три группы: «Подключение», «Приложение» и «Ещё». Переработаны экраны «Добавить» и сервера, а весь интерфейс получил единый мягкий графитовый стиль. Кнопка установки на VPS теперь доступна всегда.
- **Новые языки: чешский, словацкий и белорусский.**
- **Вид списка:** тумблер «Скрыть автоустановку по SSH».
- **CSQTT: имя локации берётся из фрагмента ссылки `csqtt://#имя`** (#74).
- **Snolc:** в каскаде прямой выход (`adapter-direct`) теперь может выходить через локальный SOCKS5 (TCP и UDP).
- **Trust Tunnel на Android:** в списке показывается реальный адрес и имя из ссылки `tt://`, а пинг (Авто/TCP/ICMP/GET/HEAD) считается по этому адресу.
- **VK-TURN / qWDTT:** если в локации не указана ссылка на звонок VK, приложение спросит её при подключении.

### Исправления

- **Android: режим TPROXY не менял IP.** Ядро открывало tproxy-вход, но правил `iptables`/`ip rule`, которые направляют трафик телефон

release.name: v0.126.0
release.notes:
## 🚀 新特性

- **项目主页静态站上线**: 新增 `web/landing/` 单页营销站，纯静态 HTML/CSS/JS 实现，支持中英双语切换。Hero 区使用真实桌面/手机截图并加屏幕反光，画廊自动无缝滚动（悬停/触摸/聚焦即停），配图统一做色阶重映射以适配深色页面（#591）
- **智能体横条展示全部 19 个后端**: 按后端注册表顺序铺开，每个后端配品牌标。默认单色（深底上亮度统一），指针悬停时交叉淡入为品牌原始彩色版；彩色版 SVG 的渐变/裁剪 id 逐条加前缀，避免多份内联 SVG 同文档时互相串用定义（#591）
- **主页推送自动部署**: 推送 main 分支时经 GitHub Actions + wrangler 直传 Cloudflare Pages，只改 `web/landing/` 或 workflow 时触发，并带 concurrency 避免两次部署争抢上线（#592）
- **站点安全头与缓存策略入库**: `_headers` 声明 nosniff / SAMEORIGIN / referrer / permissions 四个安全头，`/img/*` 一年 immutable（约定「永不原地改图、只换新文件名」）、css/js 一周、index.html 不缓存（#592）

## 🐛 问题修复

- 修复主页设备框与截图比例不一致导致的裁切：显示器屏幕框 1600/845 → 1920/1040、手机 560/1111 → 900/1980，与截图实际比例对齐后上下/底部裁切归零，手机底部 dock 栏不再被切掉（#591）
- 修复画廊跑马灯「看起来没跑起来」：暂停判定从整个 `.gal` 容器改为按单张卡片命中（容器在 1440 宽下几乎铺满视口，指针随便落在页面中间就命中），现在压在卡片上才停、落在空隙里继续滚（#591）
- 修复手机定位悬空：底边上收到与显示器支架大致齐平，`.stage` 底部留白 ≥ 探出高度，避免被下一节盖住（#591）

## 🔧 内部改进

- 移除 8 个失效的 gitlink（`test/git-graph-repos/`）：这些路径被当成子模块提交但根目录从无 `.gitmodules`，任何执行 `git submodule update --init --recursive` 的工具都会直接失败，且内容不进仓库、无代码读取，属死数据（#593）
- 清理测试注释中对上述已删除夹具目录的引用（夹具数据本就硬编码在测试文件里，不读磁盘），避免误导（#593）
- 主页新增 28 项测试（`web/landing/landing.test.ts`），覆盖翻译残留、图片 404、灯箱、画廊循环与暂停、内联 SVG id 唯一性、彩色层与单色层配对、CSS aspect-ratio 与图片实际尺寸一致性

---

Antares engine sync and stability release.

release.name: Relay 2.11.1
release.notes:
## Relay 2.11.1

**Share your phone's internet with your PC.** Tap *Start Sharing* on
the phone, click your phone in the list on the PC, tap *Allow*.
That is the whole setup.

Everything runs between your two devices: no account, no server, no
telemetry. The connection is an encrypted WireGuard tunnel, and
**every application** on the PC goes through it -- not only the browser.

Over your Wi-Fi, the phone's hotspot, or **a USB cable** -- whichever way
the two devices can already see each other.

### Download

| Platform | File | Requirements |
|---|---|---|
| **Windows** | `Relay-Setup-x64.exe` | Windows 10/11. Per-user install, no admin prompt. |
| Windows (32-bit) | `Relay-Setup-x86.exe` | Only if you know you need it. |
| **Android** | `Relay-android-arm64-v8a.apk` | Android 8.0+, 64-bit ARM — almost every phone since 2017. |
| Android (any device) | `Relay-android-universal.apk` | Same app, every CPU type. Larger. Use this if the one above says "app not compatible". |
| Android (stores) | `Relay-android.aab` | Not directly installable. |

### Install

1. Install both apps.
2. On the phone, tap **Start Sharing**. Put both devices on the same
   Wi-Fi, turn on the phone's hotspot, or plug in a USB cable -- with a
   cable, Relay offers to switch USB tethering on for you.
3. On the PC, open Relay. **Your phone is already in the list.** Click it.
4. Tap **Allow** on the phone.

No camera on the laptop? The two-digit code works on its own. Prefer
the QR? It is still there.

Windows SmartScreen warns on first run because the installer is not
code-signed yet: **More info -> Run anyway**. See `docs/release.md`.

If Android says **"App not installed"**, that one message covers
several unrelated causes. The two most common: an older copy built
from source is still installed (uninstall it first - a different
signing key blocks the upgrade), or Play Protect blocked the
sideload (**Install anyway** in its dialog).

repo.description: Wi-Fi Direct application for seamless data, message, and file transfer. No internet, no routers, just pure peer-to-peer connection that is faster and more stable than traditional methods.

release.name: WDCable v2.0.1
release.notes:
Automated Android APK build from GitHub Actions.

Source ref: main
Commit: 5ad29543042c801a7d7dc55280e2d3b7b4c04aa5
Workflow run: https://github.com/jingcjie/WDCable_flutter/actions/runs/27927799593

Requires Android 13 or newer. Android APKs support arm64-v8a and x86_64. The 32-bit armeabi-v7a ABI is not supported now.

## What's New in 2.0.1

Version 2.0.1 is the Protocol v2 release. It separates Wi-Fi Direct group-owner/client roles from WDCable TCP listener/connector roles, uses UDP rendezvous when needed, and upgrades Audio Link to RTP/RTCP over UDP with libopus.

- More reliable Wi-Fi Direct session setup, including a fix for Windows endpoint routing issues.
- Wi-Fi Direct clients now own the WDCable TCP listeners.
- UDP rendezvous lets Android group-owner devices safely discover the peer listener endpoint.
- Expanded diagnostics for device roles, selected endpoints, rendezvous, TCP setup, and handshake failures.
- Lower-latency Audio Link streaming using RTP/RTCP over UDP and libopus.
- Sender quality presets: Standard (32 kbps), Balanced (64 kbps), High (128 kbps), and Near lossless (256 kbps).
- Sender latency modes: Low latency and Stable.
- Improved audio statistics for configured and measured bitrate, packet loss, jitter, late drops, buffer level, and RTCP reports.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Protocol v2 is not compatible with Protocol v1. Both devices must run WDCable 2.0.1 or another Protocol v2-compatible build.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/jingcjie/WDCable_flutter/compare/v1.4.2...v2.0.1

release.name: Ryza Chat 1.2.23
release.notes:
## 本地模型不用再填假 Key；剧情里的「采集 / 睡觉」不再全靠模型配合；盘腿坐终于能点到

这一版把 1.2.22 之后两轮 issue 处理的结果一起发出：#13 #14 #15 #17 #18，以及 PR #16 中核实后真正存在的三处缺口。

### Downloads
- `RyzaChat-Setup-1.2.23.exe` —— Windows 安装包
- `RyzaChat-1.2.23.apk` —— Android（versionCode 26）

---

# 修了什么

## 1. 本地模型（Ollama / LM Studio / llama.cpp）不再必须填 Key（issue #17）

接口地址是本机（`127.0.0.1` / `localhost` / `::1`）时，API Key 可以留空；对话、拉模型列表、生成任务、设置页测试共用同一处判断。远程地址仍然必须填 Key。
Hugging Face 的模型需要一个兼容 OpenAI 接口的服务来跑，应用本身不加载权重；Ollama 可以直接拉取：`ollama run hf.co/<user>/<repo>`。见 `docs/SETUP.md`。

## 2. RPG 状态不再依赖模型「说两遍」（issue #18）

- **采集任务**：以前模型叙述拿到素材、也把物品加进了背包，任务进度却不动（还得另外写 `quest.step_add`）。现在**真正进包的物品数量**会自动推进采集任务；模型自己也写了进度时不会重复计数。
- **睡觉回体力**：睡觉本来就会回满体力，但提示词从没告诉模型这一点。现在写明了。另外，「冒险状态」面板新增**「回家睡觉」按钮**：只在傍晚 / 夜里可用，体力满时不可点，不会让体力变成免费资源。
- 模型写坏的 `<state>` 块（裸 key、单引号、代码块围栏）现在会尝试修复，修不了会在控制台警告，而不是静默丢弃。

## 3. 盘腿坐有入口了（issue #13）

官方坐装的动作表里本来就有盘腿变体，但一直没有开关。坐下后，坐 / 站键旁多了一个「盤」键（只有确实带两种坐姿的服装才显示），并且会保存。

## 4. 记忆会「自己变少」（issue #14）

- 读取 1.2.19 之前的旧存档会清空当前记忆卡片：已修。
- 记忆写入改为带 `.bak` 备份轮换，读坏时自动从备份恢复，坏数据另存不删。
- 「近期对白」原来只显示 40 条，看起来像被删了：现在全部显示。
- 浏览器存储满了会弹提示，不再悄悄停止保存。

## 5. 社区 PR

- **PR #15**（a9ito）：自定义人设、服装导入错误码与说明、印尼语补全。已合入，并先修好了它带进来的导入器崩溃。
- **PR #16**（qingyue-dev）：未合并（它移除了 NSFW 同意开关、引入了混淆脚本、降低了 Android SDK，并有多项回归失败）。其中三处真实问题已重新实现：
  - 桌面 / 浏览器上底部面板可以用 **Esc** 或 **×** 关闭（「冒险状态」面板以前在桌面上关不掉）；
  - 首次启动时界面语言**跟随设备语言**（已有设置不受影响）；
  - 连接失败时立绘的台词有了中 / 日 / 英 / 繁 / 印尼语版本（以前只有日文）。

## 6. 其他

- 英文、印尼语等界面下有两个按钮显示原始 key（`world.list`、`settings.speakHint`）：已修，并新增 `i18n_coverage` 检查这一类问题。
- 清理了死代码与死 CSS；补上文档里引用却一直不存在的 `scripts/verify_skins.py`。

---

# 验证

- **18 个 node 回归套件 + `layering_check --strict` + `privacy_check` 全绿**；新增断言都做了反向对照（去掉修复后测试必须失败）。
- 本版没有新增需要真机验证的原生改动：安卓 / 桌面壳只更新了版本号。

---

## English

Local OpenAI-compatible servers (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp) on `127.0.0.1` / `localhost` no longer need a dummy API key (#17). RPG state relies less on the model (#18): items that land in your bag advance a gather quest, the prompt now says sleep restores stami

## Overview

Version 0.5.2 is a major map compatibility update that introduces official support for several of the most popular community map mods across both ETS2 and ATS, alongside a reworked dynamic map scaling system powered by `scale.json`.

---

### 🗺️ Community Map Mod Support

* **American Truck Simulator (ATS):**
  * **ATS Expansion:** Added full road network and depot support for 200+ ranches, gravel pits, and rural spurs.
  * **Coast to Coast (C2C):** Added support for nationwide routes across the continental US.
  * **Reforma Suite:** Added support for **Reforma**, **Reforma Esterlon**, and **Reforma Sierra Nevada**.

* **Euro Truck Simulator 2 (ETS2):**
  * **Grand Utopia:** Added support for the 1:1 scale standalone island map.
  * **Ro-Extended (ROEX):** Added support for extended road networks across Romania and Eastern Europe.
  * **RusMap:** Added support for expansive highways and cities across Russia and Belarus.

---

### 📐 Engine & Map Scaling

* **Dynamic Scale Configuration:** Refactored internal scale calculation logic to dynamically load from `scale.json` rather than hardcoded static values. This ensures accurate GPS projection and positioning across non-standard and 1:1 scale maps (such as Grand Utopia).

---

release.name: v2.1.0
release.notes:
# Metadator 2.1.0

A feature release: every song now has a visible edit history, and online search finds and ranks matches better.

## New
- **Edit history.** Open *Edit history* from the editor's menu to see a song's saves grouped by day, each with the cover it had and the fields it changed. You can go back to the version before any of them.
- Restoring is also a save: Metadator backs the file up first and asks for write access, so a restore (or an Undo) can itself be undone. Settings uses the same wording.

## Improved
- **Better ranking of online results.** Titles, artists and albums are compared without the parts that only decorate them ("(Remastered)", "(Deluxe Edition)", "feat. …"), and word order no longer matters. Every credited artist counts, and a title written as "Artist - Title" or starting with its track number ("01. Halo") is understood.
- **The right version comes first.** Live, karaoke, remix and cover recordings no longer beat the original, and compilations lose to the original release unless you are looking for one. Duration still tells apart an album cut from a radio edit.
- **A match found by several sources ranks higher.** When two providers list the same recording, it is more likely to be the right one.
- **Deezer finds more.** It now tries several searches at once and falls back to the title alone when a strict search comes back empty (for example because of a "feat. …" it doesn't know).
- MusicBrainz results now carry the recording's version and disambiguation, which the ranking uses.

## Fixed
- **Crash in *Find metadata*.** The results could close the app with "Key … was already used" when MusicBrainz listed a release once per disc the recording is on (a song on both the Blu-ray and the DVD of an album, for example). Each release is now listed once, and the lookup lists each candidate once per provider.

Found a problem? [Open an issue](https://github.com/BobbyESP/Metadator/issues).

release.name: NetHack 3D 1.6.2
release.notes:
This update adds save backups, more display customization, rendering optimizations, and fixes for VR input, attack targeting, and saved run details.

### New features

- **Save import and export:** Back up manual saves and autosaves as `.nh3dsave` files, including character settings, and restore them to a compatible NetHack 3D installation. Supports all NetHack variants in the client: NetHack 3.6.7, NetHack 5, and Slash’EM. Open **Options → Saves** from the startup menu after saving and quitting.
- **Save import protection:** Imports check game-version and build compatibility, reject damaged backups, and prevent overwriting an existing save.
- **Tiled terrain in 3D ASCII mode:** Independently enable tiles for walls and ground surfaces while keeping characters, items, and other features in ASCII. Works in overhead and first-person views, including floors beneath characters and items.
- **Custom UI fonts:** Choose an installed font with a live interface preview. Browse installed fonts where supported, or enter a font family name manually. Confirm saves your choice; Cancel restores the previous font, and a reset button restores the default.
- Action-button labels automatically refit when the UI font changes.

### Performance improvements

- Spread terrain updates and graphics refreshes across frames to reduce large bursts of rendering work during movement, exploration, and tileset changes.
- Reduced repeated wall geometry and shading calculations, unnecessary first-person minimap redraws, and per-frame VR rendering overhead.
- Reduced repeated rebuilding of discovered dark-corridor walls in NetHack 3.6.7 and Slash’EM.
- Made loading older tilesets in NetHack 5 more responsive by processing their conversion in smaller chunks.
- Changed the default VR resolution from 150% to 130% to reduce rendering load. Existing saved resolution settings are preserved.

### VR keyboard and text entry fixes

- Fixed text prompts failing to activate the Quest keyboard
