release.name: v2.0.3
release.notes:
New
* Exclude specific apps from backups (Settings > Excluded apps).
* Choose which fields are exported (Settings > Exported fields). Leaving out app icons makes HTML backups much smaller.
* Optional "latest" backup file: a fixed file name that always holds the most recent backup, alongside the timestamped ones.
* Set a default sort field and order (Settings > Sort).
* Share a backup from the viewer, which now opens automatically after a backup completes.
* Separate toggles for user, system and disabled apps.
* Copy rows from the Markdown and CSV previews.
* Licence information and the app version code shown in Settings.


Improved
* Backups started from Tasker, Locale plugins or a broadcast intent now run reliably on Android 12 and later (they are scheduled through WorkManager instead of starting a service from the background).
* Redesigned Settings with better TalkBack support and fewer focus stops.
* Unified Markdown and CSV formatting; opening Markdown files no longer freezes the UI.
* Full folder path shown for Storage Access Framework (SAF) locations; cloud folders (e.g. Google Drive) show their real name.
* The file extension ("md", "csv", "html") is accepted as a format name in Tasker and broadcast actions.
* Note clarifying that HTML backups contain more detail than CSV or Markdown.


Fixed
* Backups started from Tasker, Locale or a broadcast silently did nothing on Android 12+.
* Disabled apps were reported as enabled (#70, #4).
* The backup folder setting was lost after a temporary storage error, which stopped all later backups.
* Crash when the backup folder permission had been revoked.
* Crash when no app was available to handle a tapped link (#75).
* The "Backup now" button in the viewer did not show progress while a backup was running.
* Latest-backup detection and installer names across Android versions.

流萤加速器是一款基于 sing-box 核心，支持多种代理协议和智能分流的 Android VPN 客户端

release.name: 流萤加速器安卓APP
release.notes:
### FireflyVPN-arm64-v8a.apk是64位安装包(默认安装)，FireflyVPN-armeabi-v7a.apk是32位安装包
### PC端下载请点击 [PC端开源项目](https://github.com/Iskongkongyo/FireflyVPN-Desktop)
## 🚀 VPN 核心与稳定性

* 重构 VPN 关闭流程，优先释放 TUN，并优化核心连接清理，改善部分 Android / HyperOS 设备关闭 VPN 后状态栏图标长时间不消失的问题。
* 增加 TUN 加锁、停止状态检查及重复建立保护，降低并发启停、重载导致的接口或描述符残留。
* 修复首次进入节点列表时分组尚未加载完成可能导致的闪退，并完善空状态及分页安全处理。

## 🌐 主流站解锁测试

* “流媒体解锁测试”统一更名为“主流站解锁测试”。
* 重构测试结果页面：测试开始后自动进入结果页，本次 APP 运行期间可随时查看最近一次结果。
* IPv4 / IPv6 详细结果改为独立页面，新增主要平台状态、可用性统计、主要地区、分类筛选及展开详情。
* 主要平台新增 Claude，并优化国家/地区、可用性标签和国旗显示。
* 修复 YouTube、YouTube CDN、BingSearch、GoogleSearch、MetaAI、SonyLiv 等项目及地区信息的结构化解析。
* 修复 IPv4 / IPv6 数据覆盖、错误续行及 ANSI 颜色码导致的结果乱码问题。
* 测试失败节点支持单独刷新并重新测试，同时完善测速任务之间的互斥处理。
* 优化测试范围选择：默认不选节点，支持取消全选，节点选择过程不再自动重排或滚回顶部。

## ⚡ 自动化测试与择优

* “自动化测试完成”和“自动化测试详情”改为独立页面，以卡片方式展示测试概览、带宽、解锁结果、综合得分及原始输出。
* 优化自动化测试结果布局，并在节点卡片中补充上行带宽及解锁情况。
* 完善上下行带宽状态记录，可区分成功、未测试、跳过、代理启动失败、超时及请求失败等情况。
* 择优面板新增“综合权重”排序，可自定义延迟、上下行带宽及解锁情况权重；未启用的测试项目会自动隐藏。
* 支持从择优面板右上角快速保存相关设置。

## 📋 节点列表与排序

* 优化节点分组切换和刷新逻辑，提升左右滑动流畅度，并修复分组被服务端移除后反复跳转的问题。
* 新增分组内手动排序：长按节点卡片即可拖动调整顺序，并持久保存。
* 优化长列表拖拽、边缘自动滚动及位置交换逻辑，修复多种异常跳位问题。
* 搜索按钮旁新增排序菜单，可临时切换“原始排序”或“延迟排序”，不会覆盖保存的手动顺序。
* TCPing 和 URL Test 仅更新测试结果，不再自动改变默认节点顺序。
* 接口分组或订阅分组更新后，将直接采用最新服务端顺序。
* 优化订阅分组卡片拖拽及长列表自动滚动表现。

## 🧩 分应用代理与规则管理

* 优化分应用代理首次配置流程：未启用时也可提前选择代理模式、绕过模式及目标应用。
* 启用代理模式时仍会校验至少选择一个目标应用，避免首次配置无法继续。
* 完善智能分流、全局代理、分应用代理及规则开关不同组合下的配置生成与校验。

release.name: C-SSH 0.9.7 · Windows / macOS / Linux / Android
release.notes:
# C-SSH 0.9.7

這次更新整合了近期的 AI 助手、伺服器瀏覽器、監控採集、雲同步與四端介面改進，並集中修正實際使用中發現的中斷、等待、資料顯示與連線問題。

**本版本只提示新版本，請前往下載頁自行下載安裝。沒有強制更新，也不會在背景自動下載或安裝。** Windows、macOS、Linux、Android 均採這個方式；iOS 暫停開發及發布。

## Added

### AI 任務並行與執行設定

- 可設定 AI 同時執行的獨立唯讀任務數，超出的工作排隊處理；同一台主機上的獨立任務也可並行。
- 子任務沿用主助手的模型上下文配置，改善委派時使用不一致窗口造成的超限。
- 權限模式、工具循環和執行設定集中管理；有依賴的工作及需要確認的修改仍遵守原有執行順序與權限。

### 更清楚的 AI 進度與結果

- AI 回覆支援逐步顯示，子任務的動作和已取得結果會持續更新，減少長時間只有「正在處理」的情況。
- 聊天主畫面保留簡潔的執行摘要，需要查看命令、檔案與個別操作時可展開詳情，避免大量工具行淹沒對話。
- 插話會出現在對話中，進行中的任務可接收補充說明；暫停、停止與重新接續的狀態更明確。

### 會話用量與快取資訊

- 提供累計使用 Token、上下文用量和快取命中率；Android 使用簡潔的三項面板，桌面保留詳細統計。
- 「累計使用 Token」包含主助手和子任務歷次請求的使用量；上下文另附單次輸入說明，避免把累計用量誤認成模型窗口占用。
- 新一輪處理或統計刷新期間保留上次已確認數值。供應商沒有回報的快取資料顯示未知，不當作零命中。
- 兼容不同模型接口的用量欄位，按實際可觀測輸入計算整體快取命中率，避免重複計數。

### 桌面伺服器瀏覽器

- Windows、macOS、Linux 可透過主機 Agent 使用伺服器出口瀏覽網站；桌面版本要求本機安裝 Google Chrome，缺少時會提醒。
- 同一台伺服器可建立多個瀏覽器環境，每個環境分別保存瀏覽資料、固定指紋種子及設定。
- 增加系統、時區、語言與權限等設定；定位、麥克風及攝影機依設定正常詢問權限。
- 改善環境重開及程式異常退出後的恢復，保留各環境既有資料和固定身份。
- Android 的伺服器瀏覽器入口目前隱藏，相關驗證暫停；不將桌面能力標為手機已支援。

## Fixed

### AI 回應速度、上下文與歷史

- 改善簡單主機檢查反覆讀取目錄、重複查詢及不必要工具循環的情況。
- 優化上下文準備、穩定前綴和歷史載入，依模型實際窗口處理上下文，避免固定小窗口限制影響大窗口模型。
- 調整工具結果處理與長會話儲存，在保留原始記錄的前提下減少一次載入、傳輸和渲染的負擔。
- 修正暫停或中斷後無法再送訊息、會話狀態誤判為由其他視窗接手，以及重開後看不到既有內容等問題。
- 修正部分 AI 執行路徑造成的 Mac 程式崩潰。
- 修正 Android 歷史對話選擇受其他會話更新干擾、恢復歷史時覆蓋當前模型，以及修改模型窗口後統計未更新的問題。

### 監控採集與資料庫

- 監控採集併發設定上限提高至 1000，搭配排隊和獨立主機調度，減少慢主機拖延整輪刷新。
- 優化本機資料庫的讀寫與高頻採集路徑，減少重複開庫及不必要的資料處理。
- 為適合的通訊資料採用選擇性壓縮；小回應維持直接傳輸，減少為壓縮小封包付出的額外成本。
- 修正雲同步後 Agent 狀態未及時更新、需要重開程式才顯示正確，以及初次採集狀態容易造成誤解的情況。
- 改善 Windows Server Agent 的監控採樣成本與 CPU 使用情況。

### 瀏覽器啟動與穩定性

- 改善首次啟動偶發失敗、參數準備耗時與重試操作。
- 修正部分驗證頁、頁面事件及導航等待造成瀏覽器意外關閉的情況。
- 瀏覽器環境之間分開保存 Cookie 與其他資料，固定身份不再因每次開啟而重新生成。
- 網站是否顯示驗證碼仍由網站及出口網路狀況決定，本更新不保證所有網站免驗證，也不宣稱完全隱藏所有本機指紋。

### Agent 接入與 ARM 相容性

- 改善已有 Agent 的跨設備接入與專用公鑰處理，減少新設備連線時出現授權衝突。
- 改善 Agent 檢測、復用、更新與就緒階段的提示，讓使用者能看出目前正在處理哪一步。
- 更新 Linux x86_64／ARM64 Agent，改善獨立通道相容性，並整理統信 UOS、麒麟 ARM 的實際適配結果。
- 保留 Agent／SSH 模式邊界，純 SSH 主機不因更新而自動安裝 Agent。

### 手動雲同步與資料保護

- 同一程式進程內完成資料保護驗證後，切頁、檢查及後續同步可復用有效驗證，不反覆要求輸入相同密碼

release.notes:
## ZenFile v3.6.6

### ✨ 新功能
- 删除文件确认弹窗现在会列出待删条目：每项显示文件类型图标与文件名，弹窗高度随条目数量自适应——条目少时是一行紧凑小条，条目多时是限高可滚动的列表；超过 50 项时末尾汇总显示「还有 N 项」
- 文件操作菜单新增「用文本编辑器打开」：任意非图音视、非压缩包的文件都能直接用内置文本编辑器打开并编辑，不必再靠改后缀名绕过

### ✨ 界面焕新
- 浏览页标签栏右侧的按钮改为弹出菜单：多标签时提供「关闭当前标签页」与「关闭所有标签页」两个选项（当前在上、所有在下），仅一个标签页时只显示「关闭当前标签页」；选择「关闭所有标签页」时不再二次确认，直接关闭全部标签页
- 设置—导航栏设置中的「导航栏位置」选项改为与「自定义快捷方式」页面同款的下拉选择器，并在下方新增 5 个底部导航槽位入口；两处槽位共用同一份配置，改动实时同步

release.notes:
# Ciallo Reader 1.5.9 · 哔哩与 19 漫画连接修复、安全加固

版本 **1.5.9 / 251**，Android 7.0+，ARM64。

哔哩漫画修复脚本 Cookie 与应用 Cookie 重复拼接、搜索凭证失效后无法续取的问题，公开请求增加直连与代理回退。书源管理新增「验证」入口；网站仍拒绝当前会话时，提示完成站点验证。验证后的浏览器身份同时用于页面和图片，不再在读图时覆盖成另一套身份。

19 漫画在移动站连接失败、空响应或页面异常时尝试同站 `www.sxchex.com` 线路，并在当前会话内优先使用成功线路。保留已有作品、章节标识与书架记录。

整章下载把完整响应体读取纳入重试，避免已收到 HTTP 200 响应头、随后连接中断时直接结束下载。仍保留单张 32 MiB 限制、取消与整章完整性检查。

## 安全边界及报毒状态

阅读图片、封面和下载共用的 HTTP 传输拒绝通过明文 HTTP 发送 Cookie、Authorization 或 Proxy-Authorization，包括重定向；自动 Cookie 读取仅用于 HTTPS。去掉下载器向新地址回填原地址 Cookie 的行为。匿名 HTTP 图床仍可访问，正常 HTTPS 登录会话仍可使用。网站验证窗口禁止文件访问、内容提供器访问和混合内容。

既有 [Issue #3](https://github.com/roxycon-dev/Ciallo-Reader/issues/3) 的历史反馈涉及 `a.gray.BulimiaTGen.h` 与 `a.gray.sexBLTWbindsnake`，不能据此确定 1.5.8 的当前检测原因。1.5.7 与 1.5.8 的发布证书、权限集合相同；原生库的代码段也一致，差异只有构建标识。没有发现之前证书校验修复被撤回。

**本版进行了实际安全加固，但未确认系统报毒已消除。** 按用户要求不启动模拟器、不进行新的查杀测试；缺少用户原机检测结果。签名、证书校验与现有功能保持。

## 验证范围

仅复验本次报告的哔哩和 19 漫画。使用主机运行实际内置源脚本，匿名 HTTPS 请求、整章图片下载及逐页解码；Android 阅读器界面、后台入库与原机检测未在本轮复测。此前其他源的通过记录沿用，不重复访问；Picacg、vomic、MYCOMIC 仍按用户授权排除。

主机实网结果：哔哩《勇者鬥惡龍 達伊的大冒險 勇者阿邦與獄炎魔王》第 52 话 **46/46 页**；19 漫画《百万勇者传说》第 1 话 **27/27 页**。共 **73 页**完成下载解码，并离线逐页复核保存文件的 SHA-256、尺寸及解码。连接中断曾在测试中实际出现；最终整章结果包含重试后的完整文件。

19 漫画还在测试端模拟主线路不可用，实际通过备用域名完成搜索、详情、目录和阅读页解析；27 个图片地址与已下载文件完全一致，没有重复下载。

离线源回归覆盖备用域名切换、无效页面拒绝、作品标识保持、哔哩过期搜索票据续取和 403 验证提示。**11 项 JVM 安全与下载回归全部通过**：证书及主机名校验、有效 HTTPS 会话、HTTP 凭据与重定向拦截、Cookie 合并，以及响应体截断后的完整重试。原始记录及测试脚本随 Release 附件提供。

## 下载与升级

[ARM64 APK](https://github.com/roxycon-dev/Ciallo-Reader/releases/download/v1.5.9/Ciallo-Reader-v1.5.9.apk) · [SHA-256](https://github.com/roxycon-dev/Ciallo-Reader/releases/download/v1.5.9/SHA256SUMS.txt) · [验证记录](https://github.com/roxycon-dev/Ciallo-Reader/releases/download/v1.5.9/validation.json)

release.name: v2.22
release.notes:
**997 probes, 4557 readings** on a reference device.

- **EC-only keybox, caught app-side.** A keybox that carries only an EC attestation key forges the RSA path with it, so the forged RSA leaf is signed by ECDSA and both chains share one attestation key. `attest:leaf_sig_alg` and `attest:batch_key_ec_vs_rsa` read that straight from the attestation, with `attest:rot_ec_vs_rsa` cross-checking the root of trust across an EC and an RSA request.
- **FLAG_SECURE self-verify.** `integrity:flagsecure_honored` sets `FLAG_SECURE` on the app's own window and reads it back; a screenshot-unlock hook that drops the bit is the tell.
- **StrongBox attestation level.** `attest:strongbox_level` requests a StrongBox-backed key and checks it attests at StrongBox level, catching a TEE keybox posing as StrongBox.
- **Also in 2.22:** fewer false positives (legitimate rebrands and GSIs, a sandbox-broken `pm`, parked CPU cores), a network-type spoof consistency check, and the per-probe fix now opens in the info dialog.

Full changelog: https://github.com/VD171/VD-Infos/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#222---2026-10-01

release.name: v5.17.2
release.notes:
## 5.17.2 — m3u8 投屏改为经手机中转

- **手机端投屏（Issue #13）**：此前投屏是把原始链接交给电视，而电视请求 m3u8 分片时**不带 `Referer` / `User-Agent` / `Cookie`**，多数片源在这些头做防盗链校验，于是「App 里能播、投屏黑屏」。现在当播放中的视频需要请求头时，投屏改为**经手机中转**：手机按真实头去取分片，改写播放列表后交给电视。链接本身不需要头时仍然直连，不为能播的源平白多绕一跳。
- **顺带修复两个投屏即坏的问题**：① Python 直播源发出的 `127.0.0.1/m3u8` 链接重写成局域网地址后**没带访问令牌**，电视侧会被本机服务直接拒绝（401）；② 投屏**本地视频**时 `/file` 地址同样缺令牌。两者现在都会补上。
- **上游请求头不落进电视可见的 URL**：把真实请求头写进代理地址虽然可行，但那会让 `Cookie` 出现在电视日志与同网段抓包里。改为只在手机内存里保存、按短 id 取回（有效期 12 小时、上限 16 条，自动淘汰）。
- 新增 `HeaderStoreTest`（7 条断言）覆盖寄存行为：透传、逐跳头剔除、大小写、空值、容量淘汰与 id 不可预测性。

### 10 个 APK 产物

文件名附带版本号，例如 `mobile-arm64_v8a-5.17.2.apk` —— 每次发版都是全新的 URL，下载不受 CDN 缓存影响。

- `leanback-universal` — TV 端通用包，适合不确定架构的电视/盒子
- `leanback-arm64_v8a` — TV 端 arm64 (v8a)
- `leanback-armeabi_v7a` — TV 端 armv7
- `mobile-universal` — 手机端通用包，适合不确定架构的手机
- `mobile-arm64_v8a` — 手机端 arm64 (v8a)
- `mobile-armeabi_v7a` — 手机端 armv7
- `mobile-lite-universal` — 手机端精简版通用包（无 MPV 内核与 Python 源）
- `mobile-lite-arm64_v8a` — 手机端精简版 arm64 (v8a)
- `leanback-lite-universal` — TV 端精简版通用包（无 MPV 内核与 Python 源）
- `leanback-lite-arm64_v8a` — TV 端精简版 arm64 (v8a)

### 兼容性提示

- 远程 JAR 必须带 `;sha256;` 否则不加载
- Android 11+ 文件管理按系统能力请求所有文件访问或回退到存储权限
- 自更新改为导出到 Downloads 通知用户手动安装
- 旧设备（Android ≤ 10）行为不变

## Ventic 0.8.1

A new look, closer to Material 3: rounded buttons, switches you can read from across the room, and a collapsed sidebar that names every page under its icon. On Android TV, the home screen tile now shows the Ventic name and fills the whole tile, and the app icon is no longer cropped. On Windows 11, the title bar takes the app's colour, and clicking the picture pauses the film.

### A new look
- **Rounded buttons**, as Material 3 draws them, everywhere in the app and in the player.
- **Switches you can read from across the room.** Off is an outlined track with a small thumb, which grows and fills in when you switch it on. Off used to be a dark grey bar on a dark page, which from the sofa looked like nothing at all.
- **Sliders and progress bars are redrawn too.** A slider has a thicker track and an upright handle, and a progress bar ends in a dot.
- **The collapsed sidebar names every page.** Each icon has its page's name under it, and the icons sit on the page instead of on a dark strip. It used to be a column of icons with only a tooltip to say which was which, and a TV shows no tooltips, so on a television it was eight unlabelled pictures.
- **Long labels wrap instead of being cut off.** Switch labels in Settings, sidebar items in longer languages and a film's credits take a second line where they used to end in "…".
- **An episode's page fits the space it has.** The picture and the details sit side by side when there is room, and the credits are no longer cut short.
- **The tabs in *Settings → Appearance*** match the app's other choosers.

### Empty pages say how they fill
- **Favourites, Watchlist and History explain how something gets there**, so a new install doesn't open on a blank page.
- **A filter that leaves nothing says "Nothing matches."** It used to look like an empty list.
- **The Calendar offers *Browse TV shows*** while you don't follow any

# Duo Launcher 0.15.0-beta01

An experimental Android launcher for foldables, with a right-side dock, native widgets and overlapping Home pages when unfolded. Android 12 or later is required; the tested configurations below are narrower than that minimum.

## Download and install

Use **DuoLauncher-0.15.0-beta01-release.apk** from the release assets (about 2.7 MiB). Open it on the phone, allow installation from that source if Android asks, and open Duo Launcher. The welcome screen lets you try Home, choose it as your default, or add a widget. All optional access can be skipped.

Updates signed with the same release key can install over this beta. A developer/debug build may use a different key and cannot be updated directly with this APK. Keep that configured installation intact rather than uninstalling to bypass a signature error; see [update troubleshooting](https://github.com/jakesgoodapps/DuoLauncher/blob/v0.15.0-beta01/docs/troubleshooting.md). Uninstalling removes saved launcher data and widget bindings.

The assets also include **DuoLauncher-0.15.0-beta01-source.tar.gz** and **SHA256SUMS.txt**. The APK's SHA-256 is:

release.notes:
# SleepManager 0.7.3

> **Note**
>
> **Recent AYN and Retroid devices:** SleepManager supports direct Wi-Fi and Bluetooth control, so the **Compatibility Helper is no longer required** on supported recent AYN and Retroid handhelds.
>
> **Other devices / brands:** install the new **SleepManager Helper** when prompted and grant its **battery optimization exemption**. If SleepManager reports that Wi-Fi control access is required, enable it in **Settings → Apps → Special app access → Wi-Fi control → SleepManager Helper**.

> [!WARNING]
> **AYANEO / KONKR devices — disable DuraSpeed.**
>
> On devices with **DuraSpeed**, turn it **OFF** in Android Settings. DuraSpeed may restrict SleepManager, its Compatibility Helper and sync integrations in the background, preventing Wi-Fi/Bluetooth restoration after long standby.
>
> **Battery usage → Unrestricted is not enough:** DuraSpeed must be disabled separately. This resolved overnight restoration failures on a KONKR Pocket Advance.

## What's New

- **RAOfflineProxy v2.2 compatibility** — when the installed version requires the Android runtime **CONTROL_PROXY** permission, SleepManager can request it through the system permission dialog. Older versions continue to use the existing permission guidance.
- **Read-only Status API v1** — compatible launchers can query whether SleepManager is **enabled** and whether its foreground service is **running**. This API does not change settings or expose private diagnostics. See [Status API documentation](https://github.com/Baggio94/SleepManager/blob/main/docs/status-api.md).

## First Install

1. Install **SleepManager 0.7.3** from the release assets below.
2. Open SleepManager and choose what you want it to manage.
3. If needed, SleepManager will guide you through installing and setting up the **Compatibility Helper**.
4. Enable **SleepManager**, then tap **Finish setup**.

repo.description: Local-first, open-source Android automation with readable rules, honest permission gates, and no account or cloud runtime.

release.name: OpenTasker v0.2.94
release.notes:
This release closes four security holes found since v0.2.93 and fixes Wi-Fi profiles that match a network name. It's signed with the same key as v0.2.93, so it installs straight over it.

### Security

- A Quick Settings tile no longer runs its task from the lock screen. The tap now waits until you unlock, so someone holding your phone can't run whatever the tile is bound to.
- Exports no longer carry a secret you typed into a "Run only if" guard or an action label. The whole guard is replaced, so a guarded action can't come back unguarded after import.
- Another app can no longer take the automation service down by sending OpenTasker a malformed push or Locale message.
- Secret values and the backup passphrase are typed on the password keyboard now, so autocorrect and the personal dictionary can't learn them.

### Fixed

- Wi-Fi profiles that match a network name work again. On Android 12 and later the name always read as "Unknown", and turning Wi-Fi off went unnoticed until OpenTasker restarted. When Android really does hide the name (Location off, or location not allowed all the time), the Inspector now tells you which (#17).
- The location button in Setup works on Android 12 and later. It asked for precise location in a way Android ignores, so tapping it did nothing.
- Global variables set by a run that was cancelled or failed are saved instead of thrown away.
- Lock device actually works. Setup has a new row that turns on a device admin with the single force-lock permission and nothing else.
- About twenty smaller fixes, from Bluetooth triggers that recover after a toggle to a Setup screen that counts what it shows. [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/OpenTasker/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md) has the full list.

### Added

- Write Setting, a new action that changes one Android setting by name, the way Tasker's Custom Setting does. Settings that would hand another app control of your phone are refused outright.
- Profiles can trigger on a broadcast another

release.name: Materializr 1.7.4
release.notes:
# Materializr 1.7.4

Materials and grids: give each body a real material with a mass and a finish, and pattern sketches into grids.

## Added

- **Materials.** Each body can carry a material, picked from the colour swatch in Items or the Properties panel. The list covers common 3D printing plastics (PLA, PETG, ABS, ASA, TPU, nylon and more), metals, wood and a few others. Plastics keep the body's colour; metals and wood repaint it. The material is saved with the project.
- **Volume and mass in Properties.** For printing plastics there is also an estimated printed mass from the infill percentage and wall count, counted the way a slicer does.
- **Material finishes in the viewport.** Metals reflect a photographed studio and wood shows a grain under a satin finish. Settings ▸ Appearance ▸ Materials turns the studio reflections off.
- **Grid sketch patterns.** Linear Pattern can now copy left, right, up and/or down, each with its own count and spacing. Two or more directions make a grid, and all four centre it on the original. Directions follow the screen, whichever way the sketch faces.

## Changed

- The appearance editor opens in place of the Items list instead of a popup, so the viewport stays usable while it is open.

## Fixed

- **Tiled sketch patterns close into regions.** A copy whose corner lands on a neighbour's now shares that point, so every cell of a tiled pattern can be picked for Push/Pull or Extrude. Before, a tiled mesh formed no regions at all.

release.name: Arcanum 1.7.0
release.notes:
### New
- **Take photos straight into the vault** — In Files, New now has Photo: a camera inside the app whose photos go into the folder you are in, encrypted, without passing through any other app or being saved anywhere else on the phone. They keep only which way up they go and when they were taken; the phone's make and model, the camera settings and the location are left out. (#145)
- **Edit a track's tags and its cover** — File info in the music player's menu shows a track's tags, lyrics and cover, and the pencil makes them editable: title, artist, album, album artist, genre, year, track number, lyricist and lyrics. A new cover can come from the vault or from the phone. A photo is turned the right way up and loses its EXIF on the way, so where it was taken does not travel with the song. ## Meow 1.0.8 (versionCode 1000025)

### Engine
- meow-rs bumped v0.18.0 → **v0.20.2** with the full protocol set: Shadowsocks (simple-obfs, v2ray-plugin), Trojan, **VLESS** (+Vision, +post-quantum encryption, REALITY), **VMess**, **Snell**, **Hysteria2**, **AnyTLS**, ech-tls-tunnel; BoringSSL-backed TLS for proxy-outbound ECH and uTLS fingerprinting.

### Fixes
- AnyTLS connections timed out while the VPN was active: session dials resolved the server hostname through the in-tunnel fake-IP DNS and connected to an unroutable address. Dials now go through the engine's real resolver + protected-socket stack (meow-rs v0.20.2).
- Config import validated the raw YAML and rejected configs the engine actually supports (e.g. mihomo's `external-controller: :9090` shorthand); validation now runs on the same stripped config the engine loads.
- Release builds silently lost every Flutter MethodChannel (R8 stripped the reflectively-invoked plugin registrant) — VPN controls were dead in minified builds.

### Project
- Project-wide rename mihomo → meow (`libmeow_android_ffi.so`, `meow.db` with automatic migration of existing profiles).
- Gradle wrapper 8.13 → 8.14; tag-triggered release CI removed (releases are cut locally; Play uploads go through fastlane).

Google Play: uploaded to the internal testing track as versionCode 1000025.

release.name: Knit 2.9.0
release.notes:
Bluetooth that reaches farther, and photos and files that cross the mesh faster

Phones now find each other over Bluetooth from farther apart. When a connection drifts toward the edge of
range, it switches to Bluetooth's long-range mode to stay up, and a phone that loses its last connection
keeps looking at full speed for three minutes. Both phones need the long-range mode, so iPhones and phones
without it connect as before.

Photos, voice messages and files now cost nearby phones fewer copies. Your phone asks the phone that sent a
photo, or one it has a faster Wi-Fi link to, and tries the others only if nothing starts within a few
seconds. Phones that only pass a message along wait, so its recipient gets the photo first, and a transfer
cut off midway picks up where it stopped. A ring shows how much has arrived.

Direct messages and groups are no longer screened as you send them; with Content filtering on, whoever
receives a message decides what stays hidden. Also new: a What's New card in your chats, Retry on a failed
direct file send, an opt-in field log, and photos that keep their sharpness when passed on.

Fixed: slow Bluetooth reconnects, a phone vanishing from nearby while connected to a watch, the same photo
sent two or three times, direct messages that stopped opening after a contact reinstalled, LoRa direct
messages stuck behind room posts, animated stickers arriving still, and a crash pasting in Add contact.

release.name: v1.2.1
release.notes:
### Release Notes

#### 核心更新：

1. Filament 版本升级：

   - 内置 Filament Java / Native 运行库由 `v1.67.1` 升级至 `v1.75.0`。
   - 同步更新 Android JNI、Java Binding 与内置材质资源。

2. 新增相机手势控制：

   - 新增 `CameraGestureController`。
   - 支持单指旋转相机、双指平移相机，以及双指缩放控制相机前后移动。
   - 支持配置旋转、平移、缩放灵敏度和相机俯仰角限制。
   - 相机手势不会消费触摸事件，可与 Node 点击和 `ViewRenderable` 控件交互共存。

3. 动画能力扩展：

   - 新增 `ARAnimationTranslation`，用于实现节点位移动画。
   - 新增 `ARAnimationPath`，用于实现 Bézier 曲线路径动画。
   - `ARAnimationModel` 新增 `getSourceDurationMillis()`，用于获取 GLTF 模型动画的原始时长。
   - 应用层可根据业务需要选择使用模型动画源时长或自定义播放周期。

4. 基本图元与几何接口扩展：

   - `GeometryUtils` 新增 Quad 创建接口 `makeQuad(...)`。
   - 新增以下基本图元创建接口：
     - `makePoints(...)`
     - `makeLines(...)`
     - `makeLineStrip(...)`
     - `makeTriangles(...)`
     - `makeTriangleStrip(...)`
   - 上述接口只需要提供顶点空间坐标和材质，可直接创建对应的 `ModelRenderable`。

5. 点图元与宽线材质：

   - `MaterialFactory` 新增 `makePointsWithColor(...)`，支持设置点图元的屏幕像素尺寸。
   - `MaterialFactory` 新增 `makeLinesWithColor(...)`，支持设置线图元的屏幕像素宽度。
   - 宽线通过三角形展开和 `CUSTOM0` 顶点属性在屏幕空间实现，不受 OpenGL 原生线光栅化宽度限制。
   - 动态 Renderable 新增可配置 Filament 图元拓扑和 `CUSTOM0` 顶点数据支持。

6. RenderableDefinition API 更新：

   - `RenderableDefinition.Submesh` 更新为语义更明确的 `RenderableDefinition.SubGeometry`。
   - 新增 `setSubGeometries(...)` 和 `getSubGeometries()`。
   - 原 `Submesh`、`setSubmeshes(...)` 和 `getSubmeshes()` 接口继续保留，并标记为过时。
   - 支持通过 `RenderableDefinition.setPrimitiveType(...)` 配置图元拓扑。
   - 支持通过 `RenderableInstance.changePrimitive(...)` 动态切换图元类型。

7. Line3D API 更新：

   - `Line3D` 新增 `dispose()`，用于主动释放其持有的 Renderable 和内部资源。
   - `setPipePointMode(...)` 的整型参数更新为类型安全的 `Line3DPipePointMode` 枚举。
   - 支持 `ORIGINAL` 和 `SIN_RESAMPLE` 两种管线端点处理方式。

#### 生命周期与稳定性：

1. GLTF 共享资源管理优化：

   - 调整 GLTF Asset、ResourceLoader、材质提供器、MaterialInstance 与 Renderable 的共享关系。
   - 优化 GLTF 资源加载、复用和回收顺序。
   - 避免 Fragment 或场景切换时提前销毁仍被其他 Renderable 使用的共享资源。

2. SceneLayout 生命周期完善：

   - `SceneLayout.destroy()` 会先递归释放当前场景持有的节点树，再销毁 `SceneView`。

# Release v0.4.3

## English

**A fix release: v0.4.2 ran the whole game on a single CPU core on phones with two big cores, and FPS dropped
below v0.4.1 on them. This version gives the game its cores back.** Upgrading from v0.4.2 keeps your settings.

### Fixed

- **Lower FPS in v0.4.2 on phones with two big CPU cores** (two fast cores and six slow ones: Helio G85 to G99,
  Snapdragon 765G and other 7-series chips, Dimensity 700/810, Exynos 1280, among others). v0.4.2 started telling
  fast and slow cores apart by the kernel's core capacity. On these chips only the two big cores counted as fast:
  one went to the native renderer's thread, and every other thread of the game (game logic, audio, XMA) had to
  share the other one. In the logs of three users (OnePlus Nord, Galaxy A17, onn tablet), the CPU was only
  12-16 % busy, the small cores sat idle, and the renderer waited ~50 ms per frame for the game, against under
  1 ms in v0.4.0.
  - Now the game is only kept on the fast cores when there are at least four of them. Otherwise it uses every
    core, as in v0.4.1, and the renderer's thread still gets the fastest core to itself.
  - **Fastest core for the game** (Performance > Processor) gets the same fix: the other threads no longer share the renderer's core.
  - On a Galaxy A17 with the fix, the CPU went back to 40-46 % busy and the renderer's wait dropped to ~15 ms per
    slow frame.
  - Phones with four or more big cores (Moto G9 Play, Galaxy S23 Ultra) keep the same setup as in v0.4.2.

# ∞ Mpv∞ 2.2.0 — The Smooth Motion Update 🎞️✨

This is our biggest update yet! The headline feature is **frame interpolation**: your videos can now play buttery smooth, up to 120 fps. On top of that, there's a whole new Liquid Glass look, proper radio support and smarter subtitles. Here's what's new 👇

---

## 🎞️ Frame interpolation — silky smooth video

- 🧈 **Buttery smooth playback** — Mpv∞ creates new in-between frames on the fly, so movies, anime and sports look fluid instead of choppy, even when the original video is 24 or 30 fps.
- 🚀 **Up to 120 fps** — match your phone's high refresh-rate screen, with 120 fps as the default target.
- 📱 **Uses your phone's GPU** — the heavy work runs on your phone's graphics chip, so playback stays smooth without overloading your phone.

at the right moment.

  recognizes vendor-prefixed codenames (an Infinix Note 30 reporting
  `Infinix-X6833B`), regional variants (a realme 7 reporting `rmx2151l1`),
  stock OnePlus names (`OnePlus6T` finds fajita), and unified family builds
  (a Redmi 8 reporting `olive` finds the shared `mi439` builds), instead of
  telling you the phone is not in the catalog.

See the full diff and commit log via the **Full Changelog** link below.

---

### iOS - unsigned IPA (for AltStore / TrollStore users)

The iOS `.ipa` asset is **not** signed by an Apple Developer account, so
it will **not** install like a normal app. It is for sideloading with
tools such as [AltStore](https://altstore.io) or TrollStore, which
re-sign it with your own certificate at install time. If you do not use
one of those, ignore this file and grab the Android or desktop builds
above.

release.notes:
### Version 1.0.0

### New Features
*   **Similarity Correction:** Implemented a new "Flag as incorrect" feature for similar media groups. This permanently records the denial, preventing those files from ever being grouped together again, improving the long-term accuracy of the algorithm.
*   **Intelligent Group Hiding:** Groups that are manually hidden now only remain hidden if their internal composition (the set of files in the group) stays exactly the same. If new matching files appear, the group will reappear, preventing missed duplicates.
*   **Support Development:** Added a "Support Development" entry to the Settings screen that provides details and addresses for users wishing to contribute financially to the project.

### Improvements & Fixes
*   **High-Priority Scan Notification:** The notification signaling the completion of a duplicate scan is now set to **High Priority**, ensuring it is more visible to the user.
*   **UI Safety for Gestures:** Bottom action bars on the Duplicates screen and Swiper Summary Sheet are now consistently lifted well and above the system navigation bar, fixing overlapping issues on modern Android devices.
*   **Smoother Gesture Detection:** Improved the logic for detecting when the user is running gesture navigation, making bottom UI adjustments more reliable.
*   **Onboarding Polish:** Fixed the first page of the Onboarding flow to correctly hide the "Previous" button, allowing the "Next" button to span the full width.
*   **Optimized Cache Management:** Changing the Similarity Threshold now only clears the scan results, preserving the image hash cache to save time by avoiding unnecessary re-hashing of files.
*   **Architectural Refinement:** Upgraded the internal Room database structure (v3) to support the new Similarity Correction feature, replacing old caching tables with the permanent denial list.

# SyncWatch同步观影 v2.4.4 发布说明

## 产品简介

SyncWatch同步观影 是开源、自托管的跨平台同步观影与实时协作系统。房主运行自己的服务器，成员通过 Windows、Android 或浏览器加入同一房间。

首次启动后请立即修改默认管理员密码，并妥善保存新的凭据。

## 下载文件怎么选

| 下载文件 | 版本标识 | 最适合谁 | 一句话说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SyncWatch-Experience-Client-Portable-v2.4.4-x64.exe` | Windows 体验版 | 普通成员 | 连接已有服务器，不启动本机服务端。 |
| `SyncWatch-v2.4.4-Full-Offline-Portable-x64.exe` | Windows 完整便携版 | 房主 | 双击即可开房，包含完整运行环境。 |
| `SyncWatch-Android-v2.4.4-universal.apk` | Android 通用 APK | 手机成员或房主 | 加入房间，受支持设备可运行手机服务器。 |
| `node-v24.19.0-*.msi` | Node.js 官方环境包 | 开发者/独立服务器 | 仅源码和独立 Node 服务端需要。 |
| `cloudflared-windows-*` | cloudflared 独立工具 | 公网部署用户 | Cloudflare Tunnel 连接器，不是 SyncWatch 启动程序。 |

## 更新公告

- 修复长时间保持房间播放时的权威时钟越界：服务端按已知媒体时长投影播放进度，到达末尾自动暂停并广播最终时间；新加入成员不再跳到影片末尾之后而持续缓冲。
- 修复原画偏好在公网或浏览器环境下选择不可解码源的问题：当 MKV、HEVC、10-bit 或其他高风险容器/编码已有已验证兼容 MP4 时，客户端自动选择 H.264/AAC 兼容源；可直接播放的 H.264/MP4 仍保留原画。
- 增加播放时钟封顶、自动兼容源选择和缺少媒体时长时的时钟投影回归测试；既有媒体 Range、NAT/反向代理、格式分类和网络恢复测试继续覆盖。
- 同步更新 Windows、Android、Docker、下载中心、Pages、仓库 Wiki、版本字段与发布清单为 v2.4.4；正式资产必须由最终 Tag 真实构建，并通过启动、哈希和远端页面验收。

## 使用说明

- 普通用户怎么选：Windows 成员下载 Experience；房主下载 Full Offline；手机用户安装 Android APK；也可直接用浏览器加入。
- Windows + Android 套装：房主使用 Windows 完整便携版，成员使用 Experience 或 Android APK。
- 一键运行包含什么：Windows 完整便携版包含服务端、前端、媒体处理和客户端/Android 离线资源。
- 架构支持边界：Windows 应用提供 x64；Android APK 包含 arm64-v8a、armeabi-v7a、x86_64；小米 14/HyperOS 真机未在本轮实测。
- cloudflared 独立工具：只从 Cloudflare 官方 Release 获取并按官方校验值核对，用于把自建服务器转为 HTTPS 公网入口。
- Node.js 官方环境包：仅用于源码开发或独立服务器，Windows 应用本身不要求另装 Node.js。

# Nboard v1.5.1 - 100 Stars Celebration: Profiles, AI Choice & Better Typing

🎉 **Thank You for 100 Stars!** 🎉

Thank you to everyone who has starred Nboard, shared it, reported issues, and helped shape the keyboard. This celebration release focuses on the requests that make the biggest difference every day: more reliable typing, flexible language profiles, configurable feedback, and freedom to choose your AI provider.

## What's New

- **Language Profiles, Your Way**: Configure both quick profiles from a dedicated page, give each one a custom name, and see that name directly in the main settings summary.
- **Profile-Specific Special Keys**: Left and right special-key choices are now saved independently for each profile and restored automatically when switching.
- **Choose Your AI Provider**: Use Gemini, Anthropic, or an OpenAI-compatible service.
- **Ready-Made Provider Presets**: OpenAI, DeepSeek, Kimi, Groq, and OpenRouter are available from a dropdown, with a Custom option for other HTTPS endpoints.
- **Current AI Models**: Gemini 3.6 Flash is the new Gemini default, with Gemini 3.5 Flash and Flash-Lite options; Anthropic includes Claude Sonnet 5, Claude Haiku 4.5, and Claude Opus 5.
- **Unified AI Settings**: Provider, model, endpoint, and credentials now live in one cohesive settings card.

## Typing Improvements

- **Swipe Typing Rebuilt**: Nboard now compares the complete finger path with word shapes generated from the active keyboard layout, then reranks matches using endpoint accuracy and local language context.
- **Reliable Fast Gestures**: Swipe paths are sampled even when the visual trail is disabled, fixing gestures beginning with `H` that could previously produce `hui` or no word.
- **Fewer Missed Keys**: Touches in the gaps between keys are routed to the nearest valid key.
- **Configurable Vibration**: Choose `Off`, `System`, `Light`, `Medium`, or `Strong`.
- **Language and Apostrophe Actions**: Both are available as configurable special-key actions.

## Nothing to redo

Deskhub 9.3.1 speaks the same authentication version as every 9.x release, so hosts and
clients on any 9.x release talk to each other and no device has to be let in again.
Coming from 8.x or older, read the

device must be on Deskhub 9.

The fixes below are on the Mac you connect **to**; the viewer needs nothing new.

## 🐛 Fixes

- **A Mac can now be signed into from the login window.** With *Allow access before
  anyone signs in* on, 9.3.0 showed a viewer the login window but swallowed its mouse and
  keyboard, and the first click froze the picture until someone signed in at the Mac. The
  host before sign-in now posts input through IOKit, the route macOS keeps open at the
  login window, and never freezes.
- **A Mac set to start Deskhub at login and share on launch shares again without a
  click.** When the app had been living in the menu bar at the previous shutdown, macOS
  brought it back at login without a window, and the share that waited for that window
  never started: the Mac answered at the login window, then went quiet the moment someone
  signed in, until the window was opened by hand. The app now starts that share on its
  own and opens its window at launch, as the settings promise.
- **A Mac that is sharing stays reachable through Log Out.** The app used to quit the
  moment macOS began logging out, while a terminal with a running process or an unsaved
  document was still asking whether to quit, leaving the viewer unable to answer. The share
  now stays up until every other app has quit; if the log-out is cancelled on the Mac, the
  app keeps running.
- **Fewer round trips to the daemon.** While waiting for a display at login, the app sent
  its *access before sign-in* copies to the daemon on every half-second probe; it now
  sends them only when the settings or the allowed list change, when a share stops and
  once at launch.

图像层(YOLO/VLM)点击现在需要会话内先确认『屏幕上真的是广告』,三种独立信号任一即可:

- **「广告」角标**:监管要求开屏广告必须标注;复用 L2 已在跑的 OCR,一次推理两用,零新增开销;
- **递减倒计时**:同一屏幕区域的数字跨轮询递减——正常界面几乎不存在此特征;时钟、电量、价格等被解析规则排除。确认后轮询窗口按剩余秒数动态延长(上限 90s),覆盖超长广告;
- **广告 SDK 指纹**:穿山甲/优量汇/快手联盟/百青藤/华为/小米/OPPO/vivo 等的窗口类名与 view id。

L1/L2 关键词层保持不设门控——精确且是无可读标记广告的兜底,已有场景不回退。

## 无广告 App 自动降级(#14)

连续 15 次无广告证据的启动会话后,该 App 降为 L1-only(不截屏、不 OCR、无图像层),近乎零开销;每第 5 次会话全量探测,SDK 信号即刻解除降级,App 更新自动重置。

## 豆瓣回归修复(#16)

豆瓣把信息流预载在广告下层,广告屏节点树 >30,#14 的全时段树检查曾把图像层整个闪屏期关闭。现核心 8s 窗口内仅证据门控决定,8s 后树检查继续保护信息流。真机验证:豆瓣冷启动 2–4s 内跳过,45s 窗口零误点。

## 诊断增强(#16)

手势注入结果(completed/CANCELLED)写入日志——『点了没反应』和『成功点击』此前在日志里不可区分。

安装包为 keystore 签名的 release 构建(minify + shrinkResources)。

### New
- **Cloud Connect:** improved cloud sync behavior with status/ping indication. The cloud now handles your data much more safely. Previously, if you saved or read content while disconnected, that activity was stored locally, and after reconnecting the server could overwrite local progress with older cloud state (including saved items and reading history). This no longer happens: reconnect now preserves local changes correctly instead of blindly replacing them.
- **Image Search:** added image-based search (via the icon in the search bar).
- **Search by ID:** you can now find titles directly by ID.
- **Account-based NH Blacklist:** your blacklist is now linked to your account and works across sessions/devices.
- **Improved catalog filters:** expanded filtering options by language and pages.
- **Tag opening behavior:** added the **“Respect active tags when opening a book tag”** setting.  
  When this option is enabled, opening a tag from a book keeps your currently active tag filters and adds the selected tag on top of them.  
  When disabled, opening a tag from a book resets current tag filters and opens only that selected tag by itself.  
  This gives you control over whether tag browsing should **refine** your current filter context or **start a new** one.

### UI/UX Changes
- Updated filter and search panel interface.
- Added visual labels for hidden blacklist content (`Hidden by blacklist`).
- Improved navigation and readability in list/grid views.

I’ll be experimenting with the design in the near future, so join us on Discord: [https://discord.gg/VnxH7yfPqf](https://discord.gg/VnxH7yfPqf)  
Thank you for using NHApp 💙

repo.description: Android app for transcribing voice messages locally on-device, with no internet required.

release.name: Anti-Vocale v1.15.0
release.notes:
# Anti-Vocale 1.15.0

## For everyone

- **Automatic WhatsApp voice-note transcription**: new WhatsApp (and WhatsApp Business) voice notes transcribe themselves as they arrive. Opt-in per app, fully on-device: detection reads only the folder listing, and a note is read only to transcribe it. Notes that arrived while the app was away are caught up with a single digest notification, and sender names land on the History rows when available.
- **Similar-words History search**: a new toggle in the History search widens a query to words the recognizer may have mis-heard (gemination, vowel shifts, voicing). Language-agnostic by construction, with a verbatim-substring floor so the similar mode never returns fewer results than the literal one.
- **Paragraph breaks on long pauses**: long silences in a dictation become paragraph breaks in the transcript, and playback can skip them.
- **Self-healing models**: a damaged model directory heals itself from a healthy sibling variant, the in-flight request retries once automatically, and the History row notes the variant switch. Backups now carry that flag too.
- **Open Transcribe provider (experimental)**: other apps can use Anti-Vocale as their on-device transcriber through the vendor-neutral Open Transcribe contract (Forkgram already lists it).
- **Streaming quality**: beam search on the streaming backend (Nemotron); repetition-loop truncation for Whisper; keyword biasing for domain vocabulary.
- **Resilience**: a corrupted History database recovers (rename aside, recreate, notify) instead of crash-looping; every preferences DataStore recovers from corruption; DataStore, watermark and recovery paths hardened through the window.
- **Community catalog**: TranscribePsy-250M-EU joined the catalog (25 locales claimed at launch); multilingual markers and language flags in the Models tab; bundle exports fall back to entry-level catalog languages.
- Engine updated to sherpa-onnx 2.0.1. On our 11-clip Italian reference bench Parakeet measu

release.name: V2X2MAP 0.2.3 — DENM cause code decoding
release.notes:
## What's new in 0.2.3

### Android: DENM cause code decoding

The app now decodes the **ETSI EN 302 637-3 UPER payload** of every DENM packet to extract `causeCode` and `subCauseCode` from the SituationContainer.

**Before:** Every DENM appeared as a generic *"Gefahrenmeldung / Hazard warning"* regardless of the actual reported event.

**After:** The log list and detail sheet show the specific event type:

| causeCode | Label |
|-----------|-------|
| 1 | Traffic condition |
| 2 | Accident |
| 3 | Roadworks |
| 14 | Wrong-way driver |
| 26 | Slow vehicle |
| 27 | Dangerous end of queue |
| 91 | Vehicle breakdown |
| 94 | Stationary vehicle |
| 95 | Emergency vehicle approaching |
| 97 | Collision risk |
| … | (all 22 standard ETSI cause codes) |

Unknown / proprietary cause codes (e.g. OEM extensions) are displayed as *"Code N"* instead of crashing or being silently dropped.

The parser follows the **EN 302 637-3 v1.3.x** schema:
- ManagementContainer without extension bit (v1.2.x-compatible)
- SituationContainer with extension bit (v1.3.x)
- AltitudeValue 20 bits, RelevanceDistance 3 bits, RelevanceTrafficDirection 2 bits
- Verified empirically against a real-world capture (556 frames, 13 DENMs from a passenger car performing a stationary-vehicle warning)

---

## Bridge / Windows / Linux

No changes since v0.2.2. The bridge binaries (`its-g5-bridge.exe`, `its-g5-setup.exe`, `.deb`) are the same as in v0.2.1/v0.2.2.

---

## Downloads

| File | Platform | Description |
|------|----------|-------------|
| `V2X2MAP-0.2.3.apk` | Android 7+ | Sideload via ADB or file manager |
| `its-g5-bridge.exe` | Windows 10/11 | USB→MQTT bridge + dashboard (double-click) |
| `its-g5-setup.exe` | Windows 10/11 | First-time setup wizard + firmware flash |
| `v2x2map-bridge_0.2.3_all.deb` | Debian / Ubuntu | `sudo dpkg -i v2x2map-bridge_0.2.3_all.deb` |

release.name: Entryway Android TV 1.0.13
release.notes:
# Entryway Android TV 1.0.13

TV 独立正式版，构建号 **57**，Release + R8、正式发布证书签名，提供 arm64-v8a 与 armeabi-v7a 两个安装包。1.0.12 之后的功能版本：推荐首页改版为独立“服务器”、无需 TMDB 密钥、详情可直接播放，搜索提速，按设备能力选择流畅的版本，并汇总反馈 #81、#100–#103。手机版独立发布 1.0.14；Entryway 永久免费。

## 新功能

**推荐首页**
- 推荐首页像一台独立的服务器：与服务器首页相同的左侧导航栏，左上角胶囊显示“推荐首页”。页面为大幅剧照配艺术字标题、年份、类型与简介，下方是分类标签（更新推荐、猜你喜欢、热门电影……电视剧榜单，电影 / 电视筛选可选类型）和竖版海报；右上角“自定义首页”可编辑分类。
- 无需 TMDB 密钥：推荐内容默认来自豆瓣；填写自己的 TMDB 密钥后，豆瓣失败或过慢时自动改用 TMDB，未填写时页面会提示。
- 推荐影片的详情页与服务器详情页一致，信息优先取自 TMDB：自动检索全部服务器，按“多版本时优先”在 3 秒内选出主服务器，可直接播放，版本、字幕、音轨都能选，剧集显示季与分集；“服务器资源”标出当前服并列出其他服务器的版本。
- 推荐影片的详情、服务器资源与剧集分集每天自动缓存，详情约 1 秒打开；不在推荐里的影片在下次刷新时清除，新加入的自动补上。
- 海报与剧照改用高分辨率图片。

**播放**
- 多个版本未指定时，优先选本机能流畅播放的版本：避开没有杜比视界硬件时的 Profile 5、超出解码能力的规格以及低端机上的 4K 60 帧；手动与记住的选择不受影响。
- 持续掉帧时，卡顿提示会到其他服务器寻找更容易播放的版本，提供“切换版本”，从当前进度接着播。
- 播放器顶栏在片名下显示正在播放的服务器（#100）。

**搜索、媒体库与配置**
- 搜索提速：各服务器的片名列表保存在本机，启动后在后台准备好，进入搜索即可搜索；过期的列表在后台更新，较大的媒体库分页并行读取。
- 媒体库按片名、上映日期或评分排序时，右侧有索引栏可按字母、年份或分数跳转；按住方向键显示“第 N 部 / 共 M 部”。
- “从手机导入”与“用手机配置”合并为一个入口，配置页可直接上传备份文件；尚未添加服务器时也能在添加服务器页用手机配置。
- 跨版本恢复手机备份与“发送到电视”：逐项导入，未能导入的项目单独列出。
- 检查更新与下载安装包改用自有双云下载服务（杭州为主、上海备用、GitHub 兜底），按系统 ABI 选择 64 位或 32 位安装包，支持断点续传与 SHA-256、签名校验。
- Trakt 同步更准确：超过 5 分钟才补发的“看完”按原始观看时间写入历史；30 分钟内未发出的“开始播放”不再补发；重试时先查历史，已写入就不再重复。

## 性能

- 杜比视界 Profile 5 在弱 GPU 上自动改用预先计算的色彩映射：天猫魔盒每帧处理从 25–50 毫秒降到 11–14 毫秒，4K 60 帧不再被限制在约 25 帧。

## 修复

- 退出跨服版本切换后回到原来的服务器与页面，播放记录记在对应服务器上（#102）。
- 播放器自动切换内核时在屏幕上说明原因，并记录每次自动切换（#103）。
- 媒体库、搜索、人物、影视库网格统一使用首页海报卡片，下方显示“年份 · ★评分”（#101）。
- 首页侧栏循环移动：在“设置”上按上键到“服务器”，在最后一项按下键回到顶部（#81）。
- 低端机不支持的“ASS 特效字幕”会提示不支持，不再看似开启却无效。
- 字体调大时，搜索页的“片名 / 演员”切换不再被切掉一截，键盘最后一行数字也不再超出屏幕（键按剩余高度缩放，正常字号下不变）。

## 安装

已安装 TV 1.0.1 及以后的正式版可直接覆盖升级，建议先在「设置 › 备份与恢复」备份。64 位系统选择 arm64-v8a，32 位系统选择 armeabi-v7a。1.0.12 及更早版本仍通过原有渠道发现本次更新；升级到 1.0.13 后，之后的更新改由双云下载服务提供。

## 验证与已知限制

- 在合并后的 main 上运行全部模块单元测试 2,648 项：0 失败，3 项因缺少 DVD/Blu-ray 宿主夹具跳过；`:tv-app:lintDebug` 无错误。已核对包名、版本、ABI、正式签名（v1 + v2）、弹弹Play native signer，包内无 AppSecret 明文。
- 正式包实机验证：arm64-v8a 在 MediaTek 投影仪（Android 11，1080p，较大字号）上由 1.0.12 正

- **Copying a world** — copying a world moved its cards and sessions to the copy and left the original empty. This is fixed. The copy now also takes the world's images, PDFs, attachments and package links, and links inside text point to the copy's own cards.
- **Downloading a world twice** — downloading the same world from **Marketplace** or **Marketplace → Official** a second time emptied the first download. This is fixed: each download is its own world.
- **Downloading a package twice** — downloading the same package a second time renamed the first one and moved its cards to the new one. This is fixed. Installing an official package as a copy is covered too.
- **Lost card edits** — a second edit made right after the first (typing a name, then the description) could replace the first edit. This is fixed: both are kept.

repo.description: RealSense™ ID SDK

release.name: Version 3.6.1
release.notes:
## New Features — All Devices

| Feature | Description |
| ------- | ----------- |
| **Embedded C SDK for low power micro controllers** | New pure-C host SDK (`rsid_embedded`) for MCU and embedded targets with no STL or exception dependencies. Full authentication and enrollment API over any byte-stream transport. Enable with `-DRSID_EMBEDDED=ON`.  |
| **One-to-One Authentication** | 1:1 authentication is now always available in the open-source SDK without additional build flags or external dependencies |
| **Android One-to-One Authentication** | 1:1 authentication is now supported on Android  |
| **Adaptive Body Part Detection** | Body part detector adapts to scene conditions and speed of walking for improved reliability and accuracy |
| **Numeric Face Distance Limit** | Maximum authentication distance is now configurable as a continuous numeric value (up to 150 cm) instead of a fixed set of options |
| **Hardware JPEG Encoding for Cropped Faces** | Cropped face images are now encoded on the device's hardware JPEG encoder, reducing CPU load and USB bandwidth during authentication. See also: Performance. |
| **Updated AI Models** | Body parts, pose estimation, and anti-tailgating models refreshed for improved accuracy |

---

## Bug Fixes

* Invalid feature results appearing in multi-face scenarios when no valid face was present
* Face Too Far not reported correctly when other faces are also in frame
* `rsid-cli` reboot command not working

release.name: PGPony 4.7.1
release.notes:
# PGPony 4.7.1

Two fixes on top of 4.7.0. 4.7.1 carries versionCode 471 and installs in place over 4.7.0.

## Opening the full text of a long message

The inline result of a decrypt shows the first 4,000 characters, and Open full text shows the rest. That view laid
out the whole message at once, which could take long enough on a slower phone for Android to report PGPony as not
responding. It now loads the text in blocks and lays out only the ones on screen. You can select text within a
block; Copy still copies the complete message.

## Signing with ECDSA keys on a security key (#102)

A security key holding ECDSA keys (secp256k1, the NIST curves or brainpool) could not sign: the card returns its
signature as two raw numbers, PGPony passed them on unchanged, and the OpenPGP library expects them in a different
encoding, so signing failed with "exception decoding signature" after the PIN and the tap. PGPony now converts the
signature, and hashes with SHA-256 on 256-bit curves, SHA-384 on 384-bit curves and SHA-512 on P-521 and
brainpoolP512r1. This covers every card signature: messages, files, mail apps, certifications and expiry changes.

The labels were wrong for those keys too. Key Details named every ECDH subkey X25519, and a card on one of these
curves was stored as Ed25519 + Cv25519. Both now show the real curve. An entry stored with the wrong label is
corrected the next time you scan the card.

release.notes:
## NewTermux 1.6.2 — Background Keep-Alive & Session Persistence

NewTermux now **survives being pushed to the background** when a fullscreen game (or any memory-hungry app) takes over the foreground — and if the system tears it down anyway, your **terminal tabs come back**.

### What's new

- **Background keep-alive.** The partial wake lock is now tied to the *session lifecycle* — held whenever at least one terminal session is alive — instead of the old Activity `onStart`/`onStop` coupling that made it flap on every lifecycle change (game launch, picture-in-picture, screen off). New **"Keep alive in background"** setting, on by default, gates it.

- **Typed foreground service (`specialUse`).** On Android 14/15 the keep-alive service previously ran with *no* `foregroundServiceType`, so the host process still looked "empty" to the OS and got trimmed under memory pressure. It now declares **`specialUse`** — a real, long-lived, user-initiated terminal session, with no daily-runtime cap. This is what stops the background reaping on aggressive low-memory-killer devices (e.g. AYANEO Pocket FIT and similar handhelds).

- **Battery-optimization prompt.** A one-time, gated request to exempt NewTermux from Doze / battery optimization, surfaced from the keep-alive setting. Only appears if you're not already exempt and haven't been asked before.

- **Session persistence.** Your open tabs (name + working directory) are saved to `~/.termux/session_state.json` and rehydrated if the service is restarted. This restores the **view** — a process the OS already killed can't be revived, but you won't lose your tab layout.

### Notes

- The main APKs use the `com.termux` package name for full binary compatibility — **uninstall the original Termux before installing**. Updating in-place from 1.6.1 or a 1.6.2 pre-release is fine.
- To trial NewTermux *alongside* Termux, install the `test-coexist` demo build (`com.termux.demo`) instead — it runs a harmless demo shell so you can explore the U

release.name: v2.0.0
release.notes:
openvpn_flutter **2.0.0** is on [pub.dev](https://pub.dev/packages/openvpn_flutter/versions/2.0.0): a new Android engine, macOS support and a reworked API.

### Highlights
- **Android:** OpenVPN 2.7 / OpenSSL 3.5 engine with **16 KB page size** support (Google Play requirement), no `MainActivity` changes, per-app VPN (`allowedPackages`), encrypted private keys, session timeouts, a single notification, clear errors instead of "OpenVPN process exited", and VPN Gate/old servers working again.
- **iOS & macOS:** macOS support (#151), one shared implementation (CocoaPods or Swift Package Manager), the stage of a running VPN after relaunch, live traffic counters, `denied`/`reconnect`/`error` stages, and a new crash-free `PacketTunnelProvider.swift` that shares its log and errors with the app.
- **Dart:** `connect()` completes (and returns `false` when the permission is refused), `disconnect()` is awaitable, stage/status/log streams, `lastError()`, `getLogs()`.

### Upgrading
```yaml
dependencies:
  openvpn_flutter: ^2.0.0
```
Android apps need `packaging { jniLibs { useLegacyPackaging = true } }` in `android/app/build.gradle(.kts)`. Read [Migrating from 1.x](https://github.com/nizwar/openvpn_flutter#migrating-from-1x) and the [changelog](https://github.com/nizwar/openvpn_flutter/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md).

Thanks to @kekko7072 for macOS support and to everyone who reported, debugged and answered issues over the years.

release.notes:
The first stable release of Jenny. From here on, a change that breaks something you rely on gets a new major number.

## What's new

- **A new home** built around the conversation, with swipeable pages: Apps, Jenny, Notebooks and Settings. A Jenny App or a notebook can be pinned as a page of its own.
- **The workshop**: the previous interface, regrouped into four drawers (Console, Brain, Hands, Memory) behind Settings.
- **Jenny outside the app**: she floats above other apps and you can talk to her there, and you can reply to her from the notification shade.
- **Notebooks in the home**, each with its own chat, pages and map, plus editing and reporting from the reader.
- **Synthwave '84** is the new default theme, and the onboarding and splash screen wear it.
- Sturdier streaming from providers, tighter network and file guards, and every word in every theme readable at 4.5:1.

Over 800 changes since 0.11.0. The full list, including the changes you may notice, is in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/flagdizero/jenny-android-ai-agent/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

## Updating

Jenny 0.7.0 or newer offers this update on its own, and Android asks you to confirm the install. Older versions need the APK below installed by hand, once. The signing key is unchanged, so it installs over your current version and keeps your data.

## Verify what you downloaded

```
sha256  6fa89bb2e6e08b260b1cbbd98def48585a1a38feb164b096d2564126cdf6ba43
size    75244909 bytes (71.8 MB)
```

```bash
shasum -a 256 jenny-1.0.0.apk
```

The hash proves you got this file whole; the **signature** is what proves it came from
this project, and Android checks it for you on an in-place update. To check it yourself:

```bash
apksigner verify --print-certs jenny-1.0.0.apk
```

The certificate is the same one published with
[0.3.0](https://github.com/flagdizero/jenny-android-ai-agent/releases/tag/v0.3.0) — if it
ever differs, the build did not come from this project.

release.name: v0.9.41: LivePortrait face editor, face animator and talking photo, and an hf-mirror download source
release.notes:
A face editor and a face animator, on LivePortrait. Make someone smile or turn their head, make a photo move like a video, or make a photo talk. And every processor is now optional.

## Face editor

**face_editor** is FaceFusion's own face editor, with its fourteen sliders: eyebrows, gaze
left/right and up/down, eyes open, lips open, grim, pout, purse, smile, mouth position, and
head nod, turn and tilt. Turn the chip on, open its gear and move a slider; the result pane
updates as you go.

The sliders are offsets. **Smile +0.5** adds that much smile to whatever the face is already
doing, so on a video every frame gets the same edit while the person keeps talking and moving
as filmed. With every slider at zero it does nothing and costs nothing. About 0.2 s per face
on an 8 Elite.

## Face animator

**face_animator** makes the face in a photo move like the face in a video you pick: head,
eyes and expression. Pick a photo as the target, turn the chip on, add a **Driver** video and
press **Run**; you get a video the driver's length, with the driver's sound. It is
LivePortrait's own use and something FaceFusion itself does not have. About 4 frames a
second on an 8 Elite.

It never swaps: swapping the frames of an animated photo is the same as animating a
different photo, so pick that photo instead.

## Talking photo

Lip sync now works on a photo too. Turn on **lip_syncer** with a photo target, pick a voice,
press **Run**, and the photo's mouth moves to it, in a video the voice's length. With the
face animator on as well, the head moves like the driver and the mouth like the voice.

## Every processor is optional

As in FaceFusion, any processor can be turned off, as long as one stays on. They run in the
order the chips are drawn: face_swapper or face_animator, then face_editor, then
lip_syncer, then face_enhancer. The screen only asks for what the processors that are on
need: a source face for the swapper, a driver for the animator, a voice for the lip syncer.

release.notes:
## v2.2.0 – Major UI Overhaul & Immersive Reading Experience

This release brings a complete redesign of the app's navigation, a brand-new Home dashboard, immersive full‑screen search, and an optional 3D page‑turn animation for Canvas mode.

### ✨ New Features

- **Tab‑based Navigation** – Three main tabs:  
  - *Home* – curated Internet Archive dashboard with book recommendations and statistics.  
  - *Scroll* – your local books in dynamic text mode.  
  - *Canvas* – your local books in original layout mode.  
- **Morphing Full‑screen Search** – tap the search bar to expand into a full‑screen modal with smooth morphing animation. Supports both local library and Internet Archive search.  
- **Grid / List Layout Toggle** – switch between card grid and compact list view for your local shelves.  
- **3D Page‑Turn Animation (Canvas Mode)** – optional, gesture‑driven page‑flip effect that mimics a physical book (with shadows, perspective, and tilt). Enable/disable in reader settings.  
- **Archive Dashboard** – curated rows of popular books from Internet Archive (Fiction, Science, History, Technology, Philosophy, Fantasy) displayed on the Home tab.  
- **Ripple Touch Feedback** – Material‑style ripple effect on buttons and cards for a more tactile experience.  
- **Ko‑fi Donation Link** – added alongside the existing Saweria option.

### ⚡ Performance & Optimizations

- **Parallel Canvas Pre‑rendering** – next and previous pages are rendered concurrently, reducing lag during page turns.  
- **ZIP Backup Improvements** – compression level lowered to 1, saving CPU/RAM; file writing is now chunked (4 MB per block) to prevent crashes on low‑memory devices.  
- **Cover Loading** – more robust handling of various cover formats (Blob, base64, URLs), applied across all book instances (grid, list, sliders).  
- **Flicker Prevention** – added `backface-visibility` and `will-change` to floating UI elements for smoother rendering.

### 🎨 UI & UX Enhancements

release.name: Release v1.4.6
release.notes:
# 更新内容

## v1.4.6（2026-10-24）

**这一版补的是三处「用起来会卡住或不敢碰」的地方。**

- **Shizuku / ADB 下自动补授「写入安全设置」**：priv-kit 在服务端不是 root、又没有
  `GRANT_RUNTIME_PERMISSIONS` 时会跳过授权，Shizuku 正好落在这一支，于是「自动开启无障碍」
  和开机自愈都缺这条权限。现在改由特权服务执行一次 `pm grant`（5 秒上限，失败只记日志）；
  权限会持久化，之后开机不再要求特权服务在线。root（KernelSU 等）行为不变。
- **新增订阅显示进度**：下载 → 解析 → 检查 → 保存四个阶段都会显示在链接对话框里，保存阶段
  不可取消（避免写一半）；失败提示留在对话框内，不用关掉重来。
- **订阅内应用分组可拖拽排序**：仅本地订阅，长按拖动；原地松手仍是进入多选。保存失败会自动
  回到拖拽前的顺序，拖拽期间不响应多选与批量操作。

本版无数据库迁移、无配置格式变更，可回退到 v1.4.5。

## v1.4.5（2026-10-20）

**这一版没有新功能，修的是「看起来正常、其实缺了一截」和「说法容易被误解」两件事。**

- **AI 回复截断**：之前只有 Chat Completions 的**流式**响应能识别「被长度上限截断」。这版把
  非流式响应（Chat Completions 非流式 / Anthropic / Responses）也纳入判定；SSE 流中途被
  掐断时不再当作完整回复，而是按原预算重试一次。
- **更新通道**：测试通道改为读取 `version/beta.json`，不再和稳定通道共用一份元数据；
  `version/*.json` 增加构建门禁——版本号、日志首条、倒序、下载地址与 tag 任何一处不一致都会
  让构建直接失败，避免出现「改了 JSON 忘了 gradle」的错版。
- **文案与接口**：应用名组件 `GkAppNameText` 的 `appId` 改为必传，把「参数都缺时的运行时报错」
  提前成编译期约束（顺带修掉两个只传 `appInfo` 的调用点）；无障碍权限按钮改为
  「单次授予」，写入安全设置改为「永久授予」，工作模式「基础 / 增强」改为
  「手动开启 / 自动开启」——原文案容易被理解成功能强弱。

本版无数据库迁移、无配置格式变更，可回退到 v1.4.4。

## v1.4.4（2026-10-15）

**v1.4.2 给外部调用加了锁，这版把钥匙递到用户手里。**

- **新增「设置 - 高级设置 - 外部调用命令」**：查看并复制 Tasker / adb 使用的完整命令。
  v1.4.2 给 `ExposeService` 加 token 鉴权之前，任意应用都能触发截图与全局同步；但鉴权加上后
  token 只落在应用私有目录和自动生成的 `expose.sh` 里，手动调用的用户没有任何途径拿到它，
  等于这条路对普通用户是关着的。现在这一页直接给出可用命令。
- token 默认掩码，只露前 3 位，点击上方命令文本才展开；复制按钮始终复制含真实 token 的完整
  命令。命令固定 `--ei expose 0`（抓取快照），没有做 -1/1 的选择器。

本版相对 v1.4.3 只有这一个设置页（`AdvancedPage` +57 行、5 条字符串）。无障碍点广告主流程、
AI 生成链路、数据库与配置格式全部未动。

### 未验证项

纯展示 + 复制到剪贴板，不碰启动流程，风险面很小。没有实机跑过的点：

1. 长命令在窄屏上的换行与可读性。
2. 页面显示的 token 与 `ExposeService` 实际校验的值不一致 —— 若发生，外部调用会得到
   「外部调用被拒绝：缺少或错误的 token」提示。

### 出问题怎么办

- **反馈**：设置 - 高级设置 - 导出日志，日志里带外部调用的鉴权判断记录。
- **回退**：本版只有 `9631ece` 一个功能提交，整体回到 v1.4.3（`93fc089`）只需 revert 它，
  不涉及数据库迁移、不涉及配置格式变更，用户侧无感。

## v1.4.3（2026-10-15）

**AI 生成这条链一次过；顺带两个界面交互修好**

- **Chat Completions 改走 SSE 流式，并加上 Max Tokens 自适应**：预算偏小自动抬到 16384、
  输出被截断（`finish_reason == "length"`）就翻倍重试、被服务端拒绝则回退到 81

repo.description: Scan your Android apps and see which ones Morphe can patch.

release.name: PatchIt 1.0.4
release.notes:
PatchIt scans the apps on your Android device and shows which of them the
[Morphe](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patcher) patch ecosystem can actually
patch — then hands the covering patch sources to Morphe Manager.

### Features

- **Scans installed apps** — version name and code, split APKs, signing
  certificate, install dates, APK size.
- **Checks compatibility** — by `versionCode` first, version name second. Verdicts
  are `supported`, `experimental`, `untested`, `too new`, `too old` or
  `no patches`, computed per source.
- **Covers community patches** — ~4,200 patches across ~970 packages.
- **Browses apps you don't have** — switch the Apps tab to **All apps** to see
  every package the sources cover, not only the ones installed.
- **Works offline** — both indexes cached, plus a bundled snapshot.
- **Sets Morphe up** — sends the covering repositories to Morphe Manager through
  its real `add-source` deep link.
- **Auto-updates in-app** — finds newer versions from a banner or from Settings.
- **Material You 3** — wallpaper-derived colour, AMOLED black, themed icon.

### New in 1.0.4

- **All apps.** The Apps tab now has an **Installed / All apps** switch. All apps
  lists every app the patch sources cover, whether or not you have it installed.
  Tap one to see which versions it supports and add that source to Morphe.

### Notes

- Requires **Android 6.0+**, and Morphe Manager for the source hand-off.
- Only add patch sources you trust.

release.name: v1.4.13
release.notes:
A Desktop entry that answers for itself and a Command Center that stays where you left it. Nova 1.4.13 is matched with Polaris 1.4.13. Experimental PyroWave is available in Android beta builds and the separate Linux bundle described below; the stable Android APKs do not enable it.

**PyroWave on Android (experimental, beta builds only)**

- Nova can decode PyroWave, an intra only wavelet codec that runs as plain Vulkan compute rather than on a hardware video decoder. A lost packet costs one frame instead of everything up to the next keyframe.
- In the Android beta, v1.4.13-beta.3 (the app named Nova Pre), pick it under **Settings → Client Stream Defaults → Change codec settings → PyroWave (experimental)**. The per-game Video Codec row in Play Setup came after that beta, so it offers PyroWave from the next beta on. The beta installs beside stable Nova with separate pairing and preferences. Use a compatible Polaris host with the PyroWave encoder, such as the official Polaris 1.4.13 Linux packages; custom builds can omit it.
- It wants a wired link at a couple of hundred megabits. It is not a codec for wifi, and it is not a replacement for HEVC or AV1.
- The Android decoder supports 4:4:4 and HDR10, but HDR also needs compatible client presentation and host capture delivering ten-bit frames with HDR metadata. End-to-end PyroWave HDR has not been validated here. Ordinary KDE/GNOME desktop portal capture cannot satisfy the HDR request; on a KDE HDR display, KMS capture can also deliver FP16 frames that PyroWave cannot read, even for an SDR request. Start with a supported SDR capture path.
- The HUD reports the network's loss rather than your device's, and it tells you the bitrate this codec wants rather than judging it at a setting it cannot meet.
- A damaged frame can still be drawn when both lowest-frequency bands are intact and at least 90 percent of its blocks are present. Frames below the decoder's minimum are dropped; packet loss can still cause visible freezes.

release.name: Samsung Region Override 4.0.1
release.notes:
This update fixes Country apply/Restore failures when another UiAutomation client is already registered, and removes the unsafe automatic UICC disable/enable recovery sequence reported in #2.

- Country operations now use a per-run shell permission handshake without opening an accessibility automation connection. Restore can finish and release a pending session so Start disguise becomes available again.
- Restore never automatically switches UICC applications off. It observes IMS for up to 15 seconds and reports when registration remains unconfirmed.
- Failed results name the Country or Network layer. Missing/failed IMS observations no longer appear as registered in diagnostics. Recovery guidance is updated in all 15 languages.

Validation: 43 unit tests passed; debug lint has 0 errors and 12 private-API warnings; debug, release and Android-test APK builds passed. On an SM-S938B / Android 17, repeated Country-only apply/restore cycles and a seeded pending journal recovered correctly. The exact signed APK was installed over 4.0.0 with the same certificate; the real stuck pending session was restored and Start became available again. A further Country-only apply/restore cycle passed in the signed app. Scoped permissions were independently checked after both debug and signed Restore and were no longer delegated. Full Android UI automation tests were compiled, not run.

Network disguise still changes the SIM identity globally and can break IMS/VoLTE on reconnect (#3, #4); this release does not claim to remove that limitation. A SIM already persistently disabled by 4.0.0 needs explicit re-enabling; reboot alone is insufficient. Other device/firmware combinations require further validation.

[Detailed validation](https://github.com/Ritel-T/SamsungRegionOverride/blob/432ab5a44d39355bb1c1b37142aa127219487903/docs/recovery-validation-2026-09-10.md) · [IMS investigation](https://github.com/Ritel-T/SamsungRegionOverride/blob/432ab5a44d39355bb1c1b37142aa127219487903/docs/ims-in

release.notes:
## Retro Rewind 6.13, a 30 FPS mode, and DriftDroid can update itself

### Retro Rewind 6.13

- **Works with Retro Rewind 6.13.0 and 6.13.1**, including Retro WFC online.
- **Already have Retro Rewind installed?** Tap Retro Rewind after updating DriftDroid. It notices the old version and updates itself (about 640 MB), then tap again to play.
- **Fresh install** downloads 6.13.0 and applies the 6.13.1 update on top, the same way the official installer does.
- **DriftDroid now follows Retro Rewind's release list** instead of knowing only one version. Updates that only change tracks or characters install without a new DriftDroid. Updates that change game code still need a new DriftDroid build.
- Large Retro Rewind updates download with a progress count and continue where they stopped if the connection drops.
- A failed install or update check no longer deletes a working Retro Rewind install.
- Fixed: picking an already-extracted Retro Rewind folder closed the app.
- The free-space check was asking for about 7 GB for a 4 GB job; it now asks for what it needs.

> [!WARNING]
> Mods that replace Retro Rewind's own menu files were made for 6.12.8 and can crash on 6.13 (for example when opening Retro WFC). Turn them off or get a version rebuilt for 6.13.

### 30 FPS races (new)

A new setting, **30 FPS races**, for phones that can't hold 60. The game runs at normal speed and draws half as many frames, using the game's own 30 FPS mode, so it stops feeling like slow motion. It works in the original game and in Retro Rewind, offline and online. Menus stay at 60. Retro Rewind time trials and ghost races stay at 60 because Retro Rewind requires it. Off by default; applies from the next race.

### DriftDroid updates itself (new, untested)

When a new version is out, an **Update available** button appears on the game chooser. Tap it, then **Update Now**: DriftDroid downloads the update, checks it, and Android asks you to confirm. The first time, Android asks you to allow DriftDroid

# 📝 BeatWave v6.1.1 Release Notes

---

## 🌟 What's New

### 1. Modern Segmented Player Mode Switcher
* **3-Way View Switcher (`[Cover | Lyrics | Queue]`)**: Added a top navigation segmented pill selector in the player allowing one-tap switching between Artwork, Lyrics, and Queue views.
* **Dedicated Queue Screen**: View and manage upcoming tracks in a dedicated layout directly from the player.
* **Dedicated Lyrics Screen**: Enhanced lyrics display with synchronized karaoke scrolling and clean typography.
* **Persistent Mini-Artwork Return Action**: When browsing Queue or Lyrics, a mini album thumbnail appears in the header—tapping it instantly slides back to the Cover view.
* **Tactile Bottom Action Pills**: Upgraded the bottom utility bar with responsive pill buttons for Lyrics and Queue featuring container-fill state indicators.

---

## ⚡ Improvements & Polish

### 1. Fluid Artwork Morphing (Crossfade & Manual Skips)
* **Fluid Ascending Glide**:
  * The outgoing album artwork smoothly glides upward (`-14.dp`) with a gentle shrink.
  * The incoming artwork ascends into frame from below (`+18.dp`), expanding naturally into place.
* **iOS / Apple Music Easing**: Tuned the animation curve using `CubicBezierEasing(0.22f, 1.0f, 0.36f, 1.0f)` for smooth, organic deceleration without jerky jumps.

# GRoute v2.1.0

SSH and SFTP access to your servers, diagnostics that reach past the client into the server and
the panel, and a free config source that tests before it adds.

---

## SSH

A new tab between Shop and Home for managing and reaching your servers.

- **Hosts** — add servers with host, port, username and password. Credentials are encrypted at
  rest with the Android Keystore.
- **Routed through the tunnel** by default, with a per-host **Connect directly** option for
  boxes that are themselves VPN nodes. Each card shows which path it will take before you
  connect.
- **Shell** — an interactive session with scrollback, command history, cursor keys and a working
  Ctrl-C that delivers a real SIGINT over the remote PTY.
- **Local terminal** — a shell on the device itself, in the app sandbox, for checking routes,
  properties and connectivity without leaving the app.
- **SFTP** — browse, upload, download, delete and create folders. Transfers go through the system
  file picker, so no storage permission is needed and files land wherever you choose.

## Server-side debugging

When an SSH host matches the config you are debugging, the debugger can now run checks on the
server rather than only from the phone.

- Is anything actually listening on the port
- Is a proxy core process running
- Firewall rules covering the port

config.

Panel type, address and credentials are stored per config, with the password encrypted.

release.notes:
<!-- install-guide:start -->
## 安装包选择

> **优先推荐：无 FFmpeg 精简版。Android 的 ARM64 设备优先选择 ARM64 + 不内置 Cronet 版（需要可用的 Google Play 服务）。**
> **GitHub 相关功能可能出现问题；推荐的不内置 Cronet 版在 Google Play 服务缺失或不可用时可能请求失败，任何版本均不保证 GitHub 在当前网络环境下可访问。**

- **精简版（推荐）**：体积更小，仍可缓存；Bilibili 缓存保留原始格式，不转 MP3、不写入歌曲元数据。
- **含 FFmpeg**：适合需要 Bilibili 缓存转 MP3、缓存写入歌曲元数据的用户，体积较大。
- **内置 Cronet**：无需 Google Play 服务，适合服务缺失或不可用的设备；文件名不含 `without.embedded.Cronet`。
- **不内置 Cronet（Android 推荐）**：需要可用的 Google Play 服务；文件名含 `without.embedded.Cronet`（本地构建名可能使用空格）。
- ARM64 适用于大多数近年 ARM 手机；32 位 ARM 设备请选择 ARM32；x86_64 仅适用于对应设备或模拟器。
- **Android 不推荐通用包**：包含多种架构、体积较大。请优先确认设备架构并选择对应的单架构包。
- **macOS 选芯片**：Apple 芯片选 `apple-silicon` 包，Intel 选 `intel` 包；不确定时查看「关于本机 → 芯片」（终端 `uname -m` 输出 `arm64` 对应 Apple 芯片，`x86_64` 对应 Intel）。装错芯片会提示应用已损坏。

每个下载链接旁均列出文件体积和该安装包自己的提交 hash；不同平台的 hash 可能不同。体积为下载文件大小（MiB），不是安装后的占用。

### Android

release.name: v0.24.1
release.notes:
A patch release with one fix for picture messages that fail to download, and the diagnostics to work out why when they still do.

## Fixed

- **Picture messages could fail to download on some phones.** Clear SMS asks Android to save an incoming picture message into a file of its own, and when granting permission to write there it named two system components by hand. On a phone whose messaging service lives somewhere else the write was refused and the download failed — and a Pixel is one of those phones: a diagnostic log from a Pixel 7 Pro showed **seven** components needing that permission, including `com.shannon.rcsservice`, where the old code granted to two. Sending has resolved this correctly since 0.22.0; downloading now does the same, through one shared piece of code so the two cannot drift apart again. ([#135](https://github.com/itsluminous/ClearSMS/issues/135), thanks @snappyapple632)
- **A failed download now records why.** Until now it logged only Android's bare error number. It now also records whether that permission was granted and to which components, whether the phone was on mobile data or WiFi, and which SIM was used. Only system component names are recorded — never message text, numbers or addresses.

## Also

Code-style checking was restored in the build. It had silently stopped inspecting the app's sources during the Android Gradle Plugin 9 upgrade — still running, still reporting success, checking nothing — which went unnoticed across two releases. The build now fails outright if that ever happens again, rather than passing quietly. No behaviour changed; 52 files were reformatted.

- **Borrowed-context binding** — when the running game has no live registered UDS handle, the payload mints one and binds it via `RegisterContext`; the handle scan now sweeps the full handle-id range.

A faithful, moddable port of Oracle of Ages and Oracle of Seasons for PC, macOS and Android. Your own ROM runs in an emulator core: [SameBoy](https://sameboy.github.io/), unmodified, the accurate reference, or [mGBA](https://mgba.io/)'s Game Boy core, lighter, with one patch (its boot ROM), for small devices; Fast (mGBA) plays by default on Android, Accurate (SameBoy) elsewhere, and Core, in Display's Advanced page, changes it. - **Windows** (`the-oracles-project-1.3.0-windows.zip`, 64-bit): unzip the folder and run `the-oracles-project.exe`. The executable is not signed, so SmartScreen may warn the first time: More info, then Run anyway.

To this end, MobileInsight v6.0.0 also updates its 4G LTE analyzers to tackle both modes. The latest LTE RRC analyzer now can analyze the 4G<->5G handovers and dual connectivity. 

- **New message support:** MobileInsight v6.0.0 beta adds support for these messages/versions


  - 5G NR RRC OTA messages: v8

  - LTE RRC OTA messages: v52, v49, v48, v46, v26

  - LTE RRC MIB Packet: v17

  - LTE RLC UL Config Log Packet: v69

release.notes:
## LineCode Pro v1.3.4

### 版本信息
- 版本名称: v1.3.4
- 版本号: 38

## v1.3.4

### 工作区与文件

- **改动文件前先读取** - 内置文件工具新增读后写保护：覆盖或编辑一个已存在的文件之前
  必须先读取它。读取成功时记录本次返回内容的 SHA-256，写入或编辑前用**同一次读取拿到的
  内容**重新比对（不再另查一次磁盘，因此记录的一定是模型看到的那一版）：
  文件从未读取过就拒绝，并提示先用 `file_read` 读取后重试；读取之后文件又被外部改动
  （其他程序、其他 Agent 或用户）同样拒绝，并提示重新读取，不再覆盖 AI 从未看过的内容。
- **整体替换要求完整读过** - `file_write` 会用新内容整份替换目标，所以只在模型确实看完整份
  文件时才放行：窗口读取（`start_kb`/`end_kb`）或结果被截断的读取只记为「部分读取」，
  此时整体替换会被拒绝并提示改用 `file_edit`；`file_edit` 只替换匹配到的片段、其余字节
  原样保留，因此部分读取也允许编辑。目标不存在时按新建处理，无需先读；工具自身写入或
  编辑成功后刷新记录，连续修改不必反复重读。
- **同一文件不会被两个工具调用同时改** - 变更期间按路径持有内存占用标记：并行子 Agent 或
  同一轮里的并发调用正在改同一文件时，后来的变更直接拒绝并提示重试，不会出现两次变更
  都通过校验、后者覆盖前者却都报成功。进程之外的写入者无法被拦住（平台文件能力没有
  compare-and-swap），这段窗口仍以最终的写入调用为界。
- **读取失败的状态不再被当作新文件** - 写入前 `Stat` 失败且错误不是「不存在」（例如权限或
  I/O 错误）时现在直接失败，不再把已存在的文件当成新建文件而跳过读取保护。
- **记录只存在内存中** - 已读记录按绝对路径保存在进程内存里，不写入数据库或磁盘：
  应用重启后从零开始，这只会让规则更严格；记录条数设有上限，超出后整表作废，
  代价仅是重新读取一次。

### 发布

- **版本** - `versionCode` 38、`versionName` 1.3.4。
- **回归覆盖** - 原生测试新增 `file_observation_tests`（SHA-256 标准向量与分块一致性、
  内存观察表语义、容量上限与变更占用标记）和 `file_tool_tests` 的读后写用例（未读拒绝、
  外部改动拒绝、内容相同不算改动、部分读取只允许编辑、窗口覆盖整份文件才允许整体替换、
  截断读取记为部分、读取失败不授权、`Stat` 失败不当作新文件、并发变更被拒绝后释放、
  写入失败后可重试、文件被外部删除后可重建、中英文提示、共享记录注入）；
  `:app:assembleDebug` 通过，工具文案目录表由 `tools/gen_tool_text_catalog.py` 重新生成。

repo.description: HaRu：面向 Rule34Video 与 Hanime 的独立 Android 客户端

release.name: HaRu 2.6.2
release.notes:
# HaRu 2.6.2

本次是 2.6.1 之后的稳定性版本，汇总了 2.6.1 以来的 14 个提交，重点在网络请求、下载收尾与界面崩溃三处。

## 网络与账号

- **Cookie 存储失败不再拖垮整个应用**：当系统 Keystore 无法解锁（恢复过备份、更改了锁屏方式、安全存储损坏）时，Cookie 的读写异常此前会被网络层当成网络错误，导致所有请求看起来都失败。现在存储失败自动降级：本次运行内照常请求，只是无法在重启后恢复登录；错误会记录到日志；
- **被限流时给出明确等待时间**：请求被限流（429/503）时不再立刻重试，会解析服务端返回的 Retry-After，超出 2 秒重试预算就直接提示需要等待多久，并在退避中加入抖动；
- **Hanime 后台请求更克制**：后台预热、频道刷新与预取请求统一排队，前一项结束至少 300ms 后才发下一项，前台请求仍然直连；校验 Cloudflare 前先核对目标页面身份，避免把别的页面误判为验证完成。

## 下载

- **下载完成的收尾更可靠**：此前插件记录被删除后，完成事件可能落在关闭阶段而丢失，任务会一直停在「下载中」。现在平台层先把完成的下载写入本地库再删除插件记录，关闭时等待收尾结束；重复完成、私有源文件已被清理等情况都会给出可操作的提示，而不是让任务留在队列里重复下载。

## 界面与稳定性

- **页面退出不再崩溃**：登录弹窗、评论区、Hanime 媒体库、播放列表与订阅按钮在等待网络或弹窗返回后会无条件刷新界面，中途退出页面就会触发 setState 断言；相关路径均已加保护；
- **一键更新不再重复提示**：每次尝试安装都会新增一个安装结果监听器且从不取消，导致同一次安装结果被重复上报、旧页面被持续持有；现在只处理首次结果并在所有分支取消订阅；
- **返回顶部按钮更稳**：不再在构建或点击时现场查找焦点祖先，避免读取已释放的节点触发框架断言；
- **新增中文兜底页**：打开不存在的页面时显示「页面不存在」与「返回首页」，与全局错误页风格一致，不再出现英文默认页；
- **本地库与播放列表消失时给出提示**：目标库或播放列表被删除后，不再抛出 StateError。

## 性能

- **连播播放列表内存可控**：只保留最近 6 条视频详情的缓存，并始终保留当前条目，缓存 miss 时重新请求；
- **下拉刷新合并请求**：刷新期间连续触发的重置会合并为一次按最新条件的重放，减少重复的分页请求；
- **日志读写更省**：缓存当前日志文件与大小，读取全部日志不再逐行 stat、重复拼接缓冲区。

Building on the localization foundation from v0.3.2 (which shipped Português Brasil), this release expands the app to cover most of the world's biggest mobile-app markets.

- 🇮🇳 **हिन्दी (Hindi)** — full app in Devanagari, colloquial Indian-Android register with idiomatic code-switching for technical nouns (कैमरा, ऑडियो, AI, चैट).

- 🇫🇷 **Français (French)** — full app, "tu" form, "souvenir" for memories, all French apostrophes properly escaped.

## 🎚️ Switch language (per-app)

Android 13+: **Settings → Apps → MemGallery → Language → \[your language\]**. The app relaunches automatically. No need to change your phone's system language.

## 🔢 Scope

~580 strings × 5 new locales = ~2,900 fresh translations, plus zh-CN's existing ~10 lines expanded to full coverage.

Download \`MemGallery-v0.3.3.apk\` from the [release page](https://github.com/Past-da-king/MemGallery/releases/tag/v0.3.3). Same signing key as the rest of the v0.3.x line — straightforward in-place update.

release.name: Lumora v6.3
release.notes:
## Lumora v6.3


### Catalogue
- **A finished import stops saying it is importing.** The card comes down when the last byte lands, not when the catalogue render finishes: everything after the transfer - the merge, the m3u_plus episode fold, the database write, the tab rebuild - can run for tens of seconds on a six-figure panel, and the card sat on "Importing <provider> · N items" through all of it, so a finished download read as a frozen one. A load that dies before its own reset (out of memory on a huge panel, an unexpected throw) takes the card down with it instead of leaving it up for good, and a late report from a source that outlived the load cannot put it back.
- **A playlist reports what it has actually parsed, local or remote.** The playlist path hardcoded 0 items, so a 150k-entry download narrated "0 items" from start to finish; the parser now counts the entries it accepts, and a playlist file picked from the device narrates its bytes and rows like a download does instead of sitting on "Connecting to <provider>" for the whole file (its size is stated too, so the "very large" warning covers a local panel).
- **The playlist import got its main-thread work back.** Parsing compiled a fresh `Regex` for the EXTINF attribute list on every single line - 150k compilations for a 150k-entry playlist - and the attribute scan now walks the `name="value"` pairs directly. The content-type gate and the per-entry copy into provider-tagged channels are whole-catalogue passes and now run with the parse instead of on the frame right after it, and so does the m3u_plus episode fold. Nothing about the result changes; the import simply stops stalling the screen while it finishes.
- **Live TV lands first; films and series import behind it.** A catalogue used to arrive all at once: on an Xtream panel the live list sat finished for the whole of the film and series ingest (minutes on a six-figure panel), and on a playlist nothing appeared until the last line of the file had been parse
