release.name: VidUltra 0.1.0-beta
release.notes:
First public beta of VidUltra, a RAW video camera for Android.

**Install:** download `VidUltra-0.1.0-beta.apk` below and open it on your phone. Needs a **Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 or equivalent** (Snapdragon only — MediaTek and Exynos phones are not supported because of hardware limitations), Android 13+ and a camera that offers RAW to apps.

**What's in it**
- RAW sensor frames developed on the GPU, recorded as 10-bit HEVC (or H.264 8-bit)
- Rec.709 auto look with smooth exposure and highlight-protecting tone mapping; no artificial sharpening or smoothing
- 14 log profiles with their real gamuts, plus "Show log as Rec.709" for the viewfinder
- Gyro stabilization with rolling-shutter correction, 180° shutter, anti-flicker
- Motion-aware noise reduction with natural grain
- All cameras (ultra-wide, wide, tele, front) with focal length in mm; tap to focus / expose; AE/AF lock
- 4K to 720p, six aspect ratios, 24/25/30 fps

**Found a problem?** Settings → Support → Copy Diagnostic Log, then paste it into an issue. The log contains no videos, photos, location, accounts or personal details.

This is a beta, tuned on one phone so far, so other phones may show rough edges. Reports help a lot.

release.name: Poseidon v0.1.4
release.notes:
## Poseidon 0.1.4

**Single-plugin install.** Apply the plugin and you're done — it pulls in the Poseidon runtime automatically. No separate `implementation("...")` line.

```kotlin
// app/build.gradle.kts
plugins {
    id("com.android.application")
    id("tech.ssemaj.poseidon") version "0.1.4"
}
```

The plugin adds `poseidon-all` (native umbrella) by default, or `poseidon-core` when `poseidon { injectNative = false }` (Play-clean, JVM-only).

### Also in this line (carried from 0.1.3)
- **Strict native/Go default-deny** — the seccomp gate blocks any unidentified destination instead of letting un-correlated IPs through.
- **TSYNC full-thread coverage** — the seccomp filter now attaches to every thread (NEW_LISTENER + TSYNC + TSYNC_ESRCH), with a NEW_LISTENER-only fallback on older kernels.
- **IPv6-aware raw helpers** — raw connect/sendto handle AF_INET6 destinations correctly.

> Note: 0.1.3 was published before the single-plugin layout and got cached by JitPack; 0.1.4 is a clean version with the auto-runtime plugin.

**Demo APK** (`poseidon-demo-0.1.4.apk`) attached — live egress dashboard across all three tiers (JVM / native / seccomp). Validated on a Pixel 6 Pro.

release.notes:
v4.3.2 — No network access at all + SMS limit check

- SMS limit check: past a per-app limit, Android holds an app's SMS behind an "Allow / Deny" dialog that never times out, so part of an SOS could stay on the phone. The app now reads that limit (LineageOS: Trust → SMS message limit) and warns you if your SOS doesn't fit, telling you what to set. Parts held by that dialog are no longer counted as sent.
- Removed the app's last network call: a legacy version check that fetched a file from oksigenia.com every time the app opened. The file no longer existed, so it did nothing, but it still contacted a server.
- The INTERNET permission is gone: Oksigenia SOS can no longer connect to the network in any way. Alerts were always SMS-only and still are; updates keep arriving through F-Droid, IzzyOnDroid and GitHub Releases.
- Same signing key, one permission fewer; updates cleanly over any previous install.

- **组合键时序设置**：支持同时按下（默认）、分帧按下与 1-100ms 自定义间隔，覆盖自定义按钮、按键盘区域、音量键与实体手柄映射；新增 `ComboSequencer` 统一处理顺序按下与反向松开，并同步网页手柄编辑器、兼容旧预设。

### 修复

- **修复自定义按键映射的组合键未同时触发**。
- **修复悬浮层方向不跟随屏幕旋转**：改为以 WMS 窗口 frame 作为唯一可信的尺寸来源，旋转后由布局回调重排；隐藏态常驻一个全屏透明窗口作为方向探针，「小眼睛」按钮不再停留在旧坐标；移除读取过期信息的 500ms 轮询与 `DisplayListener`。
- **修复 8 方向方形按键盘的角标签越界**：标签不再溢出圆弧裁剪区域。

## Windows

### 变更

- **升级 Avalonia 至 12.1.4**，并为窗口与 4 个 `DataTemplate` 启用 compiled bindings（补充 `x:DataType`），消除 AOT 与裁剪下对反射式绑定的依赖。
- **内部重构（行为等价）**：连接装配收进 `SessionIntake`、七种手柄线格式收进 persona adapter、反馈报文与音频路径收进 `PhoneDownlink`、设备身份统一为 `DeviceIdentity`、设备板从 `MainViewModel` 拆为 `DeviceBoard`、`WebServer` 拆成 HTTP 宿主与浏览器桥接。

### 修复

- **修复手动卡片合并后残留空卡片**：合并把手动卡搬空后没有移除该卡，界面上会留下一张无标题、无按钮的空卡片。
- **修复并发连接时失败方误删胜出会话**：WiFi / USB / Web 三路会话按端点串行化装配，账本不再被后发起的失败连接破坏。
- **修复 IPv6 下会话账本与路由对不上**：设备身份字符串带不带方括号的拼写差异已统一，IPv4 行为不变。
- **安装包不再携带网页端的 Git 仓库**：打包规则此前把整个 GKME-Web 仓库（含 `.git`、`.gitignore`）复制进安装目录，现在只打包网页本身，仓库元数据与文档一并排除。

- **组合键时序设置**：与 Android 端同步，支持同时按下 / 分帧 / 1-100ms 自定义间隔，旧预设保持兼容。

### 修复

- **修复 8 方向方形按键盘的角标签越界**：标签不再溢出圆弧裁剪区域。

### Сервер и сеть

- На главной вместо описания протокола показывается подтверждённый выходной IP выбранного сервера. Нажатие на IP открывает подробности, а на название — список прокси.

release.notes:
# SearchLauncher 0.1.1 — smoother keyboard transitions and fewer tab reloads

## What changed

- **Less jumping when typing on websites.** The browser now resizes the page once when the keyboard opens or closes, and changes toolbar visibility at the same moment. This reduces repeated movement of bottom navigation bars and avoids resizing Gecko on every keyboard animation frame.
- **A clearer bottom bar.** A subtle 1px line separates browser controls from the page, using a light or dark tint that follows the bar's colors.
- **Tabs stay open through more settings changes.** Switching dark mode, language, font size or display settings no longer unnecessarily reloads normal browser tabs. Favorite sites and installed web apps are kept ahead of other tabs when deciding which pages to reclaim; Android can still stop them under memory pressure.
- **Browser startup reliability.** Fixed an optimized-build crash involving Gecko's debug configuration parser and disabled that debug-file feature in production.
- **More useful diagnostics.** Feedback reports include tab-reload reasons and the most recent available main-thread ANR stack to help diagnose remaining freezes and reloads.

## Updating

This is an update to the regular SearchLauncher app. No data reset is needed when updating from 0.1.0. If upgrading directly from a WebView-era release, launcher settings, favorites and bookmarks are preserved, but website cookies and site sessions do not migrate to Gecko.

The keyboard regression was reproduced on a plain fixed-footer page: three opening/closing cycles produced 31 viewport-height changes in 0.1.0 and six after the fix. These are emulator measurements, not a claim of verified Xiaomi frame rates.

Remote background Web Push and credential-provider passkey restrictions remain unchanged from 0.1.0.

  Text contrast was checked against the deeper backgrounds.
- The album-art tile was a fixed blue in light and a fixed navy in dark, which

  in both modes.

# REM 1.5.5

Android telemetry reliability and delivery diagnostics.

- Telemetry can initiate its own direct link using trusted saved or live team peers, without chat or manual connection warm-up.
- A bounded native outbox retains the latest fix, coalesces superseded positions and recovers after readiness changes or restart. Removed and unauthorized recipients stay excluded.
- Location settings separate local acquisition, queueing, transmission, transport receipt and application acceptance/rejection.
- Malformed telemetry produces typed, position-free diagnostics and a correlated rejection when metadata permits. Android packet logs omit encoded position payloads.
- Battery transitions enqueue community updates without blocking Android's main thread; resuming refreshes the saver badge.

release.name: Hikari AdBlock v1.2.3
release.notes:
**Hikari AdBlock** — free, open-source, no-root Android ad blocker.

## What's new in v1.2.3

### Shizuku mode now fails fast and tells you why

- **Added a clear error dialog for Shizuku mode.** If your ROM and kernel deny
  permission for `iptables`/`nftables`, Shizuku mode can't work on your device.
  Previously the app could sit on "Connecting..." and silently retry for a very
  long time before giving up with no real explanation. It now detects the block
  immediately and explains exactly what happened.
- **One-tap "Switch to Direct (VPN) mode".** The blocked dialog now has a button
  that switches you straight to Direct (VPN) mode and starts protection, so you
  still get ad blocking even when Shizuku is unavailable on your ROM.
- **Added a pre-flight probe.** When you select Shizuku mode, the app now runs a
  single cheap, read-only netfilter command first. If the ROM/kernel refuses it,
  you're told right away and the service is never started, so no filters are
  fetched and no retry loop runs.

### Under the hood

- The pre-flight probe is used from the Settings toggle, from the power-button
  toggle, and when a pending Shizuku start is retried after returning to the app.
  The service also runs the same probe as a safety net.
- Filters are loaded exactly once before the retry loop, so retries no longer
  re-fetch or re-seed the filter lists.
- Bumped the version to 1.2.3 (versionCode 7).

> If your ROM and kernel deny `iptables` permission, Shizuku mode cannot work on
> your device. Use **Direct (VPN) mode** (the dialog can switch you over with one
> tap) or the **root** backend instead.

## 📥 How to download
- **`app-universal-release.apk`** — works on every phone (pick this if you're not sure)
- **`app-arm64-v8a-release.apk`** — most modern phones (recommended, smaller download)
- `app-armeabi-v7a-release.apk`, `app-x86-release.apk`, `app-x86_64-release.apk` — other CPU types

release.notes:
# 🔁 VANTA 1.16 · Both Ways

**Your playlist edits stick. Hearts go back to Spotify. The Library finally looks the part.**

1.16 fixes the thing that bugged me most about syncing from Spotify: you'd tidy a playlist in VANTA and the next sync put it all back. Now your changes stay, and the songs you heart in VANTA show up in your Spotify likes too. The Library and artist pages also got a calmer, cleaner look.

## ✨ New

### Hearts go back to Spotify

With Keep in sync on for Spotify, a heart you give a song in VANTA likes it on Spotify too, and taking the heart off unlikes it. Connected Libraries shows when your hearts were last sent.

### A calmer Library

The Library has a new look: cleaner lists, playlist covers made from the songs inside, and less clutter.

### Artist pages

One row of actions at the top, every top song an artist has (Show all), and Follow and Don't play tucked into a single menu.

### Top songs in search

When you search for an artist, their top songs read like the artist page: one tidy block with the album under each title.

## 🔧 Fixed

Sync
- Editing a synced playlist in VANTA (removing or reordering songs) no longer gets undone by the next sync. VANTA keeps your version and only brings over what changed on Spotify since the last sync.

Playback
- Dolby Atmos should crackle and skip much less when VANTA is in the background or another app is busy. The Atmos decoding now runs ahead of playback on its own thread.

## 📥 Install or update

If you already have VANTA, it will offer you the update. Or download vanta.apk below.

On a TV with the Downloader app, use code 6677141.

SHA-256: 254e61a32719eefe213c84ccf762aec7c46adf51f2b7fbb11c6d07a8cebb44cf

## ❤️ Keep VANTA free

VANTA is just me, and the servers that find your songs cost money every month. If VANTA has been a good part of your week, a Ko-fi goes straight into keeping it running and making it better. Thank you to everyone who keeps sending me feedback, it shapes every update.

release.name: Lean 1.2.0
release.notes:
## Что нового

**«Скорость»** — замер канала прямо в приложении: приём, отдача, задержка и джиттер. Пока VPN включён, можно сравнить скорость через туннель и в обход, по одному и тому же серверу, и увидеть, во что обходится туннель. В России сервер берётся из встроенного списка — каталог Speedtest оттуда недоступен.

**«Что работает сейчас»** — проверка самих сервисов: YouTube, Telegram, Discord, ChatGPT, Steam и остальные по очереди, с ответом по каждому.

**«Почему не работает»** — пробы DPI: что именно рвёт соединение (SNI, UDP наружу, подмена DNS, обрыв на объёме) и какие настройки из этого следуют.

**«Не давать системе усыплять туннель»** — включено по умолчанию. Самой частой жалобой было «VPN сам отключился»: в глубоком сне системы ядро не успевало отвечать дальней стороне, и та закрывала сессию. Теперь туннель продолжает тикать, ценой расхода батареи.

**«Восстанавливать соединение само»** — если туннель замолчал и не прошёл настоящую проверку через себя, приложение сбрасывает соединения и DNS, а затем переподключается. Обрывы пишутся в журнал.

Сборка для F-Droid больше не обращается к `api.github.com` при запуске: проверку обновлений делает сам F-Droid, а кнопка ручной проверки осталась в обеих сборках.

release.name: NovaGram v7.3.1/13.0.2
release.notes:
Базы: Telegram Desktop `v7.3.1`, Telegram for Android `13.0.2 (7175)`.

Выпуск переносит форк на свежие базы обеих платформ, добавляет проверку на запрещённый контент и подключение через WebSocket, а новый кошелёк TON из апстрима оставляет выключенным.

### Безопасность и приватность

- **Кошелёк TON из апстрима выключен (обе платформы):** новая база приносит с собой кошелёк (запросы к toncenter, курсы валют, TON Connect, собственное WebSocket-соединение). Он остаётся выключенным, что бы ни ответил сервер, а ссылки `ton://`, `tonconnect` и переходы по адресам TON ничего не открывают. На ПК схема `ton` больше не регистрируется в системе.
- **Проверка запрещённого контента (обе платформы):** список авторов и ссылок сверяется локально; сообщение с совпадением подсвечивается, а перед цитированием, пересылкой, ответом и отправкой выводится предупреждение. «Избранное» не затрагивается. Переключатель в разделе NovaGram включён по умолчанию. Список обновляется раз в сутки через закреплённые зашифрованные каналы DNS; если сохранить его не удалось, это теперь видно, а не молча пропускается.
- **Подключение через WebSocket (обе платформы):** включено по умолчанию. Клиент ходит к серверам Telegram через список ретрансляторов, который читается из опубликованного `relay.json`. На ПК добавлена маскировка TLS под Яндекс Браузер (отдельный процесс-терминатор рядом с клиентом); на Android локальный мост закрыт случайным токеном процесса, чужие приложения на устройстве им воспользоваться не могут.
### Интерфейс и удобство

- **Качество отправляемых медиа (обе платформы):** видео отправляется без пережатия по разрешению (на Android переключатель в настройках NovaGram), фото уходят с минимальным сжатием в штатном режиме HD.
- **Исправления на ПК после обновления базы:** окно ввода PIN работает с новым интерфейсом ввода пароля в Telegram Desktop 7.3.

### Из апстрима

## 更新内容

- **登录与任务恢复**：修复同账号重新登录后查询和自动任务卡住、旧任务结果覆盖新状态；任务准备或派发失败后能恢复操作。
- **避免重复提交**：桌面手动应答与自动任务共用提交门。手动可接管尚未提交的自动等待，暂停监控不影响手动应答。
- **课件下载**：续传绑定资源身份与强 ETag，避免同名不同课件或版本拼接；支持下载进度、取消和安全恢复，保留长文件名扩展名与编号。

- **邮件安全**：Android 强制 TLS 和服务器身份校验；双端仅在提交前安全切换备用端口，回执不明或成功后的退出异常不会重复发送。
- **维护流程**：加入双端 GitHub Actions、固定静态检查规则和 Windows 维护依赖约束，补充生产入口与故障恢复回归。

- Windows：退出旧程序，用新 `xmu-assistant.exe` 替换原文件，保留本地配置。

## 验证

Python 全量 800 项测试、294 个子测试通过；Android 全量 822 项测试通过，其中 19 项邮件回归通过。Ruff、编译检查与 Android Lint 通过。

release.name: ARK-launcher 0.9.4
release.notes:
A bug-fix release: the widget set-up screen on phones that enforce Android 14's background-start rule, archived apps that keep their place, clocks that follow the minute and the time zone, and a long list of smaller fixes. Updating keeps your layout, widgets and settings.

**Fixed**
- **A widget's set-up screen opens** on phones that enforce Android 14's background-start rule, such as Samsung One UI (#15). Thanks to @photonsphere-org for the diagnosis and the fix (#14).
- **An archived app (Android 15 and later) keeps its home icon and its place in a folder**; it used to be swept away as uninstalled at the next start.
- **Edit on an app a second time** no longer shows the old icon, and saving a new name no longer wipes the icon you just picked — on the home screen, in the dock and in the app drawer.
- **The clocks:** the status bar clock turns with the minute and is right the moment the screen comes back; the big clock, the next alarm and the event time follow a time-zone or 12/24-hour change at once instead of up to an hour later.
- **Home comes back on the page you left** after the launcher restarted in the background, not on page 2.
- **The app drawer:** HOME takes the drawer's dialogs and sheets with it; closing the drawer any other way drops the search and its keyboard; an icon half under the grid's top edge starts its drag under the finger; no "No results" flash on the first letter of a search.
- **Pages and the dock:** removing an empty-looking page keeps pinned shortcuts that are only hidden because the launcher is not the default home; an uninstalled app's dock favourite goes with it, so a reinstall can no longer push the last dock icon off the dock and off home; a page removed during the HOME turn no longer leaves the pager between pages.
- **Status bar:** Android 11 shows the Wi-Fi level and band (the glyph was always red); the VPN key and the Data Saver glyph update on their own.
- **Backup:** two folders that both held the same app restore one home icon

## Overview

Cyclauncher v1.0.0 Release Candidate 5 (RC5, Build 27) delivers critical performance optimizations including R8 code minification and Baseline Profiles (reducing APK size by over 90%), deep memory leak and OOM mitigations across icon packs and widget loading, system-level stability enhancements, race condition resolutions in package updates and list reordering, and unified contrast and background dim styling.

## Feature Freeze Notice

Cyclauncher remains under an active **Feature Freeze** leading into the upcoming v1.0.0 Stable milestone:
* All functional features and architectural expansions are frozen.
* Pull requests proposing new capabilities are paused until post-v1.0.0.
* Contributions during this phase are strictly focused on critical bug fixes, crash resolutions, memory/rendering stability, localization updates, and documentation.

### Performance Optimization & APK Shrinking
* Enabled R8 code shrinking and resource optimization in release builds, reducing the final signed APK size from ~23MB to 2.2MB.
* Bundled Baseline Profiles via `androidx.profileinstaller` for accelerated launcher cold starts and smoother Compose critical paths.
* Refactored `AutoResizingText` to single-pass `rememberTextMeasurer` layout calculations, eliminating layout thrashing and measurement flickers.
* Stored normalized application labels and cached package timestamps directly on `AppInfo`, bypassing redundant `PackageManager` Binder IPC in `todayActivity`.
* Pooled `BreakIterator` instances using `ThreadLocal` for accelerated unicode symbol indexing.
* Cached discovered `AppWidgetGroup` hierarchies in `LauncherViewModel` with event-driven invalidation on package update broadcasts.

* Bounded file read streams to 10MB during backup and tag JSON imports to prevent heap exhaustion.

release.name: Dashwheel v1.0.858 (beta)
release.notes:
## What's new in v1.0.858 (beta)

### GPS speed: no longer stuck at 0 under a car app that has no speed

Forum report (v1.0.85x): "my speed is not showing anything, it stays
always 0. I have only GPS, no OBD."

Since the vehicle bus, the car app (qf.car_app) and the unit bus (FYT)
are car sources, and a car speed outranks the GPS's. Their speed is
there even when the car does not give one: the car app's body share
always carries a speed field, 0 where the CAN box does not carry it (or
there is none), and FYT's decoder can send 0 the same way. That 0
then beat the GPS, for ever. Before the bus, the bar only ever read
OBD, else the GPS, so the car app's 0 was never seen.

Each of the two providers now passes its speed through a CarSpeedProof:
nothing is put until a speed above 0 has come once, then every speed,
a stop's 0 too. OBD answers only what the car says and is unchanged.

Behaviour changes:
- A car app or unit bus that has only ever said 0 leaves the speed to
  the GPS (the bar, the skins, the second screen, the drive lock...).
- Such a source's speed counts from the first move after the app
  starts; until then a parked car with no GPS fix shows no speed
  instead of 0, and the "car reports a speed" checks (CarCare's GPS
  hold, the SPEED_RPM capability) wait for that move.

Recorded in docs/vehicle-bus.md ("Decisions").

**Как пользоваться:** поставить APK, в лаунчере импортировать APK игры, запустить. Если игра не пошла — долгое нажатие, «Last run report», и пришлите отчёт в issues.

unnecessary interruption of active sessions. The home screen follows the actual
active server after a switch.

as sites are encountered, with a seven-day cache and network context. Apps can

and unrecognized traffic retain the core's routing rules.

release.name: v0.5.20
release.notes:
## Map detections follow you

A mapped camera or a Waze police report now leaves the screen as soon as you are out of its range.

Until now each one stayed for up to 5 minutes after you left it, still showing the distance it had when it was last in range. After a jump in position, the screen could keep a detection from somewhere else: the phone's last known location from earlier at START, a GPS glitch, the end of a tunnel. On an emulator moved 12 km, v0.5.19 kept showing "Flock Safety @ 66m" with an orange ring. Started with a cached position 12 km away, it showed a Waze police report there as "@ 180m".

Cameras and police reports don't move, so OVERWATCH now re-scores them at every location fix:

- **Cameras** within 1.2 km are re-scored at every fix and the rest dropped. When you move into a new area, cameras left behind are dropped before the new area's map arrives.
- **Waze reports** from the latest poll are re-scored at every fix until the next poll, and any more than 2 km away are dropped. If a poll fails, the last reports still stay for 5 minutes.
- Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, Commercial and aircraft detections keep their 5-minute memory, since the app can't re-measure those between sightings.

## Two dark-theme fixes

- **Status-bar icons follow the app's theme**, not the phone's. OVERWATCH defaults to dark, so on a phone in light mode the clock and battery icons were dark on the dark background, almost invisible. The reverse case, the app's light theme on a phone in dark mode, had white icons on a light background; that's fixed too.
- **The back arrow in Settings is visible in the dark theme.** It had been black on near-black since v0.1.0.

## New screenshots

The README and [overwatch.netslum.io](https://overwatch.netslum.io) have new screenshots of the main screen, the source sheet and Settings. They come from an Android 16 emulator with its GPS set beside Tysons Galleria in Virginia, and replace ones from v0.5.5.

release.notes:
# TVAutoPlayer V1.5.0

V1.5.0 增加多个每日时间段的独立图片/视频播放列表。规则支持跨午夜、总开关、单条停用、冲突拦截和约 30 秒边界检查；未覆盖时段继续使用原默认列表。

## 主要变化

- 新增电视遥控器可操作的时间段总览与编辑页。
- 每条规则可配置开始/结束时间、启用状态和独立混合媒体列表。
- 开始时间包含、结束时间不包含；结束早于开始表示跨午夜。
- 启用规则不能重叠，相邻时间段允许保存。
- 播放中只在有效规则来源变化时重建队列，普通检查不打断当前媒体。
- 仅有未来时间段且默认列表为空时，开机可进入等待状态并到点播放。
- V1.4.0 及更早配置直接兼容，升级后时间段功能默认关闭。
- Android 版本升级为 `versionCode=9`、`versionName=1.5.0`。

## 安装

下载 `TVAutoPlayer-v1.5.0-debug.apk` 后侧载，或执行：

```powershell
adb install -r .\TVAutoPlayer-v1.5.0-debug.apk
```

相同 Debug 签名可覆盖安装并保留设置。不同签名需要卸载旧版，会清除应用设置但不会删除媒体。

## 验证范围

- 中英文资源一致性与中文 UI 硬编码检查。
- 时间匹配、跨午夜、冲突检测、解析优先级、配置容错和旧配置兼容单元测试。
- Android Lint、Debug APK 构建、包清单、权限、ZIP 对齐、v1/v2 签名和 SHA-256。

真实电视上的 U 盘索引、遥控器焦点、边界时间精度、厂商开机限制和长时间循环仍需目标设备验收。

## 发布说明

当前 APK 使用 Android Debug 证书，适合侧载测试、展厅、门店和内网设备。正式批量部署请改用企业固定 Release 证书，并安全保管密钥。

release.name: Milki Launcher 1.3.4
release.notes:
## What's new

### Icon-first suggestion pills
Search suggestions now show icons instead of plain text:
- Links show the handler app icon (e.g. Facebook) plus your default browser icon as fallback (generic web icon if none is set).
- Search sources show the native app icon when installed (e.g. YouTube); otherwise the site favicon, fetched once and saved on-device, with an initial-letter monogram while loading or if the fetch fails.
- Shorter pill labels; full names kept for screen readers.

### Fixed: home gestures freezing after activity recreation
Swipes/taps could go dead on a normal-looking home screen after rotation, theme/font change, or window resize, while long-press menus kept working. Cause: the search dialog followed a stale visibility flow after recreation, leaving an invisible route that blocked background gestures. Visibility is now rebound on every creation, with interaction-reset and navigator hardening around it.

> Note: suggestion-pill favicons use INTERNET (normal permission, no prompt). Direct site fetch first, Google S2 PNG fallback for undecodable icons; fetched once per host and cached on-device.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/milkiLabs/launcher/compare/v1.3.3...v1.3.4

release.name: v0.5.4
release.notes:
## English

Skerry 0.5.4 fixes a Linux startup crash that could prevent the application window from opening when initialization pipes have an 8192-byte capacity.

### Fixed

- **Reliable Linux startup.** AppImage, DEB and RPM packages use a manifest classpath JAR to keep jpackage initialization data small. Dependency order and Java options are preserved.
- **Existing data stays compatible.** No vault format or configuration migration is required.

The defect also reproduces in 0.5.2; the bundled launcher and Java runtime are identical in 0.5.2 and 0.5.3. The reason the affected machine temporarily created smaller pipes has not been established.

Actual packaged startup was verified locally on Fedora with pipes forced to 8192 bytes: the AppImage opened on the desktop, and extracted DEB/RPM launchers opened in a test display. Windows/macOS and Android have no functional changes in this hotfix. The sync server is unchanged.

## Русский

Skerry 0.5.4 исправляет падение при запуске в Linux, из-за которого окно приложения могло не открываться при ёмкости канала инициализации 8192 байта.

### Исправлено

- **Запуск в Linux.** Пакеты AppImage, DEB и RPM используют JAR с manifest classpath, чтобы уменьшить объём данных инициализации jpackage. Порядок зависимостей и параметры Java сохранены.
- **Совместимость данных.** Миграция хранилища и настроек не требуется.

Ошибка воспроизводится и в 0.5.2; launcher и Java runtime в 0.5.2 и 0.5.3 побайтно одинаковы. Причина временного уменьшения ёмкости pipe на затронутой машине не установлена.

Локально проверен запуск готовых пакетов в Fedora с принудительной ёмкостью pipe 8192 байта: AppImage открыл окно на рабочем столе, извлечённые DEB/RPM — в тестовом дисплее. Функциональных изменений Windows/macOS и Android в этом исправлении нет. Сервер синхронизации не менялся.

---

[All changes / Все изменения](https://github.com/SeCherkasov/SkerrySSH/compare/v0.5.3...v0.5.4)

release.name: MotionScroll v1.0.2
release.notes:
# MotionScroll v1.0.2
## New in v1.0.2

- **New Camera Shortcut Overlay:** Added a movable on-screen camera toggle floating button to easily start or stop head tracking without opening the app. This improves control and prevents unintended scrolling.
- **Floating Button Improvements:**  
  - Tap the button to toggle the camera.
  - Drag to reposition the button anywhere on the screen.
  - Automatically updates button color based on camera state (On = grey, Off = red).
- **Internal Enhancements:** Improved service stability, updated overlay permissions handling, and fixed minor lifecycle bugs related to the overlay service.

## Previous Changes in v1.0.1

- **Improved First-Time User Experience:** Added a welcome message on the first launch to highlight the importance of using the shortcut overlay for seamless navigation within apps and device settings. This helps prevent unintended scrolling when head tracking is active.
- **Code Improvements:** Cleaned up unused code and made internal adjustments to improve stability and address reported issues related to app settings and state management.

## Previous Changes in v1.0.0

- **Fixed Scrolling:** Resolved the primary bug preventing the accessibility service from running correctly.
- **Scroll Modes:** Introduced different scrolling behaviors controlled via the "Scroll Mode/Delay" input:
  - `0`: Continuous, smooth scrolling.
  - `1`: Default skip mode with a 1-second delay between jumps.
  - `>1`: Skip mode with a custom delay (in seconds) between jumps.
- **Adjustable Skip Distance:** Added a slider to control how far the screen jumps in skip mode (when delay is 1 or greater). Default jump is 9% of screen height.
- **UI Improvements:**
  - Replaced the camera toggle button with a Switch.
  - Removed unused UI elements (old skip toggle, sensitivity/speed sliders).
  - Improved button appearance.
- **Bug Fixes:** Addressed various minor bugs and improved stability.

# android-use 1.2.0

**Highlights.** The on-device app is now called **Android-Use**, so the setup steps name what you see. `au` ships for six platforms (macOS and Linux and Windows, each on x86_64 and arm64), emulators are a first-class way to use it (`au emulator install` fetches the SDK pieces, and `cargo xtask emulator-e2e` checks the whole workflow), and the documentation and release process were rebuilt.

### Changed

- The helper app, its accessibility service, and its notification reader are labeled **Android-Use** (they were "AU Bridge", "AU semantic Android control", and "AU notification reader"). Host messages and docs now say "Settings → Accessibility → Android-Use". Upgrading with `au update` renames them in place.
- `au help` lists `install`, `uninstall AGENT`, `emulator`, `targets`, and `--target`.
- The install scripts install the newest release (they were fixed on 1.0.0) and support every platform below. `ANDROID_USE_VERSION` still pins a version.
- The README, install guide, and docs index are rewritten around one install path per platform, measured results, and the emulator workflow. Docs moved into `guides/`, `reference/`, `concepts/`, and `contributing/`; the internal planning documents were replaced by [measurements](https://github.com/austinintelligence/android-use/blob/v1.2.0/docs/design/measurements.md).

### Added

- **Platforms:** macOS Intel, Linux arm64, and Windows arm64, beside macOS Apple Silicon, Linux x86_64, and Windows x86_64. `install/platforms.json` is the one list; `cargo xtask version` fails if the release workflow or an install script disagrees. macOS Intel and Windows arm64 are cross-built.
- `au emulator install` runs Google's `sdkmanager` for the missing emulator package and system image, attached to your terminal so you read and accept the SDK license.
- `cargo xtask emulator-e2e`: create, start, set up, read and act, a refused second serve, restart with enrollment intact, snapshot save and restore, in one run.
- npm: a R

release.name: v0.2.2
release.notes:
## Features

- **Opus audio decode for MoQ** — second codec alongside AAC, with preference for Opus (20ms vs 100ms frame latency) (#39)
- **A/V sync for MoQ live streaming** — deadline accumulator pacing, deferred epoch, proportional drift controller with EMA smoothing, stall-on-underrun, alt-tab recovery (#39)
- **Android zero-copy video** — enable 8 Vulkan extensions + `sampler_ycbcr_conversion` in wgpu fork; `LuminaVideo.init(activity)` one-liner replaces ~50 lines of Kotlin boilerplate (#29)
- **Android zero-copy debug panel** — runtime stats (true zero-copy vs CPU-assisted frames, decode rate, resolution) (#29)

## Improvements

- **Replace rodio with cpal** — direct `build_output_stream` callback for MoQ live and FFmpeg VOD on macOS, Linux, Android; lock-free ring buffer end-to-end (#32)
- **MoQ live join fixes** — eliminate 3s metadata stall, fix PTS rejection during audio startup, Annex B NAL parser, URL path sanitization (#15)
- **MoQ track priority** — audio priority higher than video so relay delivers audio reliably (#39)

## Bug Fixes

- **fix(android):** replace default icon with Ferris logo (#26)
- **fix(ci):** add `gradle-wrapper.jar` + update `Cargo.lock` for `--locked` builds (#25)

## CI / Release

- **macOS DMG workflow** — builds arm64, x86_64, and universal DMGs with bundled FFmpeg (#24)
- **Android APK workflow** — builds arm64 APK on release publish (#22)

## Documentation

- Update README: features list, MoQ status table (AAC+Opus working), architecture diagram with new modules (#39)
- Update `docs/AV-SYNC.md`: MoQ sync section, drift controller, threading diagrams, cpal references (#39)
- Add `MOQ_BEST_PRACTICES.md`: protocol rules, priority scheduling, cancellation safety (#39)

This version marks the culmination of our efforts to build a feature-rich, secure, and beautiful email client. Wamail integrates powerful AI capabilities for spam detection, real-time push notifications, and a full suite of email management tools, all powered by Firebase and Google Gemini AI.

### ✨ **Key Features in This Release**

*   **📱 Full Cross-Platform Support:** A single codebase for a consistent experience on **Android** and the **Web**.
*   **🤖 AI-Powered Spam Detection:** Automatically classifies and flags spam emails using the **Google Gemini API**, with a distinct orange notification warning to keep you safe.
*   **🔔 Real-time Push Notifications:** Instant alerts for new incoming mail, powered by Firebase Cloud Messaging.
*   **✉️ Complete Email Workflow:** Full functionality to send, receive, read, delete, restore, and search for emails.
*   **🗂️ Advanced Label & Folder Management:** Organize your inbox with custom labels and pre-defined folders like Inbox, Sent, Drafts, Spam, and Trash.
*   **✍️ Rich Text & Attachments:** Compose beautiful emails with a rich text editor, attach files, view PDFs directly in the app, and download attachments with ease.
*   **🎨 Dark/Light Theme:** A stunning, adaptive UI that fully supports both dark and light modes.
*   **👤 User & Profile Management:** Secure user authentication (login, register, OTP), password change, avatar updates, and personal info editing.
*   **🏖️ Auto-Reply:** Easily set up automatic replies for when you're out of office or on vacation.

release.name: v1.0.2 — F-Droid review fixes + About dialog
release.notes:
Bug-fix release addressing **every finding** from the F-Droid inclusion review
([fdroiddata!44998](https://gitlab.com/fdroid/fdroiddata/-/merge_requests/44998)). Thanks to
[@MiggiV2](https://gitlab.com/MiggiV2) for testing 1.0.1 on real hardware and finding all four, and
to [@andrewpozdnakov7](https://gitlab.com/andrewpozdnakov7) for the source review.

No new permissions. Still no `INTERNET` permission, no tracking, no ads, no root.

## Fixed

- **The APK contents list was unreadable in dark theme.** Every screen sits in a `Scaffold` with a
  transparent container so the pastel gradient shows through, but Material 3 resolves that to no
  content colour and falls back to its hard-coded `Color.Black` default. The *Contents* header and
  all entry names on the app detail screen painted pure black on the dark background, at roughly
  1.3:1 contrast. Fixed once in `GradientBackground`, which now publishes `onSurface` as the content
  colour — closing the whole class of bug for every screen rather than patching two call sites.
- **Split bundles were saved as `.apks.apk`.** The Storage Access Framework reconciles the requested
  MIME type against the file name's extension and renames the file when they disagree: `apks` maps
  to no registered type, while the APK MIME type maps to `apk`. Bundles now request
  `application/octet-stream`, the only type that agrees with an unregistered extension, so the
  `.apks` name is written as intended. **The archive contents were always correct — only the name was
  wrong**, so existing files can simply be renamed to drop the trailing `.apk`.
- **The Settings screen could not be scrolled**, so the About card — with the app name and the
  GPL-3.0-or-later notice — was clipped below the screen edge and unreachable on shorter screens,
  and worse at large font scales.
- **Status- and navigation-bar icons ignored the in-app theme.** `enableEdgeToEdge` detects dark mode
  from the *system* night setting, so choosing Light on a system-dark de

release.name: cccodroid v0.4.20
release.notes:
**简体中文** · [English](#english)

这一版是 0.4.x 的最后一版，主题是「按自己的习惯摆」：多了一套外观，强调色和字体能换成自己的，常发的提示能存成指令，顶栏和消息下面留哪些按钮也由你定。

## 新外观「构成」

- 设置 → 通用 → 外观，多了「构成」：牛皮纸底、墨黑、宣传画红，方角、粗墨线、实心错位投影，按钮按下去会往投影那边落一下。浅色深色两套都有。
- 头像、输入框、弹出菜单、设置面板都跟着换成方的；首屏铺一层细斜线，问候下面压一道红。

## 强调色

- 设置 → 通用 → 强调色：八个预设色，或者点最后的彩色圆自己取色。按钮、链接、选中项都换成这个颜色。
- 同一个颜色会按当前外观的底色自动调深浅，浅色、深色下文字都看得清；按钮上的字自动选黑或白。

## 导入字体

- 设置 → 通用 → 导入的字体，选一个 ttf、otf、woff 或 woff2 文件导进来（单个 40 MB 以内，最多 10 个）。
- 界面字体和回复字体各有「自选…」，点了从导入的字体里挑。字体里没有的字照旧用自带字体补上，英文字体配中文也不会缺字。代码和终端仍用自带的等宽字体，免得格子对不齐。

## 常用指令

- 扩展页多了「常用指令」：常发的长提示存成一条，起个名字，之后输入框里打 / 就能选。`/名字` 后面跟的话会填进正文里的 `$ARGUMENTS`。
- 可以存给所有项目，也可以只存给当前项目。存的是 Claude Code 官方的命令文件，终端里直接敲 claude 也能用。

## What's new in 1.0.0-beta.3

**Universal Control** *(Experimental)* — push the laptop's cursor off the screen
edge and it arrives on the phone, driving the phone's own cursor. The keyboard
follows it and two-finger trackpad scrolling scrolls the phone. You choose which
side the phone sits on — or just one corner of that edge, so a dock or hot corner
keeps the rest. Push back out the way you came in, or press Esc, and control
returns to the laptop.

It needs **adb** *and* **Wayland on a recent GNOME**: holding the cursor at the
edge goes through the input-capture portal, so it does not arm on X11 or KDE.
Hiding the laptop's own cursor needs the GNOME extension on **GNOME 49+**. When
it cannot arm, the switch turns itself off and says why, in your language.

**Second screen** — the phone becomes a *real* extra monitor: it shows up in
Displays and windows drag onto it. GNOME only, view-only for now.

**Login codes to the clipboard** — an arriving SMS verification code lands on the
laptop clipboard, no retyping.

**The binary we push to your phone is now verifiable.** Universal Control works
by pushing a 20 KB helper to `/data/local/tmp` and running it as the shell user.
It is committed in built form because the app embeds it at compile time, so
`android/inject/build.sh` rebuilds it — with NDK r26b, byte-for-byte identical:

```bash
OUT=/tmp/vi android/inject/build.sh
cmp /tmp/vi linux/ui-tauri/src-tauri/assets/vortex_inject && echo identical
```

Universal Control has been run on exactly **one** pair so far — GNOME 50 with a
Redmi 9/9C. The fallback for phones that will not let adb open `/dev/uinput` has,
by definition, never run on one. If it misbehaves on yours, that is the point of
this beta: please open an issue with your distro, desktop and phone model.

- New design system and full reskin (light/dark theme, shared color/spacing/typography tokens) across every screen

# TVBox Web v1.0.0 正式版发布

🎉 **TVBox Web 跨平台双引擎影视聚合项目首个正式版发布！**

本项目致力于实现 **Android 端原生微服务 + Windows 本地端极简启动 + 跨平台现代 Web 播放器** 的现代化影视生态，支持全平台多设备流畅观影。

---

## 🌟 核心功能亮点

### 1. 跨平台双端生态
- **Windows 本地运行**：
  - `start.bat` 一键运行（自动引导检测 Node 环境，零门槛）。
  - `start_silent.bat` 无黑框静默后台守护运行。
  - `stop.bat` 优雅关停所有相关项目进程，不影响系统其他 Node 进程。
  - `修复端口占用.bat` 智能诊断并修复 Windows Hyper-V/WinNAT 动态端口冲突（EACCES 8999）。
- **Android 服务端 APK**：
  - 手机/平板/车机/电视独立运行，内置轻量 Web 服务器与网页前端，开机自启前台常驻，扫码即看。

### 2. 强大的多音轨与多字幕引擎
- **MP4 & MKV 原生切轨**：
  - 独家实现 MP4 `moov/trak/tkhd` 与 MKV EBML `Tracks/TrackEntry` 动态二进制重写中继。
  - 完美解决 Chromium (Edge/Chrome) 与 Gecko (Firefox/Zen) 浏览器播放原盘多音轨（如国粤双语、英语原声）的默认音轨差异与无法切轨痛点。
- **多维度字幕支持**：
  - 自动识别并中继 HLS `#EXT-X-MEDIA` 字幕与网络外挂字幕。

  - 对蓝光 PGS 图形位图字幕给出明确提示，避免误导。

### 3. 现代化 Web 影音体验
- **零 CDN 依赖**：全站本地化离线内置 Tailwind CSS、HLS.js，弱网及内网环境下极速加载。
- **h5player 专业快捷键**：

  - 网页全屏（`W`）、画中画（`P`）、旋转画面（`R`）、截图（`S`）

- **PWA 沉浸式设计**：
  - 支持 PWA 安装，支持 Window Controls Overlay (WCO) 视窗融合，提供接近原生桌面应用的沉浸式体验。
  - 纯黑视口消除全屏滚动条，弹窗激活时智能锁定背景。
- **追剧与历史同步**：
  - 自动记录播放断点进度，支持“继续播放”。
  - 内置网盘扫码配置中心（阿里云盘、夸克网盘、百度网盘、115网盘等）。

## v5.5.2 (2026-10-19)

### Improvements

#### Remote library updates survive network drops

When the connection to a remote (S3) library dropped during an update, for example a phone switching networks or Wi-Fi going to sleep, every song read at that moment failed, and a few seconds offline could mark hundreds of songs as unreadable. Now the update notices the outage, shows "Connection lost, waiting for it to come back…" and waits up to 5 minutes, then continues where it stopped. A remote library that cannot be listed is named in the update summary instead of being silently skipped.

#### Incomplete library updates are shown

If an update did not finish (the app was closed, or the connection stayed down), Settings, Music Library shows a warning, and a warning icon appears on the section header even while it is collapsed. Press **Update library** again and only the missing songs are read. Files that cannot be read at all (for example a damaged file) are now named in the update summary, up to three of them, so you can find and fix them. The result of the last update is now kept across restarts.

#### Android: library updates keep running in the background

With nothing playing, Android froze the app soon after it left the screen, so a large library update stopped half way and the rest of the songs stayed missing. Updates now keep running with the screen off or another app open, with a notification showing their progress; it disappears when the update is done.

#### The play button shows when a stream is buffering

Starting a radio station, podcast or remote song can take a few seconds while it connects. The play button now shows a spinner until the music starts, instead of looking like nothing happened. Clicking it stops the stream.

#### Bigger, easier to use mini player

## New Features & Key Highlights

### Deezer Support
* **Second Source**: Search, preview and download from Deezer alongside Qobuz. A Qobuz/Deezer switch sits above the search results, each source keeps its own results when you flip between them, and rows carry a source badge.
* **Sign-In**: Deezer uses the ARL cookie from a logged-in browser session (Settings → Account, or the set-up wizard). You only need credentials for one source; search opens on whichever is set up.
* **Plan-Aware Quality**: If your Deezer plan can't serve the quality you pick, the download drops to the best it can (FLAC → 320 kbps MP3 → 128 kbps MP3) and is saved with the right extension. Turn off `lower_quality_if_not_available` in the config to get an error instead.
* **Decryption While Downloading**: Deezer's encrypted CDN streams are Blowfish-decrypted as they arrive instead of being buffered whole, so a large FLAC can't run an Android phone out of memory.
* **Same Tags Either Way**: Deezer metadata is normalised to the same tag layout as Qobuz (album artist, disc numbers, cover art), so downloads from either source look the same in the library.
* **Optional Dependency**: `deezer-py` and `pycryptodomex` are imported defensively. A build without them still starts and still does Qobuz; Deezer reports what is missing.

# XPL-EX-NEXT v1.6.7

## Изменения

release.name: Knotwork 0.12.1
release.notes:
A patch release: fixes, and runs that no longer wait between their steps. The database migrates forward on update (one new column).

**Upgrading from 0.12.0 is an ordinary in-place update** within the same signer: a GitHub release or the F-Droid copy over a GitHub or F-Droid install, or Google Play over Google Play. A backup made on 0.12.1 cannot be restored on 0.12.0, which refuses a newer database.

## MCP servers with a sign-in connect right away

A server added with a sign-in or custom headers showed a connection error on the Tools screen until the app was restarted, and *Refresh* did not help. The screen received the new server before its sign-in was stored and connected without it. An edited sign-in had the same fault, and a change of the sign-in alone never reached the screen. Saving a server's form without changes, or an edit refused because another server already has that address, left the row on *Connecting…* until *Refresh*.

All of these now connect with what was saved. The agent itself was never affected: it reads the server list afresh each time it lists or calls a tool.

## Runs no longer wait between nodes

The engine paused half a second before every node and a full second after each cloud, summary, router, planner and evaluation node, background runs included. Neither pause had a measured reason. A chat message on the first-launch pipeline now skips 3.5 s of waiting, and longer pipelines skip more, up to 21 s on the longest bundled run. Node durations in the console, the run trace and Monitoring are now the node's own time.

## Fixes

- **A resumed run no longer mixes up the items of a queue that carried on past a failure.** The failed item took the next item's result, and that next item ran again, its tool call included. A run interrupted before this release with such an item ends at once with a request to restart the task. The run trace export is now `schemaVersion` 2.
- **A Keystore hiccup no longer deletes a saved API key** or the Hugging Face

## Antares 0.5.0

Antares is the in-house experimental rendering core bundled and coordinated by Solipsism Browser. The Solipsism application remains the stable user-facing browser and can switch to Antares when enabled.

### Highlights

- Synchronised 703 upstream Servo commits while preserving Antares' Android embedding layer, content-blocking policy, per-tab console bridge, IME handling and media integration.

- Updated the Android bridge to upstream Servo's `init` + `addPlatformWindow` lifecycle split while keeping the existing Kotlin/Java embedder API.
- Fixed a panic when evaluating `frame-ancestors` for sandboxed iframes with opaque origins (servo#48268). Nested sandboxed frames now render their CSP block normally instead of aborting the browser process.
- Fixed a native crash when pausing painting after Android had already torn down the rendering surface. Backgrounding the app or opening another activity no longer unwraps a missing surface.
- ARM64 production release (versionCode 10), signed with the Solipsism 9.3.1 release identity (SHA-256 `70:BC:99:FE:73:E8:70:35:3A:34:B2:F3:61:80:B0:05:35:31:A8:FE:A6:5A:21:8B:83:00:E5:0B:C8:80:34:BA`).

### Important

Antares is experimental and can differ from Android WebView on complex sites, media playback and Web APIs. Install the matching **Solipsism Browser 9.4.0** release to use it as the integrated core. Solipsism remains the stable fallback.

The companion signing identity changed from Antares 0.4.0. Uninstall the old companion app before installing 0.5.0; Android cannot update across different signing certificates.

release.name: v1.3.2
release.notes:
**Pre-release.** The installer bundles carry CoreELEC builds that have not been boot-tested on either device. See *Before you install* at the bottom.

## The fix this release exists for

A CoreELEC OS update could leave the box unable to boot CoreELEC, in a way that looked exactly like the **Reboot to CoreELEC** button doing nothing.

u-boot boots CoreELEC from the `boot_a`/`boot_b` partition, not from `/flash`. After an OS update the hook on `/flash` copies the new `kernel.img` across with `dd`. On one stick that copy stopped **659,456 bytes short** and still exited successfully. The kernel region matched perfectly; only the tail of the compressed ramdisk was left over from the previous kernel. The result on every boot:

```
rootfs image is not initramfs (ZSTD-compressed data is corrupt); looks like an initrd
Kernel panic - not syncing: Requested init /init failed (error -2).
```

`bootcmd` clears `boot_ce` *before* it runs `bootcefromemmc`, so the next boot went straight back to Android — no error, no clue. The boot gate was intact and working the entire time. Every component checked the gate; nothing checked the kernel image the gate hands off to.

Three layers now do:

- **Reboot to CoreELEC (5.1)** compares `boot_<slot>` against `/flash/kernel.img` on every press. On a mismatch it says *Repairing the CoreELEC kernel image…*, rewrites the partition, and confirms by reading it back before rebooting. If the repair does not take, it refuses to reboot rather than spending `boot_ce` on a boot that will panic.
- **CoreELEC Toolbox (1.1.3)** gained a **CoreELEC kernel image** check in Repair, with the same comparison and fix.
- **The update hook** now flushes `/flash` before reading `kernel.img`, and holds `dd` to the byte count the source implies instead of trusting its exit status. Run Repair once to put the new hook on disk.

Neither the app nor Repair will copy a `/flash/kernel.img` that fails the `kernel.img.md5` CoreELEC ships beside it — tha

release.name: AmneziaGuard 0.4.1 — a slow upload no longer freezes other apps
release.notes:
A robustness fix on top of 0.4.0 (which reached throughput parity with the
stock client). Same speeds, steadier under real mixed traffic.

**What changed**

The app's upload was forwarded to the tunnel with a blocking write on the
one thread that reads every app's packets. If the tunnel couldn't keep up,
that write stalled — and froze packet processing for *every* app at once
(a background upload could hang your browsing). Each connection now drains
its upload on its own thread, so a slow flow slows only itself.

A speedtest never showed this (it runs download then upload, never both);
it takes real mixed traffic — a background upload while you browse — to
notice, and that now stays responsive.

Throughput is unchanged from 0.4.0. Installs over it; app data is preserved.

- **Server placeholder images were cached forever**: `Cache-Control: no-store` is now honored (Navidrome's temporary placeholder for missing art is never persisted),

release.name: BurnPony 1.4.0
release.notes:
# BurnPony 1.4.0

## Route BurnPony through Tor or a SOCKS5 proxy

Settings has a new Proxy section. Choose Off, Orbot for one-tap Tor, or a custom SOCKS5 host and port. When a proxy is on, every relay request goes through it: creating a note, checking status, burning, changing expiry, and push registration. The destination is resolved by the proxy rather than on the device, so the relay hostname does not reach your local resolver while a proxy is active.

When a proxy is enabled and unreachable, requests fail instead of quietly falling back to a direct connection. There is no silent direct path.

## Stream isolation

The Proxy section takes an optional username and password. With Tor, any pair puts BurnPony on its own circuit, separate from other apps sharing Orbot (Tor's IsolateSOCKSAuth). For a SOCKS5 proxy that requires a login, use its credentials. The SOCKS5 client is BurnPony's own, so it offers exactly the method in use and sends the destination as a domain name for proxy-side resolution.

The username and password path is verified against Tor. It has not been exercised against a third-party authenticated SOCKS5 proxy, which uses the same handshake.

## For F-Droid

This is the first release published to F-Droid since 1.0.1. It also carries the accessibility, language, and reliability work from the versions in between.

repo.description: Installs and updates Android apps straight from their developers, and checks every file first. Phones, tablets and Android TV.

release.notes:
Most of this release is about picking the right file and saying less. A failure that keeps happening is said once, and on Android 12 and later nobody can start an install from a locked phone's notifications.

- F-Droid lists one build of a version for each processor. Tern took the arm64 one, so an armv7 television or an x86 tablet got an error row while its own build was listed right below. The build that fits the device now goes first.
- An app a few releases behind shows the notes of every release since the installed one, under "What's new since", newest first, ten at most.
- A publisher's checksum is found in more of the places publishers put it, such as `app.apk.sha256.txt` or `checksums_sha256.txt`. A bare sum counts only from a file made for that one download.
- Release notes keep what the developer wrote: `a < b and c > d` keeps its middle, `app_arm64_v8a.apk` keeps every `_`, and a link at the end of a sentence leaves out the full stop.
- A filter pattern that ran past its deadline is not started again while its earlier run still spins.
- Download progress redraws four times a second and its notification once a second.
- Downloads that nothing in the list will ask for again are cleared out at start and after a check of the whole list.
- A download waits up to a minute when the server asks it to.
- Settings says when Android last ran the background check, and what holds it back when something does.
- A retry after a failed background check waits for the same Wi-Fi and charger conditions as the check, and none is set while background checks are off.
- With Orbot off, or a proxy on this device not running, a background run stops once with one log line and one retry instead of failing every app. Nothing goes direct.
- A failure that repeats is logged and notified once. What Tern keeps to know that is a fingerprint of the app id and the reason, never a name.
- Installs waiting for the system's confirmation sit under one summary that makes one sound.
- A notificat

release.name: FlowReader v56.5.2
release.notes:
FlowReader v56.5.2 - 离线电子书阅读应用

> 性能优化：domain 模型稳定性配置使书架卡片、阅读器参数可跳过重组。

### 优化
- **恢复 domain 模型的 skippability**：`:domain` 无 Compose 编译器，所以 `Book`/`Chapter`/`Annotation`/`ReadingSettings` 等参数被推断为不稳定，导致每张可见书卡在任意状态变更时都重新执行——无论 `equals()` 检查有多深。
  - 新增 `compose_compiler_config.conf`（仓库根目录），声明 `com.flowreader.app.domain.model.*` 稳定。
  - 在四个 Compose 模块（`:app`、`:core`、`:feature:library`、`:feature:reader`）通过 `composeCompiler.stabilityConfigurationFiles.add()` 接入。
  - `LibraryMessage` 添加 `@Immutable` 注解（sealed interface 之前只能走 runtime）。
  - 新增 `ModelStabilityContractTest` 守卫承诺：domain 模型不得有 `var` 或可变集合字段。
- **编译器报告**：52 个不稳定类 → 37 个（所有 UiState 现在都稳定）；`Book`/`Chapter`/`Annotation`/`ReadingSettings` 现在通过 skip 检查。
- **报告生成可选**：`./gradlew -PcomposeReports=true` 写入 `app/build/compose_reports/`；普通构建不支付报告生成成本。

### 修复
- **FTS 数据库初始化竞态**：`FullTextSearch.initialize()` 的双重检查锁定缺少互斥锁，三个并发调用点（`ReaderViewModel`、`SearchRepositoryImpl` 的两处）可能同时通过 `database?.isOpen` 检查并各自 `openOrCreateDatabase()`，泄漏先创建的句柄。现由 `initMutex` 串行化，并在锁内重新检查。
- **`CacheManager.evictBookLocked()`**：原名 `evictBook()`，要求调用方持有 `synchronized(chapterCache)` 却未在签名或文档中体现。重命名并注明前置条件，避免后续从锁外调用导致 `LinkedHashMap` 并发损坏。

### 变更
- 替换三处废弃 API：`stabilityConfigurationFile` → `stabilityConfigurationFiles.add()`（四个模块）、`Intent.getParcelableExtra()` → `IntentCompat.getParcelableExtra()`（API 33+）、`Icons.Default.ViewList` → `Icons.AutoMirrored.Filled.ViewList`。

### 测试
- 测试覆盖率：76.2% → 77.8%（49/63）。
- 全量门禁通过。

release.name: V1.2 — Overview loading fix
release.notes:
## Fixes the Overview loading hang (#1)

The dashboard no longer sits on "Reading system state" at launch. Overview resolves on the first frame, with or without root.

**Root cause:** the Overview state was a `combine()` of five flows, and one of them never emitted on a cold start — so the screen never left its loading state. Navigating to Settings → Access happened to write that missing value, which is why tapping "Probe root" appeared to fix it; the root grant was incidental. The SELinux `avc: denied` messages in the report were a real but separate defect, fixed here as well.

**Also in this build**

- A denied `/proc` or `/sys` read now resolves once per session to "N/A (restricted by Android)" instead of being re-attempted on every 2 s tick — no more repeating denial spam in logcat.
- Shell probes (`su`, Shizuku) have a real deadline and drain stdout and stderr concurrently. An `su` call parked on an unanswered superuser prompt can no longer block collection.
- A granted root session is no longer wiped when access is re-evaluated.
- Per-metric restriction labels that say what would unlock them, a non-blocking no-root banner, and a manual re-probe action.

435 unit tests pass. Full write-up in #4 and `docs/ISSUE1_ROOT_CAUSE.md`.

**Build note:** signed release build, not processed by R8 — produced on an ARM device that cannot run the shrinker within its memory budget. Functionally identical to a shrunk build; the APK is just larger and unobfuscated.

**Version:** reports as 1.2 (versionCode 2). Every earlier release shipped an APK that still identified itself as 1.0 (versionCode 1), so this is the first build a device sees as an actual upgrade. It is signed with the same key as before, so it installs over an existing copy without uninstalling.

release.notes:
**TermFold 2.3: updates from inside the app, a leaner browser, and fixes for the bubble and the running-sessions notification.**

### New
- **Updates in Settings.** Settings > Updates checks GitHub for a newer release, downloads it, checks its SHA-256 and signing key, and hands it to Android's installer. Your projects and files are kept. A dot on the Settings tab shows when an update is waiting. (The first time, Android asks you to allow TermFold to install apps.)
- **A browser agents can afford to use.** Snapshots show only what is on screen, capped, without link addresses (about 25x fewer tokens than the full list on a long page). `snapshot --find <text>`, `--scope`, `--changed` (only what differs), `--all`, `outline`, `text --selector --max`. The full list is saved to `/tmp/termfold-browser/snapshot.txt` for the agent to grep. Screenshots are smaller JPEGs, can be of one element, and `--if-changed` skips a picture that would look the same.
- **One motion system.** Every animation now uses the same three speeds and one curve, a little slower on tablets where surfaces are bigger.

### Fixed
- **Codex CLI (native) would not start** with "failed to record pid-managed app-server process". Android hides /proc/stat, which Codex reads for a process start time; TermFold now provides it.
- **The bubble was square.** It is now round, with the logo clearly inside.
- **Agents could not open the browser in bubble mode.** Only a window that is actually on screen holds the browser now, and when an agent needs it while nothing is showing, TermFold asks you to open it and waits for you.
- **"N sessions running" stayed up with nothing running**, and could only be removed by closing the app from Recents. It now counts only sessions that are working, goes away after five idle minutes, and has a **Stop sessions** button.

release.notes:
### 中文

**新功能**

- **源码查看器。** 点开一个代码文件，现在它是一份**能读的代码**，不是一个纯文本块。

  - **语法高亮**，47 种语言：`json` / `yaml` / `toml` / `Dockerfile` / `Makefile` /
    `CMakeLists.txt` / `.ts` / `.go` / `.rs` / `.js` / `.cs` / `.py` / `.dart` / `.sh` / `.sql` …
    颜色与 Markdown 预览里的代码块**是同一套**（对比度是量过并断言的，深浅两种主题都 ≥ 4.5:1）。
  - **不认识的扩展名保持纯文本。** `.m` 可能是 MATLAB 也可能是 Objective-C，
    **猜错就是在你的文件上画自信的错误颜色** —— 那比不画差。
  - **图片直接看**：PNG / JPEG / GIF / WebP / BMP 在页面里显示，**点一下全屏**、
    双指放大。SVG 画成图，也能切回它的原文看。
  - **文本可选中复制**：长按选中，工具条上只有**复制** ——
    复制出来的东西**不带行号**（行号是给你看的，不是给你粘的）。
    想整份拿走用「更多操作 → 复制全部文本」。

- **会话跟踪（Beta，默认关）。** 打开「设置 → 会话跟踪（Beta）」后，终端的 `…` 菜单里
  多一行：把 agent 自己写的会话记录读出来，按**回合**画成界面。

  - 每个回合：你说了什么、思考了多久、助手回了什么（长文本会截断，**旁边一定有一个展开入口**）。
  - 工具调用表：次数、中位耗时、总耗时、失败次数。逐回合的 token，以及整个会话的汇总
    （模型、目录、输入 / 输出 / 缓存、上下文窗口、花费）。
  - **目前支持 `pi`、`dsh`、`codex`。** 其余 agent 会自动退回终端 —— 记录不存在时不假装有。

**说明**

- 会话跟踪是三层的：agent 自己的记录 → 官方 `agent.read` → 终端画面。
  **任何一层读不到，都会明说读不到**，不会显示成「这个会话没有内容」。
  按目录推测出来的会话会标出来（那不是 daemon 给的答案，是猜的）。
- 应用内**不渲染 PDF**：PDF 页面会直接告诉你去下载，用手机上的 PDF 应用打开
  （在应用里塞一个 PDF 引擎是另一件事，没做）。

release.name: ARK-Store 1.9.0
release.notes:
- **Back up the installed apps**: in the settings, under App backup, the apps installed from outside Google Play are saved as their APK files, with the splits of a bundle, to a folder on the device, on a card or in a cloud service the file picker shows, or to one zip file for moving to another phone or to a service such as Google Drive. A folder stays up to date and copies only what has changed; a zip is written whole each time. The list of apps has the whole page, with a search and the choices all, none or only the apps not from Play. The store's own settings go along
- **Restore** from such a folder or zip file, on this or another device: the page tells of each app whether it is missing, behind, the same, newer, signed with another key or in need of a newer Android, and installs what is chosen one after the other. The sources, bookmarks and settings in the backup can be brought back at the same time
- **Recent backups and restores** in the settings: when, to or from where, how many apps of what size, and how each went
- **Root**: on a rooted device (Magisk, KernelSU or APatch) root can be turned on in the settings. Installs, updates, removals and restores then go through without Android asking. Root is asked for when it is first needed; if it is refused or missing, the usual prompts are used and the settings say so
- **App data in the backup**: with root on, a backup can include the apps' own data, encrypted with a password if one is given. A restore puts the data back only into the app it was taken from, signed with the same key, and only whole: every part is checked before any is put in place, and the old data is kept until all are. Without root, the apps' own data is not part of the backup, since Android does not let a store read it
- **The settings as a page of their own**, with the way back at the top, instead of a sheet pulled up over the list

Download `ARK-Store-1.9.0.apk` below and open it on your phone to install, or update from inside ARK-Store.

- **One-Click Toggle**: Turn on/off directly from the Android TV notification drawer action button or via broadcast intent (`com.wled.tv.ACTION_TOGGLE_OVERLAY`).
- **Zero Video Interference**: Intelligent color filtering prevents sampling routines from picking up the HUD's own wireframe lines during active playback.

### Physical Corner Finder Calibration Tool
- **Corner Finder Activity**: Dedicated visual utility to help identify and map physical strip corner indices (Top-Left, Top-Right, Bottom-Right, Bottom-Left).

- **Smart Protection**: Detects when protected commercial streaming services (Netflix, Disney+, Prime Video) blank the hardware surface (100% black frame with active audio).

release.notes:
### Added

- Added an optional hardware-keyboard companion that automatically appears when a local USB, dock, or Bluetooth keyboard is active.
- Added Agent PBX, Terminal, and Minimal companion presets with Automatic, Always, and Off display modes.
- Added a compact two-row companion with Esc, Tab, sticky modifiers, navigation, arrows, and an always-visible F1-F12 row.
- Added adjustable companion row height from 44dp to 72dp.
- Added touch diagnostics for exact hits, recovered gap hits, misses, dropped releases, dispatch latency, prediction latency, and companion key events.
- Added an adjustable 5%-34% height setting for dedicated Bluetooth trackpad mouse buttons.
- Added an independent two-finger right-click option that works with or without dedicated mouse buttons.

### Changed

- Improved rapid multi-touch typing with per-pointer timing and rollover ordering for up to ten simultaneous touch points.
- Expanded touch targets into visual gaps using nearest-key midpoint boundaries without consuming the keyboard's outer margins.
- Added bounded release hysteresis so small slips near a key edge still commit the originally pressed key.
- Converted swipe thresholds to density-independent measurements for more consistent phone and tablet behavior.
- Moved typed-prediction lookup and ranking off the IME UI thread and indexed dictionaries by prefix and word length.
- Included hardware-companion and touch-diagnostics preferences in settings import, export, and reset behavior.
- Improved Bluetooth trackpad movement and tap classification with radial touch-slop handling.

### Fixed

- Fixed intermittent missed keys when pressing within visual key gaps.
- Fixed rapid multi-key releases being dispatched out of their original press order.
- Fixed small cross-boundary release movements being dropped unnecessarily.
- Fixed the OnePlus Pad 3 cover remaining falsely detected after physical detachment because its Bluetooth input device stayed registered.
- Fixed hardware-companion

## v0.4.0 — agent has the phone and the screen

Pocket Pi's first release where the agent can actually drive other apps. On top of v0.3's phone surface (notifications, intents both directions, share-sheet, camera, mic, location, clipboard, deep-link inbox), v0.4 adds a full UI-automation surface and the playbook to use it.

### What's new

**19 new `/ui/*` tools** for the agent, mirroring an AccessibilityService vendored from [KarryViber/orb-eye](https://github.com/KarryViber/orb-eye) (MIT). The agent can now:

- Read any app's element tree (`pocket_pi_ui_screen`, `pocket_pi_ui_find`)
- Dispatch taps, swipes, long-presses, scrolls, multi-finger gestures (`pocket_pi_ui_tap`, `_click`, `_swipe`, `_scroll`, `_long_press`, `_gesture`)
- Set text on focused fields (`pocket_pi_ui_type`)
- Take screenshots (Android 11+, `pocket_pi_ui_screenshot`)
- Fire global actions — back / home / recents / notifications shade / quick settings (`pocket_pi_ui_global`)
- Buffer system notifications + long-poll a window-change + notification event channel for proactive behaviour (`pocket_pi_ui_notifications`, `pocket_pi_ui_poll_events`)

All routed through the same bearer-token-gated localhost bridge as v0.3 — no companion APK, no root, no shell setup.

**Baked-in `pocket-pi-android-control` skill** at `~/.pi/agent/skills/`. Shipping the tools alone wasn't enough — flash-tier models would call `pocket_pi_intent_send` once, hit a wall, and give up. The skill anchors the fallback chain (deep link → generic intent → launch by package + UI drive → verify) with six worked examples and anti-patterns. With it loaded, the same models that bailed yesterday now complete full chains.

### One-time setup on first install

Android forbids programmatic enablement of AccessibilityService. The app's onboarding pane deep-links straight to Settings → Accessibility → Pocket Pi — tap "Use Pocket Pi", accept the system consent dialog, and the pane self-dismisses. UI tools fail gracefully with 403 until the tog

release.name: v0.4.1
release.notes:
### Fixed
- SSDP discovery could hang forever (and keep the Android multicast lock)
  when a TV accepted the description request but never answered; device
  descriptions are now fetched after the sweep, each with its own timeout,
  and the whole sweep has a hard ceiling.
- A changed LG certificate was unrecoverable from the app. Long-press a TV
  in the picker to forget it (pairing, pinned certificate and saved entry);
  connection failures are now shown on the picker too. Closes #10.
- One failed key press on LG (e.g. the pointer socket being slow) no longer
  drops the whole session; the main connection stays usable.
- Wake-on-LAN retry works again for LG sets that are fully off: the
  handshake timeout is now recognised as "TV unreachable".
- The saved LG client key is only sent to a TV whose certificate is already
  pinned; unpinned connections pair fresh.
- Declining the LG pairing prompt no longer triggers a second prompt; only
  a rejected manifest retries unsigned.
- Tapping a TV twice, or auto-connect plus a tap, no longer opens two
  sockets and two pairing prompts; the row shows a spinner while connecting.
- Overlapping discovery sweeps no longer release the Android multicast lock
  early; the lock is reference-counted and repeat scans are ignored while
  one runs.
- A paired TV no longer appears twice in the picker (saved entry with MAC
  plus discovered entry without); results are merged by host.


## Install

Most phones want `smart-tv-remote-0.4.1-arm64-v8a.apk`. Pick `universal` if unsure. Open the APK on your Android phone and allow installs from this source when asked. Checksums are in `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

release.name: v2rayV 2.5.0
release.notes:
Iran mode connects now — it never did — and the app checks between runs whether the servers it kept still work.

## Iran mode was asking the wrong question

Turning on "connect through an Iranian IP" and getting nothing was not bad luck with the servers. Every test the app ran pointed at a **foreign** host: it timed each candidate against `gstatic.com`, measured its speed against Cloudflare, and looked up where it came out through `api.ip.sb`.

Through a server that comes out *inside* Iran, all three of those leave the country over the one link that is throttled and filtered by design. So a perfectly good Iranian server answered slowly or not at all, was dropped for being over the 2.5-second limit before it was ever speed tested, and the run reported — accurately, and uselessly — that nothing came out inside Iran.

It is also the wrong question on its own terms. Nobody turns this mode on to reach Google. They turn it on to reach an Iranian bank.

So the app now asks an Iranian server whether it can reach Iran. The time limit rises to six seconds, because the route runs *into* the country rather than out of it. Download speed stops being a pass/fail test and becomes a preference, because that download leaves Iran and a server that works fine for your bank can legitimately measure zero.

A server still has to prove it is alive — it just proves it by answering, rather than by winning a race to Cloudflare.

## Your servers are checked between runs, not just when you run out

Until now the app only looked for new servers when you had worked through all ten and asked for more. Meanwhile nothing ever removed a dead server from that list of ten, so ten dead servers still counted as ten, and the background refresh that was supposed to replace them kept deciding it was not needed. That is the whole of "it worked for the first few days".

release.notes:
## v1.0.1 — ◇Mirtazapine Shield · Desktop unlock password (macOS focus)

### Added — desktop unlock password (macOS / Windows / Linux)
The desktop lock screen previously unlocked with a single click (the JVM has no unified biometric API, so the lock was UI-only). You can now set a **real first-factor password** in Settings → Shield:

- **PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256** (210,000 iterations, 16-byte salt, 32-byte output) with constant-time comparison
- **Encrypted, atomic storage** (`~/.syna/unlock_pw`, wiped by the self-destruct protocol)
- **Stackable with TOTP**: password (first factor) → 6-digit code (second factor) when 2FA is enabled
- Wrong passwords feed the existing **brute-force protection** (cooldown + self-destruct fallback)
- Settings UI: set / change / clear (change & clear require the current password); no recovery by design (stated on the lock screen)
- Unset password → previous one-click behavior is unchanged; Android is unaffected (biometrics)

This is the baseline for upcoming macOS-specific work.

### Tests
- **91 automated desktop tests** (added: password round-trip, controller unlock + brute-force counting, password + TOTP stacking)

- `Syna-v1.0.1-macos.dmg` — macOS desktop (this release's focus)
- `Syna-v1.0.1-release.apk` — Android
- `Syna-v1.0.1-server.jar` — headless private chat server (Windows / macOS / Linux)

release.name: June Beta Drop
release.notes:
## What's new in 0.1.14?
Pushing privacy, security, and safety to its peak!
- Ease of selfhosting: Some issues with selfhosted instances not working correctly on the official version of AurAchieve were fixed.
- Full end-to-end encryption for memory lanes: Memory Lanes now support end to end encryption for media files, so they are truly E2E now. (Metadata such as last updated and created date is still unencrypted and is due to appwrite's limitations. this is something that I cannot control or encrypt.)
- More secure encryption: A new KDF is used for encryption. This is seriously *significantly* more secure than our old method. While it is a bit slower, the security improvement is a massive win to prevent offline brute force attacks. All *newer* memories will be created using this.
- Auto-generated encryption passwords only: You cannot choose your own encryption password anymore. It is auto generated to prevent weak passwords. You are advised to store it in a safe place yourself to access your memories in the future.
- **What have you been listening to?**: One of the most anticipated features. It is now available! You can choose any song to add alongside your memory, and it plays directly inside AurAchieve!
- Ability to open others' public memories inside the app directly: aurapage.me memory links now open in the app directly, so you can play other people's "been listening to" songs and access their memories in full style!
- More efficient encoding: Media files now use a much more efficient encoding architectures. Images went from WebP to AVIF, videos went from standard MP4s to HEVC-encodes MP4s, and audio went from MP3 to Opus. This will help save server costs, and help the user load up their past memories' media files much faster.
- More friendly error messages: For now they're only on the login/signup screen. Im slowly working my way to add this everywhere.
- Spam protection: Spammy and temporary emails are now blocked from signing up. Email verification

release.name: EyeOpener 1.3.4
release.notes:
聚焦悬浮字幕启动链路的一组修复:Android 10–13 上「应用内声音」授权后开关自动回弹的主问题,以及它牵出的四个连带问题。

---

## 修复

### 悬浮字幕 · 应用内声音(Android 10–13)

- **授权后开关几秒自动关闭、反复要求重新授权**(#2):授权流程本身是成功的,但应用在 Android 10–13 上没有把已授权的屏幕录制凭证兑换成实际的音频投射实例,启动时误判为「未授权」直接拒绝开启浮窗。表现为:选「应用内声音」并完成授权后,开关短暂显示开启,几秒后自动跳回关闭。现在低版本与 Android 14+ 走同一条兑换路径,应用内声音在 Android 10–13 上恢复正常

### 界面与交互

- **切走应用再回来,开关显示「已关闭」但字幕其实还在翻译**:开关状态此前只做「服务停止 → 关闭」的单向同步,界面重建后不会从后台状态回填。现在开关初值直接取自运行状态,重建后如实显示
- **非首次安装时,每次冷启动都闪一下引导页**:引导页标记是异步读取的,旧逻辑在数据到达前默认按「显示」渲染首帧,约 0.6 秒后才切到主界面。现在数据未就绪时只显示纯背景色,不再闪引导页;全新安装的正常引导流程不受影响

### 启动与停止

- **ASR 模型加载期间关闭浮窗,误报「请先授权屏幕录制权限」**:模型加载耗时可达数秒(真机实测约 2.1s),期间关闭浮窗后,启动流程恢复时会读到已被释放的投射实例,误判为未授权并弹出错误提示——而用户明明已经授权过。现在启动流程会在继续前确认浮窗仍处于开启状态,期间被关闭则静默退出
- **浮窗关闭时,聊天输入栏的麦克风点了没反应**:上一条修复的退出守卫没有区分「浮窗启动」与「语音输入启动」两条路径,导致浮窗关闭时语音输入被静默拦截、无任何反应。本次一并修正

### 其它

- 英文界面补齐 3 条 API 配置相关的缺失文案(顺带解除了 CI 的存量 lint 阻塞)

## Routing
- **Happ-compatible routing profiles** (routing.happ.su format). Import `happ://routing/add|onadd/…` links or raw JSON, or get them automatically with a subscription (`routing` header, a line in the body, or the `routing` block of JSON subscriptions). One profile per subscription, removed together with it.
- **geosite / geoip** work on both cores. sing-box gets rule-sets converted from the `.dat` files. Geo files are shared between profiles with the same sources and refresh when the profile's `LastUpdated` changes or weekly.
- **Split DNS** from the profile: a remote resolver through the VPN for proxied domains, a domestic resolver used directly for direct-listed domains, and static DNS hosts.
- **Profile editor**: every field, chip lists with geosite/geoip autocomplete, a preview of what a category contains, reset to the original version, create from defaults, share as a link. Profiles from subscriptions keep your edits until the provider sends a new version.

## Fixes
- Xray + TUN: direct traffic looped back into the TUN, so sites that should bypass the VPN did not load on desktop.
- The core kept running after closing the app or "Run as administrator", and the app could then show a connection it didn't own (#2). Cores left over from a crash are cleaned up on start.
- Connect/disconnect races that left the system proxy pointing at a stopped core.
- IPv6 server addresses from share links.
- JSON subscriptions: the REALITY key named `password` (Xray 25+) is read; TLS servers no longer get a forced `h3` ALPN.
- REALITY `spx` / `pqv` are passed to Xray; the App log explains a rejected REALITY handshake.
- Xray traffic stats are read over HTTP (no extra process per poll) and are no longer doubled.
- Connection history closes the session on exit and on "Run as administrator".
- Bottom tab bar hidden under t

release.name: EasyTier miuix v1.3.0
release.notes:
内置 EasyTier 内核升级到 **2.7.0**，修复了三处会让网络配置**无法启动**的写入错误，并补齐高级配置项、修复状态页显示。

## 内核

- **EasyTier 2.6.4 → 2.7.0**（上游 40 个提交）：TCP 打洞连接 1s 保活、ACL 双向 ping 绕过 inbound drop、TCP 代理流隔离与 KCP 控制丢失恢复、有接收限速时的对端存活响应、DHCP 不再给无 IPv4 的对端分配地址，以及一批 BufPool 零拷贝性能优化
- JNI 导出符号与 2.6.4 完全一致，Kotlin 侧无需迁移

## 修复

- **打开 VPN Portal 后网络无法启动**：此前写出的是上游已废弃的 `client_cidr`，而该结构体带 `deny_unknown_fields`，整份配置会被直接拒绝。现改用上游唯一支持的具名客户端模型 `[[vpn_portal_config.clients]]`，并新增客户端编辑器
- **配置子网代理后网络无法启动**：`[[proxy_network]] allow = true` 类型不符（上游是字符串数组，且核心并不读取该字段）
- **打开「无 TUN」后网络无法启动**：`[flags]` 中写出了重复键 `no_tun`。该开关在 Android 上本无作用（TUN 由 VpnService 提供），已移除
- **NAT 类型恒显示「未知」**：核心返回的是枚举名字符串（`FullCone` / `NoPAT` 等），此前按整数解析；映射表也按 proto 的 10 个变体重建
- **事件日志等级与「清空」**：「Warnings+」筛选此前永远得到空列表；「清空」之后列表会进入无法回退的空状态
- **未就绪实例被显示成假成功**：`running` 曾被硬编码为 `true`，现在会显示核心给出的失败原因
- **多路径对端取错连接**：改按上游 `default_conn_id` 选择主连接；中继对端用 `path_latency` 兜底，不再恒显示 `- ms`
- **端口转发重启后丢失**：此前可编辑、会生效，但未纳入配置持久化

## 新增

- 高级选项面板接入 13 个此前只存在于模型、从不写入配置的开关：仅 P2P、延迟 P2P、需要 P2P、转发 RPC 包、禁用 KCP 输入、启用 QUIC 代理、禁用 QUIC 输入、禁用 UPnP、UDP 广播中继、禁用对称 NAT 打洞、系统转发、用户态协议栈、仅使用物理网卡
- 监听映射、手动路由、加密算法（含移动端更省电的 `chacha20`）、数据压缩（Zstd）、实例接收限速、中继网络白名单
- 监听地址支持自定义输入，含上游 #1967 的 URL 路径形式（`ws://host:11011/path`）
- 保存前校验 IPv4 / CIDR / 端口 / VPN 客户端，避免到启动时才以 serde 报错失败

## 界面

- 设置页按「连接 / 外观 / 其他」重新分组，语言项补上说明文字
- 关于页改为介绍本客户端，并显示内置内核版本（构建时从内核源码读取，不会与实际打包的版本漂移）
- 顶部标题随标签页变化（此前设置页也显示应用名）
- 补齐 44 条中文文案，组件中硬编码的英文标签改为字符串资源

> 与 v1.2.1 及更早版本**签名一致，可直接覆盖安装**。升级后建议重点验证：开启 VPN Portal 后的保存与启动、配置子网代理后的保存与启动、状态页的 NAT 类型与事件筛选。

release.name: GameCore 3.8.1 — Eight official plugins
release.notes:
## GameCore 3.8.1 — Eight official plugins

GameCore's plugin system now comes with a first set of **GameCore-made plugins**. Like every plugin, each one is **data only** — GameCore reads it and renders it; nothing in a plugin runs code on your device.

### The eight plugins
- **Nothing OS Gaming** — a Nothing-OS-style theme.
- **Anime Interface Pack** — an anime-inspired theme with reference screens.
- **Sensitivity Lab Pro** — a workspace for recording and comparing sensitivities.
- **Automation History** — a read-only view of the automations GameCore has already run for you.
- **GameCore Personal OS** — a personal dashboard.
- **Local Gaming Advisor** — on-device tips drawn from what GameCore already knows.
- **Benchmark Suite** — a benchmark readout.
- **Dashboard Composer** — compose your own dashboard from the widgets GameCore offers.

All eight are **bundled in the app** and also attached below as sideloadable `.gcplugin` files.

### New in the host
- **Plugin settings you can change.** A plugin can offer its own options — switches, choices and numbers — and GameCore stores and applies them. The controls live in GameCore; the plugin still runs nothing.
- **Automation history, shown by a plugin.** A plugin you allow can display the record of automations GameCore has run. It reads that history only to show it — it is handed none of your other data.
- **Live readouts on plugin screens.** Plugin screens and dashboard widgets can show figures GameCore already measures — frame rate, temperature and the like — each drawn by GameCore from data you have allowed.

### Install
Download **`GameCore.apk`** below. The eight plugins ship inside it; the attached `.gcplugin` files are there if you'd rather install one from a file (Settings → Access and tools → **Plugins**). Everything from earlier releases works unchanged.
