- Звук, сказанный в секунды между пробуждением и открытием сессии, больше не теряется.
- Запись, начатая в момент, когда движок как раз засыпает или ещё поднимается (например, после открытия настроек), идёт по пути пробуждения, а не отказывает с «Движок ещё запускается». «Распознать заново» в истории тоже будит спящий движок.
- Скачивание модели впрок больше не считается простоем: движок не уснёт посреди закачки.
- Оборванный ответ движка не оставляет «висящий» запрос, из-за которого сон мог не наступить вовсе.

Already have Bloo? Just open it and pull to refresh - it offers to download and install this build for you.

### Install - watch (optional)
Pair your watch to the phone first. Bloo then pushes the watch update to it for you: on the watch, open Bloo and tap **Update now**.
Or sideload `Bloo-watch.apk` manually the same way as the phone (see above).

### Or get it from Google Play (closed test)
Bloo is in closed testing there. Two steps, both with the Google account you use on your phone:

1. Join the testing group: https://groups.google.com/g/bloo-testing -- this is what puts you on the tester list.
2. Then install from Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.bloo.bluelink -- it resolves once you are in the group, and Play keeps the app up to date from there.

The opt-in only works for accounts in the group. Testing tracks skip review, so new builds arrive the day they are built.

### Play or APK?
The same features either way, but they are NOT interchangeable: the package name is the same and the signing key is not, because Play re-signs every upload with Google's app-signing key. A Play copy and an APK copy cannot update each other, so moving between them costs one uninstall -- and an uninstall takes the app's data with it. What differs is how each updates and how the watch gets its app:

release.notes:
# OFD Go Toolkit v0.1.6

本版本新增流式文档创作、数据模板、OFD 国密加解密，以及 CSV/TSV、EML 邮件和 SVG 导入；完善阅读器文档权限、报告输出，并修复字体、裁剪和转换取消等问题。

## 新增功能

### 流式创作与数据模板

- 新增 `pkg/creator/flow`，支持自动断行分页、六级标题、列表、图片、两端对齐、多栏和分节排版。
- 支持合并表格、按内容自动分配列宽、跨页重复表头、长单元格续排、页底脚注、图表编号、大纲、目录和内部引用。
- 提供 Material、Material 2/3、Fluent 2、Carbon、Bootstrap 5 印刷主题，以及 GB/T 9704—2012 常规公文基础版式。
- 新增数据模板填充：文字与图片绑定、明细重复、自动分页、首页/续页/末页版式及精确金额汇总。
- 补充中文综合报告、公文、表格和模板示例。

### 更多格式导入

- **CSV / TSV → OFD**：首行默认作为表头，自动列宽和分页，续页重复表头；保留编号前导零、小数位、空字段及引号内换行。支持 UTF-8、GB18030、GBK，以及标题、字体、纸张和横向设置。
- **EML → OFD / PDF**：解析邮件头、MIME 正文、字符编码和 CID 图片；OFD 输出保留原始附件，可通过阅读器下载，支持同名和零字节附件。直接输出 PDF 时包含邮件画面和附件清单。
- **SVG → OFD / PDF**：将自包含 SVG 等比放入所选纸张，保留受支持的矢量图形与文字。
- EML 和 SVG 转换需要本机 Chrome/Chromium，已接入命令行、Go API 和 HTTP 服务。
- PDF 导入新增累计解码预算调整，字节参数支持 `MiB`、`GiB` 等单位后缀。

### 国密加解密、签名与完整性保护

- 新增 `ofd-crypt` 与 `pkg/crypt`，支持 GM/T 0099—2020 口令/证书加解密、多接收者、独立条目密钥、多层加密及只读解密视图。
- 支持整包、条目和页面范围加密，以及追加加密层。
- 新增普通 SM2/SM3 数字签名、多签追加、物理包签名，以及 `pkg/integrity` 完整性检查。
- 桌面与 WASM 阅读器支持解锁加密文档，WASM 支持密码保护的 SM2 私钥；加密 OFD 缩略图显示挂锁。
- 完善加密范围、跨层依赖和完整性验证的错误处理。

### 阅读器与报告

- WASM 阅读器开始执行打印、复制和导出权限，统一菜单、快捷键和 API 检查，支持加密文档和版本切换。
- 文档信息面板分为基本信息、安全信息和字体页签，展示原文件加密状态及各文档体权限。
- 渲染和搜索支持异步取消，搜索结果报告扫描量及截断状态；改进资源读取失败的错误反馈。
- 改进拖放打开、异尺寸页面适应缩放和 URI 动作确认；桌面阅读器可选择页面渲染 DPI。
- 校验器与分析器新增 OFD 报告，OFD/PDF 报告统一排版，长问题列表按表格跨页显示。
- OFD-H 校验更新至 GB/T 48666—2026 正式版，文档对比报告支持语言选择。

## 修复与改进

- 保留得意黑等原生斜体字体的字形倾斜，避免反向剪切或重复倾斜。
- 修复 PDF 合成粗体随字号变化而偏细的问题，保持矢量输出及可复制文字层。
- 修复 `KaiTi_GB2312` 等字体被旧 Macintosh 字符映射遮蔽、英文误判缺字的问题；完善系统字体名称匹配、候选重试与失败诊断。
- 修复裁剪、图元合成和隐藏图片导出问题；矢量后端保留图片原生裁剪，降低裁剪掩码开销。
- 修复损坏页面转换时静默成功、PDF 写入错误和 TIFF 输出生命周期问题。
- 改进 Office/XPS 外部进程取消及子进程清理，增加 Windows 回归验证。
- 新增 Linux amd64/arm64 阅读器和缩略图工具 DEB/RPM 打包，完善 Fyne Web 部署、浏览器缓存更新和发布工作流。
- 更新依赖及第三方许可证信息。

release.name: DNS Orchestrator v1.10.1
release.notes:
# v1.10.1 发行说明

## 概述

v1.10.1 是一次以重构优化和安全修复为核心的版本。本版本修复 9 个依赖安全漏洞（含 6 个 High）；对前端组件进行大规模重构，引入配置驱动的 DNS 记录表单、路由懒加载和构建分 chunk 优化；拆分 domainStore 为 slice 架构提升可维护性；同时升级 Rust 核心依赖（reqwest 0.13、rmcp 1.2、sea-orm 2.0.0-rc.37 等），修复批量删除后记录未重新加载的问题，并优化 CI/CD 发布流程顺序。

## 安全修复

### 🔒 依赖安全漏洞修复

本版本通过依赖升级修复 9 个安全漏洞：

**High 级别（6 个）**：

| 漏洞 | 依赖 | 修复版本 |
|------|------|----------|
| PKCS7_verify Certificate Chain Validation Bypass | aws-lc-sys | 0.37.1 → 0.39.0 |
| Timing Side-Channel in AES-CCM Tag Verification | aws-lc-sys | 0.37.1 → 0.39.0 |
| PKCS7_verify Signature Validation Bypass | aws-lc-sys | 0.37.1 → 0.39.0 |
| X.509 Name Constraints Bypass via Wildcard/Unicode CN | aws-lc-sys | 0.37.1 → 0.39.0 |
| CRL Distribution Point Scope Check Logic Error | aws-lc-sys | 0.37.1 → 0.39.0 |
| Unauthenticated Remote DoS via QUIC Transport Parameter Parsing | quinn-proto | 0.11.13 → 0.11.14 |

**Moderate 级别（3 个）**：

| 漏洞 | 依赖 | 修复版本 |
|------|------|----------|
| `unpack_in` can chmod arbitrary directories by following symlinks | tar | 0.4.44 → 0.4.45 |
| Incorrectly ignores PAX size headers if header size is nonzero | tar | 0.4.44 → 0.4.45 |
| Certificate revocation enforcement bug | rustls-webpki | 0.103.9 → 0.103.10 |

## Bug 修复

### 🐛 批量删除后记录未重新加载

修复批量删除 DNS 记录后，如果本地记录已清空但服务器仍有数据时未自动重新加载的问题：
- 批量删除完成后检测本地剩余记录数
- 当本地为空但总数大于 0 时，自动重新获取记录列表

## 重构与优化

### 📋 DNS 记录表单配置驱动化

将 DNS 记录表单从 switch-case 硬编码重构为配置驱动模式：

- 新增 `record-type-configs.ts` 配置文件，声明每种记录类型的字段、默认值和主值键
- 表单组件代码从 600+ 行精简至约 300 行
- 新增记录类型只需添加配置项，无需修改渲染逻辑

### 📂 前端组件目录结构重组

按职责细分组件目录，提升代码组织性：

- `account/` → `accounts/`（含 `form/`、`io/` 子目录）
- `domain/` → `domains/`（含 `batch/`、`metadata/` 子目录）
- DNS 记录表格抽取 `DeleteDialogs`、`DnsPagination`、`useInfiniteScroll` 独立模块
- `DomainBatchActionBar` 从 330 行重构为 94 行，标签操作抽取为 `TagOperationDialog`

### 🧩 domainStore Slice 拆分

将臃肿的 `domainStore` 拆分为职责单一的 slice 模块：

- `domainBatchSlice.ts` — 批量选择与批量标签操作
- `domainFilterSlice.ts` — 标签

release.notes:
A tree view, a player that answers the music, and a Home screen that folds. The large new parts of this release are marked **BETA** in Settings — they work, they are not finished, and the label is on the setting rather than only here.

### Tree view — BETA

- **A folder used to replace the screen to show you what was in it.** Turn Tree view on in the view menu and it opens underneath itself instead, with guide lines down to its contents. The path bar still means what it meant and tapping a name still goes in.
- **The folder you are working in is drawn with a glowing outline**, and it is real: New folder, New file and Paste act on it rather than on whatever the path bar says. The dialog names it — *New folder in thumb*.
- **The tree used to run out of room.** The step in and the left margin now shrink when the pane is narrow or the branch is deep, with the lines staying joined the whole way down.

### The player — BETA

- **Pulse on the beat was reading loudness, which misses a snare under a sustained pad and fires on the pad swelling.** It measures the spectrum now and looks for energy arriving across many bins at once, which is what a drum is.
- **The glow only ever brightened on a beat, which is half a pulse** — between beats it sat exactly where it sits with the pulse off. It now falls below its resting level in the gaps and rises above it on the hit.
- **A ring of light circled the disc on a fixed clock**, which reads as a spinner once you notice the rate never changes. It is a wave now, driven by the track: flat at rest if you want it, deepening with how hard each beat lands.
- **Glow strength and Beat intensity are two settings.** They were one, so turning it up with the pulse off did nothing at all.
- **Sound follows the disc.** Turning Aurora's record plays the track at the speed of your hand, backwards too. A turn is 1.8 seconds of track, which is a 33rpm record, so an ordinary drag plays at normal speed — Disc travel moves that and says what it will sound

## [1.0.6] — 2026-10-19

### Added

- **Use system wallpaper.** A new Wallpaper setting lets Android draw the
  system wallpaper behind the launcher, so live wallpapers and wallpaper apps
  show on the home screen. The launcher's own wallpaper and slideshow pause
  while it is on, and picking a wallpaper or slideshow folder turns it off.
  The glass panels are tinted but not blurred in this mode.
- **Favorites background.** A new Appearance setting turns off the glass
  plate behind the favorites row, on the home screen and in the app drawer.
  It is on by default and is included in backups.

### Changed

- **Backups include custom icons.** Back up settings now saves a .zip file
  with the settings and every custom app and input icon, and restoring it
  brings the icons back. Older .txt backups still restore.

### Fixed

- **UP from the home row lands on Settings.** Pressing UP from an app on the
  home row now selects the Settings (gear) pill instead of the Wi-Fi pill.

Install instructions are in the [README](https://git.namillis.me/namillis/GlassLauncherTV#install).

release.notes:
## What's New in Fley 1.1.0

### New Features & Enhancements
- **Project Rebranding to Fley**: Complete brand evolution and design system refinement under the new application identity and package ID (`com.fley`).
- **Native Audio Trimmer & Ringtone Cutter**: Frame-accurate Kotlin audio slicing engine supporting MP3, AAC/M4A, and WAV formats. Save audio clips directly to storage or set them as phone ringtones.
- **Modern Artists & Albums View**: Grid and List layout switcher with persistent view preferences, accompanied by top highlights carousel.
- **Redesigned Track Context Menu**: Expanded viewport height (72%) with an edge fade gradient and subtle down-indicator hint for discoverability without a persistent scrollbar.
- **Responsive Lyrics Offset Controls**: Two-row layout in lyrics editor with dedicated ±0.1s and ±0.5s buttons, eliminating text and button clipping on narrow viewports.

### Performance & Reliability
- **Rock-Solid Offline Audio Core**: Streamlined audio playback engine for pure offline playback, eliminating network timeouts and unexpected pauses.
- **Smooth 60/120fps Scrolling**: Optimized heavy tabs using virtualized `CustomScrollView` delegates (`SliverGrid` and `SliverList`).

release.notes:
This update adds a trash, a password generator, breach checks, password merging and card autofill in Chrome.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Update Ravenpass on every device that opens your vault. Once an item is in the trash, or you change how long the trash keeps items, Ravenpass 0.2.0 and earlier can't open the vault.

## What's new

- **Trash.** Deleting an item moves it to the trash, and the notice offers Undo. Restore items, delete them for good or empty the trash in **Vault settings → Trash**. The trash keeps an item for 30 days; choose 7, 90 or 365 days there instead.
- **Password generator.** Open the generator from the rail, or from the toolbar on a phone, or generate a password while you edit one. By default it makes five capitalized words with a digit. Choose 3 to 10 words instead, or 8 to 64 characters with the digits and symbols you set, and leave out look-alike characters such as `I`, `l` and `1`.
- **Generator history.** The passwords you copy or use from the generator stay in a history on this device for 30 days. Change the period or turn the history off in **Settings → Privacy**.
- **Breach checks.** Turn on **Check for breached passwords** in **Settings → Privacy** and Ravenpass marks the passwords found in known breaches, lists them first and warns you on the item and in the editor. It sends Have I Been Pwned the first 5 characters of each password's SHA-1 hash, never the password. Breach checks are off until you turn them on.
- **Merge passwords.** **Merge with another password** in a password's header combines two passwords into one. You choose what to keep where they differ, passkeys move over, and the other password goes to the trash.
- **Card autofill in Chrome.** Card number, holder, expiry and security code fields open a menu of your cards. One choice fills the whole checkout, billing address included, and never the card's PIN. Every card fill asks for Touch ID or your PIN first, whether or not fill confirmation is on. Cards fill on `https` pages only.

release.name: v0.5.1-beta — Image Tools, File Discovery & FFmpeg Fix
release.notes:
## What's New

### Image Compose Tool
New native `image_compose` tool with 8 operations:
- **concat_horizontal** / **concat_vertical** — combine images side by side or stacked
- **overlay** — place one image on top of another at (x, y)
- **resize** — resize to specific dimensions
- **adjust** — brightness, contrast, saturation, hue, gamma, exposure
- **crop** — crop to region
- **grayscale** / **blur** — image filters

Uses the Dart `image` package for fast, native processing. The agent is now guided to use this tool instead of FFmpeg or PIL for all image-to-image work.

### List Files Tool
New `list_files` tool lets the agent discover files on the device:
- **output** — app output directory
- **screenshots** — device screenshots
- **camera** — camera photos
- **downloads** — downloaded files

### FFmpeg Image Fix
FFmpeg operations (`crop`, `resize`, `filter`) now detect image extensions and use appropriate codecs (mjpeg/png) instead of forcing H.264 video encoding. No more corrupted image output.

### Bulletproof File Path Resolution
When a tool receives a file path that doesn't exist, the executor now:
1. Searches common Android directories (Screenshots, DCIM, Downloads, etc.) by basename
2. Copies external files to internal storage for reliable access
3. Resolves both single paths and array paths (`input_paths`)

### Agent Improvements
- File existence validation: if an output file doesn't exist where the agent said it would, the tool result is marked as failed so the agent retries
- System prompt updated to guide the agent toward `image_compose` and away from PIL/FFmpeg for image work

## Install
Download `app-release.apk` and install on your Android device (API 24+).

release.name: CSQTT 2.1.17 — установка APK в приложении и резервные зеркала
release.notes:
## CSQTT 2.1.17

### Android: установка обновлений из приложения

Кнопка **«Обновить»** скачивает APK внутри приложения, показывает прогресс и позволяет отменить загрузку. Проверяются SHA256, package ID, версия и подпись APK; после этого автоматически открывается системный установщик Android. Если нужно, сначала откроется системное разрешение на установку из CSQTT. Подтверждение установки остаётся стандартным действием Android; браузер и ручной поиск APK больше не нужны.

GitHub — основной источник, GitLab и Forgejo — резервные. При обрыве загрузки зеркало должно подтвердить ту же версию и SHA256. При поиске обновлений исключены черновики, prerelease, отдельные OpenWrt-выпуски и неполные релизы.

### Первый переход на новый package ID

Новый ID: **`io.github.danusha2345.csqtt`**. Приложение устанавливается рядом с оригиналом amurcanov и прежним пакетом `csqtt.quic.amurcanov`. Старые данные не удаляются, но настройки, выбор приложений и разрешение VPN в новой установке потребуется задать заново. Автоматической миграции между package ID нет.

Версии до 2.1.17 не содержат нового updater и по-прежнему открывают страницу релиза. Новый APK нужно один раз установить вручную; последующие обновления будут скачиваться из приложения.

### Остальные файлы

- Подписанные APK: universal, arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a, x86_64. Для обычной установки подходит `CSQTT-2.1.17-universal.apk`.
- Серверы Linux: amd64, arm64, armv7. Протокол не изменён, обновление совместимого сервера необязательно.
- OpenWrt 2.1.17-1: nftables/fw4 и iptables, повторный запуск без накопления правил и откат ошибок. Для OpenWrt 25.12+ выбирайте `.tar.gz`; legacy `.ipk` — для 24.10 с opkg. MIPS в выпуск не входит.
- Приложен desktop 2.1.19 для Windows/Linux. Windows updater также получил резервные источники; bundled core остаётся 2.1.15.

### Проверки

184 Android unit-теста, release lint, 264 теста Rust-клиента (4 ignored), 118 тестов сервера, cross-build/clippy, 15 OpenWrt firewall-тестов и 4 release-safety теста.

- **iPhone.** Kant for iOS 15 and later, as `Kant-0.6.0.ipa` for sideloading (with AltStore, SideStore or Sideloadly), since it isn't on the App Store yet. Unlock with Face ID or Touch ID, open and save files through the share sheet, and get notifications while Kant is open or for about 30 seconds after you leave it. Notifications while Kant is closed need Apple push, which needs an Apple developer account. With a free Apple ID, sideloaded apps have to be refreshed every 7 days.
- **Host a relay without port forwarding.** Run a relay from any computer at home, even behind a router you can't configure or a mobile connection, through Tailscale, Tailscale Funnel, Cloudflare Tunnel or ngrok. One command sets it up, checks it from the outside and prints the address to share: `scripts/relay-tunnel.sh funnel`. See `RELAY_TUNNELS.md`.
- **Easier relay deployment on a server.** `scripts/deploy-relay.sh` asks what it needs (HTTPS with a domain, or HTTP on a local network), checks that the domain points at the server, gets the certificate, and makes the keys for desktop notifications itself. No Firebase, no push proxy and no key tools are needed to run a relay.

## Fixed

- **Desktop notifications from self-hosted relays.** Relays only accepted Web Push keys in an unusual format, so keys made with the standard tool (the one the instructions pointed to) silently didn't work. Both formats work now, and a relay with bad keys says so when it start

release.name: VaultPony 1.1.0
release.notes:
Argon2id support, requested in #1.

VeraCrypt 1.26.29 added Argon2id as a key derivation for volume headers. VaultPony now opens those volumes, can create new ones with Argon2id, and can move an existing volume's header to Argon2id (or back) when you change its password. It uses VeraCrypt's exact parameters (416 MiB and 6 passes at the default PIM), and volumes made either way open in both apps.

Unlocking
- A Key derivation choice on the unlock screen: Auto tries every KDF like VeraCrypt does, or pick PBKDF2 or Argon2id to skip the other one's cost. On an Argon2id vault this cuts unlock time to a few seconds.
- A Cancel button while unlocking. System back also cancels instead of leaving the screen.
- A free-memory check before any unlock that may run Argon2id, with a choice to try anyway or skip Argon2id, instead of the system killing the app.
- Biometric unlock remembers which KDF a vault uses. Enrollments from earlier versions keep working.

Passwords
- Every password field has a show/hide button.
- A PIM below the default now needs a password of at least 20 characters when you create a vault or set a new password, the same rule VeraCrypt applies (below 485 for PBKDF2, below 12 for Argon2id). Opening existing vaults is not affected.

Also
- The unlock screen has a Back button.
- New strings in all six languages.

The APK is reproducible and signed with the same key as earlier releases. Verify it with the attached .asc.

release.name: codex-for-tui-v2.5.29
release.notes:
# Codex for TUI 2.5.29

2.5.29 是第三方 Responses API 自动压缩挂死的 P0 前滚热修。

## 修复内容

Codex `0.144.1` 会把名称为 `OpenAI` 的 provider 判定为支持官方远程压缩协议。Codex for TUI 为保持 Responses API 兼容性，也会把第三方中转站显示名写为 `OpenAI`，但同时设置 `requires_openai_auth=false`。

旧能力判断只检查 provider 名称，导致第三方服务达到自动压缩阈值时误发官方专用的远程压缩请求。服务不支持该协议时会返回 `invalid_responses_request`，当前会话随后无法继续。

新版在 ARM64 musl 二进制的源码准备阶段加入 fail-closed 安全补丁：

- 只有内置且要求 OpenAI 身份验证的官方 provider 使用 OpenAI 远程压缩。
- Azure Responses provider 保持原有远程压缩路径。
- 名称为 `OpenAI`、但 `requires_openai_auth=false` 的第三方 Responses provider 改用本地压缩。
- 普通 Responses 请求、模型选择、上下文长度和 2.5.28 的 80% 自动压缩阈值保持不变。

## 已受损旧会话

本热修会在发送压缩请求前改走本地路径，防止新的线程进入同一故障链，但不会自动重建已经写入远程 compaction replacement history 的旧会话。

- 覆盖安装前不要删除或改写旧 rollout。
- 升级后的原始 P0 复测应使用新会话。
- 需要挽救的旧会话先备份 rollout，再单独做 pre-compact 历史恢复；不要把“新版能继续新会话”误报成“旧会话已自动恢复”。

## 构建门禁

- 源码补丁使用精确锚点、幂等应用；上游结构变化时直接失败，不静默生成不安全二进制。
- fixture 测试验证第三方 `OpenAI` 名称 provider 不再声明远程压缩能力。
- 源码完整性门禁验证安全条件和回归测试已进入待编译源码。
- GitHub Actions `29588836456` 在 ARM64 musl 构建后运行完整
  `codex-model-provider-info` 测试：24 passed / 0 failed / 0 filtered，并显式核对第三方负向、官方 OpenAI 与 Azure 正向三条结果。

## 升级

直接覆盖安装 2.5.29 APK 并重新打开 App：

- 不要卸载旧 App。
- 不要清除 App 数据。
- 不需要手动运行 `codex 更新` 或 `codex-local refresh-models`。
- 普通启动仍不会自动更新脚本、刷新第三方模型目录或覆盖用户手写配置。

## 版本元数据

- `versionName=2.5.29`
- `versionCode=95`
- runtime epoch：`apk-2.5.29`
- Codex binary：`0.144.1-zh.2`，包含 remote compaction safety patch
- 包名：`com.gzy3894.codexfortui`

## 回滚

Android 已安装 `versionCode=95` 后不能普通覆盖降级。若真机回归发现产品问题，应发布更高 versionCode 的前滚热修，不要求用户卸载或清除数据。

| APK Variant | Architecture | Recommended For |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `arm64-v8a` | 64-bit ARM | Most modern Android phones & tablets |
| `armeabi-v7a` | 32-bit ARM | Older Android devices |
| `x86_64` | 64-bit x86 | x86_64 Android devices & emulators |
| `x86` | 32-bit x86 | Older x86 devices & emulators |

release.notes:
# BidiLens Android 0.1.2

Native Kotlin, Android Views, and Jetpack Compose libraries for mixed RTL/LTR
text are signed and public on Maven Central. This release preserves logical
source order and keeps paragraph direction independent from physical alignment.

## Install

Add `google()` and `mavenCentral()` to your Gradle repositories. Choose the
adapter your app uses; its core dependency is included transitively:

```kotlin
dependencies {
    implementation("io.github.codeinscrubs.bidilens:bidilens-android-compose:0.1.2")
    // For Android Views instead:
    // implementation("io.github.codeinscrubs.bidilens:bidilens-android-views:0.1.2")
    // For analysis without a UI adapter:
    // implementation("io.github.codeinscrubs.bidilens:bidilens-core:0.1.2")
}
```

Core and Views support API 21+; Compose supports API 23+.
See the [versioned Android guide](https://github.com/CodeinScrubs/BidiLens/blob/android-v0.1.2/android/README.md)
for integration APIs and the [current guide](https://github.com/CodeinScrubs/BidiLens/blob/main/android/README.md)
for the post-publication status. The version-tagged guide was prepared before
publication and therefore retains its historical release-candidate wording.

## What changed

- Generated Unicode 17 combining-mark boundaries keep marked graphemes inside
  their neighboring opposite-direction isolate, matching the other BidiLens cores.
- Views adopt observable host direction, alignment, and gravity changes while
  managed instead of later restoring stale application properties.
- An explicit ownership handoff covers deliberate same-value application writes.
- `alignToContent = false` preserves authored physical alignment while BidiLens
  still applies the paragraph's direction. Pure LTR in an LTR host remains an
  unmodified-text, no-intervention path.
- The release gate rejects version drift between modules, sample, consumer,
  publishing workflow, and source documentation.

- При включённом VPN внутренние имена сети работают: имена без точки и адреса в доменах самой сети находятся через её DNS. Внутренние адреса, как и раньше, идут мимо VPN.

repo.description: Android SOCKS5 TUN tunnel client — routes the device's entire traffic through a remote SOCKS5 server. Native C (epoll) engine + JNI + Kotlin UI, TCP/UDP/DNS/QUIC support, no root required.

release.name: v1.6.7
release.notes:
- Fix: a DNS query carried over TCP (remote DNS enabled, with the query itself sent through the tunnel) was never released. The connection record and its buffer stayed allocated, and the session counter only ever went up. After 512 of them the client would refuse every new TCP connection — DNS and ping still worked, everything else was dead, and restarting the tunnel brought it back. The session now releases itself as soon as the answer has been written back, and a regression test asserts the session count returns to its pre-connection level (it fails without the fix)
- Fix: when a protected socket could not be set up, the socket that had already been created was left open. A connect timeout to the SOCKS5 server was the common case, and repeated failures leaked one file descriptor each. The socket is now closed on every failure path

<details><summary>繁體中文</summary>

- 修正：走 TCP 的 DNS 查詢（開啟遠端 DNS、查詢本身也穿過隧道）其連線紀錄永遠不會釋放。紀錄與緩衝區一直佔著，連線計數只增不減。累計 512 次之後，用戶端會拒絕所有新的 TCP 連線 —— DNS 與 ping 都還正常，其他全掛，重啟隧道才會恢復。現在答案寫回後連線即自我釋放，並加上迴歸測試斷言連線數會回到連線前的水位（沒有這個修正時該測試會失敗）
- 修正：建立受保護的 socket 失敗時，已經建好的那個 socket 會被留在那裡。最常見的是連線 SOCKS5 伺服器逾時，反覆失敗就會一次漏掉一個檔案描述符。現在所有失敗路徑都會關閉 socket

release.name: AngelaBox v1.0.129-stable
release.notes:
• **1.0.128：**
1. **链式代理只带 TCP，UDP 明确失败不再偷跑 (Chained profiles carry TCP only — UDP now fails loudly instead of leaking):** 内核的 `detour` 只作用于 TCP 拨号，落地节点自己建的 UDP 连接不会经过链路，源地址既不是入口也不是落地。以前链式开启时这类流量会照常发出去，出口地址与界面上显示的落地节点不一致。现在链式 outbound 拒绝 UDP，连接直接失败，不会再有任何一条包从你没选的地址出去。默认的「禁用 QUIC」仍会复位 UDP 443，日常浏览无感；游戏、语音、自建 WireGuard 这类 UDP 需要关掉链式才能用。
   The kernel's `detour` only routes the TCP dial; a UDP socket created by the landing hop never passes through the chain, so its source address was neither the entry nor the landing node. With a chain bound, that traffic used to go out anyway, reporting an exit address that did not match the landing node shown in the UI. The chain outbound now refuses UDP, so the connection fails visibly and no packet can leave from an address you did not pick. QUIC (UDP 443) is still reset by the default overlay, so ordinary browsing is unaffected; UDP traffic such as games, voice calls and self-hosted WireGuard needs the chain turned off.

## v1.2.4 — Notification UX, thread safety, and memory fixes

Notification improvements, thread safety hardening, and memory optimizations.

### What's changed

- **Boot notification UX** — Tap the "start services" notification to start them instantly (invisible trampoline activity), no app screen opens. Auto-cancels on tap, lowered to IMPORTANCE_LOW
- **Service notification** — Now swipeable (IMPORTANCE_MIN, no stop button). Service keeps running in the background as intended
- **Thread safety** — ReadWriteLock protects native sherpa-onnx resources from concurrent transcribe/release. ConcurrentHashMap for FileObserver debounce jobs
- **Memory** — Replace boxed `MutableList<Short>` with `ShortArray` chunks in AudioRecorder and AudioDecoder, avoiding ~8x heap waste during recording
- **Text injection fix** — Remove aggressive fallback that could inject text into wrong field
- **Service state tracking** — AudioMonitorService uses static `isRunning` flag instead of optimistic local boolean
- **Dark/light mode** — Recording overlay adapts background and text colors to system theme
- **Lazy OkHttpClient** — Only created when model download is triggered
- **i18n** — Extract remaining hardcoded English strings to resources

For the full feature list, see the [v1.0.0 release](https://github.com/hatsch/TranSlander/releases/tag/v1.0.0).

release.notes:
## NEIX 0.5.1

Патч 0.5-й линии: премиум-слой провайдеров, шифрованные ссылки и починка пинга.

### Пинг серверов

- **Сервер с открытым портом больше не выглядит мёртвым**: если проверка URL через
  сервер не прошла, но TCP-порт отвечает — показывается задержка и честная пометка
  «порт отвечает, HTTP-проверка через него не прошла». Как у INCY, но без вранья.
  Не применяется к UDP-протоколам (Hysteria2, WireGuard) и в TUN.
- **Имена серверов резолвятся самим движком** (DoH по IP), не системным резолвером:
  в TUN наш DNS-щит блокирует DNS вне туннеля, и доменный сервер мог читаться мёртвым.
- **Причина ошибки видна**: в строке сервера — «нет ответа за 5 с», «соединение
  отклонено», «проверка не поддерживается» (7 языков); в журнале — `ping failed
  server=… reason=…`.

### Премиум провайдера (подписанный конфиг)

- **Маршрутизация от провайдера**: `domains` (`proxy-except` / `direct-except` /
  `blocklist`) компилируется в routing — поверх пресетов, ниже собственных правил
  пользователя.
- **Резервные хосты подписки** (`fallbackHosts`): когда основной домен недоступен,

- Карточки серверов больше не разъезжаются: бейджи (VLESS, REALITY, Vision, uTLS…) переносятся на следующую строку, а не ломаются по буквам столбиком.

repo.description: 基于 Rust、Slint 与 mihomo 的跨平台代理客户端，支持 Windows、macOS、Linux 和 Android。

release.name: Clash of Rust 0.6.5
release.notes:
# Clash of Rust 0.6.5

本次更新修复断网启动后代理无法随联网恢复的问题，完善 macOS 与 Tailscale 的 DNS 共存，并统一桌面与 Android 的规则拖动、订阅管理和下载恢复。支持 Windows x64 / ARM64、Debian/Ubuntu amd64 / ARM64（Ubuntu 仅支持 22.04 及以上）、macOS 14 及以上的 Intel / Apple Silicon，以及 Android 8.0 及以上的 ARM64 / ARMv7 / x86_64。

## 更新内容

### 网络恢复与系统代理

- 修复 Windows 在无网络时启动、联网后代理目标仍持续 `unreach` 的问题；桌面后台在默认路由恢复或变化稳定后刷新内核出站与 DNS，并清理旧连接。Windows、Linux、macOS 的 GUI 与 `cor` 共用恢复机制，保留当前节点、运行模式、TUN、Claude 保护与订阅配置。
- 修复系统代理已经开启、窗口却显示关闭的状态不同步问题。后台按实际托管的代理字段判断状态，窗口重建与 `cor` 查询保持一致。
- macOS、Windows、GNOME 和 KDE 恢复系统代理时保留用户后来修改的绕过项；macOS 同时保留新增网络服务与非托管属性。

### Claude 保护与 DNS 检测

- macOS 开启 Claude 保护时，公网 DNS 通过本机转发器进入保护线路，保留 Tailscale 私有分域、搜索域与接口绑定，无需用户手动调整 DNS。
- 保护就绪检查等待系统原生解析器实际接管，并处理 Tailscale 重连与 DNS 配置变化；公网解析失败时不回退到 VPN 或物理网络 DNS，关闭保护后恢复仍由客户端管理的设置。
- 开启保护后先中断已有内核连接，再验证加密 DNS；失败时恢复原网络配置。桌面、Android 与 `cor` 使用相同的切换语义。
- 保护期间，代理模式、规则页与相关网络设置灰置并禁止修改，保留尚未应用的规则草稿；关闭保护后恢复操作。Android 保留保护失败快照，并将实时保护异常列为风险。
- 修正 Google 递归 DNS 地址的国家误报：匹配官方地理清单并保留原始标签与来源；修正后仍与出口国家不同的继续列为风险，不隐藏地区差异。无法确认的结果单独标注。
- 桌面与 Android 的实际递归 DNS 国家复用 IP 检测国旗素材；港澳台保留文字，不显示旗帜。调整检测卡片布局，避免保护框顶部被遮挡。

### 订阅、Geo 与客户端更新

- 新增远程订阅定时更新，默认间隔 360 分钟，可在设置或 `cor config` 调整，设为 0 时关闭；Claude 保护期间跳过当前受保护订阅。
- 订阅更新失败时保留原订阅、规则和运行状态。Android 可确认删除正在使用的订阅并自动切换到默认直连；添加与编辑期间显示保存状态，避免重复点击产生同名错误。
- Geo、订阅与客户端更新下载增加慢速及断流检测，优先尝试内核代理，再按条件回退直连；不自动切换用户节点，支持取消并清理未完成下载。
- Geo 更新校验整组新文件后再安装，失败恢复旧数据；修复旧文件损坏、缺失或与旧清单不符时阻塞更新的问题，并在冷启动时恢复未完成事务。
- 关闭“包含预发布版本”时始终跟随最新正式版，即使本地版本号更高；开启后才比较正式版与预发布版。Android 安装预发布版前以红字提醒：无法保证保留数据地返回正式版。

### 规则与移动界面

- 桌面与 Android 规则页统一支持拖动排序，浮起规则跟随鼠标或手指，靠近列表上下边缘连续滚动；保留原位占位和目标反馈，取消、筛选或布局变化时安全结束手势。
- 规则详情显示完整原文、来源和策略，支持编辑、启停、删除、跨页移动及恢复订阅顺序。Android 补齐规则表单与重复规则、数量和位置校验，失败时保留草稿。
- 修复 Android 连接、规则、日志页多条数据重叠成一条的问题；压缩分页与保存操作区域，调整长文本、横屏 Pad 和键盘展开时的布局，让列表与搜索结果保持可见。
- 规则页顶部操作随列表滚动，搜索框在条数、布局或键盘高度变化时保留输入焦点；设置独立于工具入口，Pad 的工具导航与手机保持一致。
- Fake-IP 排除项同时显示自定义与 DNS 覆盖来源，支持还原已移除的内置项；Android 将其放在 Fake-IP 开关下方，并补齐 IP 检测筛选、详情、单项重测与更新操作。
- 桌面进入代理页时，将实际使用的策略组置顶并展开；手动收起后，后台刷新不会反复打开。

### CLI、用户隔离与发布验证

- Linux 普通用户各自保留订阅和后

release.name: cmux Pocket v0.3.1
release.notes:
**First-launch onboarding, and a one-command upgrade**

A fresh install now explains what to run on the Mac before it asks for a QR code, and the CLI can upgrade itself. No protocol change: this build speaks the same protocol as 0.3.0.

### Added

- `cmux-pocket upgrade` upgrades the CLI and Gateway without the user having to remember the package manager: it reads the latest GitHub Release tag from the `releases/latest` redirect, compares it with the running build, identifies the install source (Homebrew `Cellar`/`opt`/`bin`, `CARGO_HOME/bin`, or a `brew list --versions` hit), and delegates to `brew upgrade shiquda/cmux-pocket/cmux-pocket` or `cargo install --force --git … --tag <release> cmux-pocket-cli`. The registered LaunchAgent is restarted afterwards through the existing service restart path, the printed report names the old and new build, and it points at **Settings → Connection → Recheck version** in the app. An unrecognized install is never overwritten: both manual commands are printed and the command exits non-zero. `--check` reports without changing anything and `--json` follows the existing envelope.
- `cmux-pocket status` reports the Gateway build (`gateway_version`) alongside the protocol version, so a client can tell which Gateways are actually running the upgraded binary.
- First-launch onboarding: a fresh install opens a two-step guide that shows the `brew install shiquda/cmux-pocket/cmux-pocket` and `cmux-pocket setup` commands, then the `cmux-pocket qr` command that renders the pairing code, each with one-tap copy, before handing off to the existing **Settings → Connection → Scan QR** import. Pairing or **Skip for now** records the choice in encrypted preferences; an install that already has a saved profile or a hand-configured endpoint is never intercepted. **Settings → Connection → Setup guide** reopens the same screen at any time.

### Fixed

- **Settings → Storage → Export host profiles** no longer loses its buttons on short or landscape windo

release.name: Shield AirPlay 2.0.1 — Reliable TV pause and resume
release.notes:
## Shield AirPlay 2.0.1

Fixes a missing sender-notification path for TV-remote pause and resume.

### Changes
- Send actual loading, playing, paused, and stopped playback states over the negotiated AirPlay reverse connection, with the matching session ID.
- Deliver state changes even when the sender stops polling. Suppress duplicate notifications and scope them to the current playback generation.
- Keep event writes on the native HTTP thread and nonblocking, so they do not block Android's UI thread or race playlist traffic.
- Correct reverse-response handling and bound its debug output.
- Preserve the TV interface and explicit-stop policy. No fake playing state and no blanket suppression of sender stops.

### Verification
- Signed ARM64/ARMv7 release build completed successfully.
- APK signature, signing-certificate continuity, alignment, package/version, and packaged native libraries verified.
- Installed on NVIDIA Shield as an in-place update. Device version and APK checksum matched this asset.
- Long-pause/resume behaviour was manually confirmed working on the Shield after installation.
- Automated tests and lint were not rerun for this patch. Manual acceptance is not a claim of full mirroring/audio or all-sender regression coverage.

### Download
- `Shield-AirPlay-2.0.1-shield.apk`: signed release APK; package `no.gior.shieldairplay`, version code 201.
- `Shield-AirPlay-2.0.1-shield-source.tar.gz`: corresponding source, including pinned native dependencies and `SOURCE_REVISIONS.json`.
- `SHA256SUMS`: checksums for both files.

**This is the same APK that was manually accepted on the Shield; it was not rebuilt during publication.**

Source commit: `b6e2caf1749817b954dc083c2c69954c560da46c`. For the documented Git-based build, clone tag `v2.0.1-shield` with `--recurse-submodules` and follow `SHIELD_BUILD.md`.

release.notes:
**IPTVMac for Android 1.0.4: the first version for Android TV, Google TV and Fire TV.** Phones and tablets: install it over 1.0.3 (same signing key, your data stays) and pick `arm64-v8a` unless you know you need another file. **TVs and TV boxes: use `IPTVMac-Android-1.0.4-tv-32bit.apk` (38 MB) or `IPTVMac-Android-1.0.4-tv-64bit.apk` (41 MB).** Not sure which? Try the 32-bit file first: it runs on almost every TV and box, including most Fire TV sticks and Chromecasts with Google TV. If the TV says the app is not compatible, use the 64-bit file (newer 64-bit-only devices need it). Check the file against `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Android 8 or later.

### Install on a TV
Fire TV and Android TV: install the **Downloader** app, open it and type `https://github.com/Goelir/IPTVMac/releases/download/android-v1.0.4/IPTVMac-Android-1.0.4-tv-32bit.apk` (or `...-tv-64bit.apk`), then allow installing from Downloader when the TV asks. Or copy the file to a USB stick and open it with a file manager. There is no store listing yet. Updates are manual: install the new file over the old one.

### What's new
- **Works with a TV remote.** Arrows move, OK selects, Back goes up one level, and **holding Back closes the app**. A clear focus ring shows where you are, and everything is reachable without touch.
- **In the player:** Left/Right seek, Up/Down change the channel (Up = next), OK pauses and shows the controls, Menu/Info opens the details, and the media keys work.
- **On a TV there are no downloads**, no backup files and no update banner.
- **Welcome screen:** it now says to use only sources you are authorized to access.

This is the first TV version, so please report problems at https://github.com/Goelir/IPTVMac/issues (never post provider links, usernames or passwords).

release.name: NetValve v1.0.0 - Initial Release
release.notes:
# NetValve v1.0.0 — Release Notes

**Release date:** July 24, 2026
**Tag:** `v1.0.0`
**APK size:** ~60 MB (loopback) / ~67 MB (netstack)

---

## 🎉 NetValve v1.0.0 — First Public Release

NetValve is a **root-free, local-VPN per-app traffic controller for Android**. This is the first public release — a complete, working application with all core features functional.

---

## ✨ Features

### Traffic Shaping
- ✅ **Per-app bandwidth limits** — set download/upload caps per app (KB/s, MB/s, kbps, Mbps)
- ✅ **Token-bucket pacing** — smooth, accurate rate limiting with burst tolerance
- ✅ **Suspend-to-pace, not drop** — TCP backpressure + bounded UDP queue; protects VoIP, gaming, streaming
- ✅ **DNS exemption** — name resolution never throttled (latency protection)
- ✅ **Live, no-busy-wait** — efficient coroutine-based design

### App Control
- ✅ **App blocking** — cut all network access per app
- ✅ **Time-based schedules** — e.g., block after midnight
- ✅ **Day-of-week schedules** — different rules for weekdays vs weekends
- ✅ **Foreground/Background rules** — different caps based on app state
- ✅ **Condition-based policies** — Wi-Fi/mobile/roaming/charging/battery/screen/foreground

### Monitoring
- ✅ **Live throughput** — current, average, peak (per app)
- ✅ **Connection counts** — active, throttled, blocked
- ✅ **DNS stats** — query counts and cache state
- ✅ **Connect latency** — measured per protected socket
- ✅ **Per-app totals** — persistent across restarts
- ✅ **Leveled logging** — DEBUG/INFO/WARNING/ERROR with filtering and export

### Platform
- ✅ **Root-free** — works on stock Android, no Magisk/KernelSU
- ✅ **Local-only** — no remote server, no telemetry, no trackers
- ✅ **Material 3 UI** — Jetpack Compose, dark/light themes
- ✅ **Battery-aware** — Doze exemption guidance, OEM-specific deep links
- ✅ **Boot persistence** — re-arm tunnel after reboot (opt-in)
- ✅ **VPN coexistence** — graceful `onRevoke` handling

release.name: v2.13: On-demand mode, a redesigned screen and a much smaller app
release.notes:
Video Boost no longer needs the accessibility service running all day, the app has been rebuilt around a much simpler main screen, and the download is seven times smaller.

## On demand: the service is off until you open the Camera

Until now the accessibility service stayed enabled permanently and filtered events in code. That is still the default (**Always on**), but there is a second mode under *How it turns on*:

**Only when the Camera opens.** The service sits disabled and switches itself on the moment Pixel Camera comes to the front, then off again when you leave, after a grace delay you can set from 0 to 60 seconds. Banks and other sensitive apps never see an active accessibility service, so there is nothing for them to trip over and nothing to turn off and back on.

It needs two special permissions, usage access and `WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS`, which the app grants itself once through wireless ADB or Shizuku during setup. If either one goes missing later, the app quietly falls back to Always on instead of leaving you with nothing.

The watcher survives reboots and app updates, and detection is layered: the camera availability callback is the instant trigger, and a slow screen-on poll is the backup if that callback never arrives.

## A main screen that shows less

The status hero now carries the master switch, and everything else lives in a settings list with a status summary on each row: mode, sensitive apps, notifications, wireless ADB, and About. Before the service is enabled, the screen shows only the setup guide, so the first run is a short list of steps rather than a wall of options.

## About, privacy and source code

A new screen spells out what the app does, what it never does, every permission and why it needs it, why it is not on the Play Store, and where the source lives.

## 38.2 MB down to 5.4 MB

release.notes:
> PriDroid ships no game files and distributes none — you bring your own copy of the DRM-free Linux build (GOG sells one). The Steam build isn't supported — it needs a Steam ownership-verification layer we haven't built yet; it's on the roadmap.

⚠️ Still a pre-release. Emulation is CPU-bound — big prisons want a flagship, small ones run on modest devices. Bug reports from the app menu are very welcome.

🆕 **What's new**

✅ **Download the game from GOG**, inside the app — sign in, check your library, and the game and its DLC download straight to the phone and into a new instance. No PC, no file juggling. Side menu → Sign in to GOG

✅ **In-app wiki** in English, Russian, Spanish and Portuguese — quick start, getting the game, DLC, mods, renderers, picture and controls, known issues. The ? on each screen opens it at the matching section.

✅ **Crashes fixed**. Phones on older kernels could not start the game at all; older copies of the game died during world loading. Both are gone — thanks to the testers who kept sending logs.

✅ **Updated main screen** - A getting-started card on the main screen, and mod/DLC installation reworked into cards with MODS / DLC tabs.

## Technical
 - Prison Architect is a non-PIE binary: it must load at its own address, 0x400000. Our own placeholder mapping sat there, and kernels before 4.17 silently ignore MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE, so the game loaded elsewhere and jumped into unmapped memory. box64 now takes the range back and refuses to start a relocated non-PIE binary rather than crashing later. Seen on Exynos 9825, kernel 4.14.
bionic's stdio passes its read callback an int, so a large fread wraps negative and reaches read() as SIZE_MAX, where FORTIFY kills the process. glibc returns a short read. box64 now clamps, as the earlier read() fix did — this is what let 2021-era copies of the game get past world loading.
 - CI fixed after Google removed the tools SDK package.

- **桌面端自动更新本版仍未启用**：仓库还没有配置更新签名密钥（`DESKTOP_UPDATE_KEY`），Release 里没有更新清单，「设置与更新」会提示到 Release 页面手动下载新版本。
- **运行时缺权限提示与一键处理**：运行接口返回手机上缺少的权限（`missing`：缺什么、为什么、去哪开）。网页 IDE、VS Code、PyCharm 运行后都会提示，并能一键处理每一种权限（无障碍、悬浮窗、通知使用权、文件访问、截图授权）；缺多项时逐项「下一项」，处理完最后一项后可「再运行一次」。三端共用 `protocol/permission-fix.json`，测试保证文案一致。Android 首页和悬浮窗运行缺权限时先打开小程序详情页提示开启，首页在无障碍未开时显示提醒（#315、#318–#336）。
- **网页 IDE 节点工具增强**：「试一下」在手机上验证选择器并重新截图；重新获取后保持选中同一个控件、「最近选过」一键找回；插入后可直接在手机上运行；id 重复时自动补充文字 / 描述 / 路径，只能靠路径定位时提醒并推荐更稳的子 / 父节点；不使用时钟等会变的文字；读不到节点时一键打开无障碍设置（#298–#313）。桌面端控件检查与流程画布的选择器同样处理 id 重复，并在代码节点里说明选择器为什么这样写（#299、#300、#305）。
- **蓝图运行历史**：显示状态文字、开始时间、耗时、步骤顺序和出错步骤的错误信息；失败行可一键试跑出错的那一步，本机试跑结果写入变量缓存供后续步骤接着试（#312、#314、#316、#317）。
- **基本检查与快速修复**：VS Code 支持 Ctrl/Cmd+. 快速修复（「是不是 …」、补 import 等，与网页 IDE 一致）；PyCharm 支持 Alt+Enter 快速修复（#282、#284、#285、#287）。
- **性能**：网页 IDE 大文件输入更快（行号栏不再每键重建、滚动同步合并到下一帧、补全弹窗定位不再强制整页排版：2 000 行时按键约 66 → 38 ms）；Android 太大的文件在手机编辑器里只读预览（2 万行约 2 秒 → 0.35 秒），并可复制网页 IDE 地址打开（`?file=`）；小程序列表在后台扫描工程（#283、#288、#290、#291、#293、#337）。
- 构建与 CI：Chaquopy pip 安装走 Gradle 构建缓存并在失败时重试；CI 新增网页 IDE 输入性能基准（软阈值，只告警）（#295、#297、#338）。
- **网页 IDE 节点工具**：工具栏新增「节点」，读取手机当前界面的控件节点（需要无障碍或 Root）和截图：在节点树里或截图上点一个控件，显示它的文字、id、类名、范围等属性并在截图上框出，按需生成「查找节点 / 查找并点击 / 等待出现 / XPath 查找 / 点击中心坐标」代码，可复制或插入到编辑器光标处（缺少的 import 自动加在文件开头）；支持筛选、折叠和「完整树」。生成规则与桌面端的控件检查相同（#289）。

### 桌面端 macOS 安装包（试用）
- 下载 `xscript-desktop-v0.6.0-macos-arm64.dmg`。仅支持 **Apple Silicon（arm64）**，Intel Mac 暂无安装包。打开后把 XScript 拖进「应用程序」。
- 安装包**未用开发者证书签名、未经 Apple 公证**（仅 ad-hoc 签名，签名完整可校验）。第一次打开时 macOS 会提示“无法验证开发者”或“Apple 无法检查其是否包含恶意软件”，放行方式：
  - **macOS 15（Sequoia）及以上**：先双击打开一次，在弹窗里点「完成」；再到「系统设置 → 隐私与安全性」，在页面下方找到 XScript，点「仍要打开」，输入密码后再点「仍要打开」。
  - **macOS 14 及以下**：在 Finder 里右键（或按住 Control 点按）XScript →「打开」→ 再点「打开」。
  - 以上只需一次；之后可正常双击打开。
- 如果提示 **“已损坏，无法打开”**：说明下载的是旧的安装包（v0.4.0 最初上传的 dmg 签名有误，已替换），请重新下载；仍不行可在终端执行 `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/XScript.app` 后再打开。
- 桌面端仍处于开发阶段，需要电脑上能用 `adb`，手机上装好 XScript App。可以用 `SHA256SUMS` 校验下载的文件。

Due to signature differences, you may encounter an installation failure. Depending on how you try to install the APK, you will see one of these errors:

**📦 Via Android Package Manager (On-device):**
> App not installed as package conflicts with an existing package

**💻 Via ADB (Command Line):**
> `INSTALL_FAILED_DUPLICATE_PERMISSION: Package ******* attempting to redeclare permission ******* already owned by *******`

This occurs because another **Meta or Instagram app** (e.g., Messenger, Instagram, Facebook Lite, Threads, Ads Manager) is already installed on your device. These apps share common permissions. Since this patched APK is signed with a custom certificate, Android blocks the installation to prevent permission conflicts with the official apps.

#### 🛠️ How to Fix
1. **Uninstall** all existing apps from **Meta Inc.** and **Instagram Inc.** from your device.
2. **Re-install** this patched APK. It will now install successfully without any conflicts.

# Fox VPN v1.0.0 An independent VPN client for Windows, macOS, Linux and Android, built on Mozilla Firefox VPN infrastructure and Fastly edge servers. - **Multiple Firefox accounts:** Choose the active account or switch automatically after confirmed data-allowance exhaustion. Accounts retain separate allowances. - **Persistent traffic statistics:** View monthly allowance, last-session transfers and cumulative traffic on this device. - **Flexible app routing:** Choose which apps use the VPN with selected-app and exclusion modes, a searchable app picker and synchronized manual identifiers. - **Connection controls:** Check real HTTPS delay, browse saved locations and view IPv4 and IPv6 addresses when available. - **Network compatibility:** Encrypted endpoint bootstrap, IPv4-first connection attempts and clearer timeout diagnostics. - **Adaptive transport:** Use HTTP/2 over TLS or HTTP/3 over QUIC. release.name: v0.24.3
release.notes:
v0.24.2 bundled six server binaries into the Claude plugin. The directory's
rules rule that out: a plugin file over 5 MiB stops validation (ours were 9 to
10 MB), a compiled executable is held for a reviewer, and a top-level `bin/`
folder stops claude.ai and Cowork from installing the plugin at all. v0.24.2's
code is unaffected; its plugin folder is what this release replaces.

**Changed: the plugin launcher downloads the server instead of carrying it.**
`.mcp.json` still runs `node ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/launcher/launch.js`, a small
readable file. On first run it fetches the one build for the machine from the
GitHub release, checks its SHA-256 against `launcher/release.json`, keeps it under
`${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}`, and re-checks it on every start. A download that does not
match the pin is discarded and never run. The binaries are removed from the tree
(they stay in v0.24.2's history).

**Added: the release publishes the builds the launcher downloads.** Each release
now carries `adb-mcp_<tag>_<os>_<arch>[.exe].gz` for the six targets and
`plugin-checksums.txt`, the SHA-256 of each uncompressed build. After the release,
`make plugin-pin TAG=<tag>` writes those into `release.json`; the pin is its own
commit. `make plugin-pin-check` compares it to the
release. Until that commit lands the launcher has no pin and says so.

**Added: the listing details the directory reads**, all in `plugin.json`: a short
`description`, `icon`, `documentationUrl`, `supportUrl` and `privacyPolicyUrl`
(new [docs/PRIVACY.md](PRIVACY.md)), and a plugin README that says what the plugin
runs, downloads and sends.

release.notes:
## Synco v1.0.1 — Connection Stability & FGS Crash Fix

This release fixes the **ForegroundServiceDidNotStartInTimeException** crash and the **"Connection rejected"** loop reported on Samsung/Android 13 devices, and hardens reconnection.

### Fixes
- **FGS crash fixed** — the foreground service is now started once for the whole connection lifecycle instead of being stopped/restarted on every transient state, eliminating the 5s Android startForegroundService timeout race.
- **Stale PIN handling** — the desktop generates a fresh PIN every launch; if the stored PIN is rejected, it is now cleared and the app prompts for the current PIN instead of retrying forever.
- **Auto-reconnect capped** — up to 5 attempts (3s apart); after that the app surfaces a clear "Enter the IP shown on the PC" message.
- **Desktop stale-connection takeover** — a new client connection now replaces an old lingering socket instead of being rejected with "Server busy" (1013) / "Rejecting secondary connection".
- **WebSocketClient connect()** — cancels a stale Connecting/Connected socket before reconnecting instead of silently no-op'ing.
- **Heartbeat timeout tuned** — 30s -> 10s (2 missed 5s heartbeats) for faster dead-connection detection.

### Tests
All 13 unit tests pass (was 5 failing). Robolectric pinned to SDK 34 for Java 17, test packets now carry valid timestamps/payloads, and TrustedDeviceManager is mocked (AndroidKeyStore isn't available under Robolectric).

## SnapCrop v6.91.0

- **Delete-original on save now actually removes the original screenshot from the gallery.** The previous path used a direct MediaStore update to move the source into a visible `Pictures/trashed/` album — but MANAGE_MEDIA does not authorize direct updates to media the app did not create, so on real (system-owned) screenshots the move silently failed and the original stayed in the gallery. Save & Replace now uses `createTrashRequest` (the request API MANAGE_MEDIA does authorize), so the original goes to the system trash (Recently deleted) — out of every gallery view, recoverable — prompt-free when Media management access is granted. Verified on-device.
- **Fixed the Custom redaction patterns settings section rendering as overlapping, unreadable text.** Its call site wrapped the panel in a `Box`, stacking the title, description, action buttons, and pattern list on top of each other; it now lays out vertically.

APKs are signed with the project's own release keystore (no code-signing certificate). Install the ABI matching your device, or the universal APK.

release.notes:
## 1.2.0 — 2026-10-22

Server, web client and app 1.2.0 (the app has no changes: the same code as 1.1.0, its version follows
the server). **Upgrading**: new image, `docker compose up -d` (the database migrates by itself); the
phones are then offered the app 1.2.0. Nothing is sent on the new service channel until you assign it.

- **Service channel "Zweep"**: alerts about Zweep itself on the phones and web clients of the operators
  and user groups you assign to it (Channels → Zweep): a backup failed or late, the HTTPS certificate
  not renewed or about to expire, a Zabbix whose API fails or whose token expires, webhooks refused, the
  web client plugin stopped or unable to reach the push services. An alert opens when the problem
  begins and closes by itself when it ends; it cannot be acknowledged. Each check can be turned off in
  **Settings → Zweep channel**. It does not replace monitoring Zweep from Zabbix (manual 7.5, 10.1).
- **Web client plugin metrics**: every minute the plugin reports to Zweep the notifications accepted by
  each push service, those that did not reach it, and the alarms held by the sending limit

release.name: Fcode v0.3.6
release.notes:
## 新增

- **Codex 端新建配置现在有模板**：一键填入「OpenAI 官方」（`api.openai.com/v1` + Responses API + `GPT-5.6-Sol`）或「通用中转」，你只需要补 API Key。此前 Codex 端要自己填地址、接口格式和模型 ID，任何一项填错只会得到一个看不出原因的失败。

## 改进

- **设置里能看清 Claude CLI 到底是哪一个**：同一个版本的应用，在不同手机上跑着的 CLI 可能完全不同 —— 官方二进制在部分 Android 上会被系统沙箱拦住（退出码 159），那时只能改用 npm 版，而 npm 上已经没有能在 Android 上直接执行的版本，只能固定在一个更老的版本上。此前设置页只回答"装没装"，两种情况长得一模一样，用户看不出自己正在用哪个。现在直接写明是「官方二进制」还是「npm 版」以及具体版本；如果这台设备上次真的被系统沙箱拦过，还会标出退出码，并说明 npm 版是当前的兼容方案。
- **计划面板现在按 markdown 渲染**：标题、列表、代码块围栏不再被原样显示成 `##`、`-` 和一串反引号。步骤标题这类单行文字仍走轻量渲染路径，长计划不会因此变卡。
- **模型的「过程说明」和最终回答区分开了**：Codex 在执行前会先说一句"我准备做什么"，此前它和最终结论用**完全相同的样式**，看不出哪一句才是结论。现在这段旁白带一条左侧竖线和「过程说明」标注。没有这个标记的旧格式消息不受影响，仍按回答渲染。
- **「更多」菜单现在真的从按钮里长出来、再收回去**：此前点开时右上角那个 ⋮ 会**整个消失**，收起时又要等一会儿才淡回来（中间有一小段两个都看不清），而且打开和收起用的是**两套不同节奏**的动画。现在 ⋮ 全程都在（只是变淡），菜单从它下面展开、顺着原路收回它里面，来回同一个节奏；**点一下 ⋮ 还能直接关掉菜单**（以前它开着的时候根本不存在，点不到）。

- **设置里的弹窗和聊天里的弹窗现在长得一样了**：此前聊天、抽屉、输入区的弹窗共用一套外观，而设置里 21 处弹窗各自用系统默认样式 —— 圆角、宽度、底色和弹出动画都不一样。现在全部改用同一套外壳，以后调弹窗样式只改一个地方。
- **回答正文的排版分出层次了**：标题、段落、代码块此前**用同一个间距**，所以长回答读起来像一堵墙。现在段落之间收紧、代码和表格四周留白、标题上方留更多，读起来能看出结构。顺带把散落的字号和间距收成一套刻度，并删掉了一段没人调用的旧渲染代码。

## 修复

- **修复部分手机上 Claude 端整个不可用（输入框一直是灰的）**：在**新一些的安卓**（实测为 Android 14）上，Claude 官方那个自带运行时的安装包会被系统安全策略拦下（退出码 159），App 会提示改用 Node.js 版本 —— 这条路本身是通的，但**改完之后聊天输入框仍然永久禁用**，状态一直停在「正在连接 Claude…」，日志里也一条错误都没有。现在无论哪种安装方式，只要进程活着就会在几秒内进入可用状态（真正坏掉的 CLI 仍会照常报错，只是不再把界面锁死）。
- **修复非命令工具执行期间界面上什么都不显示**：网页搜索、MCP 工具、查看图片、文件修改、子代理此前**只有完成时**才会出现一张卡片，执行过程中完全没有显示；卡住或失败的调用则**什么都不显示**，看起来像根本没有调用过 —— 也就是"不知道是不是调用成功了"。现在和命令一样，一开始就会出现「运行中」，完成后更新同一行。命令一直不受影响，所以问题只在非命令工具上暴露。
- **修复工具类型在两种拼法下识别不一致**：`web_search_call` 这类下划线拼法会因为实时与历史两条路径的比对方式不同，落到通用工具行并把**原始 JSON 直接显示出来**。现在两处共用同一套归一化匹配，并补上新版新增的类型（`McpToolCall` 也改为按类型直接识别，不再只靠标题里的 `mcp__` 前缀）。
- **修复抽屉里的历史对话一直转圈**：在 A 会话发一条消息、不等它结束就切到别的会话，那条会话的「运行中」状态在回合真正结束后**永远不会被清掉**，于是一直转圈（重启应用后会变成红色的「失败」标记）。根因是后端只在「完成的回合正好是你当前打开的会话」时才释放这个状态 —— 你切走之后它就不算数了，而通知事件也被同一道判断拦掉，所以界面完全不知情。现在切走之后的回合结束时也会正常释放。
- **修复「更多」菜单最后一项显示发虚**：菜单里最后一行（「导出对话」）此前**永远停在半透明**、位置也偏低一点，动画结束了也没归位。原因是交错动画的时间

release.name: BayesianBahn 0.4.0
release.notes:
### Added
- **A forecast for trains whose run number is too new to have one.** IRIS gives
  every run its own number and renumbers at each timetable change, so a train
  that has run for years can arrive with almost nothing behind it: over eleven
  collected days a quarter of arrivals fell through to a class-wide prior that
  knows neither the station nor the hour. Those trains still have a line, and
  the line has run all along. `pipeline/build_shards.py` now publishes a second
  set of shards keyed by line and station, and the app reads one when — and only
  when — the train's own history comes up short. Walk-forward over 781,000
  archive events at 62 stations, on exactly the events the prior answers today,
  the line scores 0.43 min of CRPS better (95% 0.40..0.46, resampling whole
  trains) with a shard available for 88% of them; across the December 2025
  timetable change, where the population doubles to 11% of events, the same
  0.41. Regional and S-Bahn both gain; long distance almost never carries a
  line number, so there is nothing to say about it either way. The screens say
  which line the numbers came from rather than claiming they are this train's.

### Changed
- **A reported delay is now an anchor with an admitted error, not a promise.**
  0.3.0 took DB's live delay and adjusted it by what the train's own past runs
  did; where DB reported nothing it used history alone. The adjustment was the
  weaker half. A report is now the centre of its own distribution, widened by
  the error such reports are measured to carry at that much notice — fitted on
  82,482 arrivals, and asymmetric, because a train that has lost time rarely
  makes it back. The connecting train's departure report is treated the same
  way, so a change is the difference of two admitted errors rather than one
  distribution against one promise. Scored against DB over the same thirteen
  days as 0.3.0: arrival CRPS −0.564 → −0.678 minutes, missed connections
  −0.147 → −0.225 Brier, and "

release.name: v1.0.0 — 取证水印相机（Flutter 重构首个正式版）
release.notes:
# v1.0.0 — 取证水印相机（Flutter 重构首个正式版）

## 算法

- **QIM-DCT 保色**（默认）：8×8 块 DCT 中频 QIM 量化，YCoCg 可逆变换只改亮度通道——**色彩零损失，PSNR≈55dB**，容量大
- **DWT 域**：Haar 小波 HL 子带 QIM——抗噪最强（noise≤10），速度最快
- **扩频**：PN 序列扩频 + 中心化相关检测——鲁棒性最强（noise≤15，JPEG Q70 存活）
- 三算法均内置 **Reed-Solomon 纠错（fail-closed）**：解码失败即判定无水印返回空串——"无水印"是可靠判定，不误报；长度前缀 3 份多数表决消除单点故障

## 特性

- **JPEG 转发存活**：默认算法实测存活至 Q60（覆盖聊天工具标准压缩档）——照片经转发后仍可提取验证
- **取证拍照**：快门自动采集 拍摄时间 + GPS 经纬度 + 设备唯一标识（ANDROID_ID / IDFV），嵌入不可见水印后保存到系统相册
- **验水印**：相册选图提取，结构化展示 算法/时间/坐标/设备；自动遍历全部注册算法，无需手动匹配
- iPhone 相机风格布局；嵌入/提取均在后台 isolate 执行

## 安装

附件 `app-release.apk`（Android，21MB）——直接安装。iOS 构建需 macOS + Xcode。

环境要求：Android 8+（API 26+）；定位权限用于水印经纬度（可选，拒绝时自动省略该字段）。

# HardPlay v1.2.0

This release focuses on playback reliability, media identification, and a more consistent library experience.

### Playback

* Fixed cases where a stale Telegram file ID could resolve to the wrong file.
* Added an identity check when opening media and automatically re-resolve the file when the stored reference no longer matches the expected media.
* Corrected file references are written back to the local database so affected items can recover as they are played.
* Improved recovery for Telegram files whose references have changed between sessions.
* Added handling for media that can be served as HLS playlists instead of progressive video files.
* Kept the existing retry and playback flow intact for cases that still require a retry.

### Library

* Added randomized library ordering as a default.
* Shuffle order is stable during an app session, so paginated results do not jump, repeat, or skip while scrolling.
* Search and Discover ordering remain unchanged.

### Artwork

* Improved media identity handling around playback without changing the existing poster fallback system.
* Existing poster and cache behaviour is preserved.

### Reliability

* Added regression coverage for stale and mismatched media references.
* Added tests around file identity and playback recovery.
* Clean release build verified with unit and instrumented tests.

### Release

* Version: `1.2.0`
* Version code: `10200`
* Minimum Android version: Android 8.0 (API 26)
* Target Android version: API 35

This release is distributed as a sideloaded APK. HardPlay remains a local-first client that communicates directly with Telegram and does not use a separate application server, analytics service, or advertising network.

release.name: VPN4TV Native 5.3.0
release.notes:
**Two Android leaks closed.** Other apps on the device could learn the VPN
server's address in two ways, both from the September write-ups on VPN
detection:

- the local bridges (xhttp, Outline, AmneziaWG, olcRTC, TrustTunnel) let
  anyone on loopback through; they now require a password, a new random one
  on every start;
- an app excluded from the VPN, or installed in another user or work
  profile, could bind its socket to the tunnel interface and get through;
  such connections are now refused. A self-check after connecting turns
  this off for the session if the system cannot name the owner of even our
  own connections. In "only selected apps" mode the check stays off, since
  there it would cut the system DNS.

**A key refresh applies right away.** Updating a key from the home screen,
the Profiles screen, at launch or in the background reloads the running
connection when anything changed, no reconnect needed. The background
update works again.

Also: the refresh button no longer gets squeezed out on phones; an address
an app kept from FakeDNS after it was turned off no longer fails with
"network is unreachable"; a reload no longer leaves the old tunnel
interface behind.

release.name: Tejar 1.6.0 — Telegram 13.0.3 и подписки любых сервисов
release.notes:
Большое обновление: Tejar переехал на свежий Telegram 13.0.3, научился работать с подписками других VPN-сервисов и стал аккуратнее с батареей.

## Главное

**Telegram 13.0.3.** Всё новое из последних версий Telegram теперь есть и в Tejar.

**Подписки не только от нас.** Можно вставить подписку почти любого VPN-сервиса: обычные ссылки (vless, vmess, trojan, shadowsocks, hysteria2) и списки в base64, а также форматы sing-box, Clash / Clash Meta, xray и SIP008. Для серверов, которые работают только через xray (например, XHTTP), в приложение добавлено второе ядро — оно включается само, когда нужно.

**Подписка обновляется сама.** Раз в 6 часов приложение проверяет подписку, и если список серверов изменился, переподключается к новому — ничего нажимать не нужно.

## VPN и батарея

- **Переключатель «Energy Saving» убран.** Теперь всё проще: пока Tejar открыт — VPN работает. Когда приложение свёрнуто, VPN работает в фоне, только если в Telegram включено «Фоновое соединение» (Настройки → Уведомления и звуки). Если оно выключено, VPN в фоне останавливается и не тратит батарею.
- **VPN больше не включается сам в фоне,** например когда телефон будит приложение ради уведомления.
- **Звонки идут через VPN.** Если VPN включён, звонки Telegram тоже идут через него. Telegram может показать предупреждение, что звонок через прокси немного хуже по качеству, — это нормально.

## Что ещё

- **Окно добавления подписки** теперь выглядит как остальной Telegram и читается и в светлой, и в тёмной теме (раньше текст мог быть белым на белом).
- **Уведомления стали приходить надёжнее** — исправлена доставка пушей.

## Что нужно знать при обновлении

- **Нужен Android 6.0 или новее.** Этого требует новый Telegram; на Android 5 версия не установится.
- **Переписка, аккаунт, подписки и настройки сохраняются.** Ничего вводить заново не нужно.
- **Хотите, чтобы VPN работал в свёрнутом приложении?** Включите «Фоновое соединение» в настройках уведомлений Telegram.

Muse on Android hardware, with a native control dashboard and programmable device capabilities.

- Native Home, Display, Media, Scenes and Device controls, with phone bottom navigation and TV D-pad navigation. Drafts survive tab changes, and command results have readable summaries.
- Local message cards and images; native audio/video, queues and subtitles; Android text-to-speech and explicit playback status.

- SDK-token reporting deduplication to avoid unnecessary credential rotation on each service restart. The upstream Muse SDK remains unmodified.

```sh
adb install -r muse-gadget-0.3.0-universal-debug.apk
```

Use the modern filename if your device needs that variant. Open the app and start the service after updating. Local controls work before Muse pairing; try **Start service → Try a card → Show card**.

### ✨ Smart Playlist Synchronization
* **Intelligent Track Deduplication:** Overhauled the playlist update logic. The app now extracts core titles and YouTube video IDs to perfectly fingerprint tracks, preventing duplicate downloads when syncing playlists.
* **Instant Re-Linking (No-Data Sync):** When updating a playlist with missing tracks, the app checks if the physical file is still in your Library. If found, it instantly snaps it back into the playlist without wasting internet bandwidth. It only downloads genuinely new songs.
* **New UI Dialogs:** Added full support for `"Update Playlist?"` and `"Already in Library"` dialogs in the Library screen, allowing users to safely merge missing tracks without creating duplicate playlist containers.

### 📶 Network Resilience & Auto-Resume
* **Zero-Drop Disconnect Handling:** Network drops (like `Errno 7` or `SocketTimeoutException`) will no longer skip or drop tracks. Failed tracks are instantly re-injected at the front of the queue.
* **Auto-Resume Manager:** Integrated a native `ConnectivityManager`. If you hit a dead zone or enter Airplane Mode, the queue gracefully pauses. The exact second your Wi-Fi or cellular data connects, the download queue automatically resumes in the background.

### 🗑️ True Storage Management
* **Physical Disk Purging:** Deleting a track from your library now guarantees the physical `.mp3` / `.mp4` file is permanently erased from your device's `DownloadedMusic` folder, preventing hidden storage bloat.
* **Safe Playlist Removal:** Removing a song from a specific playlist safely unlinks it without deleting the master file from your Library.

### 🐛 Bug Fixes & Stability
* Fixed an issue where expected network drops were logging as fatal exceptions and polluting Firebase Crashlytics. They now log quietly as stan

release.notes:
**The gap between keys no longer presses anything.** A touch that lands between two key faces types nothing. This applies at the usual gap too, so it changes every keyboard on upgrade. To get the old behaviour back, where a key answered anywhere in its cell, set **Gap between keys** to 0% on the Portrait and Landscape settings pages. The two sizes added in 0.2.2 have new units:

- **Gap between keys** is a percentage (0–40%) of the width of one key cell, a key one column wide. It is the whole space between two keys.
- **Action bar height** is a percentage (2–25%) of the screen's height, the same unit as the keyboard height. The bar is still part of the keyboard's height, so a keyboard at 30% with a bar at 8% leaves the keys 22%. The bar never takes more than half the keyboard.

- If command output cannot be anchored or saved, Gateway suppresses its normal publication, fences and stops that runtime generation, and records affected in-flight prompts as unknown when receipts can be saved. Late completion cannot overwrite the persistence failure, and Stop remains available.

**首页**

- 版式重排：日期 + 问候语 + 座右铭，右上角换成设置入口，记录入口固定在底栏正中；页面上缘多一层很淡的蓝色背光，玻璃卡片压在上面才有"浮着"的感觉

- 最近解锁从卡片改成三行：封面 + 名称 + 稀有度 + 完成日期；收尾一张很矮的卡片写「从 X 开始记录 · 已记录 N 天」
- 默认显示四段（人生进度 / 快捷入口 / 核心数据 / 分类进度）；从旧版本升上来的用户，快捷入口会自动补进布局里（只补这一次）

release.name: TraeWeb v3.15.0 · 等 OAuth 回调 + 版本号修正
release.notes:
## 先说清楚：上一版我没修对

你反馈「还是一样」，我查了设备日志，**确认我的修复没生效**：

```
[login] 登录页返回: session=61字符 token=996字符 refreshToken=空
```

`refreshToken=空` —— 而 refreshToken 正是这次修复的核心。**没拿到它，多账号问题就还是原样。**

## 两个原因

### ① 版本号一直显示 3.8.0（误导了你我）

`versionName` 从 v3.8.0 之后**再没被改过**。我每次的替换脚本都在找 `"3.8.1"`、`"3.9.0"` 这些不存在的字符串，匹配失败就**静默跳过**，只有 `versionCode` 被正常改到。

所以你以为装的是 3.8.0、以为新功能没上 —— 实际上 v3.14.0 是装上了、跑了的。已修正，并写了带校验的替换脚本（替换数不等于 1 就直接报错）。

### ② 你在 OAuth 回调触发前就点了「完成」

日志时间线：

```
13:10:09  打开登录页
13:10:32  返回（23 秒后）
```

登录页只要看到 session cookie 就启用「完成」按钮，**你立刻点了** —— 而 OAuth 回调（refreshToken 的唯一来源）通常稍后才触发。**提前结束 = 必然拿不到 refreshToken。**

**修复**：拿到 session 后**锁定按钮 12 秒**，显示倒计时，等回调；回调一到就立刻解锁。

## 这次加了排查日志

因为我**没法在本地跑 OAuth 重定向**，所以这版是**带探针的**，不是已验证的。下次登录后日志会多出：

```
[login] 回调 URL=...
[login] 最终页面=...
[login] 页面存储键(17): Cloud-IDE-Token,SLARDAR,...
```

这三行能直接回答：**回调到底有没有触发**。

## 请你这样测

1. 装新版
2. 点「重新登录」
3. **登录后别急着点「完成」**，等倒计时走完（或看到「已拿到长期凭证」）
4. 把日志里那三行发我

两种结果：
- `回调 URL=` 有内容 → 修复生效，多账号问题解决
- `回调 URL=（未触发）` → 说明 trae.cn 不往这个地址回调，我改用浏览器登录那条通路（日志证明它**能**拿到 refreshToken）

## 说明

我把「宽限期」当成原因是**推断，不是确证**。12 秒这个值是估的。真正的判据是那三行日志。

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/9agj/TraeWeb-Android/compare/v3.14.0...v3.15.0

release.name: v0.5.0
release.notes:
Keep your work when the connection drops, and reach it faster on both platforms.

## Added

- **Resumable SFTP transfers on Android and Windows.** Uploads and downloads show progress, pause, resume and cancel in Files → File transfers. A broken connection retains the acknowledged prefix; reconnect the session, then press Resume. Transfers continue while navigating within the app. The queue lives for this app launch; restarting the app starts a new queue.
- **Safer file replacement.** Downloads use an isolated partial file and replace the destination only after completion. Uploads stage separately, check for changes to the source and destination, and retain the original during replacement. A lost final rename reply is reconciled on resume instead of blindly uploading again.

# Doritrack v0.5.2

Stable release of the v0.5.2 alpha series: faster recovery after a dropout,
less network traffic during play, optional same-lane tap spacing, and safer
USB route handling. Install the Windows and Android apps from this same
release: both sides changed.

## Faster recovery after a dropout

- **The PC tells the phone right away** when the controller stops or its link
  fails, with an authenticated end-of-session message. The phone used to wait
  up to 64 ms (finger down) or 2 seconds (idle) to notice on its own.

  the PC says it is ready, instead of waiting one more round trip. The PC still
  applies everything in order after the clean session boundary.
- **Reconnects go straight to the PC** the phone was just connected to, then
  broadcast as before. Retries start after 4 ms instead of 100 ms.
- **No key-store unlock per reconnect.** The phone unlocks its pairing key once
  per Start, not twice on every reconnect.

## Less network traffic during play

- The PC no longer acknowledges the phone's immediate backup copy of each touch
  sample. Real repairs of lost packets are still acknowledged.
- While waiting for the phone, the PC repeats its ready message less often.
- The phone's network socket is locked to the paired PC.
- The phone marks its traffic for the Wi-Fi voice queue (DSCP EF). On Linux the
  PC marks its replies too; Windows needs an administrator QoS policy for that.

release.name: Beta v4.8.2
release.notes:
# 🚀 Rustify 4.8.2

Fixes a release-only bug introduced in 4.7.0 that broke Gemini Nano, lyrics translation and
language detection. Install it over any previous version; everything you have is kept.

> App `4.8.1b → 4.8.2b` · Rust core `4.8.1 → 4.8.2` · 310 tests in the core, 110 in the app.

**Which APK:**
- `arm64-v8a`: almost every phone.
- `armeabi-v7a`: older 32-bit phones.
- `x86_64`: emulators and Chromebooks.

The `baselineProfiles` zip is optional: it makes the first start faster when you install with
`adb install-multiple`, as the README explains.

---

## 🐛 Fix: on-device AI worked in debug but not in release builds

R8 (the release optimizer) removed constructors that ML Kit loads by reflection, so every ML Kit
feature — Gemini Nano for the DJ and the chat, lyrics translation and language detection — failed
silently in the release build. The app reported "this phone has no on-device AI (AICore)" on a phone
that has it, and translation icons stayed grey. Debug builds were not affected because they skip R8.

**What was wrong:** `ComponentRegistrar` classes (the entry points ML Kit discovers from the
manifest) had their no-argument constructors stripped. ML Kit's `ComponentDiscovery` instantiates
them by reflection; with no constructor, it threw and every downstream feature read as unavailable.

**The fix:**
- A ProGuard rule keeps every `ComponentRegistrar` constructor: `-keep class * implements
  com.google.firebase.components.ComponentRegistrar { public <init>(); }`.
- The AICore status check now logs its failure instead of swallowing it as "unsupported", which is
  what hid the problem in 4.8.1.
- Synchronized version bump: app `4.8.2b` and Rust core `4.8.2`.

**Affected versions:** every release build from 4.7.0 (when ML Kit was first added) through 4.8.1.
Debug builds were never affected.

release.name: v1.8.2
release.notes:
## Fixed: importing video recipes (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube)

Importing a recipe from a video link could fail with **"Import failed — 524"**, even though the recipe often showed up on your Mealie server a minute later anyway.

Mealie builds a recipe from a video by downloading the audio, transcribing it with AI, and turning the transcript into a recipe, which can take a couple of minutes. The app used to wait for a single reply at the very end. If your server sits behind a reverse proxy such as Cloudflare, the proxy gives up after about 100 seconds and returns a 524, while Mealie keeps working in the background.

The app now uses the same streaming import that Mealie's own web interface uses, so the connection stays open for as long as the import takes.

## Import progress

While a recipe imports from a link, the Add Recipe screen now shows what Mealie is doing, such as *Downloading video…* or *Transcribing audio with AI…*, in your chosen language.

Servers older than Mealie v3.13.0 don't support streaming imports; on those, the app automatically uses the previous method.

## Install

Sideload the APK below, or get it from [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.voriseklabs.mealiego).

**Note:** if you installed from Google Play, this APK won't install over it, because the two are signed with different keys. Either uninstall first (this clears your saved server and login) or wait for the Play Store update.

## ⚠️ Before you upgrade

- **Re-add printers you added by name.** Each device now advertises its own printer name, e.g. `InkPrint [3F2A]` (the code is shown on the Printer tab). Printers added by IP address keep working.
- Upgrading from v0.2 installs over it — same signing key, settings are kept.

## What's new

**"InkPrint EPUB" printer**
A second printer that turns what you print into a reflowable e-book instead of a PDF. Conversion runs on the device in the background — layout analysis plus OCR for scanned pages, including traditional Chinese — and the progress stays visible on every tab. Add it with the `ipp/epub` queue (`lpadmin -p InkPrint-EPUB -E -v ipp://<IP>:6310/ipp/epub -m everywhere` on macOS); the in-app guide shows each method.

**Searchable scans**
A new option for the PDF printer: scanned PDFs get an invisible OCR text layer, so you can search and select text on the reader.

**Black-and-white e-ink interface**
A redesigned high-contrast UI made for e-ink screens, in English, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese.

**Finding the printer on busy networks**
Several devices running InkPrint on one Wi-Fi used to hide each other, because they all advertised the same name, host name and UUID. Each device now gets its own, and the printer is also announced and reachable over IPv6. Some office/guest Wi-Fi blocks multicast between devices; there, add the printer by IP (`ipp://<IP>:6310/ipp/print`).

- Google Play compliance: R8-optimized code, and JNA's native library rebuilt with a current NDK for 16 KB page devices

**Update in place.** Install over your current version. Same signing key, so your data stays. (Uninstalling first would erase it. The app has no cloud copy.)

**Payments are recorded more accurately**
- A payment is recorded only from the paying app's own "Pay ₹" screen. Receipts, chats, notifications and autopay setups are no longer booked as spends.
- Standard SBI UPI debit alerts are now read. Loan payments are no longer mistaken for income, and scheduled or declined notices are no longer counted.
- Only real bank senders are trusted, so a fake "bank" text from a phone number is ignored.
- A bank alert that arrives late joins the payment it belongs to instead of adding a second one.

**You'll know when capture stops**
- If the Accessibility switch goes off (or stops working), you get a notification at once and every 5 hours, and every widget shows "Capture paused" until it's back.
- If you use a notification-batching app, allow UPI ET in it, or the reminder may arrive late.

**Fixing mistakes**
- Removing a payment asks once and offers Undo.
- Settings → Data → Removed payments lists everything you've removed. Payments your bank confirmed are marked, and each can be put back.
- Review asks "Did this go through?" when you opened a payment and then started another one seconds later.

**Also**
- New widget: this week and this month as a percentage of your budgets.
- Safer backups: a backup never replaces a bigger one with a smaller one, and Settings shows when the last one ran.
- Setup follows Android's real unlock order and survives rotating the phone. On Android 14 and newer it now asks Android which services are actually running before trusting the settings (#1).

**Known limits**
- Loan EMIs taken by bank mandate (NACH/ECS) are not recorded. They aren't UPI payments.
- Force-stopping the app or a phone "cleaner" can switch capture off; the reminder then appears the next time the app runs.

release.name: HarpyAndroid v0.14.0-beta
release.notes:
# HarpyAndroid v0.14.0-beta

## What's New

### iOS Void Attack Toolkit
- **DHCP Self-Implosion (Primary Void)**: Forges unicast DHCPACK packets with the router set to the client's own IP address and a /32 subnet mask. The iOS kernel deletes its default gateway and installs a host route pointing to itself outbound traffic collapses. Captures XID from real DHCP requests to race and beat the legitimate server's response.
- **ICMP Redirect Forge (Secondary Void)**: Sends forged ICMP Type 5 redirect packets to iOS devices, advertising the client's own IP as the gateway for the entire IPv4 space (0.0.0.0/1 + 128.0.0.0/1). iOS inserts dynamic host routes that void all external destinations.
- **DNS Nullification (Tertiary Void)**: Sends unicast DHCPACK with DNS Server (Option 6) set to 0.0.0.0. Network stays up but no hostnames resolve browsers spin indefinitely, iMessage fails, App Store breaks.
- **TCP RST Asymmetry (Failsafe)**: Sniffs every TCP SYN from the target and immediately responds with a forged TCP RST spoofing the destination server. Every connection attempt is killed at the handshake level. Pure Layer 4  works when DHCP is locked or protected by MDM profiles.

### Auto-Detection for iOS Attacks
- **Gateway Auto-Fill**: Router IP and MAC are automatically detected from scanned network devices and pre-filled into the iOS attack target configuration.
- **Target MAC Auto-Fill**: When a target IP is entered that matches a scanned device, the MAC address is automatically populated.

## Improvements

- **iOS Attack UI**: Dedicated screen under Settings with individual deploy/stop controls for each of the 4 void vectors, status indicators, and target configuration fields.
- **Shared ViewModel Wiring**: iOS attack screen now shares the same `NetworkMonitorViewModel` as the bottom navigation screens, ensuring scanned device data is always available.

## Technical Changes

- Added 3 new C++ native modules: `ios_dhcp_void` (XID sniff + unicast DHCPA

release.name: 1.3.0 Release
release.notes:
![1.3.0 Banner](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/29983481/148210305-13185582-d7ce-4bec-9440-d224db321c24.png)

Hello, this is @aguilaair!

This release is another big one with changes that make CovCheck the go-to app for any time you need to check EU Digital Certificates, so let's just start with the new headline features

# New PDA Mode
![PDA Mode Banner](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/29983481/148210364-a4776e16-4c46-421f-8c4e-0ac34e62a528.png)

You read that right, CovCheck now supports Honeywell PDAs directly, with other PDAs also supported as keyboard inputs. This means that CovCheck is now faster than ever and more suited to high traffic environments where the scan rate is very high. This mode will be automatically activated if a Honeywell PDA is detected, and can be activated through the new settings screen if necessary for the rest. 

I have tried it with Munbyn iPda-035 and @pedropastor has tried it with a Honeywell EDA50 and the results are great. These features also mean that desktop support is now possible (only on PDA mode) in case you need to use a Windows, Linux, or macOS device.

# New Settings Screen
![Settings Banner](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/29983481/148210595-3a6bfd76-eeae-4618-9b40-8768fdd41995.png)
With all these new features we needed a place to configure everything, so today CovCheck introduces the Settings page, where you can change the language, theme (dark or light), and PDA mode in addition to viewing the supported status and updating certificates.

This settings screen gives you more control than ever over CovCheck, while still being intuitive.


# Update Certificates via the internet
![Certificates Banner](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/29983481/148210604-3acc4a0e-1d5e-43f3-8add-147179635d7c.png)
Last but not least, you can now fetch the latest certificates from the internet directly, instead of having to wait for a new application release.
