release.name: Transcription 1.03: AssemblyAI 3.6 Live and faster Cleanup controls
release.notes:
# Transcription 1.03

- **AssemblyAI Universal-3.6 Pro Live** is available in the keyboard model browser. It uses the v3 streaming API with `speech_model=universal-3-6-pro`, mono 16 kHz PCM, supports 32 languages, and displays the published $0.45/hour rate. Existing model choices are preserved; this is a streaming model, so it is excluded from the app's batch picker.
- **Choose the Cleanup host.** Open Settings → Cleanup → model browser and tap the small arrow at the right of a model row. Pick an OpenRouter host or endpoint variant. The choice is remembered per model, survives restart and portable backup, and applies to both automatic Cleanup and Spoken Edit. A fixed host cannot fall back to another host. Automatic routing continues to prefer latency. The list loads on demand and shows reported P50 latency/throughput when available, with an explicit unavailable label when OpenRouter returns no statistics.
- **Tap the center microphone to skip automatic Cleanup.** Once transcription finishes and Cleanup begins, the keyboard and app let you keep the raw transcript immediately. Cleanup streams in the background; skipping closes that request and ignores any late answer. The audio and note remain available. Supported hosts stop processing/billing when the stream is cancelled; provider support determines whether remote work actually stops.
- **Reasoning follows the API catalog.** Models requiring reasoning automatically use their lowest reported effort when the saved choice is Off/Auto or unsupported. The picker only lists catalog-reported levels. Optional reasoning can be disabled explicitly; Auto preserves the model default instead of sending `none` accidentally.
- **Cleanup failures are visible.** The raw transcript survives failed requests, with the model/error shown in the app, keyboard and saved note. A removed model is requested by its selected ID instead of silently being replaced by another model. Successful diagnostic logs say whether the returned text changed.

release.name: v0.4.2 — cookie injection working end-to-end
release.notes:
Fix for the Looper crash in `browser_set_cookie` / `browser_clear_cookies`.

Android's `CookieManager.setCookie` and `removeAllCookies` must be called from a thread with a running Looper. The v0.4.1 implementation ran them directly from Ktor coroutines (no Looper), which threw `removeAllCookies must be called on a thread with a running Looper.`

Moved the calls into `BrowserManager.setCookie` / `clearCookies`, which post to the main handler and bridge the result back via `CompletableDeferred`. Tool handlers now delegate to these suspend functions.

**Verified end-to-end:** injected LinkedIn session cookies (li_at, JSESSIONID, bscookie, bcookie) into the WebView's jar, navigated the authenticated feed, clicked through four "Show more feed updates" buttons, and scraped 43 posts directly via `browser_eval` — no screenshots, no OCR, no interactive login.

repo.description: Android/iOS app implemented in Flutter for esp32-photoframe

release.name: v1.6.0
release.notes:
## Added
- Works with frames that put a password on their HTTP API (firmware #130): the app sends it with every request, uploads and thumbnails included, asks for it when a frame demands one, and keeps one password per saved frame.
- Settings → Advanced Network → "Password protection": turn protection on, change or remove the frame's password from the app, or store a password that was set elsewhere. Shown only on firmware that has the setting.
- A frame that starts refusing the saved password is reported as needing a password rather than as offline, and a frame in its wrong-password lockout is reported as locked out, with the wait, rather than as offline.

## Changed
- Password changes are applied in a safe order (sent with the current password, switched only once the frame accepts it, then verified) and refusals are explained, including the frame's lockout and how long to wait.
- Saved frames, including their passwords, are excluded from Android backups and device transfers.
- Connecting sends one request at a time until the frame answers, so a wrong saved password costs one attempt instead of a lockout.
- Discovery pings carry no credential and count a frame that answers 401 as online.

## Fixed
- The five-minute background settings refresh never updated the device configuration; it does now.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/aitjcize/esp32-photoframe-app/compare/v1.5.0...v1.6.0

Lemonade Controller v1.2.2 enhances visibility into the model lifecycle and provides more intelligent progress estimation. This update introduces dedicated tracking for automatic model loading and a new quadratic regression model for more accurate time-to-completion estimates during prompt processing.

## 🧠 Enhanced Model Lifecycle Tracking

Gain better insight into what your server is doing during the setup phase:

- **Model auto-loading support** — The inference activity panel now detects and tracks when a model is being automatically loaded, adding a dedicated "Loading" stage to the activity rail.
- **Smart stage transitions** — The activity status now intelligently adapts, showing relevant stages like "Loading", "Prompt", "Generating", and "Done" based on the current task state.

## 📈 Intelligent Progress & ETA

Experience more reliable time estimations during heavy workloads:

- **Quadratic ETA estimation** — Replaced simple linear estimation with a quadratic regression model that uses multiple timing samples. This provides much more accurate "time remaining" estimates by accounting for changing processing speeds.
- **Refined progress UI** — Both detailed and compact progress views have been updated to display model loading status and improved time-remaining indicators.

## 🛠️ Improvements & Fixes

- **Android build fix** — Resolved an issue with the Android build process by adjusting Kotlin incremental compilation settings.

***

**Summary of changes:**
- **New Feature:** Added `InferencePhase.modelLoading` and logic to track auto-loading logs.
- **New Feature:** Implemented quadratic regression for `promptEtaAt` calculation using `promptTimingSamples`.
- **UI Update:** Updated `inference_activity_panel.dart` to handle new loading stages and display better ETA.
- **Fix:** Updated `android/gradle.properties` to stabilize Android builds.
- **Test:** Added comprehensive new tests for auto-loading lifecycle and ETA accuracy.

# NeoAlarm v1.0.4

`v1.0.4` is the location-alarm and reliability-hardening release.

The headline feature is location alarms: NeoAlarm can now trigger when the device enters a configured destination radius, which is aimed at transit use cases like waking up before a bus or train stop. This release also includes a large cleanup pass across the native alarm engine, location-alarm internals, release artifacts, and mission UX.

## Highlights

- Added location alarms with destination search, draggable map pin setup, radius presets, native geofence registration, and normal NeoAlarm ringing/mission handoff after arrival.
- Added location-alarm health states so missing location permissions, disabled location services, unarmed geofences, Play Services issues, and already-inside-radius cases surface visibly instead of failing silently.
- Added a hybrid location trigger model: inner geofence for arrival, outer geofence for approach assistance, and passive fused-location checks near the destination to reduce missed or delayed transitions without running constant GPS polling.
- Added location-alarm repair guidance on the dashboard when an enabled location alarm needs attention.
- Replaced the earlier map/search experiment with a cleaner provider boundary using MapLibre rendering, OpenFreeMap Liberty map style, Photon search, and optional OpenCage reverse geocoding for dropped pins.
- Tightened the release pipeline so GitHub releases publish universal APKs, ABI split APKs, app bundles, checksums, build metadata, and detailed checked-in release notes.

Location alarms are now a first-class alarm type alongside time alarms.

The setup flow supports:

- searching for a destination
- selecting a search result and closing the result list cleanly
- dropping or adjusting a map pin
- jumping the map to the device's current location
- choosing an explicit trigger radius
- warning when the device is already inside the selected radius
- saving the alarm into the same da

- 优化三种歌词样式的滚动、高亮、译文层次与屏幕字号适配，以及切歌背景、导航和刷新过渡。
- 修复搜索结果滑动后回到推荐、刷新提示不消失、新建歌单报错、背景闪现、按钮重复拖拽与圆角点击反馈等问题。

- **Media sleep timer** — "pause in 15/30/60 min" for falling asleep to a movie
- **Instant reconnect** — the moment phone and PC share a network again, they reconnect (discovery beacon now broadcasts every second)
- **Natural scroll** — two-finger scroll now matches laptop touchpad direction
- **Now Playing card** — see what's playing on the PC (title, artist, progress bar) with seek and next/prev
- **Voice dictation** — hold the mic button in screen view, talk, it types into whatever's focused on the PC
- **In-app file preview** — open images and text files from the PC without downloading them first; downloads now land in `Download/Sudo` on your phone

### Removed
- Dim-display toggle (Windows panel power-off put the host laptop to sleep; removed rather than ship a half-working privacy mode)
- PIN unlock (recent Windows 11 builds block all synthetic lock-screen input)

### Setup
1. Install `sudo.apk` on your Android phone
2. Download `Sudo-Service.exe` on your PC and run it once (it auto-starts with Windows from then on; use `Sudo-Agent.exe` instead if you prefer a window)
3. Open the app — your PC appears on the home screen. Tap it, approve the prompt on the PC, done.

Full guide: https://github.com/loueylahwel/sudo#readme

# Shiori 1.4.2

Shiori 1.4.2 新增了 **本机阅读统计**，可以回顾每天的阅读时长、近期阅读趋势以及每本书的阅读记录。

本次更新还增强了 **EPUB 原书排版兼容性**，改善行内强调线、上标注释及中英文混排的显示效果。同时调整了移动端首页导航，优化 Windows 和 macOS 的启动体验，并为 iOS 用户提供 AltStore 订阅源。

## 全新阅读统计

现在可以通过首页的「统计」页面回顾自己的阅读记录。

- **阅读时长**：查看今天及累计阅读时间。
- **阅读趋势**：按最近 7 天、30 天或 12 个月查看阅读情况。
- **分书统计**：了解每本书的阅读时长。
- **交互图表**：点击或拖动查看对应日期的记录。
- **记录管理**：随时暂停新增统计或清空已有数据。

### 尊重隐私的阅读记录

所有阅读统计都保存在本机，不需要账号，也不会上传至云端。

Shiori 仅在阅读器处于有效的前台阅读状态时计时：

- 切换到后台、离开阅读器或打开阻断阅读的面板时暂停。
- 长时间没有阅读操作时自动停止计时。
- 阅读时长与阅读进度分别管理，关闭统计不会影响正常阅读及进度保存。

删除书籍时，会移除其对应的分书统计关联，但已累计的历史总时长仍然保留。用户可以在统计管理中单独清空这些记录。

目前部分使用特殊 WebView 排版的 EPUB 页面暂不计入阅读时长。

## EPUB 阅读兼容性增强

本次重点改善了部分轻小说 EPUB 中容易丢失的行内排版样式。

### 行内强调线

新增对 EPUB 中常见实线、点线和虚线强调的支持。

- 保留作者在正文中指定的行内强调范围。
- 改善强调文字跨行、跨页时的显示。
- 修复中英文混排时，不同字体导致强调线高低错位的问题。
- 相邻且样式相同的强调文字现在可以连续绘制点线或虚线。

例如推理小说中用于提示重要线索的文字强调，现在可以更接近原书的表现。

强调线仍采用适合原生阅读器的绘制方式，不保证与 EPUB CSS 边框逐像素一致。

### 上标注释

支持 EPUB 中明确声明的短文字上标，包括部分注释标号。

- 保留较小字号与上标位置。
- 支持随阅读字号调整。
- 保持正文换行、分页及链接点击功能。

对于没有明确脚注语义标记的旧式注释，继续通过普通书内链接跳转访问，不会强行识别为弹出脚注。

## 阅读性能优化

减少部分不必要的数据查询和文字绘制开销。

- 统计页面不可见、被其他页面覆盖或应用进入后台时，不再持续刷新统计数据。
- 重新打开统计页面时，按需获取最新记录。
- 合并短时间内重复触发的统计查询。
- 优化 EPUB 强调线的绘制计算，避免没有强调装饰的文字执行额外几何查询。
- 改善连续强调文字的绘制处理，减少重复计算。

上述优化不改变原有阅读进度保存和时长记录策略。

## 移动端界面改进

重新整理 Android 和 iOS 的首页导航。

- 书架、阅读统计和设置使用更加清晰的导航入口。
- 设置页面按功能分组，方便查找本地文件、缓存与应用管理功能。
- 切换首页页面时尽量保留书架原有布局与滚动位置。
- 优化底部导航的间距、选中状态及部分界面文案。

### Windows

- 启动 Shiori 时，如果应用已经运行，会优先激活现有窗口，避免重复启动多个实例。
- 记住窗口的大小、位置和最大化状态。
- 改善多显示器、DPI 变化及显示器断开后的窗口位置恢复。
- 优化快速关闭、重新打开应用时的稳定性。

### macOS

- 启动期间显示与应用主题协调的原生启动画面，直到 Flutter 首帧完成。
- 改善启动画面的移除时机，避免遮挡已加载的界面。
- 记住窗口位置和大小，并在显示器环境变化时尽量恢复到可见区域。

## iOS AltStore 订阅源

现在提供适用于 **AltStore Classic** 的 Shiori 订阅源。

- 正式版源：提供稳定版本。
- Beta 源：同时提供正式版与测试版。

[查看 AltStore 安装和订阅说明](https://github.com/Memory1031/shiori-reader/blob/develop/docs/altstore.md)

release.name: v1.0.0.Beta.5
release.notes:
# 司器 SIQI · Beta5

**1.0.0-beta.5 · build 4400 · Android 10–17 · arm64-v8a**

中文在前 / English below

## 中文 · 把每天用得到的事情做好

这次不拿菜单数量充门面：上翻时别抢滚动条，复制时别漏代码，朗读完能把声音带走。保留 logo 和现有推理运行时，重点打磨对话、语音、MCP 与设置体验。

### 对话更顺手

- 历史默认打开到末尾；上翻暂停跟随，点击向下箭头恢复。
- 回答支持引用追问；「+ → 生成库」可选择当前工作区文件继续提问。
- 整篇与逐代码块复制，走系统剪贴板并显示结果；时间戳可查看年月日和秒。
- 流式展示约每 80ms 合并更新，历史、顶栏、输入框不再逐 token 重建。后台/隐藏页停用动效，外观滑块松手保存；这是实现改进，不是未经量测的续航或帧率保证。

### 文声转换：听得到，也带得走

- TTS / ASR 统一到「实验室 → 文声转换」，管理模型、朗读与音频转写。
- **TTS 导出 WAV，ASR 导出 UTF-8 TXT**，均提供系统分享入口。导出复用已有结果，不重复推理；TXT 保留换行。
- 系统保存窗口选择位置，Android 原生 64KiB 分块复制，不为导出申请全部文件权限。本次实现 WAV，未提供 MP4。
- 修复 Supertonic 3 voice style / Unicode 索引格式不匹配导致的原生退出；旧下载自动生成经过校验的兼容缓存，无需重下。
- 停止播放后抑制尚未完成的合成结果；清缓存和删除模型避让活动任务，失败不再悄悄吞掉。
- 新增 **Moonshine v2 Base 中文 INT8 ASR**，ModelScope 直链、归档及解包文件固定 SHA-256、白名单流式解包，不执行模型脚本。
- 加固 WAV 头、采样格式与 Isolate 入口，减少畸形文件分配和工作线程传参问题。

**语言与许可提醒：** Supertonic 3 不支持中文朗读，目前提供英语、日语、韩语；中文转写使用 Moonshine Community License 模型，商用条件须单独核对。180 分钟是输入上限，不是已经验证的三小时稳定运行成绩。页面结果未持久化，离开页面或清除缓存后可能需要重新生成；已经另存的文件不受影响。

### MCP、界面与工程

- MCP 商店内页详情、搜索、标签与一键导入。没有托管地址也能保存为禁用待配置；保存不等于连接，不会自动执行商店命令。
- 隐藏完全未适配的新选购项，保留历史资产的识别、恢复和删除能力，不自动删除旧模型。
- 单输入容器，「+」紧邻发送，附件、相机、OCR、语音和生成库收纳在工具菜单。
- 黑白舒展层级、统一圆角、右侧选择器；设置按日常、隐私数据、高级开发分组，关于单独成页。
- 玻璃默认关闭。Android 13+ 原生选择菜单接入 MIT 许可的 AndroidLiquidGlassView 1.1.0，许可随包分发；Flutter 渲染边界独立处理。
- 平台桥接、能力探测与安全回退，为后续移植划清边界；**本次没有 iOS / HarmonyOS 安装包**。

### 验证与已知边界

- 同一最终源码 **80 项自动测试，两轮通过**；静态分析无问题。
- 骁龙 8+ Gen1 / 12GB / Android 17：Debug、Release 覆盖安装及启动通过，旧会话/模型保留。
- Release 实际 TTS 播放、WAV 保存及解析、中文短样本 ASR、TXT 保存及内容比对通过；MCP 检查覆盖详情和禁用配置导入，不运行第三方命令。
- 未穷尽所有 API、第三方分享目标、ROM、日语长时语音、180 分钟音频或耗电情况，不宣称零缺陷。
- 本轮不更换 llama.cpp / LES，不宣传 MiniCPM 35B 视觉、填满 64K/128K 上下文或 NPU 的新突破。

release.notes:
The first stable release under the name Beckon (formerly Telepad). It brings a new desktop app and server for Windows, Linux and macOS, and a redesigned Android app.

### Renamed Telepad to Beckon

The project is now **Beckon** (formerly Telepad). The apps, packages, files and website use the new name. How it works, including the pairing protocol, has not changed.

#### Upgrade notes

- **Nothing is migrated.** Beckon does not read Telepad's files, settings or pairings. Install Beckon on the phone and on the PC, pair again, and remove Telepad afterwards.
- **Android:** the application id is now `com.omsingh.beckon`, so Beckon installs as a separate app next to Telepad and Telepad does not update to it.
- **Desktop files:** the folder is now `beckon` (`%APPDATA%\Beckon`, `~/Library/Application Support/Beckon`, `~/.config/beckon`) and the log file is `beckon.log`.
- **Names the system sees:** the program is `beckon`, and so are the Linux packages (`beckon`, `beckon-bin` on Arch). The firewall entries are the `Beckon` ufw profile and the `beckon` firewalld service. The udev rule is `60-beckon-uinput.rules`. The start-at-login entry, the `.desktop` file, the macOS bundle id and the LaunchAgent label use the new name too. Remove Telepad's old entries by hand.
- **Environment variables:** `TELEPAD_*` is now `BECKON_*` (`BECKON_FEED`, `BECKON_DOWNLOADS`, `BECKON_REPO`, `BECKON_DEV_UPDATE_ORIGIN`). The old names are no longer read.
- **Pairing links:** QR codes now carry `beckon://pair?...`. Codes made by Telepad do not open in Beckon.
- **Release files** are named `beckon-...`, and the website is <https://beckon.omsingh.me>. The old address redirects to it.

### Upgrading from 1.x

- Install the 2.0 app and the 2.0 desktop app (or server) together.

release.name: MEDHA v1.1-build.12
release.notes:
## MEDHA — On-Device AI with Gemma 4

**Version 1.1**

### 🐛 Fix: Gemma 4 vision engine failed to load

Loading **Gemma 4 E2B / E4B** with vision enabled crashed engine creation with:

> `Failed to create engine: INVALID_ARGUMENT: The Vision Encoder model must have exactly one signature but got 3`

**Root cause:** Gemma 4 bundles ship a *multi-signature* vision encoder, but the runtime was pinned to **LiteRT-LM 0.10.0**, which predates Gemma 4 support and rejects that encoder — failing the entire engine (not just vision).

**What changed:**
- ⬆️ Bumped **LiteRT-LM `0.10.0` → `0.12.0`** — adds Gemma 4 support, so the vision encoder loads cleanly.
- 🛟 Engine init now **degrades gracefully**: if the vision/audio encoder ever fails to load on a given device, it retries **text-only** instead of failing the whole engine, and logs a warning.
- 🎛️ Image / audio attach is now gated on whether the encoder **actually loaded** (`offlineVisionAvailable` / `offlineAudioAvailable`), so the UI never offers a modality the engine can't serve.
- 📦 **CI now ships only the installable debug APK** — the unsigned release APK couldn't be installed (package/signature error), so it was dropped.

### Download & Install
1. Download **`MEDHA-v1.1-debug.apk`** from the assets below
2. Transfer to your Android phone (or download directly on the phone)
3. Enable **"Install from unknown sources"** if prompted
4. Open the APK → tap **Install**
5. Launch MEDHA and follow the in-app setup guide

# Class-D RF Covert Transmitter — Release v1.1.0

## Overview & Academic Scope
This release marks the initial formal research baseline of the **Class-D RF Covert Transmitter** project. The software implements an intentional electromagnetic side-channel transmission system that leverages smartphone Class-D audio amplifier switching characteristics and PWM harmonics to emit readable Continuous Wave (CW) Morse code signals in the VHF spectrum (specifically centered around 144.000 MHz in the 2-meter amateur radio band).

This release is archived permanently on CERN Zenodo. When referencing this implementation or using the underlying RF leakage mechanism in academic research, cite as:

- **Author:** Efe Işık [TA1EEI]
- **Project:** Class-D RF Covert Transmitter
- **Version:** v1.1.0

---

The **Class-D RF Covert Transmitter** is an Android-based research tool that transforms an ordinary smartphone into a short-range VHF Morse code transmitter **without requiring any external radio hardware, root privileges, or physical RF peripherals**.

### 🔬 The Physics Behind It (Class-D Amplifier EMI Side-Channel)
- **Class-D Switching & PWM Modulation:** Modern smartphones utilize high-efficiency Class-D audio amplifiers that switch power transistors at high frequencies, generating rich high-order electromagnetic harmonics across the VHF spectrum.
- **Ultrasonic Carrier (Covert Operation):** By synthesizing pure 21 kHz ultrasonic sine waves via Android's low-level `AudioTrack` API, the acoustic output remains inaudible to human ears while driving the amplifier switching stages at maximum amplitude.
- **CW/AM Morse Code Generation:** Modulating these ultrasonic bursts in standard Morse code timing (dots, dashes, and intra-character spaces) introduces discrete RF side-channel keying, allowing nearby handheld transceivers or SD

# Driver Driver v0.8.0

You can now keep track of the drivers you've tried and look up community reports by game. This update also includes the new DD logo.

## Исправление доставки обновлений

Версия `1.0.127` проверяет GitHub `releases/latest`. Предыдущий опубликованный
`1.0.131-test.20261023.1` находился в тестовом канале, а Latest продолжал возвращать
`1.0.127`. Поэтому обычный клиент сообщал об отсутствии обновлений.

Для обычного канала собрана отдельная APK с полной версией `1.0.131`,
возрастающим Android versionCode `43158` и прежней подписью. Тег релиза и версия
APK совпадают. Этот релиз выбран GitHub Latest и содержит совместимый asset
`YurichConnect-android-release.apk` для встроенного обновлятора и основной

release.notes:
# Warpy 1.0.7

Единый релиз для Android и Windows.

## Windows

- Интерфейс, настройки, импорт профилей и управление подключением перенесены на Rust. Рабочий клиент больше не использует WebView2 и JavaScript; привычный внешний вид сохранён. VPN-ядро sing-box осталось прежним.
- Оптимизированы отрисовка и анимации: снижена нагрузка на процессор, добавлено повторное использование графических ресурсов и остановка отрисовки скрытого окна.
- Исправлено зависание анимации, точек и таймера после сворачивания и восстановления окна.
- Исправлены ложные переподключения: недоступность одного проверочного адреса больше не считается отказом всего туннеля.
- Кнопка подключения теперь отменяет незавершённое подключение, в том числе при зависании запуска.
- Исправлены маршрутизация исключений и обработка доменных имён Google Flow; устранён обход заданного маршрута через IPv6.

## Android

- Уменьшена фоновая нагрузка: опрос статистики и задержки приостанавливается, когда приложение не видно. Проверки исправного туннеля выполняются реже при выключенном экране; восстановление после обнаруженного сбоя сохраняется.
- Исправлены отмена незавершённого подключения и восстановление VPN после смены сети.
- Проверка профилей использует дополнительный независимый адрес, чтобы уменьшить ложные отметки «недоступен».
- Исправлено измерение задержки до сервера: время HTTP-запроса через туннель больше не подменяет сетевую задержку.
- Улучшена читаемость уведомления об обновлении внутри приложения.

## Общее

- Адрес VPN-сервера исключён из маршрута самого туннеля, чтобы избежать зацикливания соединения.
- Повышена устойчивость проверки доступности и восстановления соединения.

release.notes:
## Fixed

- **Moving the cursor mid-composition no longer duplicates the previous syllable** (#16) — Tapping elsewhere while a syllable was still composing, then typing, wrote part of the previous word again at the new cursor (안녕 → 녕ㄱ안녕) or put the new letters back at the old spot. Editors that close the composing region themselves on tap (WebView/Chrome, Compose) were not recognized as a cursor move, so the keyboard kept the old syllable and re-inserted it on the next jamo, backspace, space, Enter or keyboard hide. The keyboard now tracks where its own edits should leave the cursor, tells its own delayed selection updates apart from real cursor moves, and checks that the composing text is still before the cursor before continuing a syllable. Placing the cursor right before the composing syllable or selecting a range also ends the composition now. KakaoTalk's multi-tap fix from 1.0.x is preserved.
- **Autocorrect revert on backspace works again** — With AI correction on, backspace right after a correction restores the original word, as intended; it had been cancelled by the keyboard's own selection update.

- Signed with the project's release key; updates install over 1.0.x directly.

release.name: v0.8.0
release.notes:
## What's New in v0.8.0

### Features
- **Workspace top/bottom padding settings** — two new sliders under Settings → Grids let you control the gap above the workspace and below the dock. Defaults snap to the closest multiple of 8 dp of your device's actual status bar and nav bar, so most devices look unchanged out of the box. Lower the top padding to fit an extra row under the status bar.
- Slider values snap to multiples of 8 dp; the grid preview in Settings updates live as you drag.
- Sixth dock icon (Calendar) ships in the default layout on fresh installs so the 6-column dock isn't shipped with an empty slot.
- The app drawer's search bar now sits at the same vertical position as the workspace's first row when you change the top padding.

### Bug Fixes
- Fixed empty drawer after launching an app from the search results — the drawer alpha and search state are now reset cleanly when you return to the launcher.
- Fixed widget drops from the system widget picker being rejected silently when dragged onto an existing widget stack on devices with a packed workspace (Samsung Galaxy hardware).
- Folder background color changes no longer trigger a full grid rebuild.

### Improvements
- App drawer color, scrollbar, and tab pref changes are now near-instant — no full DeviceProfile rebuild on a paint-only tweak.
- Square-grid row count is locked to a stable, OS-version-independent value tied to your padding settings rather than the OS-reported status bar height (the root cause of the One UI 8.5 "bottom row disappeared" regression).

### Infrastructure
- Architectural refactor of the all-apps container is complete: `ActivityAllAppsContainerView` shrunk from 2168 LOC to 1607 LOC across four extracted collaborators (DrawerColorController, SearchFabController, DrawerInsetsController, ProfileCoordinator, SearchLifecycle, HeaderCoordinator).
- Unified preference-change framework migration is complete: every internal pref consumer now goes through one dedup + coalescing dispatcher.

release.name: v2.1.1: Background Sync Fixes & Smarter Extraction
release.notes:
This release brings crucial reliability fixes for background processing and smarter handling of future/scheduled transactions.

### 🐛 Bug Fixes
- **Duplicate Prevention:** Fixed a critical race condition where opening the app while an SMS was being processed in the background would result in duplicate transactions. The synchronization service now uses a strict sequential lock for database insertions to guarantee deduplication works as intended.
- **Scheduled Mandate Rejection:** The parser now correctly identifies and rejects "E-Mandates" and scheduled future payments (e.g., "Rs. 1000 will be deducted on..."). It will now properly wait for the actual completed transaction SMS from your bank before logging it as an expense.

### ✨ Improvements
- **Smarter Merchant Extraction:** Upgraded the merchant regex patterns to correctly extract complex billers like "Mutual Funds Ncl Autopay" and properly segment around "mandate" and "UMN" identifiers.
- Added tests to verify these new parsing scenarios.

release.notes:
UClone Slices v0.2.7

本版延续 0.2.x 的 Manager + KernelSU Runtime 方案，不包含桌面 Hook。

主要更新

- 每个 App 可设置默认账号。外部打开或真正离开后再次进入时回到默认账号；从 Slice 内手动选择的账号在当前访问期间有效。
- 将“自动回默认账号”开关与“默认账号”选择分开。账号列表只显示原空间和已有分账号，并标明“当前默认”；首次开启后取消选择时保持关闭。
- 修复模块更新尚未生效时，旧 Runtime 因读取新版模块属性而被误认为兼容的问题。Manager 同时核对协议版本与程序自身的编译版本；不一致时提示完成模块更新并重启手机。
- 修复离开 App 时因前台快照滞后而误判为再次进入、将 App 拉回前台的问题。离开时不切换；下次主动打开时才检查默认账号，切换前再次确认前台，预检或保存操作意图期间已离开则取消。
- 自动切换失败时恢复此前的账号视图；用户已经离开时不重新拉起 App。已有账号与默认策略保留。

安装与升级

1. 校验下载文件与 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。
2. 覆盖安装本 Release 的 Manager APK。
3. 在 KernelSU 中安装同批次模块 ZIP。
4. 手动重启手机并解锁，确认 Manager、模块和运行环境中的 Runtime 协议版本均为 `0.2.7`。

Manager 与 KernelSU 模块必须配套更新。重新连接 Runtime 不能代替手机重启来应用模块更新。APK 保持固定签名与包名，覆盖安装时保留数据。

版本与来源

- Manager：`0.2.7`，`versionCode 18`，包名 `com.uclone.slices.v2`。
- KernelSU 模块：`0.2.7`，`versionCode 18`；Runtime 协议与编译版本：`0.2.7`；模块架构：arm64。
- 源码提交：[887ae7d7f0721859fff889eb34a71f063733bf29](https://github.com/gkeyes/uclone-slices/commit/887ae7d7f0721859fff889eb34a71f063733bf29)。
- 构建来源：[GitHub Actions CI #166](https://github.com/gkeyes/uclone-slices/actions/runs/39470412607)。本 Release 复用该次构建的原始 APK、模块 ZIP 与校验文件。
- APK 签名证书 SHA-256：`3a98013499c588855ac936d884d9e55497f72827c91ca01e50cf9ca4fc290648`。

验证范围

该提交的 GitHub Actions 已通过 Rust 测试、格式检查、Clippy 与文档检查，Android 单元测试、Release lint/构建，以及 KernelSU 模块检查和构建。发布前另行核验了 APK 的包名、版本与固定签名、模块版本与源码脚本，以及整组文件的 SHA-256。

随版本保存的验收记录仍将“默认账号完整实机矩阵”列为待完成项。本次发布未新增手机安装、运行或重启测试，构建通过不代表该矩阵已验收。自动切换会重新打开默认账号首页，不保证保留旧账号通知的页面或回调。

release.name: ArtCraft for Android — 5 apps (arm64)
release.notes:
# ArtCraft for Android — 5 apps

Android ports of the ArtCraft family: clean-room Rust rewrites of the Adobe creative
tools, built on `eframe`/`wgpu` over **GameActivity**, reusing each app's unmodified
desktop engine and egui UI.

Every app was verified on hardware (vivo PA2573, Android 16) as well as on an emulator.

| App | Replaces | APK | Size | minSdk |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **FilmCraft** | Premiere | `FilmCraft-0.2.1-android-arm64.apk` | 44.5 MB | 31 |
| **LightCraft** | Lightroom | `LightCraft-0.2.1-android-arm64.apk` | 35.5 MB | 31 |
| **PhotoCraft** | Photoshop | `PhotoCraft-0.3.0-android-arm64.apk` | 47.0 MB | 31 |
| **EffectCraft** | After Effects | `EffectCraft-0.4.0-android-arm64.apk` | 68.7 MB | 31 |
| **PrintCraft** | Acrobat | `PrintCraft-0.2.1-android-arm64.apk` | 50.2 MB | 31 |

All are **arm64-v8a**, **16 KB page aligned** (installable on Android 15+ devices that
require it), and signed with the debug key so `adb install -r` works on any device.

## What each one proves

- **FilmCraft** — MediaCodec hardware H.264/HEVC decode including 10-bit (P010), driven
  through the engine's own decoder factory; SAF import and export both verified on device.
- **LightCraft** — real-device startup on the Mali-G925 GPU, 24-photo sample library,
  render → JPEG export → read-back all consistent in ~1.5 s.
- **PhotoCraft** — PSD and PNG decode, and the open → edit → save round trip driven
  through the system SAF picker end to end.
- **EffectCraft** — decode 25/25 frames, import, composite and render a title card with
  78 ms frames on the device GPU.
- **PrintCraft** — PDF 1.7 parser + rasterizer + text extraction (612×792 raster,
  74 glyphs), and open → save through the picker.

## Notes

- **Arm64 only.** No 32-bit or x86 builds.
- **Debug-signed.** Fine for sideloading; rotate the key before any store distribution.
- **PrintCraft needs an extra upstream patch** (`crates/ui-egui` calls `rfd` at 32 sites
  and pulls `arboard`; neither has an Android backend

repo.description: Continuity - Clipboard, file, and media sync across macOS, Windows, Linux, and Android over your local network. No cloud, no account the continuity Apple never built for the rest of your devices.

release.name: v0.1.7
release.notes:
### Added

- **Fast, resumable file transfers.** Files now go over a connection of
  their own, several times faster than before, without holding up the
  clipboard or remote control meanwhile. A big file that's interrupted —
  the Wi-Fi dropping, a laptop going to sleep — picks up where it stopped
  instead of starting over, for up to ten minutes. There's no size limit any
  more (it used to be 500 MB): a device turns a file down only when it hasn't
  the room, and the sender says why ("Not enough free space on Pixel (needs
  1.3 GB, 300 MB free)"). Many files at once go to a device a few at a time.
  Devices still on 0.1.6 or older get files the old way.
- **Choose where received files go** (#1). In the Continuity window,
  Received files → **Change…** picks the folder and **Open** shows it. On
  Android, files now go to `Download/Continuity`, where the Files app shows
  them, and **Change folder** picks another.
- **A notification for every received file** (#2), with an **Open** button —
  on Android a pop-up that shows the progress while it arrives.
- **The Continuity window is the app's main window.** Tray menu → **Open
  Continuity** (on Windows, a click on the tray icon); it also opens by
  itself the first time, and when you start Continuity again while it's
  running. The tray menu keeps just Send File, Pause Syncing and Quit. A
  Transfers page lists files on their way and the ones that just finished,
  with **Open** and **Show in folder**.
- **Control a computer from another computer.** On a connected computer's
  page in the window, **Control** opens its screen in a window of its own,
  with the whole keyboard — Command and Control swap places between a Mac and
  a PC, so shortcuts stay where your hands expect them — and drags and
  double-clicks.
- A refresh button under Nearby in the macOS window looks for devices again.
- **Cancel a transfer** from either device: a Cancel button on every file
  on its way, in the Continuity window and the Android app

release.notes:
Klingon Honor Guard — Android port. You supply your own retail game data.

✅ **Stable** — boots to the menu and plays real missions end-to-end.

This build adds a working **Auto Aim** option and improves **graphics-driver compatibility** so the game starts on more phones.

## What's new
- **Auto Aim now works — and it's off by default.** The game's **Options → Auto Aim** switch finally does something on touch and controller. It ships **off** (the original PC game shipped it *on*), so out of the box you get full manual aim. Turn it on in **Options** if you want help: your shots then bend toward the nearest enemy in front of you — both up/down *and* left/right — which makes firing on a touchscreen or gamepad far less fiddly. Your choice is saved, and you can flip it back off any time. (Note: on the two hardest difficulties the original game intentionally limits the built-in vertical aim help, but the added left/right assist still works on every difficulty.)
- **Runs on more GPUs.** Some phones crashed the instant the 3D renderer started. The game now checks what your GPU actually supports and, on devices that lack the newer "bindless" texture feature, automatically switches to a compatibility rendering path that produces the same image. Newer GPUs are unaffected and keep using the fast path.
- **Automatic safe-mode.** If the renderer ever crashes during start-up before it can draw anything, the next launch notices and boots straight into the compatibility path — so one bad start no longer leaves the game unable to open.
- **Wider Vulkan support.** Phones that expose modern graphics features through a newer Vulkan version (instead of an older extension) are now recognised, fixing a "no supported GPU" bail-out that hit some hardware.

Saves and settings are preserved across updates. Having trouble? Send `Android/obb/com.khg.android/Unreal/System/Unreal.log`.

release.name: Enitor v0.3.0
release.notes: > *Some things aren't tasks. They just happen at four.* ## A schedule next to your tasks A class, a meeting, practice — you don't tick them off, you show up. Until now they either cluttered the task list or lived somewhere else entirely, and the day card on Today had no idea that two of your evening hours were already spoken for. The new **Schedule** tab sits next to the task list and holds exactly that kind of entry: - A start time and, only if there is one, an end. A place, a note, a color. - Repeats by weekday — **every week or every other week**, for timetables that alternate odd and even weeks — by day of month, or every N days. - Moving one class doesn't touch the rest: edit it for **this day only** and the series carries on as before. - Entries that overlap are marked, so a double booking is visible before it happens. - **Week view**: seven days at a glance, tap one to open it. - Swipe to delete, duplicate in one tap, or turn an entry into a task — a single one, or a whole recurring series. - Reminders before an entry starts, with the place in the notification. release.name: v0.2.0 (development preview): iPhone support
release.notes:
**iPhone support.** Agents now use the same 11 `phone_*` tools on an iPhone as on Android.

iOS doesn't let an app control other apps, so the iPhone is driven from the computer it's plugged into: `phone-use-mcp ios up` keeps [WebDriverAgent](https://github.com/appium/WebDriverAgent) running over USB with [go-ios](https://github.com/danielpaulus/go-ios) and serves the same token-protected API as the Android app. Other computers on your tailnet can connect to it with `ios up --network`.

- **Locking the iPhone stops the agent**, and only unlocking it on the phone resumes. `phone-use-mcp pause` locks it from the computer.
- **WebDriverAgent gets no network port.** It has no authentication of its own, so phone-use reaches it over USB only.
- **No new dependencies.** Screenshots are scaled by a small built-in PNG module.

You need an iPhone with Developer Mode, go-ios, and WebDriverAgent signed with your Apple ID. Start with the [iPhone guide](https://github.com/luckeyfaraday/phone-use/blob/main/docs/IOS.md).

**Install**

```sh
npm install -g https://github.com/luckeyfaraday/phone-use/releases/download/v0.2.0/phone-use-mcp-0.2.0.tgz
phone-use-mcp setup        # Android
phone-use-mcp ios setup    # iPhone, then: phone-use-mcp ios up
```

**Notes**

- Development preview, signed with the same key as 0.1.0, so it installs over it on Android.
- iPhone support is verified on an iPhone 13 Pro with iOS 26 from Linux. macOS and Windows hosts should work through go-ios but are untested. Details are in [testing](https://github.com/luckeyfaraday/phone-use/blob/main/docs/TESTING.md).
- Check downloads against `SHA256SUMS`. Full list of changes in the [changelog](https://github.com/luckeyfaraday/phone-use/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

## Torchain v6.0.0 Release

### What's New in v6:
- **Standalone Windows Executable (`torchain.exe`)**: Zero Python or runtime dependencies required. Bundles native Python, Tcl/Tk GUI, and self-extracting Tor bundle.
- **Performance Boosts**:
  - Enabled `OptimisticData 1` across Linux, Windows, Android, and Termux (saves 1 full RTT on stream initialization).

  - Restored clean hostname restoration without `/etc/hosts` corruption.
  - Multi-user `HKEY_USERS` registry proxy cleanup for elevated recovery scripts.
  - Removed static hardcoded bridge IPs in `torchain-termux`.
  - Full audit hardening across Linux (`tc4/`), Windows (`tcwin/`), and Android (`app/`).

release.name: v0.1.0
release.notes:
Voxy — a level-of-detail renderer that needs desktop OpenGL 4.6 — running on Android under
Zalith Launcher 2.

## Read this first

**Tested on exactly one device:** AYN Odin 3, Snapdragon 8 Elite, **Adreno 830**, Android 15.
Everything else is an educated guess. Reports either way are welcome — there is a
**Device report** issue template, and successes are as useful as failures.

- **Adreno 7xx/8xx and arm64 only.** The stack is Mesa Turnip, a Qualcomm Adreno driver. Mali and
  PowerVR will not work.
- **Frame rate has never been measured.** Everything here is verified correct, nothing is verified
  fast. Two workarounds knowingly cost performance.
- **Storage grows fast** — several GB per world, quicker still with Voxy World Gen V2.

## What is in this release

| File | Install as |
|---|---|
| `turnip-plugin.apk` | app — Vulkan driver plugin |
| `kopper-zink26-plugin.apk` | app — desktop GL renderer plugin |
| `rocksdb-native-plugin.apk` | app — RocksDB natives, so LODs persist to disk |
| `voxy-android-compat-*.jar` | Minecraft mod, into the instance's `mods/` |
| `zink-env-plugin.apk` | optional, debugging aid |

Verify downloads against `SHA256SUMS`. The mod is also on Modrinth as
[Voxy Android Compatibility](https://modrinth.com/project/voxy-android-compatibility); the APKs are
only here, since Modrinth cannot host them.

Not included, install yourself: **Fabric API**, **Sodium 0.9.1+mc26.1.2** (Voxy pins this exactly),
**Voxy 0.2.18-beta**, and optionally Iris 1.11.3+ and Lithium.

## Setup in short

Install the three APKs, put the mod plus Voxy/Sodium/Fabric API in `mods/`, then set the instance's
**Renderer** to Kopper Zink, **Driver** to Turnip, **Graphics API** to OpenGL.

⚠️ **Global settings → "Prefer system Vulkan driver" must be OFF.** It is applied independently of
the renderer plugin, so it silently overrides everything else, and the proprietary driver's shader
compiler crashes on Voxy's shaders.

release.notes:
## Changes

- Large vaults use authenticated append-only commits, so unlock, rename, move, delete, and small imports no longer copy or scan the full payload.
- Fresh per-commit index keys and mirrored authenticated root slots preserve crash safety and retire access to deleted-file metadata.
- VAULTv1 and VAULTJ1 remain supported through bounded-memory migration with legacy fallback.
- Early VAULTL2 roots using the 172-byte layout are authenticated with their original format and atomically migrated to the protected per-commit index-key layout. Failed migration leaves the original encrypted container unchanged.
- Secure Keyboard supports cursor movement, middle-of-input editing, and UTF-8-safe backspace.
- Encrypted temporary-container and import-staging files are cleaned after success, handled failure, or the next app start.

## 24 September 2026 update

- Includes the vault integrity, import, and document-preview hardening on `main`.
- Corrects the embedded release certificate fingerprint, which caused the previous APK asset to show “Environment not supported.”
- Release builds now fail if the configured fingerprint does not match the signing certificate.
- APK built from `main` commit `0b71f86`; the release tag remains at its original commit.

## Operational trade-offs

- Unlock authenticates the root and encrypted index; payload corruption is detected when the affected file or chunk is read instead of scanning every payload byte during unlock.
- Append-only commits can grow the container until storage compaction reclaims retired encrypted records and deleted ciphertext.
- Early VAULTL2 migration is a one-time bounded-memory encrypted copy and needs temporary free storage; the source remains unchanged until atomic replacement succeeds.

## Earlier release verification

- 15 Flutter regression tests passed.
- Flutter analyzer reported no errors or warnings; 104 informational lints remain.
- Android debug and release native builds passed the legacy/current VAULTL2 la

release.notes:
**Pckt now works outside India.** Pick your home currency, and Pckt reads, totals and budgets in it. Payments in other currencies are stored as they happened instead of being treated as rupees.

## Install / update
Download **`pckt-v1.0.1.apk`** below (Android 11+, 64-bit). If you have v1.0.0, it installs over it and keeps your data. Existing installs stay on INR.

## What's new
- **Home currency:** chosen at first launch (defaulting from your phone's region) and changeable in Settings → Money → Currency. Supported: INR, AED, SAR, QAR, KWD, OMR, BHD, SGD, MYR, USD, GBP, CAD, AUD, NZD, EUR, BDT, PKR, LKR, NPR, IDR, PHP, VND, THB, NGN, KES, ZAR, BRL, MXN, TRY, JPY, KRW.
- **Right formatting per currency:** lakh/crore grouping only for INR, no decimals for JPY/KRW/IDR/VND, three for KWD/BHD/OMR.
- **Spending abroad:** a card alert like "USD 12.50 spent on card XX1234" is stored as USD. If the message also gives the amount in your home currency, it counts straight away. Otherwise it's marked *not in totals* until you enter what the bank charged or a rate. Pckt never fetches exchange rates, so it still works offline and sends nothing anywhere.
- **Alerts from banks Pckt doesn't know** (UAE, UK, US, Singapore formats and others) are now read, and marked for a quick review.
- **Same-payment merging works across currencies** when a conversion is known.
- The assistant, CSV export, budgets and backup/restore all carry the currency.
- Messages v1.0.0 couldn't read (for example foreign spends) are re-read once on the next SMS sync, and your edits are kept.

## Known limitations
- Instant SMS notifications and email search still cover Indian banks only. Other banks' alerts are read on sync.
- Decimal commas ("1.234,56 EUR") and currencies outside the list above (CHF, CNY, HKD…) aren't supported yet.
- On-device AI is still slow on mid-range phones, and iOS is untested.

* Added `MediaScannerConnection` indexing so Android's native file managers immediately see new updates.

* Expanded documentation detailing the on-device inference pipeline, interactive ground-truth evaluation, and companion training repository [kavinmaranravi/Halanoi_AI](https://github.com/kavinmaranravi/Halanoi_AI).

release.name: Cura 1.4.0
release.notes:
## What's new

- **Updates from inside the app.** Cura can now tell you when a new version is
  out. Open Settings, Updates to check whenever you like, or turn on Check for
  updates automatically and Cura asks GitHub once a day. It is off by default,
  so until you turn it on, Cura never checks by itself. When there is a new
  version you get the release notes, and one tap downloads it, checks it against
  the checksum GitHub publishes, and hands it to Android to install. Your
  records are kept, and Android only accepts an update signed with the same key
  as the Cura you already have.
- **Charts in answers.** Ask about one of your own measures, like "what are my
  sugar levels" or "what is my haemoglobin and what does it indicate", and the
  answer now comes with the chart for that measure. The reply describes how the
  value has moved across your reports rather than only quoting the latest one.
  Tap the chart to open its readings. If the question names two measures you
  have, such as fasting and postprandial sugar, you get both charts. Questions
  that are not about your own values, like what a test means, still answer in
  words alone.

## What's better

- Cloud answers to general questions sometimes came back blank. An ordinary
  sentence mentioning a laboratory or a lab report was being thrown away by the
  filter meant for scanned reports. General questions now answer properly, and
  an answer that does come back empty says so instead of showing nothing.
- The app lock now covers your records from the very first frame. Before this,
  Home could be drawn for a moment before the lock screen appeared.

## Privacy

Automatic update checking is off until you turn it on, and the in-app privacy
policy now lists GitHub, what a check sends, which is the version question and
none of your records, and what the permission to install apps is used for.

release.notes:
## CrossSync 1.0.0

**Clipboard and file sync between Windows and Android over your local Wi-Fi.** No cloud, no account, no internet needed.

### ⬇️ Downloads
| Platform | File | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| **Windows 10 / 11** | `CrossSync.exe` | One self-contained file. No install, no .NET needed. |
| **Android 8.0+** | `CrossSync.apk` | Signed release build. |

### ✨ Features
- **Clipboard sync, both ways:** text and images (screenshots too) between your PC and any number of phones
- **Works in the background on Android:** copies in ChatGPT, Gemini, browsers, WhatsApp and text selection reach your PC automatically
- **File sharing:**
  - PC: right-click any file → **CrossSync** → pick a phone
  - Phone: **Share → CrossSync** from any app
  - Phone to phone, relayed by the PC
- **Multiple phones:** a copy on one phone reaches the PC and every other phone
- **Private and secure:** TLS encryption, 6-digit pairing code, certificate pinning. Nothing leaves your network.

### 🚀 Quick setup
1. **PC:** put `CrossSync.exe` in a permanent folder (e.g. `C:\CrossSync`) and run it.
   - SmartScreen warning → **More info → Run anyway** (the exe isn't code-signed yet)
   - Firewall prompt → allow on **Private** networks
2. **Phone:** install `CrossSync.apk`, open it, tap **Scan**, pick your PC and enter the **6-digit code** shown on the PC.
3. **Background sync (Android):**
   - Settings → Apps → CrossSync → ⋮ → **Allow restricted settings**
   - Settings → Accessibility → **CrossSync 24/7 Clipboard Sync** → On
   - Battery → **Unrestricted**

Full guide, including Xiaomi/Vivo/Oppo settings: [README](https://github.com/Sanket-Baviskar/CrossSync#setup)

> PC and phone must be on the **same Wi-Fi network**.

### 🔒 Verify your download
These files were built from this tag by GitHub Actions. To check a download:
- Compare it against `SHA256SUMS.txt`, or
- run `gh attestation verify <file> --repo Sanket-Baviskar/CrossSync`

### ⚠️ Known limitations

release.name: v1.4.3
release.notes:
## 听记 v1.4.3

# 听记 v1.4.3

v1.4.3 围绕「把记录顺畅地分享出去，再把别人的分享接回来」展开：新增分享链接自动识别与导入，补齐钉钉、企业微信云文档和群机器人，飞书也支持群机器人；同时重排了移动端导航、录音列表和会议详情操作区，并修复了深色模式、页面转场和更新下载中的一批细节问题。

## 新增功能

- 分享链接自动识别：复制一条听记分享链接后回到应用，会提示「检测到听记分享链接」，只有点击导入后才会访问链接，不会在后台自动读取或上传内容。
- 导入分享记录：录音记录页新增「导入分享」入口，也可以直接粘贴链接；支持 6 位访问密码解锁、内容预览和原会议时间还原，导入完成后自动打开对应详情。
- 最近导入提示：导入的记录会保留原会议时间，可能排在列表较后；列表顶部会显示最近导入数量，记录卡片带「最近导入」标记，并可直接跳到最新导入的一条，不再让人怀疑是否导入成功。
- 钉钉和企业微信云文档同步：在设置中分别配置后，可以把 AI 摘要或完整纪要直接写入钉钉「我的文档」和企业微信文档，并在分享面板和会议详情中看到同步状态。
- 企业微信服务端代理：企业微信云文档支持通过听记服务器固定出口 IP 转发请求，管理员只需把服务器 IP 加入可信 IP 一次，普通成员不需要逐台配置本机公网 IP。
- 钉钉、企业微信和飞书群机器人：为三个平台分别提供群机器人配置页，保存后可以把 7 天有效的听记分享卡片发送到群聊；钉钉支持加签校验，飞书支持签名校验，链接生成失败时会自动退回发送完整纪要。
- 独立会员权益：钉钉文档、钉钉群消息、企业微信文档、企业微信群消息和飞书群消息分别校验权益，不再共用飞书文档权益；未开通时会直接显示锁定状态，不会等填完配置再提示失败。

## 体验优化

- 移动端底部导航把「任务」改为「记录」：底栏直接进入录音记录，任务入口移到首页右上角，并用暖橙色按钮突出显示，常用入口更容易找到。
- 移动端录音列表操作栏重新排列：导入分享、排序和多选收进同一行图标按钮，搜索框保留更多空间，列表顶部不再出现空白或拥挤。
- 移动端会议详情操作区优化：五个标签页支持横向滑动，摘要类型和复制、同步云文档、重新生成放在同一行，小屏下按钮改为图标显示，减少挤压和折行。
- 导入分享弹窗、提示卡、钉钉和企业微信配置页、飞书群机器人页完成深色模式适配，弹窗、输入框、提示文字和卡片背景在暗色主题下保持一致。
- Windows 端主窗口改为自绘标题栏：去掉原生标题栏后，窗口控制按钮跟随深浅色主题，观感和 macOS 版本更统一，其他平台窗口行为保持不变。
- 二级设置页转场统一为从右向左，协作平台和 Agent 接入不再反向滑入；转场期间会隐藏悬浮滚动条，避免滚动条被页面位移推到屏幕中间。
- 更新下载稳定性优化：应用内更新改用自有镜像下载地址，避免国内网络直连 GitHub 失败；Linux AppImage 补上更新签名，下载完成后不会再因签名为空校验失败。

## 问题修复

- 修复粘贴分享链接后点击解析没有加载动画、也没有任何反馈的问题：现在会显示解析中状态，失败时给出链接无效、已过期或密码错误等明确提示。
- 修复未开通钉钉或企业微信权益时仍显示完整输入框的问题：现在只显示「未开通」说明和会员提示，保存按钮和测试按钮不会误导用户重复操作。
- 修复飞书云文档中 Markdown 和表格显示为原文的问题：优先使用飞书官方 Markdown 转换接口，表格会转成可视化文档内容；权限未生效时会给出重新同步的提示，而不是静默写入错误格式。
- 修复企业微信云文档标题为空、表格错位和插入位置报错的问题：同步时会先设置文档标题，把表格转换为可读文本，并兼容企业微信不同文档状态下的插入位置。
- 修复钉钉和企业微信配置页输入框提示文字过大、页面字号不协调的问题，表单标题、说明和占位文字恢复为统一层级。
- 修复移动端会议详情标签被截断、摘要操作按钮挤成两行的问题，标签可以完整横向浏览，操作按钮在窄屏下仍保持单行。
- 修复从录音记录进入会议详情、再返回列表时滚动条位置异常和页面从错误方向滑入的问题。
- 修复设置页「钉钉」「企业微信」「Agent 接入」进入方向与飞书等页面不一致的问题，统一为符合层级关系的右进左出转场。

## 兼容性或注意事项

- 钉钉云文档、钉钉群消息、企业微信云文档、企业微信群消息和飞书群消息需要分别开通会员权益；App 只负责展示和调用，实际权益由服务端下发，升级 App 后仍需部署对应服务端版本。
- 企业微信云文档推荐使用服务器代理模式；管理员需要把设置页显示的服务器出口 IP 加入企业微信「应用详情 → 企业可信IP」，直连模式则要配置每台设备的公网 IP。
- 飞书云文档的表格转换

release.name: 加固产物：RustDesk 1.5.0 / Dhizuku 2.12.0（apkguard 42 项，模拟器实测通过）
release.notes:
# 加固产物：RustDesk 1.5.0 / Dhizuku 2.12.0

用 [apkguard](../../README.md) 对两个第三方应用做的**加固重建包**，供研究与验证使用。
打包前已在 Android 16（API 36，x86_64）模拟器上逐个实测：安装、启动、进程存活、
零崩溃、壳无降级日志。

## 产物

| 文件 | 启用的功能项 | 能否在本机之外运行 |
|------|-------------|-------------------|
| `rustdesk-PORTABLE.apk` | 39 项（全部 42 项去掉 D2/D3/D5） | ✅ 任意设备 |
| `dhizuku-PORTABLE.apk` | 同上 | ✅ 任意设备 |
| `rustdesk-ALL-emu.apk` | 全部 42 项 | ❌ 见下方说明 |
| `dhizuku-ALL-emu.apk` | 全部 42 项 | ❌ 见下方说明 |

两个变体都是同一套加固流程，区别只在三个「运行环境检测/绑定」类功能项：

- **D2 Root 检测**、**D3 模拟器检测**：命中即终止进程。加固时测试用的模拟器本身就
  有 root（`/system/xbin/su` 存在）且满是模拟器特征（`model=sdk_gphone64_x86_64`、
  `hardware=ranchu`），所以 `-ALL` 版本在这类环境里**启动即退**——这是它们生效的
  表现，不是崩溃（实测退出时没有任何异常堆栈）。
- **D5 设备绑定**：绑定的是打包那台模拟器的 ANDROID_ID。换设备后校验不通过，同样
  终止进程。因此 `-ALL` 版本**实际上只能在打包用的那台模拟器上跑**。

**要装到自己的设备上用，请选 `-PORTABLE`。**

还有 13 项与检测无关的能力同样包含在 PORTABLE 里：A16~A20 欺骗类手法（假核心文件、
假内层 APK、假权限元数据、字符串池垃圾、花指令）、C7 原生库伪装、A5/A11 资源混淆、
B8 载荷容器化、A15 巨型 Manifest 填充等。

## 2026-10-04 这一版新增的手法

对照 `sample.apk`（一个真实加固样本）逆向出的手法做了 18 项对齐，与上一版的差异：

- **A15 巨型 Manifest 填充**：填充不再是「一段写死的未知 chunk + 全零」，而是
  **藏进合法字符串池内部的一条巨串** + 两个**类型随机**的假 chunk（样本 369 MB 的
  Manifest 里 85.4% 就是这样一条 1.58 亿字符的巨串）。填充因此不再有固定指纹，
  也不能靠「剥离未知 chunk」去掉。
- **A7（新实现）**：反射成员名强制加密 —— `getMethod/getDeclaredMethod/getField/
  getDeclaredField` 用到的名字，无论多短都交给 A2 加密（短名此前会低于最短长度门槛而留在明文）。
- **A10/A18/A14/A8**：垃圾条目与诱饵元数据成族（176 B 共用载荷、纯空格文件、
  `kotlin/` 伪装、4 位 hex 近重名、构建水印 `cfg_mark_<时间戳>_…`、同名不同值四组、
  三段时间戳），诱饵组件放主题化随机包并去掉产品名。
- **arsc 资源条目名随机化**（13% 带 `vx_<type>_` 前缀），并保证「DEX 里按名查表的
  字面量」对应的资源名**不改名**（含从原始输入 APK 采集，避免被 A1/A2 提前抹掉）。
- **A1 对 R 类的处理**：`R`/`R$Type` 类与字段一起改名（对齐样本），`static_values`
  里的资源 ID 保持不变。
- **ZIP / 签名**：所有 deflate 条目带数据描述符；v2 加防剥离属性（`0xBEEFF00D`）；
  签名块 4096 对齐（数据区补零 + verity padding）。
- **签名证书**：改用随机生成的发布身份（不再是 `O=apkguard` 这种工具指纹）。

## 重要说明（请先读）

- **签名**：这些包用仓库里的**测试证书**签名（PKCS12，口令 `apkguard`），
  **不是**原应用的官方签名密钥。因此：
  - 不能在官方版本上**覆盖安装**，需先卸载原版；
  - 仅供测试，**不要用于任何生产或分发场景**。
- **版权**：RustDesk 与 Dhizuku 的著作权与许可归各自原作者所有。本发布只包含

release.name: GTAV Mobile v0.1.0-alpha.3 — iPhone signing fix
release.notes:
Fixes **“The executable is ad-hoc signed, which is not supported on this device”** during iPhone USB installation.

Alpha.2 could copy the original executable back into the app on a repeated Run while Xcode reused its earlier signing result. The preparation phase now declares a build output, so replacing the executable triggers development signing every time.

**Verified:** two consecutive signed Xcode builds, strict signature verification, and successful installation on a physical iPhone. Gameplay and weekly signature renewal remain untested. Android and iOS game binaries are unchanged.

### iPhone installation

Download **gtav-mobile-mac-usb.zip**, extract it, and open **Install-iPhone.command**. Connect your unlocked iPhone by USB, select your Personal Team and phone in Xcode, then press **Run**. Keep the same team and bundle identifier when updating; do not delete the app to refresh its signature.

Free Personal Team profiles expire after seven days. Reconnect and Run again to renew. [Apple's account details](https://developer.apple.com/help/account/basics/about-your-developer-account) · [Installation guide](https://github.com/alihammoud21/gtav-mobile/blob/main/docs/INSTALLING.md)

The complete desktop bundle also includes Android USB helpers. The standalone APK installs directly on Android. The separate IPA is the precompiled input used by the Mac USB project.

First setup downloads about **17 GB** of game data from playgta5 on the phone. Allow **19 GB free**, plus Android's compilation cache. Mac USB setup requires Xcode 26+. iOS requires 15+ and a compatible high-memory device; Android requires ARM64, Android 9+ and Vulkan 1.1.

Checksums are in `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Runtime: GPL-3.0-or-later, based on Muguet by c22dev. Game assets have separate rights.

release.name: ThothTerm • ThothDock 0.4.1 (401)
release.notes:
**ThothTerm • ThothDock 0.4.1 (401)** — compatibility release

- **Package:** `com.thothterm.debian` (unchanged), tags `trixie-v*`; guest Debian GNU/Linux 13 (Trixie); engine ThothDock v0.2.1 (https://github.com/Lord1Egypt/ThothDock/releases/tag/v0.2.1)
- **Fixes:** PostgreSQL 17 (System V shared memory) runs; RabbitMQ, Redis/Valkey, sshd, php-fpm and several other server images now work; PRoot patches 0010–0018 (see the engine release).
- **Assets:** `ThothTerm-ThothDock-v0.4.1.apk` (F-Droid variant, downloads the Debian rootfs after explicit opt-in); `ThothTerm-ThothDock-v0.4.1-full.apk` (rootfs embedded, about 79 MB); unsigned references, SHA256SUMS, SIGNING-MANIFEST.txt.

**Read before relying on it**
- MongoDB 8 does not run on Android's 39-bit address space; use MongoDB 7.0. SeaweedFS shutdown hangs (data intact).
- Containers run under PRoot in the app's own identity: **no namespaces, cgroups or seccomp**. Do not run untrusted workloads. Android can still end the engine under process pressure; use `--restart unless-stopped`.

repo.description: 🔒 کلاینت DNS امن و پرسرعت اندروید — DoH · DoT · DNSCrypt + مسدودسازی تبلیغات/ردیاب/بدافزار | Fast, secure Android DNS client with encrypted protocols, ad-blocking & auto-failover

release.name: JB-DNS 4.3 — هستهٔ ضدسانسور و بهینه‌سازی جامع
release.notes:
## 🛡 JB-DNS 4.3 — هستهٔ ضدسانسور، شتاب‌دهی پروتکل‌ها و بهینه‌سازی جامع

### 🚀 مهم‌ترین بهبودها
- **ضد-سانسور و پایداری در اینترنت ایران (`BootstrapDns`):** تشخیص و رد آی‌پی‌های فیلترینگ ISP (`10.10.34.*`، `0.0.0.0`)، بازگشت خودکار به DoH رمزنگاری‌شده با IP مستقیم و حفظ `bootstrapIps` داخلی سرورها حتی در شرایط قطع اینترنت بین‌الملل.
- **شتاب‌دهی و پایداری `DNSCrypt v2` و `Race Mode`:** رفع باگ کش گواهی سرور در حافظه، پیش‌محاسبهٔ کلید X25519+HChaCha20، بازگشت خودکار به **TCP** هنگام مسدودبودن UDP و بازگشت فوری اولین پاسخ سالم در حالت مسابقه بدون انتظار پشت سرورهای قطع.
- **حفاظت کامل در Split Tunneling:** اعمال `VpnService.protect` روی تمام سوکت‌های DoH، DoT، DNSCrypt، DNS ساده، چت پشتیبانی و دانلود بلاک‌لیست راه دور.
- **پشتیبانی کامل IPv6 و قواعد دامنه:** پاسخ `::` در حالت Sinkhole، بازنویسی IPv6، پوشش کامل زیردامنه‌ها در استثناها، حذف خطاهای مثبت کاذب بلاک‌لیست‌ها و افزودن سرورهای **AdGuard DNSCrypt** و **Quad9 DNSCrypt** (۲۶ سرور آماده).
- **تعمیر کامل رابط WebView و تجربهٔ کاربری:** رفع باگ راه‌اندازی سرد `SPLIT`، ایمن‌سازی کامل در برابر XSS، اصلاح پوستهٔ روشن و برگه‌های شناور، افزودن مدیریت دامنه‌های مسدود/استثنا، فیلد Bootstrap IP و حذف سرور سفارشی، دکمهٔ پاک‌سازی لاگ‌ها، ویزارد باتری شیائومی/سامسونگ و ناوبری هوشمند دکمهٔ Back اندروید.
- **فوق‌سبک و سریع:** کوچک‌سازی کامل کد و منابع با R8 — کاهش حجم فایل نصب به تنها **`2.4 MB`** (امضاشده با `APK Signature Scheme v2 + v3`).

- **Edge-to-Edge Embed Architecture:** Replaced loading m.youtube.com/watch (which crammed headers, search bars, comments, and recommendations into the player box) with an isolated, pitch-black (#000000) YouTube IFrame Embed container.
- **Zero Website Chrome:** Completely removed related video grids, web headers, comments, and subscribe banners from the player frame.
- **Seamless Touch Gestures:** Double-tap seeking (-10s / +10s), volume, brightness, and play/pause gestures now communicate directly with the web player.
- **Discrete Fallback HUD:** Added a discrete '🌐 Web Stream Mirror • Retry Native' status pill for full transparency and instant retry.

### ⚡ 3. Native Stream Extraction Hardening
- **Extended Timeout:** Increased NewPipe timeout from 3.5s to 8.0s, preventing premature fallback timeouts on slower mobi

Mobile SMS Server turns an Android phone into a local SMS gateway over WiFi using a lightweight Python + Flask backend with a Kivy dashboard.

- Local HTTP API for sending SMS messages from your phone
- `POST /api/sms` endpoint for programmatic message sending

- Persistent background service with Android notifications
- Fully local workflow with no cloud SMS provider required

- Install the APK from this release and run it directly on your Android device

1. Open the app on your Android phone

# DA Tunes v2.0 — Release Notes

**A major update bringing improved streaming stability, refined animations, expanded platform support, and a smoother listening experience.**

### What's New

**Theme System**
- Introduced a complete multi-theme system with three distinct visual experiences:
  - DA Tunes Default — the original DA Tunes visual identity.
  - Material 3 — a dedicated Material You-inspired experience with dynamic light/dark appearance and redesigned M3 components.
  - AMOLED — a true pitch-black OLED-friendly interface with monochrome UI and original-color album artwork.
- Themes are deeply integrated across the app, including the player, navigation, settings, widgets, and responsive layouts.
- Material 3 includes its own Light/Dark appearance controls.

**Linux Foundation & Community Support**
- Added the initial foundation for native Linux support, including AppImage packaging infrastructure.
- Linux development is open to community contributions. Developers are welcome to help improve compatibility, functionality, and stability.
- **Note:** The Linux version is currently untested and should be considered experimental. Proper functionality is not yet guaranteed.

**Network & Playback Improvements**
- Improved networking for Airtel and Jio 4G/5G connections.
- Enhanced IPv4/IPv6 connectivity, connection reuse, and retry handling.
- Reduced prefetching from three upcoming songs to just one for better efficiency.
- Improved request management, caching, and playback reliability.

**Player & UI Fixes**
- Fixed Full Screen Player navigation in Android landscape for Material 3 and AMOLED themes.
- Improved Queue and Lyrics panel toggle behavior.
- Enhanced orientation handling and responsive layouts.
- Additional performance, rendering, and stability improvements.

### Supported Platforms

- **Android** — Supported
- **Windows** — Supported
- **Linux** — Experimental foundation added; untested, contributions welcome

release.notes:
# Napster // v1.0.3

Napster v1.0.3 introduces truth-first audio diagnostics, modular HTTP streaming add-on support, non-destructive FLAC export, and per-network quality controls.

### What's New

- **Truth-First Audio Diagnostics:** Real-time monitoring of actual Media3 decoder input formats (codec, sample rate, bit depth, bitrate) and active output routes (Speaker, Wired, USB DAC, HDMI, Bluetooth A2DP codecs including LDAC, aptX, and AAC). Streams are transparently flagged if provider-claimed lossless quality is downsampled or delivered lossy by upstream pipes.
- **HTTP Streaming Add-ons:** Connect custom streaming add-on servers using an open JSON manifest specification. Features manifest capability checks, request deduplication, HTTP 429 Retry-After backoff, and strict track matching to prevent remix or live version mismatches.
- **Lossless FLAC Export:** Export downloaded or cached lossless tracks directly to device storage via Android Storage Access Framework. Vorbis comment tags, cover artwork, and synchronized lyrics are embedded without altering or re-encoding raw audio frames. Lossy sources are exported cleanly as standard M4A files.
- **Per-Network Quality Preferences:** Independent quality selectors for Wi-Fi and Cellular data, with automatic network transition handling and Data Saver overrides.
- **Storage & Cache Controls:** Granular size monitoring for player and offline download caches with instant one-tap cache eviction in Settings.

### Fixes & Improvements

- Corrected quality selector terminology to reflect user preferences rather than unverified bit-perfect output guarantees.
- Fixed rate-limit backoff handling in HTTP add-on clients to enforce cooldown timers when retries are exhausted.
- Restored explicit user consent gates for external stream providers.
- Prevented redundant playback reloads during network transitions when the resolved quality level is unchanged.

Weitere Umsetzung aus der **F-Droid-Review**, danke an @linsui, @mezinster, @sookoothaii1
und @gitubpatrice.

### Das WebView fragt nicht mehr bei Google nach
Android schaltet in jedem WebView standardmäßig **Safe Browsing** ein: Die gerade
aufgerufene Adresse geht dabei an Googles Safe-Browsing-Dienst. Für ein Wandtablet, das ein
Dashboard im eigenen Netz zeigt, bringt das nichts und gibt interne Adressen preis. Jetzt
ist es aus, über `android.webkit.WebView.EnableSafeBrowsing` im Manifest und zusätzlich über
`safeBrowsingEnabled = false` am WebView selbst. Dazu kommt
`android.webkit.WebView.MetricsOptOut`, womit auch die WebView-Nutzungsstatistik entfällt.

Nachgemessen auf einem frischen Android 15: Vor der Einrichtung hat die App **keine einzige**
Verbindung offen, danach genau eine, nämlich den Dashboard-Host.

### Kleinigkeit
- Store-Beschreibung: Die Zeile „All files access" war seit der SAF-Umstellung in 0.4.10
  falsch und beschreibt nun die Ordnerauswahl.

Drei aufeinanderfolgende `clean`-Builds liefern byte-identische APKs
(SHA-256 `2cf860567c91353ab2c20629eb9b970d60c08feb5845eed79cb50bdf38831291`).

Signiert (CN=FullScreendy), installiert als Update über v0.4.x.


---

More work from the **F-Droid review**, thanks to @linsui, @mezinster, @sookoothaii1 and @gitubpatrice.

### The WebView no longer asks Google
Android turns on **Safe Browsing** in every WebView by default: the address being opened is sent to Google's Safe Browsing service. For a wall tablet showing a dashboard on your own network that brings nothing and gives away internal addresses. It is now off, via `android.webkit.WebView.EnableSafeBrowsing` in the manifest and additionally via `safeBrowsingEnabled = false` on the WebView itself. On top of that, `android.webkit.WebView.MetricsOptOut` drops the WebView usage statistics too.

Measured on a fresh Android 15: before setup the app has **not a single** connection open, afterwards exactly one, to the dashboard host.

## BoxAgent v0.2.0-beta

The agent no longer has to borrow your screen: a **virtual screen** mode lets it work on a private virtual display while your real screen stays untouched, and its tool belt grew from UI gestures into device-wide control.

### Virtual screen

- Agent operations can run on a private virtual display owned by a shell-uid `app_process` host (toggle in Settings → Runtime → Virtual screen)
- Apps launch on the display via `am start --display`; the accessibility layer reads it through `getWindowsOnAllDisplays`
- Drag, tap, swipe, pinch, keys and text input are injected on the virtual display by the host
- Destroying the display force-stops only the packages that ran on it — tasks no longer migrate onto your physical screen
- Scoped tools fail loudly when the display is gone instead of silently acting on the real screen

### Expanded tool surface

- `scroll_until` — scroll until text/desc/id appears (replaces scroll+screen loops, saves round trips)
- `drag`, `double_tap` — long-press-and-move for reorder/sliders, and zoom-style double taps
- `copy_text` — copy an element's text to the clipboard (pair with `clipboard_get`)
- `notifications` — read the status bar (titles, text, package, time)
- `device_control` — volume, media keys, brightness, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth
- `app_permission` — list/grant/revoke runtime permissions
- `http_request` — GET/POST/… straight from the phone, with status + clipped body
- `file_read` pagination (`offset`/`max_chars`), `type_text` `append`, `wait_for` `gone=true` (wait for spinners/dialogs to disappear), and timeouts now attach the current screen so the model doesn't need an extra `screen` call

### Transport & pairing

- Daemon and virtual-screen host moved to loopback TCP with token auth — abstract sockets were blocked by SELinux on user builds
- Wireless-debugging pairing accepts the code via an inline-reply notification, so the Settings dialog stays open

- **Daily history.** Analytics now shows the last 30 days: how many queries
  each day had, how many were blocked, and the most-blocked domains. It is
  kept on the phone and survives closing the app, restarting protection and
  rebooting (Android).

release.name: PocketStream 1.4
release.notes:
## New
- **QR code stream sharing** — tap the QR button next to the RTSP URL to show a large scannable code; another phone can scan it and open the stream directly in VLC. The URL text itself is now tap-to-copy.
- **Any-VPN support** — the stream URL now follows whatever VPN is active on the phone (Tailscale, ZeroTier, WireGuard, …), falling back to the Wi-Fi address for LAN viewing; cellular and the camera tether are never advertised. The RTSP card shows which network the URL is on ("Sharing via ZeroTier One (VPN)") and warns if the network changes mid-stream so you know to restart the server. Outgoing video packets are sized to fit narrow VPN tunnels (e.g. Tailscale's 1280-byte MTU), so viewers get video instead of a silent black screen.

## Reliability
- The Connect flow no longer depends on a hidden Android API. Ethernet-tethering detection now uses the public `NetworkInterface` API, so platform updates can no longer silently disable the scan button.
- The RTSP re-stream server now survives leaving the app (back-press, split-screen, config changes). Stop it via the in-app button or the notification's Stop action.
- Starting the server while it is already running no longer corrupts its configuration.
- Live View is blocked from binding the UDP port the server is already consuming (previously undefined behavior).
- VLC pipeline setup/teardown moved off the main thread — no more UI jank or ANR risk during stream failures and reconnects.
- Recording finalization race fixed: recordings are copied to the gallery only after the MP4 muxer has finished, and the save completes even if the player screen closes mid-save.

## Security
- Camera credentials and stream tokens no longer appear in logs; release builds strip all debug logging via R8.
- The re-stream server binds only to the selected address (the active VPN when one is up, otherwise Wi-Fi) instead of every interface including cellular.
- The tokenized stream URL was removed from the lock-screen-visib

Instead of installing every available keyboard layout, KeymapKit now lets you choose exactly which layouts you want to install.

During the first launch you can:

- Select only the layouts you need
- Install multiple layouts at once
- Start with recommended layouts based on your device language

This keeps Android's Physical Keyboard list much cleaner.

---

### 🎯 Layout Manager

A brand new Layout Manager has been added.

You can now:

- Add new layouts
- Remove installed layouts
- Search layouts
- View installed layouts
- Enable only what you actually use

No reinstall is required.

---

### 🔍 Layout Search

Finding layouts is now much easier.

Search by:

- Language
- Country
- Layout name

---

### 🌍 Language Categories

Layouts are now grouped into categories for easier navigation.

Examples include:

- Latin
- Cyrillic
- Arabic
- Indic
- Asian
- Semitic
- African

---

### ⭐ Recommended Layouts

During setup, KeymapKit automatically recommends layouts based on the current device language.

For example:

- Turkish devices → Turkish Q & Turkish F
- English devices → English US

---

### 🧪 Keyboard Test Area

A new built-in testing area lets you verify your keyboard mapping immediately after installation.

No third-party app is required.

---

### 🔧 Diagnostics

Added a diagnostics screen that shows:

- Active keyboard layouts
- Connected physical keyboards
- Provider status
- Quick refresh

This makes troubleshooting much easier.

---

### ⚡ Better Architecture

Internally the application has been completely reorganized.

# Pixel Launcher Evolved v0.1.6

Tested on a Pixel 8 Pro running Android 17 QPR1 (October 2026), build `CP3A.261005.005`, Pixel Launcher `907`, with Vector 2.2. Every launcher member the module stands on resolves (282 of 282). Your settings carry over untouched.

### Widget stacks

- **Home screen → Widgets → Widget stacks**: several widgets in one place. Drop a widget onto another and hold it a moment, or use **Create stack** in a widget's long-press menu.
- Swipe up or down to switch, or sideways if you choose, with dots beside the stack. A joining widget takes the stack's size where its app allows; a stack holds up to 10.
- **Edit stack** reorders, shows, configures, moves out or removes widgets. **Smart rotate widgets**  shows the widget you set for the time of day as you come back home.
- **Restore standalone widgets** puts every stacked widget back on its own. Without the module nothing is lost: each waiting widget appears on a home screen of its own.

### Per-Mode choices

- Each Mode in **Assign home screens to Modes** now opens as its own page with what changes only while it is on: regular home screens beside its own, hidden apps, apps at the top of the drawer, its own icon pack, wallpaper blur, home screen tint and app labels, and which search results show.
- A Mode deleted in Settings keeps its home screens to give to another Mode.

### Also new

- **App labels**: hide app names on the Home screen, in folders or in the app drawer at once.
- **Rename** shows a live preview, and the icon can be changed from your icon pack.
- **Refresh icons** in Advanced redraws the icon pack's icons without a restart.
- **Layout recovery**, in the module's own app: puts a saved home screen layout back when Pixel Launcher cannot open its settings. Needs root.
- **Diagnostics** shows which features failed to start, and why.

### Fixed

- Modes are read for your own Android user only, deleted Modes no longer come back, and a slow read no longer holds

release.notes:
## 🗺️ A detailed map of the whole world, and routes that go straight into GLYPH

### Download

**GLYPH-1.3.0.apk**: the Android app, for Android 7 or newer. Open it on your phone to install.

The app keeps itself up to date once it is installed. The GLYPH firmware (04.10.26) is inside it:
the app installs it over USB-C with the access code that comes with your GLYPH, and GLYPH then
updates itself over Wi-Fi from **Control › Firmware**.

### What's new

**Maps**
- A **detailed dark map of the whole world**: streets, hiking trails, forest tracks, peaks with their height, rivers, huts and borders.
- **Save area** keeps what you see for use with no signal. **Save for this route** keeps a 2 km band along your route.
- With no signal you still get a world map with towns, forests and borders.
- Places worldwide are found offline: every town and village with 500 people or more is built in.

**Routes**
- Bike and walking routes stay on land instead of taking a ferry.
- A smaller route panel that leaves the map in view.
- **Send to GLYPH** loads the route into the device's own memory, no card needed. The small card button saves it to the memory card only.

**Setup**
- **Install firmware over USB-C, straight from your phone**: the app's first screen, with your GLYPH access code. No computer, no internet.

**Look and feel**
- A cleaner Comms tab, a single "not connected" line in Control, the guided tour always on screen, and the map credits folded into a small **i**.

See the full [changelog](https://github.com/Mqr1oo/GLYPH/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

### Checksums

release.name: Xpense Tracker v1.0.5 — Glass that bends light
release.notes:
## Xpense Tracker v1.0.5

> ### ✅ Installs straight over v1.0.4
> No uninstall, nothing to back up first. (Coming from **v1.0.2 or earlier**? That one still needs
> the uninstall-and-restore dance — see the v1.0.3 notes.)

A visual release. The glass chrome introduced in v1.0.4 was doing half its job, and a few screens
had their content sitting in the wrong place under the app bar.

### 🔮 Glass that actually bends light

Bars and sheets already blurred what was behind them. Now they **refract** it: content passing the
edge of a bar bends the way it would through a real pane of glass, rather than just going soft.
Watch a list scroll under the floating nav bar — the rows compress slightly as they cross the rim.

The middle of a surface stays undistorted on purpose, so anything scrolling under the centre of a
bar is still perfectly readable. Warping the whole surface is the look Apple reserves for photo and
video backgrounds; over a screen full of numbers it fights the text.

### 💡 Glass is on, and stays on

The **Reduce transparency** switch is gone. In practice its main effect was leaving the glass turned
off by accident and making the app look flat.

Bars and sheets still go solid **automatically** if you've asked Android for **high contrast** or an
**accessible navigation** mode — that's a real accessibility need and it's still honoured, it just
isn't a toggle buried in Settings any more.

### 🔦 Light mode looks like glass now

In light mode the tint over the blur was thick enough that barely any of what sat behind a bar came
through, so bars read as plain white. They're properly translucent now. Dark mode is unchanged.

### 📐 Content no longer hides under the app bar

- **Records** — the income/expense/net board was tucked underneath the app bar
- **Settings** — the first row was clipped by it
- **Projects** — the opposite problem, a band of empty space above the summary

All three now sit just below the bar at rest, and still scroll underneath it as you go.

---

release.notes:
# Sub2API Batch Tester v1.3.0

v1.3.0 是一次小范围的批量测试并发选项更新。它仍是本地 Sub2API 管理测试客户端，不提供或托管 Sub2API 服务。

## 下载

- `Sub2API-Batch-Tester_1.3.0_windows-x64-setup.exe`：Windows 10/11 x64 的 NSIS 安装程序。
- `Sub2API-Batch-Tester_1.3.0_android-arm64-v8a.apk`：Android 9 / API 28 及以上、64 位 ARM 设备的已签名 APK。
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`：两个安装包的 SHA-256 校验值。
- `LICENSE.txt`：MIT 许可证副本。

Windows 安装程序当前未进行代码签名；Android APK 使用发布签名。请只从此 Release 下载，并先核对 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。

## 变化

- 连接测试并发下拉框现提供连续的 1 至 10。
- 默认并发调整为 5。新登录、没有保存偏好或清空设置后的用户会使用该默认值；已有保存的有效并发设置不会被强制改写。
- 共享 Rust 批处理器同样接受最高 10 并发，因此 Windows 和 Android 的选择、保存、恢复和执行行为一致。

## 使用边界

- 5 并发已在当前已验证的站点中稳定使用，因此作为默认值。6 至 10 并发会同时发起更多既有测试请求；请按上游限流、额度和站点承受能力选择，不代表所有站点均已验证高并发稳定。
- 测试请求的总等待上限保持约 90 秒，不新增自动重试、用户超时设置、后台任务或服务端接口改动。
- Android 批量任务需要应用保持前台；后台、锁屏、系统终止或网络中断后，未完成任务不保证继续执行。

release.name: v0.10.0
release.notes:
## Public domain names: the fips address right after connecting

The first lookup of a public domain served over fips could still take 20–30 s after you connected. Until it finished, the app got the domain's ordinary Internet address. The domain's server was usually several mesh hops away, and finding a route to it took most of that time.

The app now links directly to the servers of the two domains you verified most recently, as soon as it connects. Measured on a Pixel 9 Pro, the first lookup returned the fips address 0.25 s after the query, 4 s after connecting.

This comes with a new switch, on by default: Settings → **Link directly to the servers of domains you use**. A direct link shows that server's operator, and the Nostr relays, that your node talks to that server. Turn the switch off to keep relying on routes through the mesh.

[fips-pub-domains 0.2.10](https://github.com/fr34aky/fips-pub-domains/releases/tag/v0.2.10) also helps:
- it opens the path to pinned servers a few seconds after a connect, before any app asks;
- when a server was unreachable on the first try, it asks again in the background instead of waiting out the whole backoff.

## Network switches

- **The mesh stays up when IPv6 comes or goes.** Switching between an IPv6 network and one without it (often Wi-Fi to mobile data) used to restart the mesh connection for about 6 s. Now only the tunnel is replaced; the node, its links and its sessions stay up. Changing the selected mesh apps works the same way.
- **Stuck connections now close.** After a network switch, a clearnet connection whose server side had died stayed open on the app's side. Apps waited on it until their own timeout (about 70 s in DuckDuckGo). The app now closes it at once, so apps reconnect within about a second.

No new permissions. Installing over 0.9.7 keeps identity and settings.

Checked on a Pixel 9 Pro (arm64). The other two ABIs were built and checked in CI but have not run on hardware for this release.

SIIISHUB 1.4.0 keeps a download going when its connection drops, instead of failing it, and tidies the row of a torrent in the downloads list.

### What's new

- **A lost connection no longer fails a download.** The files of Real-Debrid and AllDebrid, and any direct link, come over one long connection, and over many gigabytes it happens that it drops. release.name: OmniVault v0.2.4
release.notes:
# OmniVault v0.2.4

Send yourself a note from your phone and find it on your laptop, without
opening a browser tab that takes forty seconds and a gigabyte of memory.

Notes, links, screenshots and tickers, kept in folders you choose. Every
device holds its own complete copy. When two of them are awake on the same
Wi-Fi they find each other and exchange what changed.

## What it will not do

There is no server in between. A note written on your phone reaches your
laptop the next time both are open on the same network — not before. Sync
traffic is not encrypted; this is built for a network you control. See the
threat model in the README before using it on shared Wi-Fi.

## Installing

**Windows** — download the zip, extract it, run `omnivault.exe`. No installer
and no runtime to install. Windows will warn that the app is unrecognised,
because the binary is not code-signed.

**Android** — download the APK and open it. Android will ask you to allow
installs from your browser or file manager. One APK covers phones and tablets.

Both are unsigned by a paid authority, so both warn. That is the cost of not
paying a certificate authority, not a sign that something is wrong.

## Verifying what you downloaded

`SHA256SUMS.txt` lists the checksum of each file.

## Known limits

- Windows and Android only. There is no iOS or macOS build.
- Devices sync only while both are open on the same network.
- Deleting a note is immediate and cannot be undone.
