release.name: Castor Android 1.3.0
release.notes:
Castor puts videos and web-page streams from your Android phone on your TV. This update brings the Castor 2.4 casting engine: casts adapt to the speed of the TV's Wi-Fi, DLNA TVs can seek with their own remote, and a TV left paused keeps its connection.

*Versione italiana più sotto.*

## Before you install

- **You have Castor 1.1.0, 1.2.0 or 1.2.1:** install **castor-android.apk** over it. Your TV and settings are kept.
- **You have Castor 1.0.0:** uninstall it first, then install **castor-android.apk**. Version 1.1.0 changed the signing key, so Android cannot update 1.0.0 directly. Uninstalling removes your saved TV and settings, so you will choose them once more.

Works on Android 9 or newer phones (64-bit ARM, which covers current phones).

## What's new

**Casting**
- While a video plays, Castor follows the speed of the TV's Wi-Fi: it sends a lighter picture when the connection slows down and a better one again after a good stretch.
- If a cast had to fall back to a less suitable link, Castor tries the better one again after a while of smooth playback and resumes where it was.
- On DLNA TVs, seeking with the TV's remote now works when Castor sends the video as a single stream with a known length and no generated subtitles.
- A TV left paused for a long time no longer loses the connection and starts the video over.
- The end of a video is no longer cut short: Castor waits for the TV to play what it has already received.
- When a page offers several links, the one whose sound is in your language is tried first.
- Subtitles reach every DLNA TV, Samsung included, in the standard way.

Updated to the Castor 2.4.0 casting engine. Full list: [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/kdpkke/castor-android/blob/android-v1.3.0/android/CHANGELOG.md).

release.name: v1.3.13 — Dolby Vision films now play on TVs without Dolby Vision
release.notes:
## What's new

- Dolby Vision profile 7 films (UHD Blu-ray remuxes) now play on devices without Dolby Vision: you get the picture in HDR10 instead of sound only.
- The "This device can't handle this video track" warning no longer shows when the video is actually playing.

Why it happened: the player only ever fell back to the standard HEVC decoder for Dolby Vision profiles 4 and 8. Profile 7, which is what UHD Blu-ray remuxes use, needs a real Dolby Vision decoder in the media framework, so a device without one had no video decoder at all and the film played with sound only. GTD now offers the HEVC decoder for the base layer of those films, and devices with Dolby Vision keep using it as before.

This APK is arm64 only — it covers the Shield and virtually every Android TV. Use the Play build if your device is 32-bit.

---
Testers welcome — install it, point it at your Emby server and use it normally. Feedback and bug reports are very much appreciated.

release.name: beta-2.0
release.notes:
# VDroid Scripter, beta-2.0

Second beta of VDroid Scripter (Visual Android Scripter). beta-1.0 gave you a library, steps and routes. This release makes them travel: one library now serves phones of different sizes and densities, one route serves any text you pass to it, and typing needs no keyboard setup at all. The AI seat grew the most: two working modes, the ability to see the screen and curate its own icons, and a much smaller bill per turn. Underneath, OCR reads screens it used to miss and the server no longer depends on your distribution's libraries.

## ✨ Highlights

- **⌨️ Typing with no keyboard setup.** `type_text` now reads the open keyboard off the live frame, recognises its layout by the language of the step (QWERTY, AZERTY, QWERTZ, ЙЦУКЕН and the other European layouts) and taps the keys. Capitals go through Shift, digits through the number row, and the locale `numeric` types on a numeric keypad or an app's own dial pad. Nothing about keyboards is stored any more, and the key editor is gone.
- **🧳 A library that travels between phones.** A recorded gesture is scaled to the screen it is replayed on, so it covers the same share of the display. A template image is saved with the screen density of its device and resized to the density of the phone it is searched on. One crop and one recording serve phones of different resolutions, as long as they draw the element the same way.
- **🧮 Routes with arguments.** Put `%s` in the text a route types or looks for, and pass the values when you run it: `args=Молоко&args=Молоко`. One route now adds any item to a basket or messages any contact. `args_locale` names the language of the values, and a wrong number of values is refused before anything runs.
- **✂️ Run any slice of a route.** `end_id` joins `start_id`, both inclusive. Run a route up to a step, from a step, or just the part in between.
- **🧭 Two modes for the AI.** The MCP server starts in **navigator**: it records nothing, treats a request as a go

**卫戍协议：终端（Stronghold-Protocol : Terminal）** —— 《卫戍协议：盟约》的**非官方安卓启动器**，把上游同人复刻一键装进手机，直接在手机上跑起来。

---

## 🤖 本项目完全由 AI 制作

本项目的**全部代码、界面、架构与本文档，100% 由 AI（WorkBuddy）编写**，人类只负责提出需求与真机测试。
请以「AI 生成项目」的预期来使用它 —— 可能有个别粗糙之处，欢迎提 Issue。

## 🙏 致敬上游作者

游戏本体（代码、美术、Spine 模型、音频、玩法、数据）**全部来自上游同人复刻项目**：

### ➡️ https://github.com/sganggs/Stronghold-Protocol ⭐

**没有上游作者的开源，就没有这个启动器，请务必去给上游点一个 Star。**
同时致敬《明日方舟》版权方 **Hypergryph（上海鹰角网络）/ Yostar** —— 相关素材版权归其所有，本项目**不包含、不分发任何游戏素材**。

---

## 本版内容（v0.1）

- 🚀 **一键运行**：内置 Node.js 运行时，手机上直接跑，无需电脑 / 无需 Root
- 📦 **空壳安装**：APK 不含任何游戏代码 / 素材；首次启动自动从上游 Releases 拉取
- ⬇️ **首装自动下载**：下载上游**完整包**（约 556MB，含全部美术 / 音频素材），**多镜像并发测速**自动选最快
- 🔄 **应用内更新**：菜单「检查更新」→ 展示该版本**更新日志** → 原地进度条下载**增量包**（约几 MB）→ 自动重启应用
- 🔍 **启动静默检查**：每次启动后台检查更新，有新版本自动静默下载，不打断当前游戏
- 🌐 **联机**：局域网 / 外部连接（内网穿透）一键切换
- 🔗 **邀请链接直达**：把完整邀请链接粘进大厅密钥框，直接跳转加入
- 📋 **复制联机地址**：一键复制本机局域网地址发给好友
- 🎛 **顶部折叠菜单**：返回本地 / 检查更新 / 复制地址 / 刷新 / 联机方式 / 关于
- 📱 全屏适配（隐藏系统栏、适配刘海 / 挖孔屏）、👤 启动器侧多账号、🧩 全部增强走注入**零改游戏**

## 附件说明

| 文件 | 大小 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `Stronghold-Protocol-Terminal-v0.1-release.apk` | ≈38 MB | **推荐下载**，正式版 |
| `Stronghold-Protocol-Terminal-v0.1-debug.apk` | ≈42 MB | 调试版（含调试符号，一般用不到）|

## 安装与使用

1. 要求 **Android 11+ / arm64-v8a**；首次安装若提示"未知来源"，允许即可。
2. 首次启动会自动从上游下载**完整包**（约 **556MB**，已含全部素材，**建议连 WiFi**），开屏页显示进度。
3. 进入大厅即可单机 / 联机游玩；顶部小箭头展开菜单。

## 注意

- 本启动器**非官方、非商业**，与上游项目作者、与 Hypergryph / Yostar **均无关联、未获授权**。

release.name: QuickSSH 1.25.0
release.notes:
QuickSSH 1.25.0 release build (signed with the Android debug keystore).

New:
- Reverse (-R) tunnels: a server port forwards to a port on the phone. Typical use: expose the built-in SSH server on a jump host (jump:2226 -> phone 8025) so the phone can be reached from anywhere, no Termux needed.
- Resident tunnels: turn on "常驻 / Resident" on a tunnel preset and it starts right away, with the app, after reboots and app updates, and reconnects without a retry limit. On Xiaomi/Redmi (MIUI/HyperOS) allow QuickSSH in Security Center → Auto-start; the tunnel page links there.
- The tunnel page is organised by remote host: workspaces that reach the same host share their tunnel presets.
- Built-in SSH server card: step-by-step guide to log in from a computer (login command, first login with the generated password, one-line command to add your public key for passwordless logins, reverse-tunnel shortcut). The password only lets other devices log in to this phone; it is unrelated to the passwords QuickSSH uses for your servers.
- Agent workspace API / MCP / skill: tunnels accept `direction` (LOCAL / REMOTE) and `autoStart`; resident tunnels an agent creates start immediately.

Fixes:
- Termux setup command: works when `opencode` runs inside proot-distro (the skill and MCP server are registered under the distro's /root, the quickssh CLI finds its token from proot), and the quickssh MCP server is merged into an existing opencode.json (with a backup) instead of only printing a hint.
- While tunnels run, the built-in SSH server and Agent Bridge keep running after the app is closed.

Notes:
- Database upgrade v12 -> v13 (adds tunnel direction / auto-start); existing tunnels are kept as local forwards.

repo.description: 基于Clash Meta for Android改造的Android网络代理客户端分支，重点优化后台连接策略、最近任务隐藏与原生界面体验。

release.name: ClashMetaPlus-1.0.0
release.notes:
# Clash Meta Plus 1.0.0

Clash Meta Plus首个正式发行版本。

本项目基于Clash Meta for Android修改，继续使用Mihomo内核。本次首发主要围绕界面、局域网共享、后台运行和应用更新流程进行调整，保留原有的配置导入、订阅管理、节点选择及规则/全局/直连模式。

## 与原版Clash Meta的主要区别

|项目|Plus版的调整|
|---|---|
|界面|重新调整主页和常用页面，采用大标题、圆角卡片、半透明背景及浅色/深色样式|
|局域网共享|增加独立入口，直接显示其他设备需要填写的IP和代理端口|
|共享端口|提供固定共享端口设置，保存后不再随订阅切换或更新而变化|
|后台运行|增强运行状态保存、服务恢复和连接期间的保活控制|
|应用更新|增加启动检查、后台定期检查、关于页手动检查和应用内APK下载|
|操作体验|修复多处图标按钮过小、难以辨认和点击的问题|

HTTP/SOCKS代理、代理规则和协议支持等基础能力来自原版及Mihomo内核；Plus版主要改进这些能力的入口、设置方式和使用体验。

## 界面与操作调整

- 重新整理主页的连接状态、流量显示、配置、代理及局域网共享入口。
- 统一常用页面的卡片、背景、标题和浅色/深色样式。
- 修复部分按钮尺寸与内边距不匹配，导致图标几乎不可见的问题。
- 放大配置页的添加和更新按钮，以及测速、保存、日志、文件和覆写设置中的相关操作按钮。
- 同步调整加载指示和输入框预留空间，减少按钮与内容挤在一起的情况。

## 局域网共享

- 在主页增加“局域网共享”入口，集中管理局域网访问、共享端口、监听地址和代理认证。
- 显示本机局域网IPv4地址及HTTP/SOCKS代理端口，方便连接热点或同一Wi-Fi的设备填写。
- 增加“固定共享端口（HTTP/SOCKS）”，同一个端口支持两种代理协议。
- 首次进入共享页时优先沿用当前可用端口，没有可用端口时使用7890；返回上一页保存后生效。
- 修复切换订阅后共享端口跟随订阅改变的问题，同时处理普通HTTP/SOCKS监听与复合端口重号的情况。
- 共享页的局域网访问设置改为明确的启用/禁用，减少“不修改”造成的理解偏差。

连接设备仍需配置代理。例如iPhone连接手机热点后，在该Wi-Fi的“配置代理”中选择“手动”，填写安卓手机的热点IP和共享端口。

热点IP由手机系统分配，固定共享端口不会固定热点IP。这项功能也不等于热点透明代理，只有发送到代理入口的流量才会由Clash处理。

## 后台运行

- 增加增强后台保活设置，连接期间可持有CPU部分唤醒锁，减少休眠对运行的影响。
- 完善运行意图保存、服务恢复及启停时的资源清理。
- 提供电池优化、始终开启VPN等相关系统设置入口。
- 最近任务隐藏设置可即时生效，VPN前台运行通知继续保留。

增强保活可能增加耗电，实际后台运行仍受Android和手机厂商的省电策略影响。

## 应用内更新

- 打开应用主页时，在后台检查本项目的GitHub正式发行版本。
- 后台按每3小时安排一次检查，有网络时执行；系统省电限制可能延后执行。
- 在“设置→关于”中增加“检查更新”，可随时手动检查。
- 发现新版后显示版本和更新说明，按设备架构选择APK，在应用内下载并显示进度。
- 离开更新页面后，下载仍由系统下载管理器继续处理，返回后可查看进度。
- 更新页在前台时，下载完成后自动打开系统安装程序；在后台完成时，通过通知提供安装入口。
- 同一新版避免重复通知，安装完成后清理对应的旧下载状态。

首次安装更新可能需要开启“允许来自此来源的应用”，最终安装由系统界面确认。版本比较支持1.0.0、V1.0.1等数字标签，跳过草稿和预发行版本。

## 安装说明

- 最低支持Android5.0，请选择与设备架构匹配的APK。
- 本项目不提供节点或订阅，需自行导入配置。
- 默认包名保留为`com.github.metacubex.clash.meta`。能否覆盖原版或其他修改版，取决于安装包签名是否一致，不能仅凭包名相同判断。
- 覆盖更新需要相同签名和更高的内部安装版本号。遇到签名不一致时，请先确认配置备份与迁移方式，不要直接卸载导致数据丢失。

## 项目来源

Clash Meta Plus是独立修改分支，不是Clash Meta for Android或Mihomo的官方发行版本。项目继续遵循GPLv3，保留上游及第三方版权和许可声明。

> A seamless, lightning-fast, and secure local companion bridge for **Android ↔ Linux** and **Android ↔ Android**, with **zero cloud dependency**.

---

## ✨ What's New & Changes in v1.1.1

### 📞🎙️ Remote Calling & PC Audio Bridge (Call by Number)
Dial phone calls and speak directly through your Linux PC when your phone is across the room:
- **Dial by Number**: Trigger cellular phone calls on your Android phone straight from your Linux terminal (`linlink call <number>` or in-shell `dial <number>`) or mobile app.
- **PC Mic & Speaker Bridge**: Use your computer's microphone to talk and computer speakers/headphones to hear your calls with ultra-low latency.
- **Interactive Call TUI & Controls**: Live call duration timer, real-time VU audio meters for Mic and Speaker, and keyboard shortcuts (`[m]` mute, `[s]` speaker, `[q]`/`[h]` hang up).
- **In-App Call Interface**: Built `CallScreen` and `CallCard` UI with animated voice ripple waves and live equalizer meters.

### 🚀 Online Software Auto-Updater
Check for and download online updates directly from GitHub releases:
- **Linux Companion CLI**: Run `linlink update` or `update` inside `linlink shell` to automatically check versions, fetch release highlights, and perform atomic self-replacement of the binary.
- **Android APK Downloads**: Use `linlink update --apk` to download the latest Android package and auto-send it to your connected phone for instant installation.
- **In-App Mobile Checker**: Added an online update checker directly into the Android **Settings** screen under *About LinLink*.

### 📁 Enhanced Directory & Scoped Storage File Listing
- **Full File & Folder Visibility**: Resolved Android 11+ scoped storage permission scoping in `_handleList`. Both files and directories now display correctly with exact file sizes (`KB`, `MB`, `GB`), types, and modification timestamps.
- **Seamless Shell Navigation**: Fixed remote folder exploration via `ls`, `cd`, `get`, and `cat`

release.name: v1.0.0 · 方舟寻访录
release.notes:
《明日方舟》抽卡记录查询工具的首个版本。按卡池算出**每个 6 星实际花了多少抽**。

## 下载

| 文件 | 平台 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `arklog.exe` | Windows 64 位 | 双击即用，首次启动自动生成 `config.yaml` 并打开浏览器 |
| `arklog.apk` | Android 7.0+ | **仅 arm64-v8a**（目前绝大多数手机都是） |

两端功能完全一致 —— 安卓版内部就是把同一个 Go 服务跑起来，用 WebView 显示页面。

```
SHA256
1639e862efc3bff4b0d2c399f9c7af8ffb757621ca24de4463fe2194715a61d1  arklog.exe
4b2a97685d23556f36fca265f798cd802941673117a3671e8a361587cb0ae650  arklog.apk
```

## 功能

- 四栏横排：**普通池 / 限定池 / 中坚池 / 全部抽卡记录**
- 每期卡池各成一块、可折叠；每个 6 星一行，点开看这一段抽到的 5★ / 4★ / 3★
- 每个 6 星显示**实际花了多少抽**，按抽数分四档配色；跨期结转标「上期结转 N 抽」
- 首次获得的干员标 `new`
- 总览统计：总抽数、6★/5★ 个数与出现率、平均 / 最惨 / 最快出金间隔
- 全部记录支持按卡池、星级、名称筛选与排序

## 登录

**手机号 + 短信验证码**，仅此一种，全程不接触也不保存密码。
凭据只留在本机进程内存里，不写磁盘、不下发给浏览器，关闭程序即失效。

只支持国服。国际服用 Yostar 账号体系，官方也没有提供抽卡记录接口。
B服 角色若绑在同一个鹰角账号下可通过 `binding_index` 选到，但**未经验证**。

## 已知限制

- 官方接口能回溯的历史有限，`data/` 目录是唯一的长期存档，**搬走程序时记得一起带上**
- 两端存档目前无法互相同步

## 说明

第三方工具，与鹰角网络无任何隶属或合作关系。只读取你自己账号的抽卡记录，
不修改游戏数据。请勿把 `delay_ms` 调得过小。详见 README 的免责声明。

许可证 GPL-3.0。

release.notes:
《明日方舟：终末地》抽卡记录查询工具的首个发布版本。用鹰角账号手机短信登录，
拉取抽卡记录并在本地网页上按卡池展示 —— 重点是算出每个 6 星实际花了多少抽。

## 下载

| 文件 | 平台 | 大小 |
|---|---|---|
| `endlog.exe` | Windows 64 位 | 7.6 MB |
| `endlog.apk` | Android arm64-v8a，最低 Android 7.0 | 3.0 MB |

## 使用

**Windows** — 双击 `endlog.exe`，首次运行会在同目录生成 `config.yaml` 并自动打开浏览器。
抽卡记录存在同目录的 `data/` 里。

**Android** — 安装后打开，点「启动服务」再点开网页。仅支持 arm64-v8a。

两端都是本地运行：账号 token 只留在内存，不落盘、不外发，网页只在本机监听。

## 记录会累积

官方接口只保留一段时间的记录。本程序每次同步都与本地存档合并，按卡池各记增量水位，
所以长期使用能攒出比官方接口更完整的历史。**换机器或重装时记得把 `data/` 目录一起带走。**

## 校验

```
sha256  endlog.exe  77f6c2a7ee44f44654457af2722b1ddf92b0bd5c36775e0aca4a9993c96af19b
sha256  endlog.apk  e1871366c21cd1c5421e4267a5563fa0603f25a6d7c5cf1cb9f9eb415ab182d5
```

APK 用自签名密钥签的，安装时系统会提示来源未知，属正常现象。

## 说明

自用工具，非官方，与鹰角网络无关。GPL-3.0。

release.notes:
# Kern v1.0.2 (build 261029)

The second release. Two things shaped it: **package management in the Linux environment finally works**, and **the agent stopped doing things you did not ask for**.

No account, no cloud, no root, no desktop — still just a folder, an OpenAI-compatible endpoint and your phone.

---

## Highlights

**`apt install` works.**

This was the bug that mattered. Every file extracted from the Ubuntu rootfs now keeps the permission bits recorded in the archive, instead of only gaining the execute bit. The hard-link fallback was the culprit: Android refuses `Files.createLink` on app storage, the file was copied instead, and the copy kept the umask — so `/usr/bin/perl` arrived as `0600`. `dpkg-preconfigure` and the debconf frontend are perl scripts, which is why every install died with `Permission denied`, exited 126, and left packages half-configured. Fixed at the extractor, verified on device: `apt-get install -y git` now ends with `git version 2.43.0`.

**The package screen lists packages.**

A fresh image has no apt index, and `apt-cache pkgnames` answers with a handful of names instead of nothing — so an almost-empty list looked like a complete catalogue. Anything under a hundred names is now treated as a missing index and triggers one `apt-get update` plus a re-list, with the ten-minute package budget instead of the shared two-minute cap.

**The agent stays in its lane.**

Every shell command is re-entered in the workspace root, so a single `cd` in one command can no longer move every later command out of the project. It also no longer browses `/sdcard`, `/sdcard/Downloads` or other device storage unless you ask it to.

**Memory is reference, not a to-do list.**

Memory used to read like the model's own notes, so a task from weeks ago could be picked up again in a fresh conversation — an old "build a React + Vite app" request, for example. It is now described to the model as background about the codebase, never a task list, and work in it is o

release.notes:
## 证道 v2.2.1 — 正式版

v2.2.0 之后的一批：小说工程、工作区放开、记忆、文生图、计划卡降噪，以及一批修复。

> 覆盖安装即可，数据与环境保留；门槛不变：Android 16（API 36）＋ arm64。

**下载提速（并入凌晨 2.2.1 的内容）**

- 环境包改 **4 路分片多连接**下载：谁快谁多拉，断一条只补那一片；不支持分片的服务端自动退回单连接，断点续传。
- 进度从「20% 一档」改成「1% 一档」（约每 1–2 MB 跳一个数字）。
- 修掉两个续传老问题：续传写盘会截断已下载分片、分片合并后没改名到目标文件。
- 实测同一台手机：单连接 20–170 KB/s → 分片后 0.6–1.4 MB/s（网络差别大，不承诺固定倍数）。

### 本版新增

**① 小说工程 v1（W1/W2）**
- `novel_create` 建项目（过 CONFIRM，目录已存在就拒绝、不覆盖）；`novel_project` 看总览（章节、字数、人物/设定）；`novel_continue` 给**续写简报**（接哪一章、接哪一段、本章目标字数与差距、人物一致性提示）。
- 项目落在 `小说/<书名>/`：`book.json` ＋ `正文/`，**一章一个文件**；正文仍走 `write_file` / `edit_file`，不另开写盘路径。

**② 工作区放开**
- 越界不再硬拒：`WorkspaceAccess` 判「内 / 需问 / 拒」，**一次运行问一次**，同意即放行；回收站与备份的保护不动。可以直接让它处理工作区外的目录（比如 Obsidian 库）。

**③ 记忆能力批**
- 情景记忆日记层＋日记检索；同日多轮累计不再撞 provenance 闸；`list_dir` 的路径可以省略。

**④ 文生图**
- Gemini 生图/改图：按一句话画图，或照着工作区里的图改；**每次一张确认卡**，会烧额度。
- 工具参数表改走 `parametersJsonSchema`；执行时**现取 Key**（避免装配时池子冷却把空 Key 固化）。

**⑤ 计划卡降噪**
- 同一版计划只按「排版归一化」判断：**被拒过的不重复弹卡**；只有明确点拒才记账。

**⑥ 小修**
- 「关于」页显示**构建 commit**，用来分辨手机里装的到底是哪一次构建。
- 自定义通道指向 Google 时强制走原生协议（工具参数表才完整）。
- 工具约束类建议可采纳——落点是自己的人设（C 层），走既有备份通道。

### 修复

- Gemini 原生工具参数 `type` 必须小写（大写会被当成没有参数表）。
- 157/MEM-D1：同日多轮日记累计不再撞 provenance 闸。
- `libzhengdao_core.so` 回编并刷新同源基线（改了 Rust 源码未重编导致 CI 红）。
- 移除误入库的本地构建临时目录。
- 文件头统一为「本项目原创、不含第三方源码拷贝」（仅注释，不改行为）。

### 质量读数

- 全量单测：**4927 例 / 0 失败 / 0 错误**（收口复跑）。
- lint：**235 总 / 0 error**（基线锁 235，上调即解冻）。
- 清债：24 个已合并分支清理完毕，在飞表归零。

### 说明

- 版本号：`versionName 2.2.1`、`versionCode 39`。
- 本版不含破坏性改动；升级不需要重下环境。

release.name: Lockstep 1.0
release.notes:
Lockstep 1.0 — the first release.

Two-factor codes generated entirely on your device. No account, no cloud, and
no internet permission.

**What it does**
- Add accounts by scanning a QR code or entering a setup key
- Scanned codes are shown for confirmation before anything is saved
- TOTP and HOTP, with SHA-1/SHA-256/SHA-512
- Group and search your accounts, drag to reorder
- Tap a code to copy; the clipboard clears itself
- Encrypted backup and restore, protected by a password you choose
- Auto-lock on a timer you set, and the moment you leave the app
- Light and dark, following your system theme

**Security**
- Secrets encrypted with AES-256-GCM under a key held in the Android Keystore,
  hardware-backed where the device supports it, and released only after you
  authenticate
- Codes kept out of screenshots and the app switcher
- Backups protected by an Argon2id-derived key
- Excluded from Android's automatic cloud backup
- The app requests one permission: camera, and only for scanning

**Requirements**
Android 11 (API 30) or newer, with a screen lock set and a fingerprint enrolled.

Storage to Dropbox and other cloud services through the file manager (document provider) works, however some services in particular, namely Dropbox, might fail, due to the way that Dropbox handles locks on its files, in which case you will get an integrity check error and the option to retry, which you can do until it passes.   (needs the GNOME 49 runtime from Flathub: `flatpak install flathub org.gnome.Platform//49`)
- **macOS (Apple Silicon & Intel):** open `Vaulti-macos-universal.dmg`, drag Vaulti to Applications.

- **Android (arm64):** download `Vaulti-android-arm64.apk` on the phone and open it
  (allow installing from your browser). Alpha builds may be test-signed: if an update
  won't install, uninstall the old version first.

### Get started
1. Create your vault on the computer. Write down the backup code.
2. On the computer: **Devices → Pair new device**. On the phone: **Scan QR code**.
3. Check that both show the same 6-digit code and confirm on the computer.
4. Unlock on the phone with your master password. Both sync whenever they're online together.

﻿First public release of VaultSnap -- a local-only password manager for Android. No cloud. No accounts. No telemetry.

Download `VaultSnap-v1.0.0.apk` below. Sideload on Android 8.0+ (API 26+).

**SHA-256**

```
3c11e698f6ef1564fbf5efa9545ec23727d2bfdb41092ee3a0e129d3bdf28112
```

Verify after download:

```
sha256sum VaultSnap-v1.0.0.apk
```

## Highlights

- AES-GCM-256 encryption under a single Vault Master Key derived via Argon2id
- Android Autofill with biometric unlock and per-entry website / app linking

- Encrypted backups with a dry-run verify wizard
- Recovery question path if the master password is forgotten
- Wall-clock auto-lock that wipes the master key from RAM
- Sensitive clipboard masking on Android 13+
- **Zero `INTERNET` permission in the release build**

## Verify the no-network guarantee

```
git clone https://github.com/cedsceds-12/vaultsnap.git
cd vaultsnap
pwsh ./scripts/verify_release_manifest.ps1
```

The script builds a release APK and asserts the merged `AndroidManifest.xml` contains only `USE_BIOMETRIC` (plus benign auto-added entries from `local_auth` and AndroidX). Any other permission fails the script.

Quick check on the published APK:

```
aapt dump permissions VaultSnap-v1.0.0.apk
```

`android.permission.INTERNET` will not appear. By design.

# NebulaLock v1.2 发布说明

本次更新聚焦于隐私增强与功能拓展，让密码管理更全面、更安全。

---

## ✨ 新功能：内置 2FA 生成器

现在你可以在 NebulaLock 中直接管理双因素验证（2FA）令牌，无需额外安装应用。

- 支持手动输入 Base32 密钥，或通过扫描二维码快速添加账户。
- 实时生成动态验证码，每 30 秒自动刷新，点击即可复制到剪贴板。
- 所有密钥通过 Android Keystore 加密存储，与密码本享有同等级别的保护。

---

## 🔒 元数据加密：隐藏文件名与数量

此前 `images` 和 `files` 列表在 JSON 文件中明文存储，可能暴露文件数量、名称等敏感信息。  
**v1.2 开始，所有图片和文件的元数据（文件名、大小、MIME 类型）均会被加密存储**，只有成功解密后方可查看。

- 旧版本文件在首次打开时会自动迁移，兼容无痛升级。
- 元数据加密进一步提升了隐私保护，即使文件被窃取，攻击者也无法得知你存了哪些文件。

---

## 🔁 重置主密钥优化：不再清空数据

之前勾选“重置一级密钥”会直接清空保险箱内容，现在改为**保留所有数据**。重置过程中：

- 系统会使用旧密钥解密所有内容，再用新密钥重新加密图片、文件及元数据。
- 耗时操作会显示实时进度（如“正在重新加密文件…”），避免界面假死。
- 既更换了主密钥，又保证了数据完整不丢失。

---

## 🕵️ 隐私清理：移除 NFC 传输日志

- 彻底注释了 `NfcTransferActivity` 和 `NfcTransferService` 中的所有日志输出，确保 NFC 传输过程真正无痕，不留任何系统日志。

---

## 📱 其他改进

- 修复了若干场景下的应用崩溃问题。
- 优化了部分界面的显示细节和操作稳定性。

---

欢迎下载体验，如有问题或建议请在 GitHub Issues 中反馈。感谢大家的支持！

repo.description: A decentralized, off-grid messaging concept using Bluetooth LE advertising to broadcast messages without pairing or internet.

release.name: v1.0.0 - EchoSphere
release.notes:
Project Overview

EchoSphere is a decentralized, off-grid communication tool for Android. This application allows users to broadcast short text messages to nearby devices without requiring an internet connection, cellular data, or the traditional Bluetooth pairing process.

How it Works: Range and Technology
The application utilizes Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) Advertising. Instead of connecting to a specific device, the app "shouts" small packets of data into the surrounding environment.

Transmission Range: The effective distance for receiving messages typically spans between 10 and 30 meters (30 to 100 feet).

Variable Factors: This range depends strictly on the hardware of the smartphones involved and physical obstacles. In open spaces without interference, the signal can reach its maximum distance, while walls or electronic interference may reduce the radius.

Proximity Protocol: Because it uses BLE Advertising, the "Echo" is received by any device running the app within the broadcast sphere, making it ideal for hyper-local communication.

---------------------------------

**Installation Instructions**

Download the EchoSphere_v1.0.apk file.

During installation, Android may prompt a security warning (Play Protect) because the app is self-signed. Select "Install Anyway".

Grant the necessary Bluetooth and Location permissions (required by Android for BLE scanning).

release.name: Safi — GitHub build #12.1
release.notes:
## صافي — بناء من المصدر داخل GitHub Actions

نزّل ملف `Safi-*-github.apk` من Assets وثبّته على أندرويد 8 أو أحدث.
الملف موقّع بنفس شهادة النسخة الأصلية؛ الروت غير مطلوب ولا يطلب التطبيق صلاحياته.

هذه نسخة تجريبية. نجح البناء والاختبارات الآلية في GitHub، ونجح أيضًا فحص المحاكي عبر UID منفصل (8 اختبارات: حجب UDP/TCP، والنطاقات المسموحة، ومُحلِّل النظام). نجاح البناء والفحص لا يعني أنها اختُبرت على كل هاتف.
يحجب التطبيق مصادر الإعلانات عبر DNS، ولا يضمن إزالة إعلانات يوتيوب أو إعلانات نفس نطاق المحتوى.
لا يعمل مع VPN آخر، ولا تفعّل معه «حظر الاتصالات بدون VPN».

يوجد اختيار لمزوّد DNS المشفّر (Cloudflare افتراضيًا، وأيضًا AdGuard DNS وGoogle)، وقائمة إضافية اختيارية من رابط https،
وزر في الاختصارات السريعة، ودعم «VPN دائم التشغيل» مع تحذير صريح من خيار حظر الاتصالات بدون VPN.
لا توجد نتيجة مؤكدة بأن إعلان Passion Drama Lite اختفى.
يمكن تشغيل فحص DNS بموافقة منفصلة لمدة دقيقتين: حتى 128 سجلًا في ذاكرة الجهاز، وقد يشمل أي تطبيق مفتوح، ولا يُرفع التقرير تلقائيًا.
حجب شبكة الإعلان قد يمنع أيضًا فتح حلقة تشترط مشاهدة إعلان، ولا يفتحها بداله.

المستودع عام، فالتنزيل لا يحتاج تسجيل دخول.
الكود المقابل متاح في ملفات Source code لهذا الوسم، تحت GPL-3.0، بلا ضمان.
بصمات APK ومعلومات المصدر والتوقيع مرفقة مع الإصدار.

[نطاق التحقق في هذا الإصدار](https://github.com/Pomtoto/safi-adblock/blob/8509e11ebc68f67853eaaf236beebd9b1d59998f/tests/UPDATE-1.2.md)

release.name: YourTOBA 0.1.0
release.notes:
First release. Two builds from one codebase, sharing the same ad stripping.

| File | Install on | Interface |
|---|---|---|
| `YourTOBA-tv-0.1.0.apk` | Fire TV, Android TV | Leanback (`youtube.com/tv`), remote control |
| `YourTOBA-Mobile-0.1.0.apk` | Android phones | The ordinary mobile site (`m.youtube.com`), touch |

Different package names, so both can be installed side by side.

**Requires Fire OS, not Vega OS.** The Fire TV Stick 4K Select (Oct 2025) and
Fire TV Stick HD (2026) run Vega and cannot sideload at all. `minSdk` is 21, so
Fire OS 5 through 8 all install.

### What it does

Ads are removed from YouTube's own innertube JSON before the player ever learns
they exist, so there is no ad to skip. Network-level blocking of ad and tracker
hosts sits behind that as a supporting layer.

### If the picture is black but audio plays

That is the WebView decoding video into a layer the compositor never shows.
Press **Menu**, then **Up/Down** to change layer type, and **Select** to run a
bundled video self-test that tells you whether frames are decoding at all.

### Signing

These are signed with a personal sideload key that is not in the repository.
Building from source generates your own, so an APK you build cannot be installed
over one from here without uninstalling first.

Data Saver — Usage & Blocker, version 0.8 (versionCode 8).

Same build as the Google Play release of this version.

## What changed since 0.7

- **The bulk-restrict and monthly-bundle dialogs are translated.** Their titles, bodies and
  buttons were English string literals in code, so on an Arabic, Urdu or Hindi phone the
  dialog that asks you to approve restricting five apps at once appeared in English. Three

  than the app's chosen one.

- **A Source code row in Settings**, opening this repository.
- **A rating prompt**, once, after a week of blocking actually running. Decline and it waits
  a month. It is the app's own dialog; no Play library is linked.
- **One build, no flavours.** The Play in-app review library was removed, so the only
  dependency is `androidx.core:core-ktx` and the dex contains no `com/google/android/play`.

## Permissions

Six, and no `INTERNET`. Check it yourself:

```
aapt dump permissions DataSaver-v0.8.apk
```

| Permission | Why |
|---|---|
| `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE` | tell mobile data from Wi-Fi |

| `PACKAGE_USAGE_STATS` | read per-app data figures (you grant this by hand) |
| `POST_NOTIFICATIONS` | the engine's own status notification |
| `RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED` | restore blocking after a reboot |

Blocking uses `VpnService` in package-list mode — no packet forwarding, no tunnel, nothing
leaves the device. No analytics, no crash reporter, no account.

- **Negotiated USB link:** the Windows client reports whether the connected
  phone is actually using Low, Full, High, SuperSpeed or SuperSpeedPlus.
- **USB 2 fallback warning:** VeXArk highlights when a USB 3-capable phone has
  negotiated only the 480 Mbit/s High-Speed mode.
- **Real throughput:** a 256 MiB generated stream measures ADB and Fast Wi-Fi
  without opening photos, videos or other personal files.
- **Integrity checked:** every probe is validated with SHA-256.
- **Clear recommendation:** the client recommends ADB or Fast Wi-Fi and
  estimates transfer time for 10, 50 and 100 GiB.
- **No test artifacts:** the benchmark does not create a temporary media file
  on the phone or computer.

The release build was validated on a Xiaomi 15 with a custom ROM. With a USB
2.0 cable, Windows correctly reported High-Speed and VeXArk measured about
39.4 MiB/s through ADB. Encrypted Fast Wi-Fi measured approximately
50–58 MiB/s under the tested network conditions and was recommended
automatically.

Throughput depends on the cable, USB controller, phone, access point and
computer. A cable's charging wattage does not indicate its data speed.

## Summary

Daily Notes v1.2.0 turns tags into part of the writing flow and adds optional WebDAV synchronization. Notes remain local-first, while users who provide their own WebDAV account can merge changes across devices without handing data to a built-in service.

- Type `#tags` and `#parent/child` directly beside note text.
- Browse tags from a persistent desktop sidebar or a mobile side sheet.
- Filter a whole tag branch and open a random active note for review.
- Test and securely save a WebDAV endpoint, username, password, and remote directory.
- Synchronize both sides by note ID and `updatedAt`, preserving local-only and remote-only notes.

- **Stacked Photo Effects**: Added a visual "stack" indicator for prompts containing multiple reference images.

## 🛡 Advanced Selection & Workflow
- **Power-User Selection Mode**: Enter a new bulk-editing mode via long-press. Support for **Multi-Select Export, Multi-Select Cloud Upload, and Multi-Select Delete**.
- **Context-Aware Back Navigation**: Pressing the Android back button while selecting items now intelligently exits selection mode first, preventing accidental app closures.
- **Vault UI Overhaul**: Moved Search and Filter tools directly into the main Vault header for immediate access, reducing the steps needed to find secure prompts.

> **本次恢复强制自动完整备份与写后读回校验，活动写入仍采用固定 Toybox `dd`。** 用户确认后必须先完整备份目标并通过 `verifyBackup`；写入和同步后，精确字节范围的长度/SHA-256 必须与写前源一致，并再次复核源文件，才能成功。备份或校验不可跳过。**这不是镜像兼容性、设备安全、可启动性、可恢复性或掉电持久性认证。** 本文是发布输入；实际 CI、签名与产物证据由工作流追加在后面，GitHub 发布状态以发行页面为准；文档本身不预先宣称完成。

## 本次变化

### 1. 确认后必须先备份完整分区

- 保留单个危险确认框，展示目标名、路径、源文件实际字节数、警告与免责声明；不要求准确输入目标名。
- 不再是确认后立即 `dd`。每次写入任务自动读取**整个目标分区**，不是只备份将写入的前缀；已有手动备份不能替代本次自动备份。
- 复用现有 `SafetyPolicy.backup` 和备份实现，不新建绕过读取限制的通道。DATA、挂载中/挂载状态未知、映射/映射状态未知、无效或未知容量/身份等不能通过；`Risk.UNKNOWN`/`Risk.CRITICAL` 分类本身不一定拒绝读取。
- 使用设置中明确选择的 **`/sdcard/download` 或 `/sdcard/Download`**；目录不存在或不可写时失败，绝不静默切换大小写或回退另一位置。
- 空间至少为完整分区容量加 **64 MiB**；短镜像也不减少备份需求。空间检查不是容量预留，其他进程仍可耗尽空间。
- 每次建立唯一任务目录，先写 `.img.partial`，同步、检查完整长度与 SHA-256，复核目标身份和文件摘要后提交镜像及元数据。不覆盖已有任务备份；孤立镜像或 `.partial` 不是完整备份成功。
- 写入协调器必须再执行 **`verifyBackup`**，核对文件长度、摘要及提交元数据。策略、身份、读取路径互锁、目录、空间、备份或复核任一失败都不得启动本次 `dd`。

**影响：不满足现有备份政策的目标不能写。** 本版不是“所有分区/整盘均可无条件直接写入”，也没有“跳过备份继续”选项。

### 2. 源摘要与写后精确范围校验

- 文件仍从 `content://` 流复制到私有普通文件，不修改原文档，不按镜像格式解析、解压、展开或转换。
- 自动备份及复核后，重新测量私有源的**实际长度和 SHA-256**，作为写前基准，不只依赖提供器长度或导入时统计；与已确认的导入字节数不符或摘要无效时不启动 `dd`，但不要求源与分区等长。
- 仍使用固定 `/system/bin/toybox dd`，保留基本路径限制与 Shell 引用，不提供任意 Shell。仅 `dd` 返回 0 后独立调用 `/system/bin/toybox sync`。
- 写后由**只读助手**通过已安装 APK 的 `CLASSPATH` 和 `app_process` 流式读回目标 `[0, 写前源长度)`，核对实际长度和 SHA-256。读取不足、I/O 异常、助手失败或结果不符均不能成功。
- 不生成另一份大型临时读回镜像，不依赖 `dd | sha256sum` 等可能掩盖上游读取错误的 Shell 管道。
- 最后再次测量源文件长度/SHA-256，检测相对写前基准的变化；读回比较使用的是**写前源**，不能用已改变的源重定义成功基准。这不是从导入起锁定内容，也不能排除检查之间修改后又恢复的竞态。
- 自动备份、`verifyBackup`、写前源摘要、`dd`、`sync`、精确范围读回与源复核全部成功后，才记录 `SUCCESS`。只有 `dd`/`sync` 返回 0 已不再足够。

```text
明确确认
  → 现有策略准入 → 完整自动备份 → verifyBackup
  → 写前源实际长度 + SHA-256
  → 固定 dd → 独立 sync
  → 只读助手精确范围读回长度/SHA-256，与写前源比较
  → 源长度/SHA-256 再复核 → SUCCESS
```

固定写入与同步命令（两次独立调用）：

```text
/system/bin/toybox dd if=<引用后的私有文件路径> of=<引用后的已发现 /dev/block 路径> bs=1048576
/system/bin/toybox sync
```

### 3. 保留的界面、发现与任务边界

- 修复主页重复“点击获取分区表”提示：只保留一个 **“一键获取分区表”** 按钮，初始诊断为空；读取时仅显示一次 **“正在读取分区表”**，隐藏旧诊断。详细诊断也不会重

release.name: EatBefore 1.17.0
release.notes:
Четырнадцать новых возможностей и шесть исправлений. Решения о новых полях карточки, заморозке и разделении партии — ADR-0009.

Запас и сроки

• «Держать дома минимум». В карточке продукта задаётся, сколько должно быть дома. Когда остаётся меньше, продукт сам попадает в список покупок — откуда бы его ни списали: из карточки, со списка или из уведомления.
• «Напоминать заранее» — своё окно для отдельного продукта: мясо за неделю, крупа за день. Уведомление и карточка считают «скоро» по нему.
• Заморозить и разморозить. Перенос в морозилку предлагает новый срок (курица — 9 месяцев, фарш и рыба — 3, хлеб — 3), из морозилки — день-три. «Оставить как есть» — одно нажатие.
• Разделить партию. Переложить можно часть: половину фарша в морозилку, остальное — на ужин. Цена делится по количеству. Отмена собирает партию обратно.
• Календарь сроков («Ещё → Календарь сроков»): месяц сеткой, на каждом дне — сколько истекает, под сеткой — что именно.

Быстрее

• Ярлыки на иконке: долгое нажатие — «Сканировать», «Добавить», «Домашнее», «Покупки».
• Плитка «Сканировать» в шторке быстрых настроек.
• Список из мессенджера: «Поделиться» текстом → «В список покупок». Каждая строка или пункт через запятую становятся строкой списка, «x2» и «2 шт» — количеством, маркеры и галочки убираются, повторы сливаются.
• Подсказки названий в форме добавления: известные продукты подставляют бренд, категорию, единицы и штрихкод, и упаковка ложится на существующую карточку.
• «Купили снова?» на главном: частые покупки, которых сейчас нет дома, добавляются одним нажатием — сколько, куда и на сколько дней, как в прошлый раз.

Аналитика и данные

• Почему выбросили: при «Выбросить» можно (не обязательно) указать причину — испортилось, забыли, купили много, не понравилось. В аналитике — раздел «Почему выбрасываем».
• История цен в карточке: цена за единицу в последней покупке, средняя и насколько дороже или дешевле прошлого раза.
• Итоги недели: в воскресенье вечером уведомление — сколько съели, сколько выб

release.notes:
# v1.0.0 — Daily Ledger · 日常记账

English | [简体中文](#简体中文)

Initial public preview for Windows and Android, published on 2026-10-12.

## Downloads

- `daily-ledger-1.0.0-android-debug.apk`: installable, debug-signed Android development build. Requires Android 7.0 / API 24 or newer, arm64-v8a or x86_64, and Android System WebView.
- `daily-ledger-1.0.0-windows-source.zip`: Windows source package. Requires Python with Tkinter, SQLite 3.37+, and CustomTkinter 6.0.0. Verified with Python 3.14.4. Extract it, install `requirements.txt`, and run `python app.py` or double-click `启动记账.cmd`.
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`: checksums for the APK and Windows ZIP.

Both source projects are included in the repository. All published guides and release descriptions present English first and Chinese second. The current app interfaces use Chinese.

## Included features

Expense CRUD and filters; exact RMB amounts up to six decimal places; annual calendar and daily/monthly/yearly totals; category statistics; monthly budgets; product prices and quantity calculations; filtered CSV export; complete SQLite backup and restore.

Each version stores data locally. Move data between versions by exporting a SQLite backup and restoring it on the other device. Restore replaces the complete ledger, budgets, and products. There is no automatic synchronization.

## Current limits

- Android is a debug build; Android 16/17 device acceptance is pending. Static APK checks and Python/browser tests do not establish device compatibility.
- Windows is distributed as source and requires Python. A standalone Windows EXE is not included.
- Restore requires the current ledger to be readable. It cannot repair a current database that is already too damaged to open.
- Android draft state covers page refresh, without guaranteeing recovery after process termination. Export an accessible backup before uninstalling or changing phones.

Personal databases, import records, backups, logs, local toolchains, and signing keys are exclude

release.name: MutCube v0.1.3 — First GitHub Prerelease
release.notes:
# MutCube v0.1.3 · 首个 GitHub 预发布版本

MutCube 是开源 Android AI 客户端与模板服务平台。本次为开发阶段预发布，采用 MIT 许可证；名称与 Logo 的商标使用权不随软件许可证自动授予。

## 主要功能

- 多 Provider 与模型管理，支持 OpenAI-compatible、Google 和 Anthropic 协议。
- 项目与聊天、消息分支、Markdown、图片与文档附件、收藏、搜索及生成统计。
- Agent Skills、MCP 工具、项目记忆与上下文管理。
- TTS/ASR 服务配置、朗读停止、音色选择和录音波形。
- 内置健身模板：资料整理、AI 候选计划、实际训练记录和日历；计划经用户启用才生效。
- 第三方模板包导入、项目授权、声明式数据/AI Action、浏览器 SDK 与 Mock Host；英语学习模板为官方开发样板。
- 本地、WebDAV 与 S3 备份恢复；API Key 等凭据不进入备份。

## 下载与安装

- 下载 Release 附件 `MutCube-0.1.3-release.apk`，支持 Android 8.0（API 26）及以上。
- 正式包名为 `com.dwl.mutcube`，版本号 `0.1.3`，`versionCode=4`。
- 与本机此前分发的 0.1.2 使用同一发布证书，可覆盖升级；升级前建议备份数据。
- Debug/Alpha 包使用独立包名，数据不会自动迁移到正式版。
- `SHA256SUMS.txt` 提供 APK 完整性校验。APK 不附带 API Key、发布证书或用户数据，AI 功能需要自行配置服务。

## 验证与边界

- [GitHub CI](https://github.com/damonwl/MutCube/actions/runs/37720330804) 的 Android 单元测试/Lint/Debug 与 Release 构建、SDK 检查及数据库模拟器测试全部通过。
- 发布 APK 使用原发布证书签名，并核验包名、版本、签名和对齐；构建与签名校验不等同于所有真实模型和设备组合的人工验收。
- 本版本仍属预发布：没有账号同步、模板市场或第三方开发者签名认证；Android Skills 不执行附带脚本；健身模板每自然日仅支持一份训练记录。
- 不保证所有模型厂商支持相同的工具、图片和语音协议。AI 建议需自行核对，不替代专业或医疗意见。

## English

The first GitHub prerelease of MutCube: an MIT-licensed Android AI client and template service platform with multi-provider chat, Agent Skills, MCP, voice, project memory, backups, a built-in fitness template, and an English-learning SDK starter.

Download `MutCube-0.1.3-release.apk` for Android 8.0+. Package: `com.dwl.mutcube`; version code: 4. It uses the same release certificate as the previously distributed 0.1.2 APK. Back up your data before upgrading; Debug/Alpha data does not automatically transfer. Configure your own Providers and credentials. Verify the APK with `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

All three GitHub verification jobs passed for the release code. This is a development prerelease, not a guarantee of compatibility with every device or AI service. Account synchronization, a template marketplace, authenticated third-party packages, and Skill script execution are not available.

release.notes:
**Budge 0.1.1** — the same app, written down better.

## What changed

Every string you read in the app was rewritten. Not the words — the shape of the sentences.
Release notes used to be one long line with six fixes strung together by semicolons. The
licence page used a colon and a list, and ended with a sentence that said what the app does
*not* do in the most complicated way available. A few lines explained how honest the app was
being instead of simply stating the fact.

Chinese had its own version of the same problem: 分号串, 四字并列, 书面语 connectors. Those are
gone too.

## What did not change

Nothing else. No behaviour, no feature, no fix, no setting, no data. The diff against
`0.1.0` touches two files — `values/strings.xml` and `values-zh/strings.xml` — and contains
no line that is not a string value. The only line of app code added is this release's own
history entry, which every release needs so that the version window can say what it changed.

The other seven languages still have the older phrasing, so their text is one voice behind.
Keys and format specifiers are unchanged everywhere, which is what the build checks.

## How to report a bug or propose a change

This release also puts a stated route on the repository, instead of leaving you to guess:

- **[Report a bug](https://github.com/stephen2754/budge/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml)** — the form asks for your app version, the steps that reproduce it, your Android version and device, and how you installed the build. Those are the things that make a report actionable.
- **[Suggest a change](https://github.com/stephen2754/budge/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml)** — describe the problem you are in before the solution you have in mind.
- **[Open a pull request](https://github.com/stephen2754/budge/compare)** — the template's checklist is short, and [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/stephen2754/budge/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) explains how to build the app, the rules that break the build if you igno

release.notes:
# 📱 KeepMe v1.0.2 — Unlimited Cloud Storage for Android

Transform your personal Telegram account into high-speed, unlimited cloud storage.

### ✨ Key Features
- ☁️ **Unlimited Storage**: Personal cloud drive powered directly by Telegram MTProto (TDLib).
- 📁 **Folders as Private Channels**: Create, rename, delete, and organize folders backed by private channels.
- 📅 **Smart Capture Date Grouping**: Pre-uploaded photos are chronologically arranged by true capture month using EXIF metadata and camera timestamps.
- 🔄 **Automated Camera Backup**: Scheduled daily photo/video backup with Wi-Fi only constraints.
- 🎬 **Instant Media Streaming**: Stream videos directly without waiting for full download using Media3 ExoPlayer.
- 💎 **Liquid Glass UI**: Ultra-clean dark theme with AGSL runtime shaders and native haptic feedback.

release.name: v1.5.7
release.notes:
## What's new in 1.5.7

**Fixed: Attendance % could read too high, most visible when WFH days made up a big share of the month.** The app infers extra "leave taken" days when your reported leave balance drops by more than what you've explicitly marked as Leave on the Calendar — useful when leave gets taken and the balance updated without a matching tap on a day. But it wasn't checking whether there was actually a genuinely-unmarked day to explain that drop: if every weekday that month was already accounted for (Present, WFH, or an explicit Leave mark), it would still shave the inferred amount off Eligible working days without touching Attended — quietly inflating the percentage, and in some cases making Eligible read lower than Attended plus WFH, which never makes sense. It now only ever borrows from days that are genuinely still unmarked, and never more of them than actually exist. Every past month recalculates automatically — nothing to redo.

---
*Personal attendance tracker built for ANZ employees. Nothing leaves your device — no login, no backend, no analytics.*

release.notes:
# v1.8.0 — put your backups back

The app could archive a month to Google Drive, but it could not read one back.
That was the wrong half to have: a backup is only worth having if the day the
phone is lost, wiped, or replaced by a new one is not the day the history ends.
So this release adds the way back.

**Import a file.** *Backup* → *Import a backup* → *Choose a backup file* opens
Android's own file chooser; pick one of the `expense-tracker-<YYYY-MM>.json` files
this app exported (from Downloads, or wherever you saved it) and its transactions
are written back. No Google account needed for this half.

**Restore from Google Drive.** Signed in, the same card offers *Restore from
Google Drive*: it lists the months already archived in your `Expense Tracker`
folder, all of them chosen to begin with, and imports the ones you keep ticked.
Progress says which month it is on, and the summary at the end says how many
transactions arrived and how many files could not be read.

**Nothing is imported twice.** A transaction is matched on what you can see —
its day, type, amount, category, subcategory and note — rather than on the id the
backup recorded, because those ids mean nothing in a database that numbers its
rows from one. Importing the same file again therefore writes nothing, and a
restore that failed halfway can simply be run again.

Two coffees on the same day for the same amount are two transactions, not a
duplicate: the note is part of what identifies a row, and one `Coffee` with a
friend next to it is enough to tell them apart.

**What it brings with it.** A backup can name a category or subcategory this
install has never seen — its own custom ones, or the ones it seeded differently.
Those are created rather than renamed or dropped, matched on the name exactly, so
what you restore is what you had.

import is added beside whatever is already stored, never on top of it. There is

release.name: v0.4.2
release.notes:
A quad bike in the shop, wheels that actually turn, machines that roll through a corner instead of pivoting on the spot, a view from behind your own eyes, and animals that walk at their own pace. Eighteen commits since v0.4.1, nearly all of them from riding about on a phone and reporting what looked wrong.

### A quad bike

Purple, because nothing else in the valley is and a machine is recognised at two hundred metres by its colour long before its shape. It costs 199 coins — between the bicycle and the motorcycle, as it is in speed — and goes at twelve metres a second: steadier than the motorcycle because four wheels turn at any speed, and nearly as good a climber, because the grip is in the tyres rather than in the speed.

Balloon tyres with lugs round them, suspension arms out to the hubs, curved mudguards, footwells, a seat with a back, braced bars, twin headlights, a rack and an exhaust down the right side. One stands on the shop floor at the end of the bicycles.

### Machines roll

Every steered machine turned at a rate per second scaled by how fast it was going, which at low speed spins it on the spot like a shopping trolley — a quad sitting still could be rotated on its own axis with the stick. What a machine on wheels does is roll: how fast it comes round is its speed divided by its wheelbase, times the tangent of the angle the bars are at. Standing still it does not turn at all; creeping it turns sharply; at speed the same lock sweeps a far bigger circle. Backing up it steers the other way round, as a car does.

The bars take time to go over and centre themselves when the thumb lifts, and they move less at speed. Machines have weight: they gather speed rather than reaching it, and roll on when the throttle is let go. And wheels do not slide sideways — a quad cornering used to drift like a car on ice, because its heading turned while its velocity kept pointing where it had been going.

release.name: Relaxify v1.2.47
release.notes:
Relaxify 1.2.47 fixes the queue rows flickering after you drag a song to a new place. Discover now finds songs you haven't heard, the + button shows when a song is in any of your playlists, and sharing has a new icon.

### Fixes

- **No more flicker in the queue.** After you dragged a song to a new place, the rows around it could flicker for about a second. They now settle straight into place.
- **Discover finds new songs again.** Discover was meant to suggest songs like the ones you play, but its source found nothing for many of them, so the page fell back to songs you already play a lot. It now uses the same sources as the radio and suggests up to 24 songs at a time.
- **The + button knows about your playlists.** A song you added to a playlist without liking it used to show the empty +, as if it weren't saved anywhere. Now the coral tick shows when a song is liked or in any of your playlists. Tapping it opens the list of playlists.

### Changes

- **Tapping the doodle just plays it again.** The caption message no longer pops up each time.
- **A new share icon:** an arrow rising out of a tray. It's used for Recommend Relaxify in the menu, for sharing a playlist and for sharing your Recap.

release.name: v2.1.3-android
release.notes:
## 2.1.3

**MAC 不用再手填了。** 真机实测确认：手机拿自己 Wi-Fi 网卡的 MAC 就能通过认证，不必再冒充电脑那块有线网卡。

### 改动

- 新增 `LocalMac`：依次尝试 `NetworkInterface` / `WifiInfo` / `sysfs` 读取本机 wlan MAC，界面改成只读展示；读不到就留空，不编造一个假 MAC
- 新增 `NetworkBinder`：认证前用 `ConnectivityManager.bindProcessToNetwork()` 把进程绑到 Wi-Fi。未认证的校园网 Wi-Fi 会被 Android 判定成「连着但没有互联网」，默认网络留在移动数据上，认证包就从蜂窝跑掉了 —— 这是上一版「获取挑战码失败」十秒超时的原因
- 修引擎里的接口回退 bug：`_interface_addresses()` 返回的字典以网卡名为键，旧代码按数字下标取值，回退分支从未真正生效
- 修「没法保存账号密码」：凭据本来就加密落盘了，只是界面启动时没有回读
- 移除 `BuildConfig.DEFAULT_MAC` 与 `local.properties` 的 `defaultMac`
- `gradle.properties` 不再写死构建者本机的 JDK 绝对路径

### 安装

需要 Android 8.0（API 26）及以上。首次启动请同意电池优化白名单，否则国产 ROM 会把后台服务掐掉。

校验值见 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。

release.name: GrabKit for Android 0.1.0
release.notes:
## First Android release

On-device port of GrabKit — no backend, no accounts, yt-dlp runs in-process via Chaquopy.

### What's included
- TikTok (web JSON → feed API → yt-dlp, no watermark), Instagram, Facebook, X, YouTube
- MP4, MP3, JPG, WebP output via ffmpeg-kit
- Foreground download service with per-job progress and notifications
- MediaStore saving (Android 10+), legacy storage permission for Android 7–9
- Batch downloads, carousel picker, session history
- Link unwrapping (t.co, vm.tiktok.com, fb.watch, …)

### Known limitations
- YouTube requires a bundled QuickJS binary (`libqjs.so`) — yt-dlp has required a JS runtime since late 2025. Without it, YouTube may fail.
- TikTok TLS fingerprint is approximate (Conscrypt, not a true Chrome ClientHello); falls back automatically.
- The ffmpeg-kit coordinate defaults to the community fork `dev.ffmpegkit-maintained:ffmpeg:6.0.3` — the original `com.arthenica:ffmpeg-kit-full` is retired.

### Download
Grab `app-debug.apk` from the assets below.

### Build from source

```bash
cd grabkit-android
./gradlew assembleDebug
# APK → app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
```

See [grabkit-android/README.md](https://github.com/iCreate-Impact/grabkit/blob/main/grabkit-android/README.md) for full build requirements.

---

**Full changelog:** [grabkit-android/CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/iCreate-Impact/grabkit/blob/main/grabkit-android/CHANGELOG.md)

release.name: v1.8.2
release.notes:
### Исправления и улучшения читалки:
- **Исправлена потеря позиции при изменении масштаба**: при зуме (±, клавиши +/-/0) в вертикальном режиме читалка теперь запоминает текущую страницу и позицию внутри неё и восстанавливает после перестройки. Больше не «улетает» на другую страницу при смене масштаба.
- **Исправлено вертикальное сжатие высоких страниц**: убрана тройная обёртка `Container→Center→SizedBox` с жёсткими constraints, заменена на `Align + ConstrainedBox`. Изображения webtoon/manhwa с нестандартным aspect ratio теперь отображаются в полную высоту без сжатия.
- **Клавиатурный скролл в вертикальном режиме**: стрелки ↑↓ плавно прокручивают на 25% экрана, Space/PageDown — на 85% экрана, PageUp — назад на 85%.
- **Debounce на ползунке страниц**: при перетаскивании ползунка номер страницы обновляется мгновенно, а прыжок к странице происходит с задержкой 150мс, устраняя дёрганье при быстром drag.

### Исправления и улучшения:
- **Устранено сжатие и искажение пропорций страниц в читалке**:
  - В вертикальном режиме (вебтун / лента) убраны ограничивающие вьюпорт контейнеры, изображения отображаются в своем естественном размере без искажений по высоте.
  - В постраничном режиме по умолчанию включено масштабирование «По экрану» (BoxFit.contain), предотвращающее обрезку и деформацию страниц манги.
  - В настройки читалки добавлен выбор режима масштабирования страниц («По экрану», «По ширине», «Заполнить»).
- **Публикация в RuStore**:
  - Улучшен скрипт публикации: автообнаружение и переиспользование черновиков, защита от ошибок создания дубликатов.

release.name: Lull 1.12 — delete a track from the device
release.notes:
**Delete a track from the device.** The last entry on the selection bar — long-press a track, an album, a folder — and a button on the **Now Playing** top bar, because the moment you decide a track has to go is usually the moment you are listening to it.

- **Lull asks before the system does.** On Android 11 and up the platform puts its own confirmation over the app and does the deleting itself, and Lull's dialog still comes first: the system's asks whether you meant to delete *a file*, while Lull's says which track, how many, and that the rating and the playlist entries go too. On Android 9 and below there is **no system dialog at all**, and Lull's is the only thing between a long-press and a file being gone for good.
- **All three of Android's answers to deleting are covered** — `MediaStore.createDeleteRequest` for the whole batch on API 30+, a per-file `RecoverableSecurityException` consent on API 29, and a plain `WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE` delete below that (which is why that permission is back, capped at `maxSdkVersion="28"`).
- **Nothing trusts the result code.** `RESULT_OK` says the user pressed a button, not that every file went. What actually happened is read back out of MediaStore afterwards, so the toast can say "Deleted 3 of 5" rather than claiming five.
- **Everything keyed to the track goes with it** — the rating, the measured BPM, the loudness profile and its place in every playlist, each in one write. The deleted tracks come out of the playing queue too, highest position first.
- **The API deliberately cannot do this**, and `GET /api/docs` now says so: from Android 10 up the system has to ask a person, and this is the only irreversible thing in the app.
- 171 unit tests to **183**.

Full notes in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/PortableDiag/Lull/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

release.notes:
## Media Proxy v1.0.0

HTTP-to-WebDAV bridge for Android. Browse and stream media from HTTP browsable indexes (nginx autoindex) using Nova Video Player or any WebDAV-compatible player.

### Features
- Multi-source support — combine multiple HTTP index servers into one WebDAV endpoint
- Full video streaming with seeking support (range requests)
- Real file sizes fetched via parallel HEAD requests
- **Directory caching** — listings cached for 5 min, pre-fetched on startup
- Auto-start on boot (toggleable in settings)
- D-pad / remote friendly UI with focus highlights and confirmation dialogs
- Source management — add, edit, delete media sources

### Install
1. Download `MediaProxy-v1.0.0.apk` below
2. Install via `adb install MediaProxy-v1.0.0.apk` or open directly on device
3. Open app, add your HTTP index URL(s), press Start Proxy
4. In your media player, add WebDAV share: `127.0.0.1:8088`

### Compatibility
- Android 5.0+ (API 21)
- Works on phones, tablets, Android TV, Chromecast with Google TV, Fire TV
- Works with nginx autoindex and similar HTML directory listings

release.notes:
- **Fixed floating windows dying with "Can't play this video in a window" after you open a video from a different folder.** Your description of it was exactly right, and the cause is the folder: the permission to read a video that a file manager gives Loopr belongs to the *screen* that received it, and Loopr closes that screen the moment it hands the video to a floating window. The window keeps playing on the file it already has open — and dies the next time it re-opens it, which is every few loops of a short clip and every move to the next video. **Opening another video from the same folder hid it**, because a file manager hands over the whole folder, so the older window's file got its permission renewed by accident. From a different folder, nothing renewed it.
  - From your phone's own log: `SecurityException: Permission Denial: opening provider androidx.core.content.FileProvider from com.loopr.player … that is not exported from UID …`, reported to the player as a plain I/O failure — which is why Loopr thought the *video* was broken, skipped to the next one, and closed the window when that failed too.
  - Loopr now passes the permission on to the window when it hands over the video, and back to full screen when you tap ⛶, so a window holds the files it is playing for as long as it is open.
  - A permission can't outlive the app's process, so a window **restored after Android kills Loopr** still can't read files opened from a file manager. It now says so plainly instead of hunting through the folder first.

release.name: Mathlificient v1.1.2
release.notes:
Mathlificient v1.1.2 is a correctness fix for the practice questions.

## The one that matters

In v1.1.1, **partial fractions could mark a right answer wrong** in about 11% of
questions on that topic.

When the two roots were negatives of each other, one of the "wrong" options was the
correct answer with its two terms written in the other order:

    correct     -3/(x + 5) + 4/(x - 5)
    also shown   4/(x - 5) + -3/(x + 5)

Both are the same answer. If you picked the second, you were marked wrong *and* the
app recorded a misconception you had not made — which then influenced what it asked
you next. If your partial-fractions score looks worse than it should, that is why.

Progress already recorded is not rewritten by this update. You can clear a single
skill from the progress screen if you want that topic's history reset.

## Also fixed

- **circle equations** printed the same value twice: `(x - 3)^2 + (y + 2)^2 = 4 = 4`
- **complex numbers** were written with stray coefficients — `(4 - 1i)` instead of
  `(4 - i)`, and steps reading `16 + 8i + -4i`
- **six templates printed a plus directly against a minus** — `(10 + -14)`,
  `A(3 - -4)`, `4A - -3C`, `dy/dx = -2(-3x - 2) + -3(-2x - 6)`. Nothing there was
  false, but it is not how maths is written, and it is the line you copy down.

None of these changed any answer. They were all in the *working*.

## What is checking for it now

The generator checker gained two rules, both with their own tests: one rejects two
signs in a row anywhere in a question, step or answer, and one rejects the bracket
helper being used where a visible product is needed. A full audit of all 365 rendered
samples across all 73 templates found no false arithmetic and no other mis-marking.

## Android

Download `Mathlificient-1.1.2.apk` and open it. Signed with the same permanent
release certificate as every earlier public build, so it updates in place and keeps
your progress.

## Windows

The installer is unsigned — there is no Windows code-sign

# Learning Hub 🧮

**Learning Hub** is an engaging and well-structured primary mathematics learning application designed to help children master basic math concepts and build confidence through practice and testing.

* **Secure Authentication:** Supports user profile creation, login, and password reset functionality using Firebase Authentication.

---

* **Local Data & Progress Tracking:** Uses a local SQLite database to safely store user records and test reports directly on the device.

* **Focused Local Storage:** Keeps user data and performance progress local, ensuring fast offline access for practice sessions without relying on cloud backups.
* **Child-Friendly Structure:** Designed specifically to make early math education approachable, structured, and rewarding for primary students.

release.name: meow-academy 0.3.2 — 功能模型配置 + 会话标题自动总结 + 流式增量桥接恢复
release.notes:
# 喵仓 0.3.2 发行说明

## 添加功能

- **功能模型配置**：设置页「模型管理」下方新增「功能模型」入口，可按功能指定 provider + 模型（当前落地=会话标题总结，架构预留翻译/OCR/压缩）。首项「跟随会话模型」；配置经新 RPC `features/getModels` / `features/setModel` 下发（provider/model 必须成对，半对报 `FEATURE_MODEL_INVALID`），DSH 侧新 provider 走「释放旧 → 按新 route 重注册」（上游 `session-title-llm` 是加载期配置 + 单 provider 槽位），`initialize` 成功后统一下发、设置页改动即时推送、失败回滚本地配置。
- **会话标题自动总结恢复**：`session-title` 接回 LLM 总结，复用上游 `generateSessionTitleWithLlm` 同源策略（提示词 / JSON 封装 / 字节上限 / deadline / 输出校验 / 审计事件全部不变）；App 侧 `session/title` 实时事件 + `session/query` 水合**双路消费**，补上 App 不在线时错过的标题。
- **聊天正文行距纳入动态配置**：`markdown-config.jsonc` 新增 `paragraph` 段（`lineSpacingMultiplier` 默认 1.3、`lineSpacingExtraDp` 默认 0），改值即时生效、无需重启；作用范围 = 正文 / 标题 / 列表 / 引用的段落，代码块、公式、表格各自独立不受影响（值未变化不调 `setLineSpacing`，流式每帧不白付一次布局）。

## 修复

- **聊天页流式输出失效**（回复整段一次性蹦出）：0.1.5 把逐 delta 流式从 durable 事件 `assistant/chunk` 搬进了进程内 scoped 事件 `agent/assistant-stream`，而 `meow-jsonrpc` 从未订阅 → App 只能在每个 step 结束时拿到整段内容。新增 `installAssistantStreamBridge()`：按 `attemptId` 登记 `start` 帧的 `{sessionId,turn,step}`，把 `chunk` 帧包成**旧形状** `assistant/chunk` 透传，App 端既有分支 + `TurnSegmentBuilder` 直接消费（映射缺失不转发——丢增量不丢正确性）。
- **标题模型不可用时回退**：`session-title` fallback 上限调大（中文约 30 字）＝用用户问题截断兜底；App 侧 Room **v4 → v5** 新增 `sessions.titleSource`（default / auto / user），采用规则＝fallback 只在 default 时采用、provider 标题可升级 default/auto、**用户手动重命名永不被覆盖**。
- **改 `appconfig/*.jsonc` 毫无反应**（热更静默失效）：AOSP `FileObserver` 按 inotify **wd** 一对一保存 observer，而同一目录 inode 只返回同一个 wd → 后注册者覆盖先注册者（issue 37017033），`ThemeConfigRepository` 落地后 `MarkdownConfigRepository` 热更永久失效（连 `onEvent` 都不回调，只能重启 App）。新增 `AppConfigWatcher`（目录级唯一 watch + `ConfigChangeDispatcher` 按文件名分发），两仓库改走同一 watcher；**新增 JSONC 配置禁止再自建 FileObserver**。

## 优化

- **dsh-fork 插件化改造（patch 10 → 7 条）**：把「改上游源码」换成 Cordis 插件 overlay 换实现——fs-local deny → `meow-modules/fs-android.js`、web-search-tavily → `meow-modules/web-search-tavily.js`、tool-cordis 部署段 → 创造预设内 `cordis-deploy-note.js`、`link()` 三处 → `meow-modules/compat.mjs` 加载期 shim + koffi stub；上游既有文件口径

Keeps an accessibility service alive on Xiaomi HyperOS, which silently switches it off. No root, no Shizuku.

release.name: v1.0.0
release.notes:
First release.

NoScroll Guard keeps an accessibility service alive on Xiaomi HyperOS, which
silently switches it off — the system writes `secure accessibility_enabled = 0`
and marks the service as crashed, leaving you with a focus app that quietly
stopped working. The guard notices and repairs it, without root and without
Shizuku. The [README](https://github.com/haku4130/hyperos-accessibility-guard#readme)
walks through the diagnosis in full.

### Install

You need a computer with `adb`, and two Developer options on the phone —
**USB debugging (Security settings)** and **Install via USB**. The cable is
needed exactly once: the permissions this app requires cannot be granted from
the phone itself.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/haku4130/hyperos-accessibility-guard
cd hyperos-accessibility-guard
./install.sh --apk ~/Downloads/noscroll-guard-1.0.0.apk
```

The script installs the APK, grants the permissions, adds the app to the
battery whitelist and starts it. One step stays manual, because ADB cannot do
it: **Security → Permissions → Autostart → enable NoScroll Guard.**

### Verifying the download

```
SHA-256 of the signing certificate:
eec4f5695fddf0e7207a5cc01826aa78168a5148488bbc00d1ebc36acce1d49e
```

Built and signed by [GitHub Actions](https://github.com/haku4130/hyperos-accessibility-guard/blob/main/.github/workflows/release.yml); the signing key never leaves repository secrets.

### Tested on

Xiaomi 14T Pro, HyperOS 3.0.301.0, Android 16. Requires Android 13 or newer.

repo.description: Personal Moonlight Android fork that forwards system keys (Esc, Alt+Tab, Win) to the host while streaming, via an accessibility service. For any Android TV device whose system intercepts those keys.

release.name: Working build 317 (12.1-syskeys.4) — keyboard in Windows mode
release.notes:
Build **317** (`12.1-syskeys.4`). The working release.

Moonlight Android (`master`, 2024-07-27) plus an accessibility service that forwards **Esc**, **Alt+Tab**, and the **Windows key** to the host while streaming, so Android TV stops intercepting them.

## Important: keyboard must be in "Windows" / PC mode

This only works if your Bluetooth keyboard sends standard PC key codes. Many keyboards have an OS-profile toggle (often **Fn + Windows** vs **Fn + Android**). In an Android profile the top row is remapped (Esc becomes Home, the F-row becomes search/media/volume), and Android never hands those keys to an app, so they cannot be forwarded. **Set the keyboard to its Windows/PC profile.**

## Install

1. Install **Downloader** (by AFTVnews) and allow it to install unknown apps: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.esaba.downloader
2. In Downloader, open `is.gd/mlsyskeys`. It updates in place over any previous build.
3. If Play Protect blocks it, turn off Play Protect scanning, install, turn it back on.
4. Enable the service: Settings → Device Preferences → Accessibility → Moonlight System Keys → On (re-enable after each update).

## Behavior while streaming

- Esc, Alt+Tab, and the Windows key go to the host.
- The mouse's right-click is untouched.
- The **TV remote's Back still exits the stream** (only the keyboard's Esc/Back is forwarded). Keyboard quit is Ctrl+Alt+Shift+Q.

Installs as **Moonlight** (`com.limelight.unofficial`), alongside any official Moonlight.

release.name: v0.2.22
release.notes:
Stops avoidable live TV disconnections during playback recovery.

- Buffering that is still filling the saved cushion no longer triggers a restart every ten seconds.
- Decoder recovery keeps the existing shared provider connection and resets only the player timeline.
- Choppy playback can raise the cushion without disconnecting playback that has already resumed.
- A timestamp warning no longer starts a competing five-second restart loop. The no-progress watchdog still recovers stuck playback.
- The player waits for its cached channel to load before opening a restored stream, preventing an initial direct connection followed by a second live connection.
- Decoder recovery does not compete with the shared socket’s own reconnect attempts.

The supplied live stream was checked through one connection: first byte after 12.2 seconds, then 45 seconds of delivery without disconnecting. Audio in the captured sample decoded without warnings. This is a bounded test, not a guarantee against future provider or network outages.

# Deskflow Droid v1.1.0 — 实验版

**通过局域网，用电脑键鼠操作 Android 手机。**

基于 ITESaurabh/deskflow-droid 的独立修改版，配合电脑 Deskflow 服务端使用，非官方发行。不是 Android 反向共享鼠标、投屏或文件传输工具。

📖 [中文安装与使用说明](https://github.com/nmdft/deskflow-droid/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md) · [English documentation](https://github.com/nmdft/deskflow-droid/blob/main/README.md)

## 下载哪个文件？

- **安装应用：** 下载 `deskflow-droid-v1.1.0.apk`，不是 Source code 压缩包。
- **校验文件：** 下载 `SHA256SUMS.txt`，与 APK 放在一起执行 `shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS.txt`。
- **查看对应源码：** 使用本发布标签下的 Source code；当前 main 分支已整理文档并清除未使用的旧辅助程序，但没有替换本 APK 或改动本标签。

不保证游戏、自绘画布、所有快捷键、手机输入法拼音组词、任意后台剪贴板或深度休眠后的亮屏。应用界面目前中英混合，并非完整双语界面。

release.notes:
TapStop 0.9 ergänzt „Lokal – Qualcomm NPU“ als dritten STT-Provider neben OpenAI und Groq. Whisper Large V3 Turbo FP16 erkennt Sprache auf dem Gerät; ein separat gewählter OpenAI-/Groq-Provider kann anschließend Plus, Chat oder Formal überarbeiten. Roh mit Local benötigt keinen Cloudaufruf.

- Validiert mit echten Mikrofon-Diktaten, direkter Texteingabe und Encoder-/Decoder-HTP-Nachweisen: Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra (SM8650, V75, socModel 57) und HONOR MagicPad 4 (SM8845P, V81, socModel 97).

- Vorhandene Einstellungen, API-Keys und Statistiken bleiben bei einem kompatibel signierten Update erhalten. SQLite bleibt auf Schema Version 1.

**Bekannte SDK-Grenze:** Bestimmte Aufnahmen nahe 30 Sekunden können in VoiceAI mit `SPECTROGRAM FAIL` scheitern. TapStop weist dieses gesamte Diktat jetzt als Fehler ab, fügt keinen Teiltext ein und startet keinen Rewrite. Ein neues, kürzeres Diktat kann dieselbe Runtime weiterverwenden. Der interne Qualcomm-SDK-Fehler selbst ist nicht behoben.

Die APK enthält die geprüfte Qualcomm-Runtime einschließlich beider HTP-Targets und der unveränderten Lizenzhinweise. Die etwa 2,2 GB großen Modellpakete sind weder in der APK noch als Release-Assets enthalten. Lokaler Import und der reproduzierbare FP16-Buildweg sind im Repository dokumentiert; der normale Quellcode-Build funktioniert auch ohne proprietäre SDK-Dateien.

Validierung: 59 JVM-/Robolectric-Tests, neun Python-Tests, Android-Instrumentierung, Chrome-Einfügetests, Live-API-Regression für OpenAI/Groq und reale Roh-/Plus-Abnahme auf beiden Geräten. Beide separaten PoC-Apps wurden danach entfernt; TapStop und seine eigenen Modelle bleiben installiert.

release.name: Max Strike 1.0.11
release.notes:
**VPN, который не просит ничего лишнего.** Ни root, ни аккаунта, ни доверия на слово — просто ссылка на подписку и туннель на движке Xray-core.

В этом обновлении — заметный скачок в скорости интерфейса и несколько важных исправлений под капотом.

**Что изменилось**

- Интерфейс стал заметно плавнее — переработан рендеринг карточек и списков, включена оптимизация сборки (R8), подключены baseline-профили. Скролл больше не тормозит.
- Поддержка 120 Гц на современных экранах — анимации и переходы используют максимальную частоту обновления, если её поддерживает телефон.
- Исправлен редкий случай, когда часть сайтов могла не открываться при подключённом VPN — резолв DNS стал надёжнее (второй резервный сервер), и починен маршрут для пресета «Обход РФ».
- Автообновление задержки серверов стало экономичнее для батареи.
- Полный аудит безопасности: защита от утечки IPv6, более надёжная защита от подмены DNS-ответов, отключён резервный бэкап конфигурации на случай физического доступа к телефону.
- APK стал компактнее в несколько раз — убраны лишние архитектуры процессора, оставлена только та, что нужна реальным телефонам (arm64).

Скачивайте, ставьте — и, как всегда, всё работает без единого байта телеметрии.

**Установка:** скачайте `MaxStrike-1.0.11.apk` ниже и откройте файл на телефоне — система сама предложит разрешить установку из неизвестных источников при первом запуске.

release.name: v1.0.0 — Initial Release
release.notes:
## STT Compat Scanner v1.0.0

First public release of STT Compat Scanner — a small diagnostic Flutter app for checking whether an Android device (especially GMS-less tablets) supports speech recognition.

### Highlights

- **Layered diagnostics**: distinguishes "OS reports a recognizer exists," "an engine is actually installed," and "the engine actually works"
- **Vendor-agnostic engine discovery**: queries `PackageManager` for any installed `RecognitionService`, not just Google's
- **Defensive service binding**: catches OEM `SecurityException` crashes (observed on Huawei/EMUI) natively before they reach Flutter
- **Live interactive speech test**: real `listen()` call with selectable locale (`en-US`, `zh-CN`, `zh-HK`)
- **No ADB required to use**: install and run by tapping the APK on-device
- **Zero backend**: no login, database, or network dependency beyond the on-device speech engine

### Installation

Download `app-release.apk` below, transfer it to your Android device, and tap to install (allow "install from this source" if prompted). No root or ADB required.

See the [README](https://github.com/JasonGui-Workspace/stt-compat-scanner#readme) for full diagnostic details and sample output.

### Requirements

- Android 5.0+ (matches Flutter's minimum SDK support)
- `RECORD_AUDIO` permission for the speech test

---

**Full Changelog**: Initial release

release.name: Spiritus Android v2.1.1
release.notes:
## Spiritus Android v2.1.1 — the VPN connects again

**Fixes**
- **VPN connection works again.** v2.0.0 and v2.1.0 started the tun2socks engine with `--loglevel warning`, which tun2socks v2.6 rejects, so the tunnel died the moment you pressed connect. It now uses `warn`.
- The app builds again with AGP 9.2.1 (source-set fix + a missing Compose import).

**Engines (all verified, see `app/native-bin/provenance.json`)**
- Xray-core **26.3.27** — official XTLS release assets, checked against the upstream `.dgst` files
- tun2socks **2.6.0** — official release assets, checked against GitHub's published digests
- sing-box **1.13.13** — rebuilt from the tagged source + the Android VPN-fd patch (NDK, API 23)

Tested on an Android 14 emulator against a VLESS + REALITY server: connects and carries real traffic.

> ⚠️ **New signing key.** This release is signed with a new V7lthronyx key, so it cannot update v2.0.0 in place.
> **Uninstall the old app first, then install v2.1.1.** (v2.0.0 could not connect anyway.)

**Signature:** `CN=v7lthronyx, OU=Spiritus, O=v7lthronyx, C=IR`

release.notes:
## Shabbat Alert Dismisser — v1.0 Beta

Automatically dismisses Pikud HaOref / cell broadcast emergency alerts during Shabbat so the full-screen overlay doesn't block your screen while the siren plays.

> ⚠️ This is a beta release. Tested on Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra (Android 15). Please report issues on GitHub.

### Installation

1. Download **app-release.apk** below
2. Open the downloaded file — **Play Protect will show a warning** (this is normal for apps not on Google Play)
3. Tap **"More details"** (פרטים נוספים) → then **"Install anyway"** (להתקין בכל זאת)
4. If there's no "Install anyway" option:
   - Open **Play Store → Profile (top right) → Play Protect → Settings ⚙️**
   - Turn off **"Scan apps with Play Protect"**
   - Install the APK
   - **Turn Play Protect back on**
5. Open the app → tap **Open Accessibility Settings** → enable **Shabbat Alert Dismisser**
6. Tap **Update Location** and grant location permission
7. Select your minhag and preferred end-of-Shabbat
8. Recommended: tap **Open Battery Optimization Settings** and add this app to "Never sleeping apps"

### Features
- Auto-dismiss during **Shabbat only**, **Shabbat + holidays**, **always**, or **disabled**
- **Minhag profiles**: Ashkenaz, Or HaChaim, Kise Rachamim, Ben Ish Chai, Jerusalem
- **Standard (Gra) or Rabenu Tam** end-of-Shabbat
- Accurate times via **Hebcal API** with offline fallback (NOAA solar algorithm)
- **Persistent status notification** showing current state and next Shabbat times (optional)
- **Keep screen on** during Shabbat or always (optional)
- Configurable delay before dismissing (5–60 s)
- Hebrew and English UI
- Minimal battery impact
- Supports AOSP, Google, and Samsung cell broadcast packages

### Keeping the service alive (Samsung)
Go to **Settings → Battery → Background usage limits → Never sleeping apps** and add this app.

release.name: Braille eMotion Jailbreak Toolkit 2.0.0
release.notes:
# Braille eMotion Jailbreak Toolkit 2.0.0

Первый публичный выпуск объединяет доступный «Диспетчер приложений» для Braille eMotion и автономный установщик для Windows.

Windows-программа сама ищет подключённый B340, различает полную, частичную и отсутствующую установку, показывает журнал и предлагает только два действия: установить компоненты проекта либо удалить их. Наличие RuStore не требуется и на статус не влияет. ADB, APK и необходимые библиотеки уже находятся внутри EXE.

Android-приложение автоматически собирает список запускаемых программ, открывает безопасное системное удаление и устанавливает обычные APK из `/sdcard/Download`. Длинные списки полностью доступны с клавиатуры. Русская справка читается по абзацам и начинается с ответственности и условий гарантии.

## Файлы

- `Braille-eMotion-AppManager-Setup-2.0.exe` — рекомендуемая установка и удаление с Windows;
- `Braille-eMotion-AppManager-1.5.apk` — основной Android-пакет для ручной установки;
- `Braille-eMotion-Factory-Menu-Shortcut-1.0.apk` — мост для ярлыка в заводском меню;
- `SHA256SUMS.txt` — контрольные суммы всех трёх файлов.

Для обычного пользователя нужен только EXE и файл контрольных сумм. Два APK опубликованы для проверки и ручной установки разработчиком.

## Перед запуском

Сохраните важные данные и прочитайте [руководство пользователя](https://github.com/andreykadelite/braille-emotion-jailbreak-toolkit/blob/v2.0.0/docs/USAGE-RU.md). Установка сторонних приложений меняет программную конфигурацию устройства и может повлиять на данные, стабильность и гарантийное обслуживание.

EXE не подписан коммерческим сертификатом, поэтому Windows SmartScreen может запросить дополнительное подтверждение. Скачивайте файл только из этого релиза и сверяйте SHA-256.

Проверенная конфигурация: Braille eMotion 40 B340, Android 12, 64-разрядная Windows 10/11. Другие модели установщик намеренно блокирует.

repo.description: GKD 非官方定制版：免 root 防御摇一摇 / 跳转劫持 / 假跳过 / 快应用流氓下载，坐标点击守卫 + 无障碍自动守护，内置开箱即用订阅。

release.name: GKD 特调版 1.12.2-fok0030（v123）
release.notes:
# GKD 特调版 1.12.2-fok0030（v123）

> 本轮三件事：**卸载残留清理**（新页面）· **假跳过保护重做** · **日志增强**（守卫筛选 + 保留天数/清除过期）。
> 全部在 MuMu（Android 15 / `emulator-5554`）端到端验收；真机（vivo 手机 / 联想平板）待装复验。

## 一、新增：设置 → 常规 →「卸载清理」（卸载前把系统里的痕迹清干净）

卸载 GKD 之后，系统里会留下它写过的痕迹（真机实测：控制中心里一个**点不动的 GKD 磁贴**、
`global` 里 7 条 `li.songe.gkd|<权限>` 记录…）。**应用一旦被卸载就无法再执行任何代码**，
所以这件事只能"**卸载前**在 App 里做"。本页把它做成逐项勾选 + 一键全清，并且：

- **清之前先记原值**（改动台账），页面上有「恢复改动」可整批还原 —— 包括最要紧的一条：
  **被「快应用引擎」页停用/禁装的引擎会按原状态还原**（否则卸载后引擎永远停着，你在系统里也找不回来）；
- 覆盖：控制中心磁贴、`global`/`secure`/`system` 里含包名的键、无障碍启用列表 + 总开关、快应用引擎；
- **如实写明清不掉的**：桌面小组件（系统没有"应用移除自己小组件"的接口，卸载后长按那个空白框删掉）、
  安装历史（`dumpsys package` 的 `seq=`，无公开 API）；电池白名单/权限/appops/数据目录会随卸载自动消失；
- 页面上直接给**可复制的 adb 命令**，给"没跑清理就卸载了"的场景兜底；
- **不提供"代替你卸载"的按钮**（卸载仍由你在系统里操作）。

⚠️ 两个实测限制（页面会如实提示）：
1. **Android 14+ 应用读不到 `sysui_qs_tiles`**（`SecurityException … targetSdkVersion <= 33`），有
   `WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS` 也没用 ⇒ 磁贴这一项**需要 Shizuku**（或电脑 adb 命令）；
2. fork 的「无障碍自动守护」会在几秒内把刚摘掉的条目写回来 —— 清理时会自动先置"手动关闭"标记让它放手。

## 二、重做：假跳过保护（治"真跳过反而不跳"）

用户实测反馈：**"有些广告并不是假的跳过，只是跳过的按钮区域不在右上角，这时也会触发，导致广告不跳过"**
（现象 = **根本没点**）。根因是旧版只按"点击之后的落点"判断，且一旦判错就把**整个 App 永久拉黑** ——
于是这个 App 的广告从此再也不点。

现在改成：

| 层 | 做什么 |
|---|---|
| **事前（新）** | 点之前用无障碍树判断"那个点上有没有**明显更大的可点层**盖着"（面积 ≥8 倍或占屏 ≥50%）。**只看结构，绝不看位置**（右上角/底部/正中都是同一套判据）。判"被压住"就不点；判不准（树读不全等）**一律照点**。规则自己写明 `clickable=true` 或 `clickNode` 的，永远放行。 |
| **事后** | 落点校验保留，但**放宽**：事前判"没有覆盖层"的点击，之后跳到别的应用 = **App 自己的正常业务跳转**，只记日志，**不按返回键、不拉黑**。 |
| **降级** | 从"整 App 永久拉黑"改成 **按"应用 + 规则组 + 节点形态"降级，24 小时自动恢复**（老名单只读+可一键清空）。 |

设置里新增「**事前识别假跳过(推荐)**」开关，关掉即退回"只做事后落点校验"。

## 三、增强：运行日志（看触发 + 清过期）

- **守卫筛选标签**：`全部 / ShakeGuard / JumpGuard / 假跳过 / 坐标守卫 / 快应用 / 关联守护 / 无障碍 / 异常`，
  chip 上直接显示命中条数，与搜索框**叠加**过滤 —— "刚才那一枪是哪个守卫打的"在手机上一眼看到。
- **日志保留天数**（设置 → 高级设置 → 日志，1/3/7/14/30 天，默认 7）：自动滚动清理按它执行，
  日志页新增「**清除过期(N)**」按钮（确认框写明将删除几个文件、共多少 KB）。

## 验收（MuMu / Android 15）

- 假跳过 8 用例：真跳过（右上角/底部/正中）全部 `verdict=real` 放行并**真的点掉了**；
  假跳过（右上角/底部）全部 `reject verdict=fake ratio=77.0`，**靶子侧 0 条触摸**；
  真跳过之后的正常跨应用跳转记

repo.description: Android app that speaks who a message is from - SMS, RCS and WhatsApp - without reading the message aloud

release.name: v1.0.0 - first working build
release.notes:
﻿First working build of Message Announcer.

## What it does

Speaks the sender of an incoming message, and nothing else:

- SMS / RCS - "Raja texted you"
- WhatsApp - "Raja sent you a WhatsApp message"
- WhatsApp Business - "Raja sent you a WhatsApp Business message"
- Group chat - "Raja sent a message in Family Group"

The message body is never spoken, never logged and never stored.

## Install

Download `MessageAnnouncer-debug.apk` below and open it on your phone. This is a **debug build**
signed with a debug key, so Play Protect will warn that it is from an unknown source - that is
expected for any app installed outside the Play Store.

After installing, open the app, press **Test announcement** to check text-to-speech, then grant
**Notification Access** when prompted. Android requires you to grant that by hand; the app
cannot grant it for you and receives nothing until you do.

## Privacy

No `INTERNET` permission. No `READ_SMS`, `RECEIVE_SMS`, `READ_CONTACTS`, `READ_CALL_LOG`,
`READ_PHONE_STATE` or `QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES`. No account, no analytics, no message history.
Verified against the packaged APK with `aapt2 dump permissions`.

## What has been verified

- 69 unit tests pass; `lintDebug` reports no errors; `assembleDebug` succeeds
- Installs and runs on a Motorola moto g 5G (2024), Android 15, with the notification listener
  confirmed bound by the system

## What has not

One device and one Android version. WhatsApp publishes no notification-format contract for this
use case, so WhatsApp parsing is best effort and may break when WhatsApp updates. WhatsApp
Business has not been exercised at all. See TESTING.md for the full checklist.
