release.name: XLTD VPN 2.2.4 — olcRTC master tip (jitsi/server stability)
release.notes:
Ядро (Android + Windows) обновлено до **вершины ветки `master`** openlibrecommunity/olcrtc (`e7588c0`, было `39cc3fa`).

## Изменения ядра (新 коммиты master)
- **jitsi:** byte-stream сессии теперь поддерживаются живыми через RTP; убран цикл реконнекта по RTCP-keepalive.
- **server:** толерантность к устаревшим control-кадрам во время handshake; добавлен счётчик пиров.
- **transport:** ограничение числа ожидающих пересборки сообщений (cap pending reassembly).

API не изменился — combo и `cmd/olcrtc` компилируются чисто против вершины, правок в мосте не потребовалось.

## Перепроверка на баги
- `flutter analyze` по всему проекту — **0 ошибок / 0 предупреждений** (30 info — косметика).
- **Багфикс (регрессия из 2.2.3):** карточка режима маршрутизации на Windows подсвечивалась с задержкой до ~10 c — `setRouteMode` ждал поднятия Wintun-адаптера перед обновлением UI. Теперь выбор отражается мгновенно, применение идёт следом; повторный тап по активному режиму игнорируется.

- **Android:** `xltd-vpn-2.2.4-android.apk` — сайдлоад.
- **Windows x64:** `XLTD-VPN-2.2.4-windows-x64.zip` — распаковать, запустить `xltd_vpn.exe`. Full tunnel · Wintun требует прав администратора; SOCKS5 (по умолчанию) — нет.

release.name: 1.11.2-a4
release.notes:
## 1.11.2-a4

Исправление после перевыпуска релизов: если сборка из кэша больше не опубликована, приложение зацикливалось на ошибке «HTTP 404».

- **Что было не так.** Приложение запоминает найденный релиз (версию, имя файла, размер и хеш) и на следующем запуске показывает его сразу, не дожидаясь сети — в том числе в уведомлении с кнопкой «Скачать». Если релиз после этого удалён или перевыпущен под другим тегом, ссылка из кэша начинает отдавать 404, и «Скачать» снова и снова заканчивается ошибкой.
- **Что исправлено.** На 404 при скачивании кэш сбрасывается, и приложение тут же перепроверяет релизы: если есть актуальная сборка, предложение обновиться появляется заново, а сообщение объясняет, что произошло.
- **Почему вы это увидели.** В кэше остался *временный* релиз `1.11.2-a4`: он публиковался на несколько минут для проверки резервного пути обновления и затем был удалён. Отсюда «Не удалось скачать: HTTP 404 while downloading TgWsProxy-1.11.2-a4-android.apk». Теперь `1.11.2-a4` — обычный релиз, поэтому и ссылка из кэша снова рабочая.
- **Что сделать.** Закройте и снова откройте приложение (при запуске оно перепроверит релизы и обновит кэш), затем нажмите «Скачать и установить». Если не хочется ждать — можно поставить APK вручную со страницы релиза.
- **Остальное — как в `1.11.2-a3`:** исправленный резервный путь проверки обновлений (через ленту релизов), проверка кэша загрузки по SHA-256, проверка скачанного файла перед установкой. Ядро `1.11.2` и настройки не менялись.

Пакет `com.nixikon.tgwsproxy`, версия `1.11.2-a4` (versionCode 20), ABI `arm64-v8a` + `x86_64`.

Обновление ставится поверх `1.11.1-a1`, `1.11.2-a1`, `1.11.2-a2` и `1.11.2-a3`.

Rediseñamos la aplicación para eliminar las líneas duras, recuadros marcados y bordes que recargaban la vista. Ahora la interfaz utiliza fondos suaves y tarjetas estilizadas que facilitan la lectura de tus ingresos y gastos.

release.name: FinanceTracker v1.3
release.notes:
# FinanceTracker v1.3

Expenses now appear for everyone the moment they're added, plus a new look, dark mode, and a home screen shortcut.

## Everything updates live

No more pulling to refresh or hunting for a refresh button — they're gone.

When someone in the household adds, edits, or deletes an expense, it shows up on everyone else's phone straight away. The same goes for budgets and recurring expenses, and every total and chart updates with them.

## Add an expense in one tap

- **Home screen widget** — drop the "Add Expense" widget on your home screen and tap it to go straight to the form. Long-press an empty spot on your home screen, choose Widgets, and find Finance Tracker.
- **Long-press shortcut** — press and hold the app icon and pick "Add a new expense".

## Dark mode

Head to Household → Appearance and pick **System**, **Light**, or **Dark**. System follows your phone's setting. Your choice is remembered.

## A proper app icon

The app no longer uses the default Android icon. It also supports themed icons, so it can match your wallpaper colours on newer phones.

## Fixes

- **Recurring expenses no longer get logged twice.** If two people opened the app around the same time, a due bill like rent could be recorded twice. Each bill is now claimed once, no matter how many people open the app together.

## Install

Download `FinanceTracker-v1.3.apk` below and open it on your phone. You may need to allow installs from unknown sources.

Installs over v1.0, v1.1 and v1.2 as an update — your data is kept.

**Requires Android 8.0 or newer.**

release.name: SpendWise 0.9.35
release.notes:
SpendWise is an Android ledger that reads your bank's own notifications and
keeps everything on the phone. No account, no sync, no internet permission.

## What's new in this one

**The app tells you when it has gone wrong, and asks before it destroys
anything.** Two dozen error messages used to show you the raw exception --
literally `Instance of 'SqliteException'` -- which is a message written for
somebody reading a stack trace, and this app deliberately sends crash reports
to nobody. They now say what SpendWise was trying to do, and add the error's
own words only when those words are readable. Removing one of your categories
used to be a single unconfirmed tap on a small cross, which re-filed every
entry under it and deleted the rules the app had learned for it; it asks
first now, and names both of those losses. Erasing all local data used to
finish in silence, on the one screen whose result you cannot check by
looking -- it says it happened. And Review and Insights no longer claim
capture is working before you have granted notification access: each now
says the access is missing and offers the control that fixes it.

**Home's category breakdown now describes the same stretch of time as the
figures above it.** The shape and the legend read the window Home resolves;
the bar underneath was still reading a cached one, pinned to whenever that
cache was last filled. On a rolling week or month the two parted company
every midnight, so the bar quietly described a different period than the
number directly above it. Home reads a single window now.

**The flow shape on Home leans like the app's own mark.** Its branches
splayed almost to the edge of the canvas and read as two legs rather than
one thing dividing. Four copies of the geometry had drifted apart -- the
widget, the painter, the Android home-screen widget's Kotlin renderer, and a
test holding a stale constant of its own -- and all four now read one source,
so the phone widget and Home can no longer disagree about

release.notes:
## 聚账 · FinanceHub v0.1.1

首个公开版本。本地优先的个人财务数据聚合 App —— 导入微信 / 支付宝账单，自动去重、三级分类、可视化，账单不出本机。

### 本版修复

- **修复「手机端数据库打开失败」**：Android 上执行 `PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL` 会让 `openDatabase` 直接抛异常，
  表现为应用启动即报错、账本打不开。现在 PRAGMA 按平台区分：Android 只设 `foreign_keys`，桌面保留 WAL。
  机理与取舍见 `docs/DATABASE.md` §7.1。
- 新增**启动闸门**：数据库万一打不开时，显示可读原因 + 可复制的错误原文 + 重试按钮，而不是一片红色错误屏。
- 修复手动记账单号在同一时刻可能撞号、导致静默丢一笔（改为时间戳 + 进程内自增序号 + 随机段）。
- 修复 `.gitignore` 误把 `lib/data/database/` 整目录忽略、导致裸克隆无法构建的问题。

### 安装包

- `finance_hub-v0.1.1-release.apk`（约 61.8 MB），release 正式签名，**零危险权限**
- 覆盖 `arm64-v8a` / `armeabi-v7a` / `x86_64`
- 系统要求：Android 7.0 (API 24) 及以上

### 验证状态

- `dart analyze`：零 error / 零 warning / 零 info
- `flutter test`：249 个用例全部通过
- 包名 `com.financehub.finance_hub`，应用名「聚账」，版本 0.1.1 (2)

---

## English

First public release. A local-first personal finance hub: import your Alipay / WeChat Pay bill files,
get automatic deduplication, three-level categorisation and dashboards — your bills never leave the device.

**Fixed in this version**

- **Android "database failed to open"**: running `PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL` on Android makes
  `openDatabase` throw, so the app failed on startup. PRAGMAs are now applied per platform
  (Android sets only `foreign_keys`; desktop keeps WAL). See `docs/DATABASE.md` §7.1.
- Added a **startup gate** that shows a readable reason, the copyable raw error and a retry button
  instead of a bare red error screen.
- Fixed a manual-entry ID collision that could silently drop a transaction.
- Fixed a `.gitignore` rule that ignored `lib/data/database/`, breaking bare clones.

**Asset**: `finance_hub-v0.1.1-release.apk` (~61.8 MB), release-signed, zero dangerous permissions,
covering arm64-v8a / armeabi-v7a / x86_64. Requires Android 7.0 (API 24) or newer.

The app interface is in Chinese.

release.notes:
## 旅行者便签 v1.1.16（只更新手机端）

### 洞天宝钱不再误报「已回满」

- **现象**：手机端「洞天宝钱」一到 **300** 就显示「已回满」，好像 300 就是上限
- **原因**：实时便笺接口（widget v2）的 `max_home_coin` **永远只报初始上限 300**，
  而洞天仙力升级后真实上限是 600 / 900 / 1200 / ……，接口并不给；
  宝钱一旦到 300，接口就把 `home_coin_recovery_time` 回成 0，界面把它当成"已回满"
- **现在**：只有接口确实报了 **> 300** 的上限时，才显示「当前 / 上限」和回满时间；
  否则只显示**当前数量**——不会冒出「已回满」，也不会把 300 当成你的上限。
  以后接口如果开始返回真实上限，界面会自动恢复「当前 / 上限」的写法
- 树脂那一行不受影响（树脂上限恒为 160，接口给的是真值）

### 手表端

本次**没有改动**，手表 rpk 仍是 1.1.15，不用重装；新版手机端与它照常同步

## MyBudget 0.1.4

  Multi-device sync is the headline: two devices now stay in step on their own,
  without anyone opening Settings and pressing Sync.

  ### Sync
  - Real-time push: a change on one device lands on the other in about a second.
  - Every install carries its own identity, so two devices restored from one
    backup no longer cancel each other out.
  - The server requires a shared token before it serves any budget data.
  - Deletions stay deleted, settings and SMS presets travel, and a wiped server
    can be rebuilt from the device that still has the data.

  ### Money
  - Amounts are stored in exact minor units per currency, so balances and
    subtotals no longer drift by a cent.
  - One conversion path for all currencies, and an honest "cannot be priced"
    instead of an invented 1.0 rate.

  ### Forecast
  - New Forecast tab: net-worth trend over 1, 5 and 10 years, with the share of
    the movement the trend actually explains.
  - The compound model is withheld when a balance grows by contributions rather
    than returns, instead of extrapolating a savings habit into millions.

  ### Speed
  - Balances and dashboard totals come off SQL aggregates instead of replaying
    the whole history, so adding a transaction no longer freezes the screen.

  ### Everywhere else
  - Keyboard shortcuts for view, sort, filter and selection actions across all
    main screens.
  - 10 languages, with dates formatted in the app's language.
  - Failed writes, imports and rate lookups now report themselves instead of
    failing silently.

repo.description: Privacy-focused E2E encrypted messenger for Android

release.name: Beacon Messenger v1.039 — Anonymous Routing & Cover Traffic
release.notes:
Privacy-focused self-hosted encrypted messenger for Android.

## Security
- End-to-end encryption: Signal Protocol (X3DH + Double Ratchet v3 + AES-256-GCM)
- Double encryption at rest: Storage Master Key layer on top of EncryptedSharedPreferences
- No phone number or email required for registration
- Mutual invite system — nobody can message you without your consent
- Certificate pinning, anti-debugging, root detection
- Intrusion detection: proxy, user CA, VPN, ADB monitoring at runtime

## Privacy
- Anonymous token routing — server sees no sender/recipient identities
- Anonymous mailbox — first contact does not reveal the A→B pair
- Constant-rate cover traffic to resist timing correlation attacks (Moderate / Aggressive modes)
- Tor hidden service support via Orbot
- WebRTC P2P calls — media never passes through server
- Screen capture prevention (FLAG_SECURE)
- Paranoid Mode — log suppression + remote alert on threat detection

## Emergency features
- Panic password — triggers silent data wipe on login
- Panic button in notification — wipe accessible from locked screen
- Three wipe levels: SOFT / HARD / NUCLEAR
- Decoy mode — fake account shown after wipe for plausible deniability
- Dead Man's Switch — automatic wipe if check-in missed

## Backup
- Full encrypted backup including identity keypair (fingerprint preserved across wipe+restore)
- AES-256-GCM + Argon2id (m=64 MB) — resistant to GPU brute-force

## Self-hosted
- Deploy your own server: `pip install websockets cryptography && python server.py`
- SQLite storage, no external dependencies
- Full source code available

**Requirements:** Android 8.0+

# VOID Releases
Official APK releases for **VOID Messenger** — a privacy-first encrypted messaging app for Android.

> Source code is maintained in a private repository. This repo exists solely for distributing signed release builds.

---

## Download

**Latest:** [v3.0.2](https://github.com/TOUTAKUN04/void_messenger/releases/latest)

Or visit **[void.toutakun04.qzz.io](https://void.toutakun04.qzz.io)** to download directly.

---

## Installation

1. Download the APK from the [Releases](https://github.com/TOUTAKUN04/void_messenger/releases) page
2. On your Android device, enable **Install from unknown sources**
   - Settings → Apps → Special app access → Install unknown apps
3. Open the downloaded APK and install
4. Launch VOID and sign in with Google or email

> Minimum Android version: **Android 8.0 (API 26)**

---

## Verifying the APK

All releases are signed with the VOID release keystore. You can verify the signature using `apksigner`:

```bash
apksigner verify --print-certs void-3.0.2.apk
```

The certificate SHA-1 should match the one published on the official site.

---

## What is VOID?

VOID is an end-to-end encrypted messaging app built around one principle — your conversations belong to no one.

- **E2EE** — EC P-256 + AES-256-GCM, encrypted on device via AndroidKeyStore
- **No phone number required** — sign up with Google or email
- **Zero data collection** — no analytics, no tracking, no metadata
- **Server-side queue only** — messages deleted from server immediately on delivery
- **Group messaging** — fully E2EE group chats with per-member key delivery
- **Open architecture** — Cloudflare Workers + Supabase + Backblaze B2

---

## Features

|--------|--------|
| 1:1 E2EE messaging | ✅ |
| Group messaging (E2EE) | ✅ Beta |
| Voice messages | ✅ |

release.name: CashGuard v1.0.2 — Signed Release
release.notes:
## CashGuard v1.0.2 — first properly signed release

### Important — please read if you installed v1.0.0 or v1.0.1

Those earlier releases shipped a **debug-signed** APK (fine for testing,
not appropriate for public distribution — the debug key is a well-known
shared Android SDK key, not unique to this app). This release switches to
a dedicated release signing key.

**Because the signature changed, Android will refuse to install this as an
update over v1.0.0/v1.0.1.** You'll need to uninstall the old debug build
first (this clears its local data) before installing this one. Sorry for
the inconvenience — from this release onward the signing key stays the
same, so all future updates will install in place normally.

### Changed
- Release builds are now signed with a dedicated release key (see the
  README's "Signed release builds" section for how `key.properties` works).
- Version bumped to `versionCode 2` / `versionName 1.0.2` to reflect this
  as the first real distributable build.
- Download links (website + README) now point at the stable `CashGuard.apk`
  asset name, which will keep working across all future releases via
  `/releases/latest/download/CashGuard.apk`.

### Install
Download `CashGuard.apk` below and sideload it, or build from source with
`./gradlew assembleDebug` (a release build requires the maintainer's
private signing key and isn't buildable by contributors — see the README).

After installing, grant **Notification Access** (Settings → Apps → Special
app access → Notification access → CashGuard).

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/premathunga/CashGuard/compare/v1.0.1...v1.0.2

Correcciones sobre la [v0.9](https://github.com/ellokojavi/UFChile/releases/tag/v0.9).

## Descarga

**[UFChile.apk](https://github.com/ellokojavi/UFChile/releases/latest/download/UFChile.apk)** — este enlace siempre apunta a la versión más reciente.

## Fechas en formato chileno

El calendario de Material seguía el idioma del teléfono. En un equipo configurado en inglés mostraba **"Select date · Jan 1, 1990"**, iniciales de días **S M T W T F S**, y el modo de teclado esperaba mes-día-año, contradiciendo al resto de la app.

Ahora la aplicación fija su configuración a es-CL: **"Seleccionar fecha · 1 ene 1990"**, teclado en **01-01-1990**, y la semana parte en **lunes** como en cualquier calendario chileno.

## Pantalla "Acerca de"

Nueva, y deliberadamente discreta: sin diálogo al abrir, sin banner, sin nada que aceptar. Se llega desde una línea al pie de la pantalla principal o tocando la insignia que indica de dónde viene el dato.

Contiene:

- Que **UF Chile es una aplicación independiente**, sin afiliación ni respaldo de la CMF, el Banco Central, el INE ni ningún banco.
- Las **fuentes con sus enlaces**. Los [términos de uso de la CMF](https://api.cmfchile.cl/terminos-de-uso.html) autorizan publicar sus datos en una app de terceros con una condición: nombrar la fuente *más un enlace a su sitio*. La versión anterior nombraba la fuente pero no la enlazaba.
- Cómo se calculan las cifras.
- Que no son asesoría financiera, y que una simulación de crédito es un modelo, no una cotización.

## Corrección de gestos

El gráfico capturaba los arrastres verticales, así que un dedo que empezaba sobre él no lograba desplazar la pantalla. Ahora solo reclama los horizontales, que son los del explorador de fechas.

release.notes:
**INVESTigator** watches what you actually own, decodes what's really inside your ETFs, and sends you a calm, noise-filtered briefing that explains *why each thing matters to you*. It never says buy or sell — it's a context amplifier for your own thinking, not a trading assistant.

Same pure-TypeScript engine on both platforms. All data sources are free and public; your holdings never leave your machine.

### Highlights
- **ETF look-through** — decomposes your ETFs into their real holdings, so you see your *true* company exposure.
- **Hidden concentration & overlap** — names you hold both directly and inside funds.

- **Noise-filtered news** — only material items, scored by how much they touch *your* capital, deduplicated and capped.

- **Android:** allow "install unknown apps". It starts empty — use **Settings → Backup & transfer** to import a backup exported from desktop.

repo.description: Anonymous end-to-end encrypted messenger

release.name: BeHide 1.1.0
release.notes:
BeHide is an anonymous, end-to-end encrypted messenger. No account, no server-side history, no idea who you are.

This release adds photos and videos to conversations, with the same promise as the rest of the app: nothing readable leaves your device, and nothing readable sits on your phone.

## What's new

- **Photos and videos.** Send images and video clips in any conversation. Media is sealed with XChaCha20-Poly1305 like every message, split into chunks, and each chunk travels in its own encrypted envelope. The relay handles them exactly as it handles text: opaque envelopes it cannot open.
- **Encrypted at rest, too.** Received media lands in an encrypted vault on the device, alongside the encrypted database. Playback uses a short-lived plaintext cache that is purged when the app locks.
- **Clickable links.** URLs in messages are now tappable. Only `http` and `https` are followed, and invisible text-direction characters are stripped, so a link cannot disguise where it really points.

Two limits are deliberate: 16 MB per file, and 60 seconds per video. Images are recompressed before sending. Videos are not re-encoded, so an oversized one is refused with a clear message rather than silently truncated.

## Also in this release

Updated to Expo SDK 57.0.9 and React Native 0.86.2, with the usual round of dependency patches.

## Install

**Android** : Download `behide.apk` below and open it to install.

**iOS** : Download `behide.ipa` below. It is unsigned, so you install it by sideloading (AltStore or Sideloadly) with your own free Apple ID. With a free account, iOS requires reinstalling the app every 7 days.

Each file ships with a `.sha256` checksum so you can verify your download.

## Good to know

BeHide is an independent project and has not been audited by anyone. If your safety truly depends on it, use Signal instead. The full, honest list of limitations is in the README.

# Health Toolbox
A lightweight, simple and function-oriented health/fitness **android** app.

All formulaes and health-indicators are derived from research papers (Papers are cited in-app). 
Please note that this app does NOT serve as medical advice.

## Main Features

### Calculators
1. Body Mass Index
2. Body Fat Percentage
3. Basal Metabolic Rate
4. Calorie Burn
5. One Rep Max
    - Various formulae included to provide better 1 Rep Max estimations based on the exercise.

### Various Health/Fitness Tools
1. Blood Pressure Tracker
    - Checks your Blood Pressure (BP) input to the BP chart.
    - Chart references based on the American Heart Association's guidelines as of 161220.
2. Interval Timer
    - Customisable and save-able intervals.
    - Comes with pre-set 'TABATA' option.
3. Workout Planner
    - Planning and keep track of workouts.
    - Customisable names, reps and weights used.
    - Extra options available to...  
        a. Create a timer for an exercise. (e.g. Planks)  
        b. Disable weights (For calisthenics/bodyweight exercises s/a Pullups)  
        c. Change number of reps to 'Do To Failure'.
4. VO2 Max Test Calculator
    - 4 Tests with different formulas and metrics to estimate VO2 Max.
5. Manual Heart Rate Timer

## Pre-requisites
1. To install this your device needs to run on **Android 8.0 (Oreo)** and above.
2. At least 3MB of space.

2. If you are here for the app only, **do not download the source code**. That is not the application.

# AgentDeck `0.2.0-beta.11`

安全通道预发布包（`secure`）。Lab 见 `v0.2.0-beta.11-lab.md`。

## 产物

| 文件 | applicationId |
| --- | --- |
| `app-secure-arm64-v8a-beta.apk` | `com.agentdeck.app.debug` |
| `app-secure-x86_64-beta.apk` | `com.agentdeck.app.debug` |

版本：`versionName=0.2.0-beta.11` · `versionCode=16`

## 本版要点

- **会话模式**：对话顶栏左侧选「轻聊 / 开发」；列表只显示当前模式会话。
- **轻聊**：无本机 Agent，Chat Completions + 角色；设置隐藏运行环境/扩展/会话高级。
- **开发**：Codex / pi / dsh 本机 Agent 路径；Runtime 横幅仅在开发模式出现。
- **启动手感**：预热、历史落盘预览、列表按压预取、pi `set_model` 热路径等 P0/P1。
- Runtime 按 CLI 分目录（Codex under `runtimes/codex/`）；dsh / pi 按需安装。
- 菜单背景统一主题 `surface`（模式菜单、会话三点菜单）。

## Secure 边界

- 不含无障碍屏幕代理，也不含本地 MCP。
- 备份文件不含 API Key、Bearer、capability。

release.name: Hush Chat v2.14.3 - Calls fixed over mobile data, multi-device ringing, session self-repair
release.notes:
## Hush Chat v2.14.3

**Calls work from outside your home network again.** The relay server was telling callers to reach it at a local address, which only works on your own Wi‑Fi — so a call placed over mobile data would ring, hang for a long time and never connect (while the other phone started ringing only after you'd already given up). It now advertises its public address, and keeps that correct automatically if your internet provider changes it. *This part is server-side and already live — it works even without updating the app.*

**Answered on one device, silent on the rest.** If you're signed in on several devices, picking up (or declining) a call now stops the ringing on your other devices instead of leaving them ringing.

**Chats stuck on "unable to decrypt" now repair themselves.** If the other person reinstalled the app, the secure session no longer matched and every later message from them failed to decrypt — permanently, because the app never rebuilt a session it thought it already had. It now detects the mismatch and re-establishes the session. This also fixed calls failing silently, since call setup travels through the same encrypted channel.

### Install
- **Android:** `HushChat-v2.14.3.apk`
- **Windows (installer):** `HushChat-Setup.exe`
- **Windows (portable):** `HushChat-v2.14.3-portable.zip`

The app also updates itself — you'll be prompted the next time you open it.

### Phone and watch
- The watch's activity in progress now really does update on the phone's map about once a second. The phone now asks the watch for its position the way Garmin Explore does; before, the watch never sent it.
- While the watch records a GPS activity, a "Recording on the watch" banner shows on every page. Tap it to open the map.

**Erst den Relay aktualisieren, dann die App.** Der Relay dieser Fassung speichert eine zusätzliche Signatur je Gerät und prüft sie bei der Anmeldung (siehe Geräteliste unten). Das ist additiv: Ältere Apps schicken das Feld nicht und laufen weiter, ein älterer Relay ignoriert es. Neue Endpunkte gibt es nicht, an der nginx-Liste ändert sich nichts. Beim Relay selbst zuerst das Zwischenlager aktualisieren: Es zählt jetzt die Gesamtmenge der Anhänge (siehe unten).

**App-Sperre: zwei Lücken aus der Sicherheitsprüfung vom 18.10.2026.**
- **Einen Faktor hinzufügen verlangt jetzt eine frische Anmeldung**, genau wie das Entfernen. Bis 2.0.0 konnte jemand mit dem kurz entsperrten Telefon ein eigenes App-Passwort anlegen und sich damit ausweisen: für die zwölf Wörter, die Sperrfrist, die Fernlöschung und die Teilgeheimnisse. Dasselbe gilt für das Panik-Wort. Ein neu angelegter Faktor zählt erst nach dem nächsten Entsperren als Ausweis.
- **Die Sperre greift jetzt auch im Hintergrund.** Bis 2.0.0 ging die App erst beim Zurückkommen zu. Bei „Sofort“ blieben die Schlüssel offen, solange sie im Hintergrund lag. Jetzt sperrt sie bei „Sofort“ beim Weglegen und sonst, sobald die Frist um ist. **Der Hintergrundempfang verlängert die Frist nicht:** Bei 1 oder 5 Minuten empfängt die App nur in dieser Zeit. Dauerhaft geht es nur mit „Nie“. Die Einstellungen sagen das jetzt dazu.

**Geräteliste: ein Relay, der eine Abmeldung verschweigt** (Befund aus derselben Prüfung). Bis 2.0.0 bekamen Kontakte die signierte Geräteliste nur über den Relay. Nahm er eine neue Fassung an und lieferte weiter die alte aus, verschlüsselten die Kontakte weiter an das abgemeldete Gerät, und es konnte weiter als Besitzer schreiben. Protokoll und Grenzen: [`secure-messenger/docs/GERAETEABMELDUNG.md`](https://github.com/Henner4746/BitDM/blob/v2.0.1/secure-messenger/docs/GERAETEABMELDUNG.md) §12.

release.name: v1.1.3 — 运动检测引擎优化 & 多语言支持
release.notes:
## 🎯 运动检测引擎优化

### 多信号稳定性检测
- HOLD 类运动（平板支撑、靠墙静蹲等）现在支持多信号并行检测
- 新增 `signal_mode`（ALL/ANY）门控，控制多信号确认逻辑
- StabilityDetector 支持为每个信号创建独立实例

### 波形范围指示器
- 波形图上用红色虚线标注 HOLD 运动的目标角度范围
- 角度信号显示°符号，归一化信号不显示
- 一眼就知道姿势是否在正确范围内

### 出拳检测优化
- 从肘角检测改为手腕位置追踪
- 支持直拳、摆拳、勾拳三种拳法
- 防守姿态 → 出拳位置 → 收回 = 1 次

## 🌍 完整多语言支持

- 37 个运动全部支持中英文翻译（name/intro/constraint）
- API 按 `Accept-Language` 返回对应语言
- 客户端零处理成本

## 📊 运动配置重构

### 7 分组结构
- `meta`: 名称、介绍、约束说明（多语言）
- `body`: 肌肉权重、部位标签
- `reward`: 铜币奖励、单位、每日上限
- `config`: 摄像头开关等运行时配置
- `template`: 引擎检测参数（rule + wave）

### template 子结构
- `rule`: 规则引擎（阶段、周期、防抖）
- `wave`: 信号检测（共享字段 + REP/HOLD 专用字段）

## 🎯 运动优化

### 移除 4 个运动
- 动态射箭（archery-draw）：需要侧面视角
- 射箭保持（archery-hold）：同上
- 门框胸大肌拉伸（doorway-chest-stretch）：需要门框辅助
- 臂屈伸（tricep-dip）：检测逻辑与实际动作不匹配

### 新增 1 个运动
- 站姿体前屈（standing-hamstring-stretch）

### 修复 HOLD 类运动
- 18 个 HOLD 运动补全 `hold_range` 角度范围
- 眼镜蛇拉伸：修复髋角条件（逻辑反了）
- 背后扣手扩胸拉伸：降低肘角阈值
- 靠墙天使：增加肩角和肘角检测
- 猫牛脊柱活动：改为跪姿检测 + 计时模式
- 收腹跳：建议改为膝角检测

## 🎨 UI 改进

- 拉伸运动排序权重 *0.5（选中部位时优先显示力量训练）
- 运动排序 bug 修复（muscleGroupMapEn 统一使用英文 key）

## 📦 技术细节

- App: Kotlin + Jetpack Compose + MediaPipe BlazePose
- Server: Go + Gin + GORM + SQLite
- 模板: 37 个运动，7 分组结构，16 个引擎字段

release.name: CielFit v1.2 - vector launcher icon
release.notes:
**Launcher icon rebuilt as vector drawables.**

The adaptive icon is now three `<vector>` XMLs instead of rasterised PNGs, so Android renders it natively at every density and screen size:

- `ic_launcher_background.xml` - near-black radial wash
- `ic_launcher_foreground.xml` - amber-to-pink gradient ring with a green two-tine fork
- `ic_launcher_monochrome.xml` - flat white layer, so Android 13+ themed icons recolour cleanly instead of turning the gradient to mud

Also fixes two rendering bugs that made the icon look wrong:

1. **The ring was almost invisible.** The vector arc (`A27,27 0 1 0` - large-arc, counter-clockwise, the long 320 degree path) was correct, but the PNG generator drew the short 40 degree path, so the raster fallback disagreed with the vector.
2. **The square legacy icons showed a sliver in the corner.** The mark was composited as a separate square canvas and pasted in, putting it off-centre. Now the whole 108dp grid is scaled so the mark stays centred.

Design notes: the ring carries a 40 degree gap at the top so the fork never tangles with it, and the fork uses two thick tines with a wide gap - three thin tines lose the gaps between them when rendered at 48px and read as a tuning fork instead.

**Carried over from v1.1** (all verified against the real TFLite model, 22/22 unit tests):
- Scan food works - output array is sized from the tensor shape (2024), not the label row count (2022), which was throwing on every capture
- Labels keyed by the file's own id column; id 0 is the model's background class
- Scan food is a shutter button - point at the plate, tap the button
- No more per-frame Bitmap allocation crash-looping the camera

- 新增 15 项离线真人 GIF，涵盖卧推、划船、引体向上、腿举、哑铃罗马尼亚硬拉和肩臂训练；逐项核对实际动作、器械、素材作者与许可，保留转换参数和来源校验信息。

- 修正鸟狗式、蟹行的对侧手脚示意；Apple 原生端暂停与后台时间不再推进动图时间轴。
- 手机动作库增加「仅离线演示」，搜索支持用空格组合动作、器械和部位，大小写不敏感。动作选择器使用同一搜索规则。
- 手机列表使用按需渲染和单次历史统计，不再为每一行重复扫描全部训练记录，也不把 0 kg 显示为最高负重。
- 手机播放器新增前台 20 秒网络加载超时与重试入口、直达动作步骤；进入文字教学时暂停动图。动图默认跟随系统「减少动态效果」，仍可手动播放；呼吸引导在该设置下保持文字和倒计时，不缩放圆环。

xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Jogging.app

signed): *More info → Run anyway*. `JoggingBleBridge.exe` next to it handles Bluetooth and the spoken
announcements; allow it when Windows asks. The Windows Bluetooth helper hasn't been tested on a real treadmill
yet – feedback welcome in the issues.

Allow "Nearby devices" (or "Location" on older Android) so the app can find the treadmill and heart-rate strap.

simulated treadmill:

```bash
open /Applications/Jogging.app --args -beltsim
```

- **Outings**: a walk or run with a goal, with vibrations or a voice at the milestones.
- **Insights**: your streak, your records and your averages.
- **Measure your step**: walk a distance you know, no GPS.
- **Two widgets** and a **Quick Settings tile**.
- **Notifications**, each optional: goal reached, an evening reminder, a weekly summary.
- **Your data**: a backup to a file, CSV for spreadsheets, an import that never deletes.
- **The guide**, light and dark themes, two palettes, three typefaces.
- **For every reader**: TalkBack, text up to twice its size, foldables.
- **English and Italian**, through the system per-app language picker.

### Private and light

- No `INTERNET` permission: Passo cannot send anything.
- No Health Connect, Google Fit or Play services: the step counter is the only source.
- No timers with the screen off; about 1% of a day's battery.

The full development record is in
[docs/CHANGELOG-1.0.0.md](https://github.com/fiorenzobrioni/passo/blob/main/docs/CHANGELOG-1.0.0.md).

release.name: ReadIt v0.1.8
release.notes:
# ReadIt v0.1.8

版本：v0.1.8（versionCode 8）· minSdk 19 / targetSdk 34

一个**交互**版本：新增翻页方式，并修掉 v0.1.7 里状态条刷不出来的缺陷。
功能面与 v0.1.7 一致（TXT / EPUB / DOCX / PDF 四格式、WebDAV 同步、云端版本化备份、
阅读统计、书签、反色、屏幕灯、书架长按菜单与书籍属性）。

## 新增：翻页方式（仅非墨水屏设备）

设置 → 屏幕适配 → **翻页方式**，四种可选：

| 方式 | 行为 |
|---|---|
| **点按翻页**（默认） | 点屏幕左/右三分之一翻页，中间调出菜单 —— v0.1.7 之前的行为 |
| **左右滑动翻页** | 只有左右滑动才翻页；点按不再翻页（手机上拇指习惯滑动，点按容易误触）。中点调出菜单仍保留，它不属于翻页 |
| **上下滚动** | 正文变成连续的一长条，纵向拖动阅读 |
| **翻页动画** | 翻页时带横向滑动动画（旧页滑出、新页滑入，220ms） |

**墨水屏上固定为点按翻页，且整个选项不显示。** 原因是一次刷新就是一次全屏重绘：
动画过程会留下一串残影（读起来像「屏幕脏了」），连续滚动会变成一整屏一整屏地跳。
这与同类墨水屏应用的取舍一致（EinkBro 把「所有控件高对比度、无不必要动画」列为基本要求）。

用户的偏好值**本身不被改写** —— 墨水屏上只是不生效，换到普通屏幕（平板 / 手机）时自动重新生效。

### 上下滚动模式的实现要点

- 把分页接成一条**连续行流**，画满一屏就接着画下一页，页与页之间没有缝。
  顺带修掉一个老问题：按页画时，一页里多出来的视觉行会被屏幕下边界截断丢弃
  （静默丢字）；连续行流把它们顺延到下一屏，**一个字都不会少**。
- 滚动位置用（页、页内行号、行内像素偏移）**增量**维护，像素级平滑，不是「一行一跳」。
- 滚动位置的字符偏移改成「首个可见行真正的起始字符」—— 进度不再一页一跳。
- 固定版式的 PDF 没有「连续」可言，滚动模式对它仍按页翻。

## 修复：底部状态条刷不出来

**v0.1.7 起就存在**：页码与已读长度条始终是空白。

根因是画布的「页变了」回调有两个来源，两个都会让直接 `setText` 失效：

1. `onSizeChanged → rebuild → notifyPageChanged()` 发生在**布局过程中** ——
   此时 `setText` 会触发「布局中调用 requestLayout」，Android 把这次改动丢掉；
2. `setDocument()` 跑在 **io 线程**（打开 TXT 的解码在后台），它内部的 `rebuild()`
   同样会回调 —— 那是**跨线程改 UI**。

两种情况的症状一模一样：页码空白、长度条不出现。
修法：抽出 `PageStatusWriter`，一律 post 到主线程（`View.post` 对已 attach 的视图走主线程
Handler，且在当前这一轮布局结束之后才执行），顺带把 `contentDescription` 的跨线程写也挪进去。

## 验证

- 单元测试 438 → **458**（本批新增 20 条：翻页方式枚举与回落规则 6 条、滚动边界 5 条、
  状态条 post 纪律 5 条、动画可观测状态与渲染对比 2 条、状态条真实链路渲染 2 条）
- 真机验证（小米 Civi2 / Android 15，非墨水屏）：四种方式逐一实测通过 ——
  点按翻页、滑动翻页（点按不翻页 / 滑动才翻页）、上下滚动（正文连续无断层、页码同步）、
  翻页动画（抓到中间帧：旧页滑出、新页滑入）
- `clean` 后 assembleDebug 15.28 / 15.13 MB，assembleRelease 13.2 / 13.1 MB，均在 16MB 红线内

## 体积提醒

**体积必须在 `clean` 之后量。** 增量构建产出的 APK 会在 zip 内部留下数 MB 的填充，
实测虚报为 19.7MB —— 逐条目比对确认内容只比基线多 24KB（648 个文件，无任何独有条目）。

## 升级

debug 包用工程内固定 keystore 签名，可直接覆盖安装。release 包仍未签名，需自行签名后安装。

release.notes:
## X-pense v1.1.0

First versioned release since the `beta` tag, consolidating the `playground` branch plus security and feature work merged via PR #45 and its follow-ups.

### Security
- Passcode and security-question answers are now stored as salted SHA-256 hashes instead of plaintext (`storage_service.dart`).
- App lock now enforces brute-force lockout with an escalating cooldown after repeated failed passcode/security-answer attempts.
- CSV export sanitizes category/account fields to prevent spreadsheet formula injection.
- `AndroidManifest.xml` hardened: removed broad external storage permissions, disabled `allowBackup`.

### Features
- New opt-in email sync for Canara Bank transaction alerts (IMAP-based), with a review-and-confirm step before transactions are imported (`mail_sync_*`, `bank_email_parser.dart`).

### Performance
- `getAvailableYears()` results are now cached and invalidated on transaction mutations instead of recomputed every call.
- Income/expense sorting and filtering moved out of the UI layer and into `TransactionViewModel`, avoiding repeated work in `home_screen.dart`.

### Code health
- Remaining raw `print()` calls across `storage_service.dart` and `transaction_viewmodel.dart` replaced with `debugPrint`, gated by `kDebugMode` where appropriate.
- Added unit test coverage: `FilterState.copyWith`, `SelectionState` toggling, `Formatters.currency`/`relativeTime`, `Transaction` JSON serialization, CSV auto-categorization.

### Notes
- No signed APK is attached to this release; build one locally with `flutter build apk` if you need a binary.
- `pubspec.yaml` version bumped to `1.1.0+1`.

## v1.8.1

### Removed
- **App lock section** removed from Settings (the app stays unlocked by default, as intended).

### Fixed
- **Auto local backup rewritten and crash-free.** The old flow launched the system folder picker, which could crash on some devices. Backups now write automatically into the app's own private storage — no folder picker, no permissions, nothing to fail.

### How auto local backup works
- When enabled, a weekly snapshot of **all your data** (expenses, budgets, borrow/lend entries) is saved as JSON inside the app's private storage — a safety net that works even without Supabase configured.
- Keeps the **latest 8 snapshots** and shows the last backup time.

- Restore: Settings → Data → **Import** → pick the shared JSON file.

release.notes:
# Zentra v2.5.0

A major production-hardening, security, and system-integration release focused on making Zentra more reliable, performant, and release-ready on Android 14 (API 34).

## Highlights

- **Focus Session integration:** Connected the Dashboard and Quick Settings tile to the background Focus Session foreground service, including native countdown notifications.
- **Persistent focus tracking:** Persisted completed Pomodoro and Deep Focus sessions, along with focus streaks, to Room.
- **Automated app limits:** Integrated per-app daily usage limits, Quiet Hours suppression, and Mindfulness Overlay launches into background checks.
- **Live Focus Score widget:** Synchronized Focus Score updates with the home-screen widget.
- **Insights performance:** Fixed the daily breakdown list's `LayoutManager` issue and upgraded adapters to `DiffUtil` with lazy icon caching.
- **Settings and security:** Converted `SettingsManager` into a Hilt singleton with in-memory caching, Keystore corruption recovery, and backup exclusion rules.
- **Android permissions:** Replaced `QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES` with scoped `<queries>` declarations and added Android 14 foreground-service permissions.
- **Build and database improvements:** Enabled R8 code and resource shrinking, added the non-destructive `MIGRATION_1_2` Room migration, and adopted `java.time` date handling.
- **Testing and documentation:** Expanded unit and Room instrumentation tests, added GitHub Actions CI and release workflows, and introduced `PRIVACY.md` and `SECURITY.md`.

## Validation

- Unit tests passing
- Room instrumentation tests passing
- Android lint passing
- Release build successful
- Tested on an Android emulator

Download the signed APK from the **Assets** section below and install it on a compatible Android device.

**AI 解析卡死** —— 之前点「AI 解析」后界面会长时间停在「AI 解析中…」，既无法取消也无法恢复。

根因有两处：

1. 失败重试最多 11 次、每次超时 30 秒，**没有总时长上限**；API Key 失效、余额不足、模型名错误这类永久性错误也会被反复重试；
2. 协程被取消时界面状态没有复位，按钮会**永久**停在「解析中」。

本次改动：

- 重试次数 11 → 3，新增 **45 秒总时长硬上限**，到点必定返回；
- 永久性错误立即失败，并直接说明原因（Key 无效 / 余额不足 / 模型名错误 / 限流），不再笼统提示「解析失败」；
- 解析中按钮保持可点，文案为「AI 解析中… 点击取消」，可随时中断；
- 状态复位移入 `finally`，任何情况下都不会再卡住。

**语音记录来源标记** —— 首页「按住说话」记的账会被错误标记为手动录入（不显示 🎤 图标），已修复。

release.name: v3.6.0 — Two-way sync, editable credit categories
release.notes:
## ⚠️ Read this before updating

This release is signed with a new key, so Android **cannot** update over your existing install. You have to uninstall first, and uninstalling erases local data.

Do it in this order:

1. Open your current app and **sync** (Settings → Google Sync → Sync Now). Wait for Pending to hit 0.
2. Uninstall the old app.
3. Install the APK below.
4. Open it and sign in to Google — your data comes back from the spreadsheet.

**Step 1 is not optional.** On 3.5.0 the sync only ever pushed data up, so anything you haven't synced lives only on your phone and goes with the uninstall. If you want to be extra safe, open your spreadsheet and do File → Download → Microsoft Excel before you uninstall.

## What's new

**Credit categories are editable.** They used to be a hardcoded list. You can now add, rename and delete them, same as the debit side.

**Linked categories.** If the same name exists on both sides — say Home — it's now one category, and Reports nets the two together. ₹18,500 of rent minus ₹6,200 from a flatmate shows as ₹12,300, with both figures still visible. Same for lending to a friend and being repaid.

**Google Sheets sync works both ways.** Signing in on a fresh install pulls everything back down: transactions, categories, friends, budgets, payment methods and autopay rules. A reinstall is no longer a data loss event.

**Balances ask the right question.** Instead of asking what your account held before your first ever transaction, the app asks what you have today and works backwards.

## Fixes

- The in-app updater never worked — it was fetching `version.json` from a branch that doesn't exist. No update notification has ever been delivered until now.
- The v3.5.0 download link was broken (filename mismatch).
- A fresh install used to invent a ₹15,000 opening bank balance.
- Budgets offered credit-only categories, so you could set a spending limit on Salary.

**Work in progress**: it runs on the Android emulator, but crashes on some phones with a Mali GPU, in the graphics driver. After a crash the app shows why when opened again, and saves the report as `Download/MacGuitar-crash.txt`: sending it helps find a way around.

## New in 0.15.0

- **The library**: albums of tabs, like a learning diary
  - Make an album of a folder: its tabs, PDF tab books and cover come along (choose the folder and tap "Use this folder")
  - Or start an empty album and add tabs, PDFs and a cover image
  - Each song is split into its parts (the markers of the tab); tap a part once it is learned, and the song and the album show how much is done
  - PDF tab books open in the phone's PDF viewer
  - The library is kept in `MacGuitar/Library` on the phone
- **One APK for every phone**: arm64, 32-bit arm and x86_64 (Chromebooks, emulators)

## Install

Download `MacGuitar-0.15.0-android.apk` on the phone and open it; Android asks to allow installing apps from the browser or the file manager it was opened in. It installs over 0.14.0.

## On the phone

- A tap places the playhead, a finger moving scrolls
- A hold loops the measure, a hold then a drag loops the measures it goes over, a hold on a loop clears it
- Upright or across, with the zoom (− / +) above the tablature
- Tabs open from the in-app file browser (it asks once for the access to all files) or with "Open with MacGuitar" from a file manager

release.notes:
Голос: сказали — получили заметку и напоминание.

### Добавлено
- Быстрая заметка голосом: кнопка с микрофоном в библиотеке, визуализация
  громкости и текст по мере распознавания. Сказали «встреча, 15:00» —
  получили заметку «Встреча» и напоминание в 14:30.
- Разбор сказанного в ядре: время (`15:00`, «в 17», «в 9 утра», «в 15 30`),
  относительные дни («завтра», «в пятницу»), отсчёт от сейчас («через час»).
  Непонятое слово остаётся в заголовке, а не становится чужим временем.
- Настройки → «Быстрые заметки»: запас перед названным временем
  (по умолчанию 30 минут) и время для фраз без времени (по умолчанию 19:00).
- Плагин `speech`: распознавание только офлайн-моделью устройства, звук
  никуда не записывается.
- Числа словами в разборе: «в три часа», «полвторого», «в половине третьего»,
  «без пятнадцати шесть», «полдень», "half past three". Час, сказанный словом,
  читается как дневной, а если тот прошёл — как вечерний.
- Части суток без часа: «завтра утром» → 09:00, «вечером» → 19:00.
- Подбор языка распознавания по тому, что телефон умеет: интерфейс → язык
  телефона → русский, с надписью на экране, если слушает не на языке
  интерфейса. Кнопка «Скачать распознавание», если офлайн-модели нет.
- Ярлык «Продиктовать» по долгому нажатию на иконку приложения.
- В плашке результата: что сказали и на когда поставлено, «Отменить» и сдвиги
  времени ±15 минут / ±1 час; причина, если напоминание не встало, и кнопка в
  настройки Android, когда дело в разрешении.
- Переводы нового интерфейса на все 8 языков.

### Исправлено
- «через 20 минут» отсчитывался с вычетом запаса и звонил почти сразу; теперь

- «на 20 минут», «в 2 раза больше», «встреча 12.03», «матч 14-15» превращались
  в напоминание и теряли число из заголовка.
- «сегодня забрать посылку» вечером отвечало «время в прошлом» и не ставило

# StreamNook for Android 1.0.2

Send pictures in chat, smoother playback on the desktop's quality rules, a lighter battery footprint, and moderator tools from desktop 8.8.15.

## What's new

- **Send pictures in chat.** The emote panel has an Images tab: pick a picture and its link lands in your message box. StreamNook asks once per host and removes location and camera details first. Your uploads stay in the tab, grouped by host, with when each link expires.
- **Playback on the desktop's rules.** Auto picks a quality your connection can carry before the first frame, and changes it only where the switch is seamless.
- **Easier on the battery.** Battery Saver turns emotes, badges and paints still and caps the screen at 60 Hz. A stream paused for 30 seconds stops downloading and comes back at live when you press play, and chat and background checks rest while the app is out of sight.
- **@ puts the streamer first** in the list, even before they've said anything.
- **Moderator tools.** Unban requests show in the Moderation sheet, Manage channel has a Blocked terms page, and Ban confirmation (Settings > Moderation) makes Ban ask for a second tap.

- **Pokémon evolutions.** The Rewards page lists each evolution line and lets you pick the one to evolve.
- **Mentions while you're away** also cover offline chats you've opened in the last two weeks.

## Fixes

- Landscape volume and brightness dials ignore swipes that start at the top or bottom edge.
- The mini player shrinks and grows in one smooth move, keeps mute and close in its corners, and a tap that opens it never presses what's underneath.
- Badges you can earn right now show in Available Now, with the same dates as the badge's page.
- Custom commands that run another command, like /tt for /timeout, now run it.
- When two providers share an emote name, the panel picks the one chat shows, and stacked emotes keep their full size.
- Emotes, badges and 7TV paints kee

repo.description: Локальный MTProto-прокси для Telegram на Android (форк amurcanov → Flowseal/tg-ws-proxy) с исправлениями и актуальной поддержкой.

release.name: v1.2.4
release.notes:
1.2.4 — своё приложение, батарея и патчи оригинала

Батарея. Главная причина расхода — фоновая работа, которая не останавливалась никогда:

    Пул заготовленных соединений засыпает, если Telegram 2 минуты не открывал новых соединений, и просыпается при следующем подключении. Раньше он пересоздавал соединения каждые 2 минуты круглосуточно.
    Медиа-соединения заготавливаются по требованию, а не сразу для всех дата-центров.
    «Умный» wakelock: держится, только пока Telegram что-то передаёт, и отпускается в простое.
    TCP keepalive — раз в 120 с вместо 30 с, ping моста — раз в 60 с вместо 30 с.
    При выключенном экране уведомление не обновляется, статистика опрашивается реже.
    Логи читаются только при открытом приложении (раньше logcat читался в фоне постоянно), подробные логи движка — только если включён фильтр «Debug».

Стабильность и патчи из [TgWsProxy](https://github.com/Flowseal/tg-ws-proxy):

    Мёртвые соединения в пуле теперь распознаются до того, как их получит Telegram (аналог _is_stale из оригинала). Раньше такое соединение «висело», и помогал только перезапуск.
    Самовосстановление: если несколько подключений подряд не нашли рабочего маршрута, прокси сам сбрасывает блокировки и пул.
    Backoff для TCP-fallback: прямой TCP до дата-центров не пробуется заново на каждом подключении (оригинал, 50c980e).
    Для обычных (не медиа) соединений используется только основной домен kwsN (оригинал).
    Пул CF worker: исправлено пополнение (после первого использования он больше не пополнялся) и закрытие при остановке (оригинал, #1411).

Остальное:

    Отдельное приложение (io.github.alexingin.tgwsproxy) с собственной подписью. Обновления приходят из этого репозитория, а не от автора оригинального порта.
    Переключатель «Не давать телефону засыпать» в настройках. Если выключить, расход батареи заметно меньше, но фоновая работа может стать менее стабильной (https://github.com/amurcanov/tg-ws-proxy-android/issues/253).
    Android

## New

- **Link two PCs.** On the first PC, open **Pair**: it shows a 6-digit code. On the second, open **Pair → Join a PC**, pick the first PC from the list and type the code (or run `dotlink nearby`, then `dotlink join "<name>" --code 123456`). Pasting the first PC's link (**Copy link**) works too. The two PCs then send each other files and the clipboard. Clipboard changes go to a linked PC only with **Clipboard sync** on for it; **Send clipboard** works either way. A linked laptop's or MacBook's battery shows next to it.
- **Link two phones.** In the app's new **Phones** tab, tap **Pair a phone**: one phone shows a QR code, the other scans it. They then send each other files and the clipboard directly on the same Wi-Fi, with or without a PC, and **Share → Dotlink** asks where to send. Phones on the same Wi-Fi show as Online.
- The PC app has separate **Phones** and **PCs** pages instead of one Devices page. The phone app's tabs are now **PC**, **Phones**, Remote, Shell, Camera and Settings; without a PC, only Phones and Settings show.
- Dotlink is now licensed under the GNU GPL v3 or later.

## Fixes

- Windows: **Open** and **Show in folder** on a "Received from …" notification did nothing once the notification had moved to the notification center. They work from there now, even with Dotlink closed.

Both PCs, or both phones, need this version to link.

release.notes:
## 安卓客户端 v1.8.3

### 修复

- **内置网页台的「逐行 / 逐句」切换现在真的能用了**
  局域网网页台的路由表里，`POST /api/doc` 的处理分支被同路径的**读取**分支挡在了前面 ——
  Kotlin 的 `when` 只取**第一个命中**的分支，于是切换请求从来没到达过处理函数，在浏览器里点按钮只会收到
  400「缺少 id 参数」，前端只好提示「切换失败」。现在 POST 分支排在读取分支之前，点一下即时切换，
  仍按原文重新切分并保留已有译文与收藏。

- **在网页台里输入的中文，回到手机上不再是乱码**
  内置网页台跑在 NanoHTTPD 上，请求头没有声明 charset 时它会用 **US-ASCII** 解码请求体，
  非 ASCII 字符会变成**不可逆**的替换字符 `U+FFFD`（`你好，世界` 会变成 15 个 `�`）。三处一起修：
  - 网页台前端发 POST 时请求头带 `charset=utf-8`；
  - 服务端不再依赖请求头声明：先按 `Content-Length` 读原始字节、再按 UTF-8 解码 ——
    **浏览器缓存着旧版网页台也安全**；
  - 独立网页服务端的请求体解析同步改为按 UTF-8 解码（见 line-trans-web v1.8.3）。

  ⚠️ 注意：**在此之前已经被写坏的译文无法自动还原**（替换字符不可逆），那几句需要手动重打。

### 兼容性

- `versionCode = 14`，可直接覆盖安装 —— 签名 SHA-256 指纹与历史版本逐位一致
  （`64:08:46:12:…:A5:AC:59`）
- 逐行 / 逐句切分规则未改动
- 内置网页台的前端资源与离线词库随包不变

> 与网页端、PC 端共用同一条版本线。

release.name: ClipLex v1.0.0
release.notes:
# ClipLex v1.0.0

ClipLex v1.0.0 is the submission-ready ARM64 Android build for the Arm AI Optimization Challenge.

## Highlights

- Private on-device playback capture, transcription and translation.
- Captures permitted learning moments for up to 180 seconds (3 minutes).
- Video-first lessons with safe audio fallback.
- Bounded video and audio captions that remain usable with long text.
- Tappable vocabulary, saved words, quizzes and pronunciation practice.
- Refined Android-native V2 interface with consistent hierarchy and accessible touch targets.
- `arm64-v8a`-only native packaging and quantified Whisper optimization on an OPPO CPH2781.

## Distribution profile

- Android 10+ (`minSdk 29`).
- ARM64 only.
- Release-optimized, R8-minified, resource-shrunk and non-debuggable.
- Direct-install APK for challenge judges.
- Compact safe flavor with no overlay permission and no bundled LiteRT-LM runtime.
- Speech and translation model files are downloaded separately after installation.

## Runtime compatibility

- Android on-device speech APIs are called only on Android 13 or newer.
- Supported older Android versions safely use the Whisper fallback instead of invoking unavailable platform APIs.
- The three-minute capture ceiling is defined once as `MAX_CAPTURE_SECONDS = 180` and covered by a unit test.

## Verified optimization result

A controlled 9.4-second Whisper test on the OPPO CPH2781 reduced median native inference from 2,393.764 ms to 692.659 ms, a 3.456x speedup and 71.06% latency reduction, while preserving normalized transcript content.

## Important scope

ClipLex works only with permitted Android playback-capture sources. Protected media, DRM, or source-app policy can block audio or video capture. The app does not bypass these restrictions.

Shorter focused clips usually process faster and produce cleaner practice activities, even though the maximum capture length is three minutes.

Google Play publishing requires the maintainer's permanent private upload

release.name: Handover 0.4.1
release.notes:
Handover 0.4.1 keeps Google Messages sessions connected through outages and drops the KDE Connect compatibility backend. The native Android connection is the device path.

## What's new

- Messages recovery stays active through keyring and network outages, and retries credential recovery when the keyring unlocks.
- Reconnect catches up cached conversations, reuses completed history pages, and retries expired or stale sessions after resume.
- Live sessions stay up across history failures, receive bursts, interrupted streams, inactivity, and temporary Google service failures.
- Focused conversation history is archived, the archive size is configurable, and offline contact names are kept.
- The open message stays visible when history resets the list.
- Direct RCS typing events are received.
- A Messages failure stays limited to the fetch or conversation it belongs to.
- Notification keys that are padded or contain control characters are rejected.
- A missing contacts cursor is reported as a truncated snapshot.
- The KDE Connect compatibility backend is removed.

## Install or upgrade

Download the Linux tarball, unpack it, and run `./install.sh`. Choose the optional Google Messages setup component when prompted, or pass `--with-google-messages-setup`. It requires Python 3 and an installed Chromium browser.

Install the signed Android APK to update the companion. Android version code is 57. Installations using an old, differently signed debug APK require uninstalling that APK and pairing again.

See the [user guide](https://github.com/mananlalwani/handover/blob/v0.4.1/docs/user-guide.md) and [known limitations](https://github.com/mananlalwani/handover/blob/v0.4.1/docs/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md). Handover remains pre-1.0, and public interfaces may change.

release.notes:
## 本版更新内容

## 修复

- **开机自启后白屏（X10-124）**：经 LaunchAgent 开机自启时 macOS 不会激活应用（开启「隐藏 Dock 图标」后尤甚），WKWebView 在应用从未成为活跃窗口前不执行首次绘制，导致主窗口纯白、只能退出重开。修复：在应用事件循环 `Ready` 时主动 `show() + set_focus()`，强制首帧绘制；正常启动重复调用无害。

## 界面调整

- **帮助中心默认折叠（X10-125）**：帮助页的每篇主题现在默认只显示标题，点击标题展开正文、再点收起——页面一眼能扫全部主题，不用再长篇滚动。展开状态不持久化，切页后恢复折叠。

## 升级提示

已安装旧版的用户会通过应用内自动更新收到本版；全新安装请从下方下载对应平台的安装包。

---

MirrorDock 桌面镜像工具测试版。本地优先：画面、截图、录像与文件传输只经过你自己的数据线或局域网，不上传任何服务器。

**下载哪个文件**（文件名含版本号，按后缀识别即可）
- Windows：`...-setup.exe`（安装版）或 `....msi`
- macOS（Apple 芯片 M1 及以后）：`..._aarch64.dmg`
- macOS（Intel）：`..._x64.dmg`
- Linux：`....AppImage`（免安装）/ `.deb` / `.rpm`
- 手机伴侣 App：`app-debug.apk`

**安装后怎么开始**
1. 电脑端打开 MirrorDock → 用数据线连手机，或选「无线连接」。
2. 手机开启「开发者选项 → USB 调试 / 无线调试」。Android 11 及以上可直接用「无线调试 → 使用二维码配对设备」扫电脑上的二维码，自动配对连接。
3. 需要伴侣 App 时安装 `app-debug.apk`，与电脑在同一 Wi-Fi 下扫码建立加密连接。

**本版说明**
- 测试版**已内置永久激活码，无需手动激活**，录制等专业版功能直接可用；在「设置 → 版本与授权」点击撤销后可选择不再自动激活。

- 未做自动更新：升级请回到本页面下载新版本。
- 镜像画面方向默认跟随手机旋转，打开横屏游戏会自动转为横屏。
- 会话进行中可用全局快捷键（Ctrl/⌘ + Alt + S 截图、+ R 录制开关、+ D 轮换方向），组合可在「设置」中修改。

**校验与透明**
- 每个平台的 `SHA256SUMS-<平台>.txt` 为对应安装包的校验值，建议下载后核对。
- `sbom-cargo-*.json` / `sbom-npm-*.json` 为依赖清单（SBOM）。

测试版仍在迭代，遇到问题请在本仓库提 Issue，并附上「设置 → 诊断」导出的诊断包（已抹去序列号、配对码与文件路径）。

2. **⚡ Native DNS Endpoint Resolver**: The app parses Surfshark domains (e.g. `tr-ist.prod.surfshark.com`) and resolves them directly to their raw IP addresses before starting the tunnel, preventing DNS blockages.
3. **🔒 AmneziaWG Header Obfuscation (H1-H4)**: Patched the native WireGuard tunnel to rewrite the handshake packet header types to AmneziaWG's obfuscation magic values (H1=32, H2=33, H3=34, H4=35). This hides the WireGuard handshake from DPI firewalls.
4. **🚀 Junk Packet Padding**: AetherNoize is configured to send custom junk padding packets (`Jc` = 4, `Jmin` = 50, `Jmax` = 100) before and after the handshake to mimic the exact packet length obfuscation of AmneziaWG.
5. **🛑 Cancel & Stop Any Time**: Stop stuck connection attempts instantly with a single tap.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/sheshocked/Aethery-Ultimate/commits/v2.4.1

release.name: 僵尸农场 · Windows「游戏已经在运行」误报修复
release.notes:
# 僵尸农场 · Windows「游戏已经在运行」误报修复

Windows 管理器曾把「有没有一个叫 touchHLE 的进程」当成「游戏在不在跑」。闪退之后，模拟器可能留下一个没有窗口、也看不到界面的残留进程，于是管理器一直提示「游戏已经在运行了」，而任务管理器里又找不到可以关掉的东西；从另一份安装启动的游戏、以及被系统复用的旧 PID，也会造成同样的误判。

现在管理器在启动时记录真正的进程（PID、启动时间、可执行文件路径），每次判断都核对这三项，任何一项对不上就立即清掉记录。崩溃之后不会再被卡住，备份、还原和货币修改都不会再因为一条过期状态被拒。另外：

- 崩溃时不再弹出可能藏在窗口后面的错误对话框，改为在状态栏直接说明退出原因（例如 `0xC0000005 访问冲突`）和崩溃信息首行。
- 游戏窗口消失但进程还在时，管理器会自己回到前台，并询问是否结束这个残留进程。
- 点「启动游戏」发现无窗口的残留进程时，会说明 PID 和成因，并提供「结束它并继续」，不再只是一句拒绝。
- 同一份安装不能同时开两个管理器；不同的安装副本仍可各开一个。
- 新增 `touchHLE\zfr_manager.log`，记录启动、退出、拦截与看门狗判断，便于反馈问题时直接定位。

本页同时提供 Windows 更新包和现有 Android 入侵修复版。Android 端没有这个问题：它的运行状态来自一把真正的文件锁（游戏跑在独立进程，进程结束锁即释放），本次未改动。APK 与上一版逐字节相同（versionCode `4`），已经安装该版的玩家无需重复升级。

| 平台 | 下载附件 | 大小 | SHA-256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| Windows 10/11 x64 | `zombie-farm-windows-x64-v29fix-running-detect.zip` | 95,955,050 B | `FE942A83D6409C26268F4F637EF51D4A0347E117E6BAE21EDF70B089DD0C69F4` |
| Android 5.0+ / ARM64 | `zombie-farm-android-arm64-v29fix-invasion-fix.apk` | 97,312,084 B | `C10F0E00B4AADA2E47944F41245AB5B64C5142849926FCC538179DD405920B7F` |

## 使用与升级

- Windows：解压到新目录，运行 `游戏管理.exe`。已有进度请先用旧管理器备份，再在新目录的管理器中恢复；保留旧目录，避免覆盖自己的进度。
- Android：首次安装可使用本页 APK；更新时覆盖安装即可，签名保持一致。内置 v29fix IPA，其他 IPA 可按需导入。
- 两端默认夜间模式，发行包不预置玩家存档；首次进入游戏后自行创建进度。
- 如果仍看到「游戏已经在运行了」：请确认用的是本页的新包。新版本在遇到无窗口残留时会给出 PID 并允许直接结束；`touchHLE\zfr_manager.log` 记录了当时的判断依据。

## 验证与源码

管理器自检新增 5 项运行状态用例（活动记录被采信、PID 复用被拒、已消失的 PID 被拒、退出码解码、崩溃信息提取），全部通过；脚本语法与 BOM 检查、布局与设置往返检查同样通过。重建的 Windows 发行包独立运行实际 `45.0 s` 通过，包内 sandbox 为 0 文件。

另有一份端到端探针 `_analysis\_probe_launch_state.ps1`：在 `%TEMP%` 的发行包副本里真实启动游戏，验证记录写入、PID 与路径正确、正常退出（`code=0`）与强制结束（`code=-1`）两种路径下记录都在 1 秒内清除。测试全程未接触玩家真实存档。

ZIP 内有 42 个文件、单一同名顶层目录，无 sandbox 存档与运行日志；包内管理器与本次 Git 源码逐字节一致，SHA-256 为 `C8DF5046DD39DE0CFF0A23E6375134653666CE6581BC67D96AA89B59BCA82F40`。

管理器源码见本次 tag [`v29fix-running-detect`](https://github.com/Ashena1017/zombie-farm-touchhle-cn/tree/v29fix-running-detect)。两端 touchHLE 原生程序沿用源码 commit `2a478424b50591360f91790ee760f34b78072987` 的入侵分配器修复

release.name: TabExtend v0.1.0-alpha.1
release.notes:
**Pre-release: the extended screen works; touch input does not yet.**

TabExtend turns an Android tablet into a wireless extended monitor for GNOME on Wayland. This first alpha is for trying the display side and reporting how it behaves on your hardware.

### Works
- Pairing by QR code or pairing link, over TLS 1.3 with both sides' certificates pinned
- GNOME adds the tablet as a second monitor; drag windows onto it over Wi-Fi
- The stream is sized to what the tablet's decoder handles (e.g. 1808×1130 on a Lenovo Idea Tab)
- Hardware H.264 encoding chosen at runtime (Intel/AMD VA-API, NVIDIA NVENC, or software)
- Automatic reconnect; GNOME's permission is remembered

### Known issues
- **Touch, pen, mouse and keyboard on the tablet do not reach the laptop** (#1): GNOME's portal rejects input positions on virtual monitors. A fix through libei is planned.
- Frame rate drops to about 12–16 fps when content moves (#3)
- Text is small: the monitor starts at scale 1 (#4)

### Install
- **Tablet** (Android 11+): download `tabextend-v0.1.0-alpha.1.apk` and open it.
- **Laptop** (GNOME on Wayland, x86-64): download the `linux-x86_64` archive (attached a few minutes after publishing), install GStreamer and your GPU's video driver, run `./tabextend doctor`, then `./tabextend pair`.

Full steps: [Install a release](https://github.com/St3inberg/TabExtend/blob/main/docs/setup.md#install-a-release-no-building). In GNOME's sharing dialog, turn on **Allow remote interaction**.

release.name: Rowd v0.8.2-alpha — Event-driven Android idle
release.notes:
Rowd v0.8.2-alpha improves Android idle behavior and SAF diagnostics without changing sync protocol V12, pairing, Shares, or StateStore.

- Android waits on TCP plus a Unix socketpair instead of polling every second. Local changes, remote WakeShare, network changes, cancel, and service stop wake the existing worker. The remaining idle deadline is the periodic audit; an incomplete application frame retains its 90-second liveness deadline.
- Safe EINTR retries check cancellation between attempts. Partially progressed frames/writes are never replayed.
- Generic SAF callbacks are coalesced in a fixed 100 ms window while preserving all relevant Shares. Metadata discovery reports directory/entry counts, changes, completed hashes, duration, and strategy.
- Recursive metadata diff remains the safe strategy: directory metadata cannot prove that descendants are unchanged. Full/deep fallbacks and periodic audits remain enabled.
- Diagnostic summaries estimate Android-minus-PC clock offset from unambiguous two-way protocol trace exchanges. Insufficient evidence returns null; latency uncertainty is reported.
- scripts/build-desktop.sh builds the current Linux release and keeps ~/.local/bin/rowd linked to it. ROWD_BIN_DIR overrides the installation directory.

Assets: Linux x86_64 executable, normal Android ARM64 APK, diagnostic ARM64 APK, and SHA256SUMS. The APK variants have the same application ID and are alternatives to each other. Android versionCode is 15; APKs use the existing debug signing configuration.

Validation: 124 Rust workspace tests passed (3 existing benchmarks ignored), 18 JVM tests, 9 Python tests, native socketpair/TLS wake tests, and release builds. No Android device/emulator was available: real SAF providers, suspend/resume, APK source locations, and a 10-minute idle trace remain device validation. scripts/validate-android-idle.sh reproduces that scenario.

﻿## TGTV v1.0

First full release of the Netflix-style Telegram library for Android TV.

### UI overhaul
- Netflix red/black theme throughout: black windows, charcoal cards and tiles, red accents and focus states
- **Tall 2:3 poster cards** on the home grid, backed by the official TMDB poster (backdrop and Telegram thumbnail as fallbacks)
- Bold red TGTV wordmark on the home screen
- Details screen: stronger backdrop scrims so hero text is always readable, IMDb-style graded rating ring (80+ dark green, 70 light green, 60 yellow, 50 orange, below red), charcoal Play / Watchlist / Download buttons
- Flat charcoal login buttons that light up red on focus

### Library & metadata
- TMDB metadata built in with a bring-your-own-key option (Settings -> TMDB metadata)
- Resolver improvements for release-style names: byte-boundary `HDRip` tokens, unbalanced `(trailing
  paren groups, colon stripping, trailing-junk retries for truncated forwarded file names
- Web-assisted title resolution (Wikipedia / DuckDuckGo -> canonical title -> TMDB) for transliterated titles

### Playback & storage
- Subtitles: embedded toggle, language priority list, OpenSubtitles fallback (BYO free API key)
- Storage-aware playback: preflight warning for oversized videos and pause-before-disk-full watchdog
- 2 MiB sync streaming windows and a 15 s cache monitor for diagnosing stutter
- Two login modes: bot token (live pickup) or phone/QR for the full chat history

release.name: Meshora v1.1.3
release.notes:
**还在早期**：没有经过安全审查，还没在两台真的电脑之间拿真的游戏联机试过。

## 这一版改了什么

版本号与 [Glassium](https://github.com/Kerxs/glassium) 同步：这一版用 Glassium 1.1.3。

**手机和电脑一样的液态玻璃**
- 手机上的卡片、按钮、头像、网状图的节点、延迟胶囊都换成电脑上那样不模糊的液态玻璃：后面的点阵透过来，边上被拉弯、分出红绿蓝（Glassium 1.1.3 的 SVG 位移滤镜）。以后电脑和手机的内容保持一致，只有 Windows 独有的功能不同
- 弹窗里的玻璃也有了真的折射

**流畅度和 bug**
- 手机上网络页不再一直被拖慢：连线上跑的光点以前每帧重绘整张图，带着下面的玻璃一起重新合成
- 去掉手机上大面积的磨砂，底部导航的透镜画布降到 2 倍像素（为了底部导航连点卡住的问题；真机上还请帮忙试一下）
- 切回网络页时，节点不再在错的位置待一秒（手机上也不再能横向滚动）
- 电脑上点开弹窗时，按钮不再闪一下底色
- 网络图里的线在节点、延迟胶囊、中继方块的边上断开，不再穿过透明的玻璃

## 玩家：Windows 桌面客户端

`Meshora-*-setup.exe`：装到 `Program Files`，运行时需要管理员权限（要建虚拟网卡）。
装过旧版本的直接运行它就是升级，网络、名字、私钥都留着。卸载在"设置 → 应用"里。

- **安装程序没有代码签名**，SmartScreen 会提示"未知发布者"
- 要有 Microsoft Edge WebView2 运行时（Windows 11 自带；没有时安装程序会给出下载地址）
- 没有免安装版，理由见[威胁模型](https://kerxs.github.io/meshora/guide/threat-model)

用法见[桌面客户端](https://kerxs.github.io/meshora/guide/desktop)。

## 玩家：安卓客户端

`Meshora-*-android.apk`：和桌面端同一个界面，靠系统的 VPN 功能组网（只接管网里的地址，上网不受影响）。
第一次连接时系统会问"是否允许 Meshora 设置 VPN 连接"；安卓 17 还会问"是否允许访问局域网"，都点允许。

## 自动更新

客户端每次打开都查一次 `latest.json`（设置里可以关）；查到新版本会弹窗问要不要更新。新版本的安装包有 Ed25519 签名，核对过才装：
Windows 上点一下就装好、自动重新打开；安卓上交给浏览器下载，系统安装器会核对 APK 的签名。

## 核对

下载后核对 SHA-256，和 `SHA256SUMS.txt` 里的对得上再用：

```powershell
Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 .\Meshora-*-setup.exe
```

repo.description: Fast Rust Android automation for AI agents: CLI + MCP, compact screen reads, action batches and paired Wi-Fi accessibility control (preview).

release.name: android-use 0.2.0
release.notes:
android-use 0.2.0 adds saved flows: record a sequence of phone steps once, save it, and replay it with one command (`android-use flow draft|run|list|info|validate|update|report|publish`, plus matching MCP tools).

Flow runs are built for debugging on a real USB phone. Each run writes timestamped step events (events.jsonl) that line up with `--record` screen recordings and `--logcat`. Failures name the step and the reason, save the screen elements and a screenshot, and give a resume hint (`--from N`). `--dry-run` and `flow validate` check a flow without a device.

Before the first step, and after any failed step, the phone is checked: not attached, unauthorized, offline, screen off, locked, daemon not running or outdated, runner not running. Each case has its own error code and next action. A USB disconnect mid-run ends the run without replaying anything. `device_busy` names the owner holding the device and how to release it. Saved failure element trees are redacted.

Known limits: flow recording, `--record` and `--logcat` have been tested with a mocked device but not yet on a physical phone; lock-screen detection may vary by vendor. Publishing flows is local only.

release.name: HomeBar 1.7.1
release.notes:
An iOS-style home indicator for Android, drawn as a single accessibility overlay.

It does **not** replace the navigation bar, does **not** intercept gestures, and does **not** alter system animations. Back gestures, swipe-to-home and predictive back keep running exactly as the system ships them.

## Features

- Width, thickness, corner radius, position, opacity and glow are all adjustable
- Adaptive black/white colour, sampled from the screen with WCAG relative luminance
- Immersive auto-hide, hide on home & recents, hide on notification shade, hide on lock screen
- Tap the bar and it springs back
- Nine easing curves with a live plot in the settings screen
- Live preview with light/dark background toggle
- Emergency pause from the persistent notification

## Install

1. Download `HomeBar-1.7.1-debug.apk` below
2. Allow installation from unknown sources when prompted
3. Open **HomeBar**, tap the enable button and turn on the accessibility service
4. The bar appears near the bottom of the screen

`minSdk 30` (Android 11) · `targetSdk 36` (Android 16) · debug-signed

## Notes

- The system gesture bar is still there. To see only this one, disable it in *Settings → System → Gestures*.
- Bounce reacts to taps on the bar itself. Cross-app touch coordinates are not readable on Android (`ZERO_COORDS`), so a bottom-only trigger is not implementable — see the README for the details.
- 1.7.1 fixes a bug where the bar could stay hidden forever after unlocking.

release.name: Silence 0.5.2 (Spotify mute-only)
release.notes:
Silence 0.5.2 (versionCode 10): reworked Spotify ad handling. It only mutes, and only locally on your phone.

**What changed**
- **Mute only.** Silence never skips ads, never modifies Spotify and never interferes with Spotify's network traffic. It mutes your phone's media volume while Spotify reports an ad and restores it when music resumes.
- **Stricter detection.** It uses Spotify's own ad markers (`spotify:ad:` media IDs, the Android advertisement flag), exact "Advertisement" or "Spotify Ad" titles, and a cautious check for a short ad that can't be skipped. Songs like "Ad Astra" or "A.D." no longer cause false mutes.
- **Sound always comes back.** It unmutes when music resumes, when you pause or stop, when Spotify closes, or after 35 seconds at most. If Silence crashed while muted, it unmutes the next time it starts.
- **"Wrong mute? Unmute now"** is available on Home, in Settings and in the "Spotify ad muted" notification.
- **New "Spotify ads muted" counter** (today and total) on Home and in Settings.
- The notification-based detection could mute without ever unmuting. That's fixed.

**Setup:** Settings > Spotify ads > turn on "Mute Spotify ads". This excludes Spotify from the VPN automatically. Then grant Notification access, restart protection, and in Spotify turn on Settings > "Device Broadcast Status" for best results.

For a fully ad-free Spotify that also supports artists, consider Spotify Premium.

**Install / update:** signed with the same key as 0.5.0 and 0.5.1, so it installs as an update. If Play Protect blocks it, go to Play Store > profile > Play Protect > settings, pause "Scan apps with Play Protect" while you install, then turn it back on. Or use `adb install -r Silence-0.5.2.apk`.

Ad detection depends on what Spotify exposes and is best effort. This version hasn't been tested on a device yet.

# 🚀 Godot GPS Android Plugin v1.0.0

We are pleased to announce the first stable release of the **Godot GPS Android Plugin**! This plugin provides native and performant access to GPS location services for **Godot 4.2+**, optimized for **Android 14 (API 34)**.

The plugin utilizes modern Google Play Services `FusedLocationProviderClient` APIs to ensure an optimal balance between location accuracy and battery consumption.

## ✨ Key Features
- **Android 14 Support**: Full support for API Level 34 requirements.
- **High Accuracy**: Integration with `FusedLocationProviderClient` to obtain precise coordinates.
- **Permission Management**: Automatic management of runtime permission requests (`ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION`, `ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION`).
- **Instant Feedback**: Function to immediately retrieve the last known location on startup.
- **Lifecycle Optimization**: Intelligent management of GPS updates (stops on pause, resumes on return to app) to save battery.

## 🛠 Available Methods
- `start_location_updates()`: Requests permissions and starts real-time GPS tracking (1-second interval).
- `stop_location_updates()`: Stops receiving updates.
- `get_last_location()`: Forces immediate emission of the last known location saved on the device.

## 📡 Signals
- `location_updated(latitude: float, longitude: float, accuracy: float)`: Emitted whenever a new position is acquired.

   - **Target SDK** is set to `34`.
   - `Access Fine Location` and `Access Coarse Location` permissions are enabled.

release.name: TUB_GD v1.1.1 正式版发布：全新 AI 驱动工作流
release.notes:
## TUB_GD v1.1.1 版本更新说明

本次更新重构了底层提示词引擎，聚焦 Godot 4.x 生态，带来更极速的 AI 辅助开发体验。
*(注：本次 Release 未提供独立的 ZIP 源码包，因为 Git 源码库已完全同步，您可直接拉取仓库最新代码)*

### 🚀 新增：三档 AI 提示词工作流
设置页全新支持三种模式，精准匹配不同开发场景：
*   **纯净模式**：不注入任何提示词，仅输出源码。
*   **通用模式**：注入基础约束，适合常规代码问答。
*   **TUB 同款模式（开发者自用推荐）**：专为项目级重构设计。启用后，AI 将直接生成**纯 Python 自动化脚本**。只需放入项目根目录一键运行，即可批量完成文件的新建、覆盖与删除，彻底告别手动复制粘贴。

### 🛑 架构调整：全面精简至 Godot 4.x
彻底移除所有 Godot 3.x 的兼容逻辑。去除历史包袱后，AI 上下文更加纯净，彻底杜绝旧版 API 干扰，大幅提高生成代码的准确率。

### 🎯 核心升级：4.x 全版本动态感知与防错
系统自动读取 `project.godot` 精准识别具体小版本，并向 AI 动态注入对应的底层红线：
*   **4.4+**：强令禁止 AI 手写或篡改 `.uid` 文件。
*   **4.6+**：拦截 `unique_id` 修改，并提醒 Jolt Physics 物理引擎变更。
*   **4.7+**：注入最高级别防错（`StringName` 类型约束、`RichTextLabel.add_image` 新参数、`PackedArray` 赋值陷阱等）。

### 🛡️ 智能兜底：未知版本拦截
遇到未配置的新项目（无法读取版本），系统会弹窗提示并引导 AI 自行读取配置文件，彻底杜绝 AI 瞎猜 API。

👉 **下载最新 APK 覆盖安装。** 首次启动需授予“所有文件访问权限”。建议前往设置体验「TUB 同款」模式，感受极速自动化开发。

repo.description: Serendip — BLE mesh chat with end-to-end encryption, Nostr presence, and geohash neighbourhood maps

release.name: Serendip v1.0.0
release.notes:
## Serendip v1.0.0

First public release.

### Features
- **Bluetooth LE mesh chat** — messages hop peer-to-peer, no internet required
- **End-to-end encrypted DMs** — X25519 + AES-256-GCM, Noise protocol sessions
- **Channel-based group chat** — password protection, ownership transfer, message retention
- **Nearby Map** — live BLE peer locations with coverage circles
- **Neighbourhood Activity Map** — geohash grid with Nostr participant counts
- **Nostr presence** — broadcasts ~1km geohash only, never exact GPS
- **Location sharing over mesh** — location hops through relay to extend range
- **Store & forward** — messages cached for offline peers
- **Emergency wipe** — triple-tap to clear all data
- **IRC-style commands** — /j, /m, /w, /channels, /block, /pass, /transfer, /save

### Requirements
- Android 8.0+ (API 26)
- Bluetooth LE

### Install
Download the APK below, enable "Install from unknown sources" if prompted, and open it.

release.notes:
BP Digitizer is a local-first Android app for recording blood pressure, reviewing
trends, exporting backups, and reading an upright monitor display with bundled
on-device OCR. No account, cloud service, or model download is required. Always
review detected values before saving.

## Install

1. Use an **ARM64 phone running Android 8.0 or later**. This APK does not support
   32-bit ARM or x86 devices.
2. Download `BP-Digitizer-1.6.3-arm64.apk` from the assets below.
3. Open it on the phone and allow installation from the browser or file manager
   when Android asks. The source-code archives are not installable apps.

For updates, keep using the same distribution channel and signing certificate.
Play, F-Droid, debug, and self-built packages may use different keys and cannot
necessarily update one another. Export a JSON backup before changing channels;
uninstalling deletes local readings and the profile. Automatic Android backup
and phone-to-phone app-data transfer are disabled.

## What's in 1.6.3

- Build and packaging cleanup for F-Droid, including removal of AGP's encrypted
  dependency metadata and automatic JDK downloads.
- Store metadata in all 12 app languages and clearer model provenance.
- The same offline OCR models, app behavior, and database schema as 1.6.2.

This is the first GitHub release with an installable APK. It is built from the
existing [v1.6.3 source tag](https://github.com/zandaulion/BloodPressureMonitor/tree/v1.6.3)
at commit `8dee5237a37324d1ea719b9fb79954c0731d28af`.
See the [full release history](https://github.com/zandaulion/BloodPressureMonitor/blob/main/docs/Release_Notes.md)
for earlier changes.

- Clientes e catálogo próprio de materiais e serviços.
- Orçamentos com quantidades fracionárias, mão de obra, desconto e PDF paginado.

release.name: Pondok v0.2.0 — self-explaining failures + DIRECT fallback
release.notes:
## Apa yang berubah

Menjawab laporan bug pertama di HP: tombol Start selalu berakhir **"Kehilangan Proses (crash)"** tanpa log apa pun (D-17).

### Perbaikan
- **Pesan kematian tak lagi tertelan**: stdout+stderr didrain sebelum exit diklasifikasi; kode exit didekode (sinyal vs exit biasa); output proses terakhir tampil di layar.
- **Fallback DIRECT otomatis**: jika stack proot gagal di perangkatmu, aplikasi otomatis mencoba mode DIRECT (box64 via loader rootfs, tanpa ptrace) dan menyimpan mode yang berhasil. Mode ini diverifikasi CI di hardware arm64 nyata — boot 8 detik (restart 3,5 detik), jalur join pemain dijawab, stop bersih, world persisten.
- **Tangga diagnostik on-device** (tombol "Diagnostik"): sh → proot → rootfs → box64 → direct, lapis per lapis, dengan catatan per-kegagalan.
- **Log persisten** di `logs/pondok.log` (rotasi) + **tombol salin laporan bug** di kartu kegagalan (info perangkat: ABI, Android, SELinux, ukuran halaman ikut).
- Kegagalan spawn kini membawa alasan (mis. izin eksekusi ditolak → indikasi SELinux/OEM).

### Angka
- pondok_core: **154 unit test** hijau (sebelumnya 119) + 6/6 integrasi BDS nyata.
- App: 3/3 widget test hijau (termasuk jalur kegagalan end-to-end).
- CI: mode stack baru `direct-ld` kini gating di runner arm64 ASLI.

### Status jujur
Penyebab kegagalan di HP pemilik **belum teridentifikasi** dari build lama — bug observabilitasnya justru menyembunyikannya. Build ini: kalau server jalan via DIRECT → selesai; kalau tidak → layar menunjukkan lapisan mana yang mati + buktinya. Bila masih gagal, tekan tombol salin di kartu "Mengapa gagal?" dan kirim laporannya.

release.notes:
Getting on track now starts from what's really in your accounts.

- **Your balance is the truth.** Where you stand used to take this half's food money and Personal Expenses off again on top of your balance, as if that money were still waiting to be spent. Someone with $0 in the bank could be told they were hundreds short today. Now what's in your accounts pays the bills due before your next money comes in first, then food, then Personal Expenses, and anything the balance can't cover is counted as already spent.
- **"Food so far" is now a quick check.** Instead of guessing what you've spent, LoonieMate works out what's left: "After the bills due before Nov 27, about $75 is left for food until Nov 30. Sound right?" Tap **Yes, that's right** or **Change it**. The difference is logged once as "Spent before LoonieMate", so Month and Spending match what really happened.
- **A payday due today?** The balances step asks whether it's already in your balances. If it isn't yet (deposits often land later in the day), it's counted as coming in today.
- A $0 or low balance gets a kind word instead of an alarm: it just means what came in has gone on bills and spending, and LoonieMate starts from there.
- The steps are now: balances, this month so far, anything you're behind on, Personal Expenses, what's left for food, where you stand.
- **Web version:** the same maths.

release.notes:
## Для часов, на которых запускаются только 32-битные APK

Скачайте **NOVA-VPN-WearOS-0.3.2-armv7-debug.apk** — [прямая ссылка на 32-битный APK](https://github.com/leoraijin/NOVA-VPN-WearOS/releases/download/v0.3.2/NOVA-VPN-WearOS-0.3.2-armv7-debug.apk). Для часов владельца этого проекта, где ARM64 не запускается, нужен именно этот файл.

Это версия 0.3.2 с исправлениями кнопок. ARM64 — другая архитектура, а не более стабильная версия. Сборка остаётся экспериментальной: полноценная работа VPN на физических часах пока не подтверждена.

## Что исправлено

Верхняя кнопка: проверяет профиль до запроса VPN, перехватывает ошибки системного окна разрешения/запуска/остановки и показывает подсказку рядом с кнопкой. Нижняя: отправляет команду одному телефону, ждёт ответ приложения и сообщает о таймауте через 12 секунд вместо молчания; требуется Android 0.2.20 для подтверждений. Старые/чужие ответы игнорируются. Профиль передаётся только вручную из списка серверов телефона, туннели остаются независимыми. 20 unit-тестов прошли; ARM APK собраны, подпись проверена и совпадает с телефоном. Журнал пользовательского вылета не получен, точная причина и реальные Watch Ultra / One UI 8 для этой версии пока не проверены. Исправлены выявленные небезопасные обработчики, а не заявлена гарантированная совместимость аппаратного VPN. Экспериментальная debug-сборка; GPL-3.0-only. Обновления в Releases этого отдельного репозитория.
