release.name: WearBridge v1.32
release.notes:
## WearBridge v1.32 / Wear 1.17

Русский:
- Phone 1.32: Termux API token копируется в Settings; `scripts/wadb configure` сохраняет его в Termux без root на телефоне и без Termux:API plugin.
- Добавлен AI skill `.agents/skills/wearbridge-termux-api/SKILL.md`; общий Codex Termux API skill также обновлён.
- README на русском и английском, GitHub Actions, GPL-3.0 для кода WearBridge и список сторонних источников/лицензий.
- Удалены ненужные инструменты и скрипты декомпиляции jadx/apktool.
- Важно: защиты от ошибочных команд практически нет. SHELL/ROOT исполняют команды напрямую на часах; ROOT не использует песочницу и анализ опасных команд.

English:
- Phone 1.32 copies the Termux API token from Settings; `scripts/wadb configure` saves it in Termux without phone root or the Termux:API plugin.
- Added the AI-agent skill at `.agents/skills/wearbridge-termux-api/SKILL.md` and updated the shared Codex Termux API skill.
- Bilingual README, GitHub Actions, GPL-3.0 for WearBridge code, and third-party attribution/license notes.
- Removed the unused jadx/apktool decompilation scripts and local tools.
- Safety warning: there is almost no protection against operator mistakes. SHELL/ROOT commands run directly on the watch; ROOT has no command sandbox or dangerous-command analysis.

Assets are signed with the project's existing signing certificate. Phone updates install over earlier WearBridge builds signed with the same key. The Wear APK remains v1.17. CI builds both debug APKs as workflow artifacts.

release.notes:
# DigiWear v2.4.7 Release Notes

### Wear OS Smartwatch Startup & Auto-Launch Fixes
- **Resolved App Launch Failure on Samsung Galaxy Watch / Wear OS**:
  - Removed `android:taskAffinity=""` from `wear-os-app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml` to allow the Wear OS and Samsung One UI Watch system app drawers to properly transition to and display `MainActivity`.
  - Added ProGuard / R8 keep rules (`-keep class com.digiwear.wear.** { *; }` and `-keep class androidx.wear.** { *; }`) to ensure sensor managers, DataLayer clients, sound engines, and ambient lifecycle callbacks are preserved in release builds.
  - Safe-guarded `StepTrackerManager` and `NfcDuelManager` against unhandled `SecurityException` during startup (`onResume` / `onEnterAmbient` / `onExitAmbient`) when runtime activity recognition or body sensor permissions have not yet been granted.
- **Enhanced Sideload Auto-Wake & Explicit Launch**:
  - Automatically wakes the smartwatch display via `input keyevent 224` (`KEYCODE_WAKEUP`) prior to launching the newly installed APK to overcome background launch throttling when the watch screen is asleep.
  - Fires an explicit intent launch with `--user 0 -f 0x10000000` (`FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK`) directly targeting `com.digiwear.wear/.MainActivity`.
- **Dynamic APK Cache Invalidation**:
  - The companion app invalidates local cache and downloads the latest release APK upon version bump so that upgrades always sideload the freshest build.

release.name: Orbit Voice 0.1.0-alpha.3
release.notes:
# Orbit Voice 0.1.0-alpha.3

Third alpha. The watch now keeps working while the phone app is closed, a watch-face
shortcut joins the tile, and speech recognition no longer loses a quietly spoken phrase.

## Included

- **Resident phone companion.** The watch request service is started once from the phone app
  (or after an app update), stays in the foreground and is re-armed after a reboot, so a watch
  turn never has to start a service from the background. Android 12 and later forbid that
  background start, which is why earlier builds asked the user to open the phone app first.
  An ongoing low-priority notification shows that the phone is ready. The service type is
  `connectedDevice`, which has no daily runtime cap.
- **Watch-face shortcut.** A complication provider so Orbit Voice can sit on the watch face:
  one tap opens the conversation screen already listening. The Tile in the tiles carousel
  behaves the same way. Wear has no API for an app to add its own tile or complication, so
  both are placed by the user.
- **Recognition fixes.** A quietly spoken phrase could be dropped before it ever reached the
  phone: the capture gate needed several consecutive frames above its threshold, and frames
  before the gate opened were discarded, which was exactly where the speech was. The pre-roll
  now keeps three seconds, the gate accumulates instead of resetting, and only the silence
  before the phrase is trimmed. Verified on a Pixel Watch 3: `decode samples=42880 ms=4080`,
  `lang=ru`, "Проверка связи." and a spoken Russian answer.
- **Faster answers.** The speech engine's voice is switched and warmed as soon as the
  recognized language is known: the first spoken sentence starts about 2.6 s after the answer
  text instead of 5.2 s.

release.name: SweetSpot 7.2
release.notes:
### What's new

A small reliability release about tomorrow's prices.

The day-ahead auction sets tomorrow's prices shortly before 13:00 CET, but the data sources do not
all publish them at the same moment: on some days the main source is hours late for a country while
another source already has them. SweetSpot waited for the main source, so on those days you could
still see only today's prices in the evening.

- **Tomorrow's prices from whichever source has them** — from 14:00 CET, if the main data source
  still has only today's prices, SweetSpot tries the other sources for your country in order and
  uses the first one that has tomorrow's. If none has them yet, you keep the main source's prices,
  and SweetSpot looks again on your next search a few minutes later. Once it has switched, it keeps
  that source's prices until about midday the next day, even if the main source publishes in the
  meantime.
- **Where it helps** — wherever a country has another source with its own data, such as EnergyZero
  in the Netherlands. Where every source depends on the same upstream data, there is nothing to
  switch to until it is published. The other source may publish hourly rather than quarter-hourly
  prices; the results screen always names the source it used.

Nothing changed in how prices are calculated or displayed — the cheapest time you are shown is
worked out exactly as before.

Thanks for using SweetSpot!

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/jmerhar/sweetspot-android/compare/v7.1...v7.2

## MCP web search

- Explicit commands such as `найди в интернете ...`, `поищи в сети ...`, or `web search ...` retrieve up to three sources through Exa MCP on the phone.
- The existing local model summarizes bounded excerpts. Actual source URLs are appended by the app. Ordinary prompts stay local.
- Searches work through the existing phone API and watch Bluetooth transport. Internet is required on the phone. The watch displays source links but does not read the URL footer aloud.
- A phone switch disables internet search. Network failures and provider limits produce explicit errors, not fabricated search answers. Exa receives the search query and generic retrieval options, not chat history.
- Model settings, lazy loading, two-minute idle unloading, weather, timers, and Bluetooth transport are unchanged.

## Build and validation

Commit: `17bb03210a11b42ade212ba7e56b38319f42dc7c`.

Both debug APKs are built by GitHub Actions, then re-signed locally with the existing app certificate so they can update matching installations without removing model data. The private signing key has not been uploaded to GitHub. CI artifacts alone use a temporary runner certificate until a stable signing secret is configured.

Local validation and GitHub Actions passed all 70 JVM tests, both APK builds, and lint. The actual Java MCP client also completed a live Exa search on the development computer. Device installation, speech input, and local-model search summarization have not been tested on physical devices for this build: no ADB devices were connected.

Phone APK: arm64-v8a. Watch APK: Wear OS companion. Model weights are not included. These are development/debug builds, not production releases. Summaries can contain model errors; verify the linked sources.

release.notes:
# Що нового у версії 1.3.0

Цей випуск містить важливі архітектурні оновлення, спрямовані на підвищення надійності відображення статусів у реальному часі, безшовну синхронізацію між смартфоном і годинниками Wear OS, а також гарантію актуальності даних на циферблатах.

## 3-позиційне відображення статусів та усунення застарілих даних
* **Чітка 3-позиційна модель (ВІДБІЙ / ТРИВОГА / ОЧІКУВАННЯ):** Повністю усунено ризик синтезування хибного стану «Відбій» за відсутності або застарілості даних. Як смартфон, так і годинник тепер чітко розрізняють підтверджений стан відбою, активну тривогу та невизначений/офлайн стан «Очікування даних…».
* **Безпечні базові мітки часу:** У доменній моделі `AlertStatus` значення `updatedAt` за замовчуванням змінено на `0L`. Завдяки цьому порожні чи неініціалізовані записи гарантовано вважаються застарілими і більше не інтерпретуються як актуальний відбій.
* **Коректне завершення служби моніторингу:** Під час зупинки фонової служби активні тривоги негайно скидаються, а на Wear OS надсилається фінальне повідомлення про завершення моніторингу.

## Автономна синхронізація Wear OS та надійність ускладнень
* **Темпоральне обмеження ускладнень:** Ускладнення циферблатів Wear OS тепер мають жорстко визначений інтервал валідності (15 хвилин). Система циферблата автоматично приховує застарілі дані у разі втрати зв'язку зі смартфоном.
* **Автономний фоновий слухач на смартфоні:** Додано системну службу `WearableListenerService`, яка реагує на запити ручної синхронізації з годинника (`/request_sync`), навіть коли інтерфейс додатка закрито, а служба моніторингу зупинена.
* **Синхронізація активності моніторингу:** У `WatchSyncData` додано прапорець `monitoringActive`. Якщо моніторинг на смартфоні вимкнено, ускладнення на годиннику одразу переходять у режим офлайн (`—` / `⚠️` / «Немає зв'язку»), запобігаючи нескінченному показу застарілої інформації.
* **Автоматичне очищення відсутніх профілів:** Wear OS автоматично видаляє налаштування ус

release.name: WhaleChat 2.0 —— 从「问答工具」到「问答 + 聊天」
release.notes:
## 下载

| 文件 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `WhaleChat-2.0-release.apk` | **装这个。** 干净包，无预置凭证 |
| —— | 仓库里没有 debug 包。**别装任何 `-debug.apk`**，那里面带着预置凭证，只供自测 |

- 体积 4,047,772 字节 / sha256 `6f7a5a54cb9cb50ba60c0f34ca45654bcac30b4e8e0ca5877dd1afc6400cc389`
- 包名 `com.naoh.whalechat`，`versionName 2.0` / `versionCode 2000`，minSdk 30

---

## 一句话

1.0 只有一个「问一句答一句」的 Ask。2.0 把它变成了两件事：**问 DeepSeek**，和**跟一个角色聊天**。

---

## 最大的变化：Chat 模式

首页往左滑进通讯录，选一个人开聊。这里不是「换个提问方式」，是**换一个说话的对象**。

跟 Ask 本质不同的地方：

- **提示词不是全局那套。** 角色会话的提示词 = 人设六块 + 一段运行时硬编码的输出规矩，每次发送时现拼。设置里的「系统提示词」对 Chat 完全无效 —— 两套 prompt 分家、互不覆盖。
- **对话里有「人」。** 每个角色有自己的名字、性格、说话方式。删角色只能一张卡一张卡地删，没有 Ask 那种「一次清空所有对话」。

**人设六块**

| 块 | 是什么 |
|---|---|
| 人格内核 | 性格、价值观、动机、遇到事情怎么反应 |
| 说话风格 | 语气、用词、口头禅、句子长短 |
| 行为规则 | 能做什么、不能做什么、边界在哪 |
| 场景 | 此刻在哪、你们什么关系、为什么聊起来 |
| 示例对话 | 2–4 轮「你：… / TA：…」，性价比最高的一块 |
| 开场白 | 进会话那一刻 TA 说的第一句话 |

前五块拼进提示词；开场白作为第一条消息上架。

**造角色三条路**：一句话让模型现编 / 从内置预设挑一个改 / 手机扫码在网页上逐块填。

**几个保底设计，让角色聊天不掉链子：**

- **输出规矩硬编码**：每次只说一到三句、不列点不铺陈、不说自己是 AI/程序、不拿「好的我来帮你」凑数。模型默认爱写长、爱出戏，这段把它拽回来。
- **开场白零延迟**：创建时存好的固定值，进会话当场写进第一条消息，不等联网、不会失败。
- **没聊过的角色不消失**：角色的存亡只由通讯录决定。

---

## 其他新增

- **内置角色「大肥鱼」**：装完就在通讯录里，不用联网生成、不花钱、人人一致。它是 DeepSeek 的拟人化二创角色「蓝色大肥鱼」—— 蓝发蓝瞳、有鲸鱼耳鳍和鲸尾的少女女仆，穿蓝白女仆装；傲娇、慵懒、爱白米饭，最爱把「我消耗了那么多 Token」当功劳，一被追问成果就心虚摸鱼，口头禅「哦鲸鲸」（偶发，不是每句都挂），称呼你为「鱼片」。**删掉能加回来**：创建人设页的预设第一项就是它。
- **联网搜索**：走 DeepSeek 官方 `POST /v1/tools/search`，同一个 Key，按次计费（5 元 / 1000 次成功请求）。Ask 与 Chat 各一个开关，**默认关**。取 top-5、过 `rerank_score >= 1.5` 质量闸门，`summary` 拼进上下文。**失败静默降级** —— 搜不到就当没开搜索，绝不让对话一起挂。搜索资料只拼进本次请求的临时副本，不写进会话记录。
- **语音识别三档**：系统（设备自带）/ 通用接口（OpenAI 兼容 `/v1/audio/transcriptions`，可指向自建服务）/ 讯飞听写（流式，边说边出字）。对话页的麦克风说完即发，文字输入页的麦克风先出字再改。
- **Token 用量与缓存命中率**：记账一直在跑。通讯录角色卡显示累计用量，对话页底部显示「已用 xx tokens」。缓存命中率照记照存，但界面上不再显示 —— 圆屏那一行放不下，挤成两行比不给看更糟。
- **气泡时间**：你自己发的消息右上角显示 `HH:mm`。只给自己的气泡挂 —— 助手响应很快，挂时间是噪音。
- **扫码页从「只改凭证」扩到「凭证 + 人设」**：人设六块是大段文字，在手机上写比在表上敲现实得多。页面存活从 2 分钟放宽到 10 分钟。
- **关于页**：从设置页末尾三行小字升级成独立二级页，显示真实版本号（读 `BuildConfig`，不写死）。

- **对话页定位**：进入对话页的落点从「列表最底」改成「最后一条回答」—

## Bugfix: WLAN-Banner klebt nicht mehr

Der rote **„Kein WLAN"-Hinweis** auf der Uhr blieb in manchen Fällen stehen, obwohl das WLAN längst wieder verbunden war. Behoben:

- **WLAN wird jetzt über alle Netzwerke erkannt** (nicht nur das Default-Netz). Auf Wear OS ist das Default-Netz oft der Bluetooth-Proxy (Internet übers Phone), obwohl WLAN verbunden ist — das führte zur falschen Anzeige.
- **Status wird zusätzlich periodisch frisch gelesen** (alle 3 s, solange die App sichtbar ist, und sofort beim Aufwecken). Damit kann ein vom System verschluckter Netzwerk-Callback den Banner nicht mehr „hängen" lassen — er verschwindet nach einem Reconnect binnen ~3 s von selbst.

Reiner ConnectivityManager-Lookup, **kein** zusätzlicher Funk-/Akku-Aufwand.

|---|---|
| `HOMI-mobile-v2.3.6.apk` | Android-Smartphone (Begleiter-App) — unverändert zu v2.3.5, nur Versions-Bump |

release.name: Voxara 0.9.2
release.notes:
## Voxara 0.9.2: first public release

A hearing-protection dosimeter for Wear OS, with an Android phone companion.
It measures the sound around you in dBA, tracks your daily and weekly noise dose (NIOSH / WHO),
estimates how loud your headphones are, and warns you **before** you reach the limit.

### Downloads

| File | Install on |
|---|---|
| `voxara-wear-0.9.2.apk` | Wear OS watch (Wear OS 3+, Android 11+) |
| `voxara-phone-0.9.2.apk` | Android phone (Android 9+) |

Install **both** so the watch and the phone can sync.

### What's included

**Watch**
- Live sound level with four zones: OK, Moderate, Loud and Dangerous
- Daily and weekly dose with haptic alerts at 50 %, 80 % and 100 %
- Automatic headphones mode, with a volume warning and a **Lower volume** button
- Situation modes: Quiet, Street, Transport, Work and Concert
- Tono, a coach that explains your numbers in plain language
- Guided calibration against a sound level meter
- Tiles, watch-face complications and ambient mode

**Phone**
- Home with today's ring and the last alert
- Day, week and month trends, plus a heat calendar
- Watch link status and setup help
- Settings that sync with the watch, light/dark theme, English and Spanish
- CSV export and a home-screen widget

### Installation

**Phone:** open the APK on the phone and allow "install unknown apps".

**Watch:** turn on ADB debugging on the watch (Settings → Developer options), then run:

    adb connect <watch-ip>:<port>
    adb install voxara-wear-0.9.2.apk

### Known limitations
- **Auto** mode (automatic scene detection) is not included in this release.
- Tono works offline with built-in phrases and does not use cloud AI.
- Until you calibrate it, the microphone reading is an **estimate**.

> ⚠️ Voxara is **not a medical device**.

repo.description: Track leg movements during sleep from a Wear OS watch worn at the ankle. Measures the rhythm of periodic limb movements (PLMS) linked to restless legs syndrome and PLMD. Open source, no account, no network. Not a medical device.

release.name: Pendulum 0.2.0
release.notes:
**Pendulum** estimates periodic limb movements in sleep from a smartwatch worn at the
ankle. It tracks the *rhythm* between movements rather than their number, because the
rhythm is the stable quantity.

> **Not a medical device, not an official health application, and it diagnoses
> nothing.** It has never been validated against polysomnography. No treatment
> decision should be taken on the basis of a number it produces.

### What changed since 0.1.0

The repository is now entirely in English — code, comments, tests and documentation.

Five figures were being published without support, and no longer are. A rate whose
denominator did not exist was stored as zero rather than as nothing. A quality check that had
never been measured was displayed as passed. The periodicity index was shown whatever its own
validity flag said, falling back to zero — an index of zero being a legitimate reading meaning
no periodicity at all, that is, the most reassuring figure the scale can produce. On the watch,
"Storage full" was printed next to the several gigabytes that disproved it. And "quality
acceptable" was asserted above two checks that had just failed.

A recording gap now ends a movement series, as WASM 2016 rule 3.3.3 requires. A three-second
hole between two movements forty seconds apart used to leave the series open and record an
interval measured across a stretch in which nothing could have been observed. This moves the
measured index by up to 15 %.

The full chain was exercised on real hardware for the first time: evening context sealed on the
phone, published, found by the watch, recorded, transferred, acknowledged, and the watch's files
cleaned up afterwards.

### What does not work yet

- **A night with no sleep source stays out of the list.** It is recorded, transferred and
  analysed, but the accelerometer mask alone cannot carry a denominator that is independent of
  the numerator, so the night is held back rather than shown with a figure it cannot support.
  Health

release.name: WatchNav v0.20.39
release.notes:
# WatchNav v0.20.39 — 手机与 Wear OS 离线导航

公开发布整理：2026-10-25。手表 `0.20.39 / code 64`；手机 `0.20.26-companion / code 10049`。

本应用源于中国大陆国行三星 Watch 的独立离线地图需求，需要自行侧载。请把 `phone` APK 安装到手机，把 `watch` APK 安装到 Wear OS 手表。

文档图片更新：地图保留环形路线，其余位置圆点、非环形连线与具体起点名称已改为随机演示数据。本次图片和手册更新不改变 APK 版本或签名。

## 下载与安装

- `WatchNav-watch-v0.20.39.apk`：手表端。
- `WatchNav-phone-v0.20.26-companion.apk`：手机端，Android 11+、arm64。
- `E120_N30-20260816.rd5`：BRouter 路网分片快照。
- `sentinel2-2025-test.mbtiles`：小范围卫星地图样本，EOX / Copernicus，CC BY-NC-SA 4.0。
- `WatchNav-docs-v0.20.39.zip`：离线图文手册、技术架构及重要日志。
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`：下载文件完整性校验。

[图文安装与使用手册](https://github.com/yzgpk2002/watchnav/blob/codex/public-release-0.20.39/docs/USER_MANUAL_ZH.md) · [地图来源与许可](https://github.com/yzgpk2002/watchnav/blob/codex/public-release-0.20.39/docs/MAP_RESOURCES.md) · [完整改进日志](https://github.com/yzgpk2002/watchnav/blob/codex/public-release-0.20.39/CHANGELOG.md)

![手机路线工坊](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yzgpk2002/watchnav/codex/public-release-0.20.39/docs/images/phone-routes.png)

## 本次累计重要改进

- 到达检测独立于路线匹配；未按规划路径抵达也可完成导航。路线接驳固定到 GPX 声明的第一个点，修复错误接入第 92/100 点及到达仍显示 2.2 km 的问题。
- 原始 GPX 与临时接驳分开保存，重开路线按最新位置重算；拼接使用连续距离轴。
- 导航显示实际偏航距离，超过 60 m 红字、声音和振动告警；船位图标缩小，边缘滑动可缩放。
- GPX 航点、Via/Shaping、转向和多种环境/传感器扩展解析及往返保留。
- 山地定位匹配、高程融合、盲区步数推算及坡度 ETA 改进。
- 手机与手表双向资料管理、Wear/LAN 同步、录音回传与手机离线转录。
- 公开工程内置所需 BRouter 源码与许可证，补齐手机和手表的图文侧载手册。

## 使用边界

当前提供保留原签名的 Debug 侧载包。源码和构建版本以本 Release 标签为准。手表与手机同包名但用于不同设备，勿装反。

558 MiB OpenAndroMaps 等高线备份未捆绑公开附件：其来源许可要求随应用捆绑前取得许可，用户应从官网自行下载并导入。路网分片和卫星样本不是全球地图。

接驳到 GPX 起点后会结束第一阶段；在起点再次启动可继续沿 GPX。第三方路网的门禁、通行和海拔数据可能不完整。海图/潮汐/活性估算不替代现场判断。

详细验证记录见仓库 `docs/RELEASE_VALIDATION.md`。历史真机截图不代表本次新增户外回测。
